AI.motivation: TBD范式已成MOT主流，但现有研究引入的相似度度量、数据关联、运动模型等模块常在不同基线跟踪器、超参数和数据集下评估，协议不一致，掩盖了各模块的真实贡献，阻碍客观比较。
AI.method: 系统综述TBD-based MOT技术，涵盖相似度度量、数据关联、相机运动补偿与插值策略，并从一个最小基线跟踪器出发，在多种数据集上公平评估各方法的贡献，累积出均衡的方法组合。
AI.result: 建立了一个强基线跟踪器，并识别出各模块的公平贡献，形成可累积的均衡方法。
AI.conclusion: 为鲁棒且通用的MOT系统的原则性设计提供基础，适用于真实场景部署。

title: Online Signature Verification Using Augmented Path Signature and T-Mamba
comment: International Conference on Document Analysis and Recognition (ICDAR) 2026
summary: Handwritten signature verification is vital for personal authentication across commercial and financial applications. Although deep learning methods are widely adopted for online signature verification (OSV), they often struggle with capturing highly discriminative features and modelling long-range dependencies. To address these issues, we propose a novel framework that integrates the augmented path signature (APS) descriptor with the T-Mamba model. The APS descriptor first applies time and basepoint augmentations, then computes sliding-window path signatures. The path signature is a non-parametric feature map from rough path theory that effectively captures geometric structures and nonlinear inter-channel interactions. Inspired by the efficacy of state space models (SSMs) in sequence modelling, our T-Mamba model employs a hybrid design combining two temporal convolutional network (TCN) blocks with a time-scanning Mamba. This design enables the model to learn both local temporal patterns and global long-range dependencies, substantially improving verification accuracy. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art EERs on three public benchmark datasets (MCYT-100, SVC-2004 Task 2, DeepSignDB), validating its effectiveness and robustness, especially when the training data is limited. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/DLRL04/OSV-using-APS-and-T-Mamba.

AI.tldr: 提出APS描述子与T-Mamba结合的在线签名验证框架，在三个公开数据集上取得SOTA的EER。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习在线签名验证方法难以提取高判别性特征且长程依赖建模不足。
AI.method: APS描述子先做时间与基点增强，再计算滑窗路径签名；T-Mamba模型混合两个TCN块与时序扫描Mamba。
AI.result: 在MCYT-100、SVC-2004 Task 2、DeepSignDB三个公开基准上取得SOTA的EER。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效且鲁棒，尤其在训练数据有限时表现优越。

title: What Eviction Destroys: A Restore-Counterfactual Audit of Forgetting in Agent Memory
summary: Agent memory systems must discard stored information when their history exceeds a fixed token budget. Existing budget-accuracy frontiers quantify the resulting loss in accuracy, but do not distinguish irreversible losses caused by eviction from recoverable retrieval failures. We introduce the restore counterfactual, a per-question paired intervention that reinstates the question's gold evidence in the read-time context and reruns the same reader. Combining the change in correctness with whether the evidence was retained after eviction classifies each oracle-answerable error as recoverable, irreversible, or residual; in the residual case, the answer remains incorrect after restoration. We evaluate FIFO, random, redundancy-aware, and LLM-importance eviction on LongMemEval-S at three budgets and under two retrieval regimes, using GPT-4o-mini as the primary reader and judge and GPT-5.4-mini as a robustness reader. Under top-k retrieval at an 80k-token budget, the irreversible share among errors corrected by restoration is 0.67-0.73 for FIFO, random, and redundancy-aware eviction, compared with 0.60 for LLM-importance. At 8k tokens, it reaches 1.00 for all four policies. Recoverable errors occur under top-k retrieval at 80k tokens but are absent under forced-gold injection by construction, so budget-accuracy results are not directly comparable unless the retrieval regime is reported. An exploratory matched-accuracy analysis detects no difference in irreversible rate among accuracy-matched policy pairs at a resolution of 1.2-6 percentage points. The same analysis detects the deliberately destructive control. To our knowledge, this is the first per-item, per-question restore-counterfactual audit of eviction for external agent-memory stores on a standard conversational benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"恢复反事实"（restore counterfactual）逐题干预方法，用于区分智能体记忆系统中因驱逐导致的不可逆损失与可恢复的检索失败，并据此对四种驱逐策略在不同预算和检索机制下进行分类审计。
AI.motivation: 现有预算-精度前沿只量化记忆驱逐带来的精度损失，却无法区分"因信息被驱逐而不可逆丢失"与"信息仍在但检索失败可恢复"这两类错误的性质差异，导致不同检索机制下的结果缺乏可比性。
AI.method: 提出 restore counterfactual：对每道题进行配对干预，将金标准证据重新注入读取时上下文并重跑同一 reader。结合正确性变化与证据在驱逐后是否保留，将每个 oracle 可答错误分为三类——可恢复（recoverable）、不可逆（irreversible）、残余（residual，恢复后仍错）。在 LongMemEval-S 上评估 FIFO、随机、冗余感知和 LLM 重要性四种驱逐策略，覆盖三个预算和两种检索机制，以 GPT-4o-mini 为主 reader 与 judge，GPT-5.4-mini 作稳健性 reader。
AI.result: 在 top-k 检索、80k token 预算下，被恢复纠正的错误中不可逆比例为：FIFO、随机、冗余感知为 0.67-0.73，LLM 重要性为 0.60；在 8k token 预算下四种策略均达 1.00。可恢复错误仅出现在 top-k 检索的 80k 预算下，在强制金标准注入下按构造不存在，故不同检索机制下的预算-精度结果不可直接比较。匹配精度探索性分析（分辨率 1.2-6 个百分点）未检测到精度匹配策略对之间不可逆率的差异，但能检测到刻意设计的破坏性对照。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个在标准对话基准上，针对外部智能体记忆库驱逐问题开展的逐项、逐题恢复反事实审计。作者强调报告预算-精度结果时必须同时说明检索机制，否则结果不可比。

title: SAM3-O2D2: Zero-Shot Object Out-of-Distribution Detection by Object Class Prompting of the SAM3-Image Model
summary: Object detectors have shown remarkable performance in various fields, among these medical imaging, surveillance, and autonomous driving. However, they are prone to overconfidence when encountering unseen objects in real-world deployments, causing potential safety issues. To address this, detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) objects is essential for reliable object detection. Modern approaches leverage the broad semantic knowledge of foundation models such as CLIP for post-hoc few- and zero-shot OOD detection. However, these methods typically perform OOD assessment in feature space, which can be sensitive to object detector localization errors and variations in object appearance. Moreover, the current state-of-the-art (SOTA) zero-shot method performs computationally costly diffusion in inference. In this work, for our proposed zero-shot object OOD detection method SAM3-O2D2, we employ the SAM3-image foundation model in an efficient manner. Specifically, we prompt SAM3 only with the object detector's predicted classes and compare the predictions of the object detector and SAM3. An object is in-distribution (ID), if SAM3 also detects an object at the corresponding location. If SAM3 does not detect the prompted object, this indicates a mismatch between the detector's prediction and the image content, suggesting that the object is OOD. Experimental results show that our method significantly surpasses the so-far zero-shot SOTA method. Specifically, we achieve new SOTA AuROC and FPR95 metrics over both ID datasets Pascal-VOC and BDD100K and both OOD datasets MS-COCO and OpenImages.

AI.tldr: 提出零样本OOD检测方法SAM3-O2D2，通过用检测器预测类别提示SAM3并对比两者检测结果来判定ID/OOD，无需高成本扩散推理。
AI.motivation: 目标检测器在遇到未见过的对象时易产生过度自信，带来安全隐患，因此需要对分布外（OOD）对象进行检测。现有借助CLIP等基础模型的few/zero-shot方法多在特征空间评估OOD，对检测器定位误差和外观变化敏感，且SOTA零样本方法推理时需计算昂贵的扩散过程。
AI.method: SAM3-O2D2为零样本OOD检测方法，高效利用SAM3图像基础模型：仅用目标检测器预测的类别作为提示（prompt）输入SAM3，并比较检测器与SAM3的预测。若SAM3在对应位置也检测到该对象，则该对象为ID；若SAM3未检测到提示对象，说明检测器预测与图像内容不符，判定为OOD。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法显著超过此前的零样本SOTA，在ID数据集Pascal-VOC和BDD100K、OOD数据集MS-COCO和OpenImages上均取得新的SOTA AuROC与FPR95指标。
AI.conclusion: 通过以检测器类别提示SAM3并比对检测结果，可在无需昂贵扩散推理的情况下实现高效零样本OOD检测，并在多个ID/OOD数据集上刷新SOTA。

title: Dreaming in Flow: Generative Grounding Feedback for Self-Evolving Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Unified multimodal models integrate visual understanding and generation within a single network, yet the two capabilities are commonly optimized as separate tasks. We introduce Generative Grounding Feedback(GGF), a self-evolving post-training framework that uses only text prompts and the model's own visual experience. Given a prompt, the model first generates a visual ``dream.'' Flow-level feedback compares text-, image-, and repair-conditioned predictions at the same noisy latent state, transferring image-grounded generation directions to the prompt condition. Dream replay grounding replays this dream through captioning and re-imagination, training claim-level evidence to remain consistent across the replay while separating unrelated visual experiences. Jointly optimized, these two directions let generation provide visual grounding for understanding and understanding refine subsequent generation without paired image--text supervision. Experiments across unified models with different understanding--generation integration designs show consistent improvements in text-to-image generation together with modest gains in visual understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出 Generative Grounding Feedback (GGF) 自演进后训练框架，仅用文本提示和模型自身视觉经验，将生成与理解能力相互强化，无需成对图文监督。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型虽在同一网络内整合视觉理解与生成，但二者通常作为独立任务分别优化，缺乏相互促进的机制。作者希望在不依赖成对图文监督的前提下，让生成与理解互相提供监督信号。
AI.method: 框架包含两个方向：1) Flow-level feedback，在同一噪声潜状态上比较文本条件、图像条件与修复条件的预测，将图像驱动的生成方向迁移到文本条件；2) Dream replay grounding，将模型生成的"梦"（dream）通过描述与再想象进行重放，训练 claim-level 证据在重放中保持一致，并分离无关视觉经验。二者联合优化，使生成提供视觉 grounding、理解反过来细化后续生成。
AI.result: 在具有不同理解—生成集成设计的多种统一模型上实验，文本到图像生成取得一致性提升，视觉理解也有适度增益。
AI.conclusion: GGF 表明生成与理解可以互为监督、协同自演进，为统一多模态模型提供了一种无需成对图文数据的后训练范式。

title: MARS-CLIP: Multi-Resolution and Attention Refined Zero-Shot Image Segmentation
comment: Accepted to IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP) 2026
summary: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) has demonstrated impressive capabilities in zero-shot transfer but often struggles with dense prediction tasks due to low spatial resolution and the loss of structural information. To address these limitations, we propose MARS-CLIP (Multi-resolution and Attention Refined Segmentation for CLIP), a novel framework for zero-shot semantic segmentation. Our approach introduces two key strategies: (i) a multi-resolution feature extraction module that fuses local fine-grained features with global context to overcome input resolution constraints, and (ii) an attention refinement mechanism that injects spatial and color biases from intermediate layers into the final self-attention block to accurately restore object boundaries. A set of experiments on six public datasets demonstrates that MARS-CLIP significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出MARS-CLIP框架，通过多分辨率特征提取与注意力精炼两个策略，解决CLIP在零样本语义分割中空间分辨率低、结构信息丢失的问题，在六个公开数据集上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: CLIP在零样本迁移上表现出色，但在密集预测任务（如语义分割）中因输入空间分辨率低、结构信息丢失而性能受限。作者希望克服这些限制，实现更好的零样本语义分割。
AI.method: 提出MARS-CLIP（面向CLIP的多分辨率与注意力精炼分割）框架，包含两个核心策略：（i）多分辨率特征提取模块，将局部细粒度特征与全局上下文融合，以突破输入分辨率约束；（ii）注意力精炼机制，将中间层的空间与颜色偏置注入最终自注意力块，以精确恢复目标边界。
AI.result: 在六个公开数据集上的实验表明，MARS-CLIP显著优于当前最先进（state-of-the-art）方法。
AI.conclusion: 多分辨率融合与注意力精炼可有效弥补CLIP在密集预测中的结构信息与分辨率不足，验证了该框架在零样本语义分割任务上的有效性与优越性。

title: Human-Centric Image Captioning with Subject-Centered Spatial Understanding
summary: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve remarkable performance on generic image captioning, they frequently suffer from structural hallucinations in human-centric scenarios. Accurately modeling human subjects is foundational for critical downstream applications, such as accurate avatar/video/image generation and fine-grained human action understanding. However, these tasks require highly precise subject-centered spatial grounding, such as distinguishing egocentric left/right laterality and maintaining correct anatomical-object bindings. Although catastrophic for structural integrity, these localized spatial inversions are often overshadowed by overall descriptive metrics in existing benchmarks. To systematically expose and quantify this bottleneck, we introduce SPACE (Subject-centric Poses, Appearance, and Characteristics Evaluation), a benchmark designed to evaluate subject-centered spatial understanding. On SPACE, we reveal that despite strong generic perception, current MLLMs consistently fail to ground descriptions in the subject's intrinsic frame of reference. To bridge this gap, we propose a specialized data construction and alignment pipeline. We first extract structured spatial hints from fine-grained body-part localization to guide a two-stage caption rewriting process, yielding highly spatially-faithful training data. Furthermore, we design a rubric-based reward for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that explicitly penalizes structurally critical spatial errors during alignment. Extensive experiments on SPACE demonstrate our framework significantly improves human-centric caption quality, particularly in subject-centered spatial reasoning, achieving performance competitive with strong closed-source models. Our benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/JHang2020/SPACE-Eval.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SPACE基准，揭示多模态大模型在主体中心空间理解上的结构性幻觉问题，并通过数据构建与对齐策略显著提升该类描述质量。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在通用图像描述上表现优异，但在人本场景中存在结构性幻觉，难以准确建模人体主体。此类任务需要精确的主体中心空间定位（如自我中心左右侧性、解剖-物体绑定），而现有基准的整体描述指标掩盖了这些局部空间反转问题。
AI.method: 引入SPACE基准系统评估主体中心空间理解；提出专用数据构建与对齐流程：先从细粒度身体部位定位提取结构化空间提示，指导两阶段描述重写生成空间忠实数据；设计基于评分细则的奖励用于GRPO，显式惩罚结构关键的空间错误。
AI.result: 在SPACE上实验表明，当前MLLM虽具备强通用感知，却持续无法以主体内在参考系进行描述；所提框架显著提升人本描述质量，尤其在主体中心空间推理上达到与强闭源模型相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 主体中心空间理解是现有多模态模型的瓶颈，SPACE基准与所提数据构建及对齐方法能有效缓解结构性空间幻觉，基准与代码已开源。

title: Distribution-Consistent Inference for Dynamic Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have emerged as a powerful paradigm for scaling model capacity while preserving efficient inference in large foundation models. However, most MoE models use a fixed top-$k$ expert selection policy, assigning the same expert budget to every token even when fewer experts may be sufficient. Inference-time dynamic top-$k$ routing can reduce computation without retraining, but existing methods often overlook the distributional shift caused by deviating from the training-time routing configuration. We show that reducing the number of activated experts consistently increases the RMS scale and variance of SMoE outputs, inducing a representation mismatch that contributes to downstream performance degradation in addition to the loss of expert capacity. To address this correctable component, we propose Layer-wise Distribution Alignment (LDA), a lightweight inference-time correction that uses layer-wise calibration statistics to align reduced-routing representations with the default configuration. Across multiple SMoE LLMs, benchmarks, and routing strategies, LDA recovers much of the performance lost induced by the distributional shift under reduced routing while preserving sparse-inference efficiency with negligible overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出LDA，一种轻量级推理时校正方法，通过层校准统计对齐减少专家路由后的表示分布，在几乎无开销的情况下恢复性能。
AI.motivation: 多数MoE模型采用固定的top-k专家选择策略，为每个token分配相同的专家预算，即使更少专家可能已足够。推理时动态top-k路由可无需重训降低计算，但现有方法忽视了偏离训练时路由配置所带来的分布偏移。
AI.method: 作者发现减少激活专家数会持续增加SMoE输出的RMS尺度与方差，导致表示不匹配，进而在专家容量损失之外引发下游性能下降。为此提出Layer-wise Distribution Alignment (LDA)，利用层级的校准统计量，将减少路由后的表示与默认配置对齐，作为轻量级推理时校正。
AI.result: 在多个SMoE大语言模型、基准测试和路由策略上，LDA恢复了因减少路由导致的分布偏移所损失的大部分性能，同时保持稀疏推理效率，额外开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 减少路由引发的表示分布偏移是可校正的性能损失来源；LDA通过层校准统计对齐有效缓解该问题，为动态top-k推理提供低成本解决方案。

title: TRIUNE-Net: Harmonizing Scale, Shape, and Efficiency in Pancreatic Tumor Segmentation
summary: Pancreatic tumor segmentation in 3D CT volumes is challenged by extreme scale variability across both the pancreas and tumor, and highly irregular tumor morphology. While recent advances have pushed segmentation performance, existing methods do not explicitly address these challenges and come at the cost of excessive computational complexity, limiting their practicality in resource-constrained clinical environments. We propose TRIUNE-Net, a lightweight unified architecture that harmonizes scale, shape, and efficiency through three synergistic innovations. A multi-scale context aggregation module with stage-adaptive dilated convolutions enables the model to reason across the broad range of anatomical scales present in both organs. A serial linear-deformable attention mechanism combines large effective receptive fields with shapeadaptive deformable convolutions to capture irregular, non-convex tumor morphologies. Finally, an information-preserving downsampling module replaces conventional max pooling entirely, retaining all spatial information while adding negligible parameters, preventing small tumors from being discarded before they can be recognized. On both the MSD Pancreas and NVD Pancreas datasets, TRIUNE-Net achieves state-of-theart results with only 5.86 M parameters and no external pre-training, outperforming all baselines across all key tumor metrics. Specifically, it surpasses the next-best model by 0.45% in tumor Dice, 6.0 points in F1 score, 6.6 points in sensitivity, and 3.4 points in precision, simultaneously reflecting its ability to suppress both missed tumors and false alarms in clinically realistic conditions. Our code is available at: https://github.com/abdora-ai/TRIUNE-Net

AI.tldr: 提出轻量化统一架构 TRIUNE-Net，通过尺度、形状与效率三项协同创新，在胰腺及肿瘤 3D CT 分割中兼顾精度与计算成本。
AI.motivation: 胰腺肿瘤 3D CT 分割面临胰腺与肿瘤跨尺度差异大、肿瘤形态极不规则等挑战；现有方法未显式应对这些问题，且计算复杂度高，难以在资源受限的临床环境部署。
AI.method: 三项关键设计：1）多尺度上下文聚合模块，采用阶段自适应空洞卷积，覆盖器官的多尺度范围；2）串行线性-可变形注意力机制，结合大有效感受野与形状自适应可变形卷积，捕捉不规则、非凸肿瘤形态；3）信息保持下采样模块，完全替代最大池化，以可忽略的参数量保留全部空间信息，避免小肿瘤在识别前被丢弃。
AI.result: 在 MSD Pancreas 与 NVD Pancreas 数据集上取得 SOTA，仅 5.86 M 参数、无外部预训练；在所有关键肿瘤指标上超越全部基线：肿瘤 Dice 高出次优模型 0.45%，F1 高 6.0 点，敏感度高 6.6 点，精确度高 3.4 点，同时降低漏检与误报。
AI.conclusion: TRIUNE-Net 以轻量统一设计有效协调尺度、形状与效率，在临床现实条件下提升胰腺肿瘤分割精度与鲁棒性，代码已开源。

title: FPicker: Topology-Guided Evolution for Filament Tracing in Low-SNR Microscopy
comment: Accepted to the 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026). 18 pages, 6 figures. Code is publicly available at: https://github.com/tomzhaosky/FPicker
summary: Automating filament tracing in Cryo-Electron Microscopy (Cryo-EM) is essential for 3D helical reconstruction but challenged by intersecting topologies and extremely low Signal-to-Noise Ratios ($\text{SNR} = σ_s^2/σ_n^2$ < 0.1 or -10 dB). Existing paradigms fail: pixel-wise segmenters suffer from severe topological fracturing, box-based detectors face ghost center drift, sequential trackers derail due to error accumulation, and traditional active contours collapse under artificial closed-curve constraints. To resolve these bottlenecks, we present FPicker, the first topology-guided framework reconciling these incompatibilities. It unifies perception via a center-endpoint representation and an open-curve evolution module to explicitly model non-cyclic connectivity. On simulated benchmarks, FPicker outperforms top baselines by over $40\%$ relative gain in mean spatio-angular precision (mSAP) and reduces topological gap rates by over $60\%$ under extreme noise ($-20\text{ dB}$). By learning intrinsic physical geometry rather than local texture, FPicker demonstrates strong potential as a resilient geometric backbone. Its zero-shot performance on the real-world EMPIAR dataset exhibits robust topological resistance, achieving a state-of-the-art 82.9\% mSAP upon fine-tuning. Our results also suggest modeling physical priors is a highly robust path toward bridging the sim-to-real gap in signal-starved scientific imaging. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/tomzhaosky/FPicker.

AI.tldr: 提出 FPicker，首个拓扑引导的冷冻电镜丝状体追踪框架，通过中心-端点表示与开曲线演化模块显式建模非环状连通性，在极端噪声下大幅超越基线并实现强零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 冷冻电镜三维螺旋重建中的丝状体自动追踪至关重要，但面临相交拓扑结构与极低信噪比（SNR<0.1，即-10 dB）的挑战。现有范式均存在缺陷：像素级分割器拓扑断裂严重，基于框的检测器存在幽灵中心漂移，序贯跟踪器因误差累积而脱轨，传统主动轮廓在人工闭合曲线约束下崩溃。因此需要一个能调和这些矛盾的统一框架。
AI.method: FPicker 是首个拓扑引导框架。其核心包括：1) 中心-端点表示（center-endpoint representation），2) 开曲线演化模块（open-curve evolution module），从而显式建模非环状（非循环）连通性，避免闭合曲线约束导致的拓扑错误，并学习内在物理几何而非局部纹理。
AI.result: 在模拟基准上，FPicker 的平均空角精度（mSAP）相对增益超过40%，在极端噪声（-20 dB）下拓扑断裂率降低超过60%。在真实世界 EMPIAR 数据集上，零样本展现出强拓扑鲁棒性，微调后达到最先进的 82.9% mSAP。
AI.conclusion: FPicker 可作为鲁棒的几何骨干网络；结果表明建模物理先验是弥合信号稀疏科学成像中 sim-to-real 差距的高度稳健路径。代码已公开于 https://github.com/tomzhaosky/FPicker。

title: HoneyRoute: Honeypot-Model Routing for Adversarial LLM Serving
summary: We introduce HoneyRoute, an inference-serving layer that detects whether an incoming request is malicious and, if so, routes it to a dedicated honeypot model, shielding production while the adversary's interaction is continuously harvested for intelligence. Existing defenses embed traps inside model memory or rebuild deception at the protocol layer, leaving the serving tier unprotected and feeding nothing back into detection. HoneyRoute couples (i) a streaming router (a frozen 0.8B-embedding backbone with per-domain MLP heads), (ii) a dual-implementation honeypot (a rule/prompt-engineered code honeypot or a dedicated same-family replica), and (iii) an analysis loop that converts trapped interactions into attacker fingerprints for router retraining. On a production trace plus a seven-domain attack corpus, the router reaches F1=.911 at 38 ms median added latency, matching 96% of a two-tier guard-LLM cascade's F1 at 1/385 of its latency with 0% evasion under 13 adversarial transformations; diverting the malicious share cuts production-model token consumption under concurrent flooding with real GCG-suffix payloads by 97.8%; the trained replica agrees with the production model on 92.9% of benign holdout requests, while naive unconditional bait injection collapses to 7.6% and selective camouflaged injection recovers to 88.9%, mapping the recoverable fidelity-traceability frontier; and a loop-trained correction head cuts misrouting of legitimate security research 9x while raising detection F1 to .933.

AI.tldr: HoneyRoute 是一个推理服务层防御系统：先检测恶意请求，再将其路由到专用蜜罐模型，从而保护生产模型并持续采集攻击者交互用于情报与检测能力迭代。
AI.motivation: 现有防御将陷阱嵌入模型内存或在协议层重建欺骗，未保护服务层，且无法将诱捕信息反馈给检测模块。因此需要一个同时具备检测、诱捕与闭环分析能力的服务级方案。
AI.method: HoneyRoute 由三部分耦合组成：(i) 流式路由器，采用冻结的 0.8B 嵌入骨干加按领域的 MLP 头；(ii) 双实现蜜罐，可为规则/提示工程代码蜜罐或同家族专用副本模型；(iii) 分析闭环，将诱捕交互转化为攻击者指纹以重训练路由器。
AI.result: 在生产轨迹加七领域攻击语料上，路由器达到 F1=.911，中位附加延迟 38 ms；以两层 guard-LLM 级联 1/385 的延迟达到其 96% 的 F1，且在 13 种对抗变换下实现 0% 逃逸。分流恶意流量后，在并发洪水攻击与真实 GCG 后缀载荷下，生产模型 token 消耗降低 97.8%。训练副本在良性保留请求上与生产模型一致率 92.9%；朴素无条件诱饵注入降至 7.6%，选择性伪装注入恢复到 88.9%，刻画了可恢复的保真度—可追溯性前沿。闭环训练的纠正头将合法安全研究误路由降低 9 倍，同时检测 F1 提升至 .933。
AI.conclusion: HoneyRoute 在服务层实现了低延迟、高检测率与强抗规避能力，可在保护生产模型的同时大幅削减恶意请求带来的算力消耗，并通过诱捕—分析闭环持续提升检测精度、降低误路由风险。

title: From Glance to Scrutiny: Progressive Distortion Reasoning for Fine-Grained Image Quality Assessment
summary: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in image quality assessment (IQA) by bridging visual perception with descriptive evaluations. However, existing approaches mainly focus on holistic quality prediction, often functioning as black boxes that provide limited insight into where distortions occur and how they affect perceived quality, hindering fine-grained analysis of localized and heterogeneous degradations. We propose GS-IQA, a framework that reformulates IQA as a progressive Where--What--How diagnosis, emulating the human perceptual process from an initial glance to closer scrutiny. Since a severity judgment is meaningful only for a correctly localized and recognized region, we realize this progression through a two-stage reinforcement learning paradigm that respects such dependencies: the glance stage uses a perception-gated reward to establish where degradations lie and what they are, activating severity feedback only once both are correct, while the scrutiny stage introduces online reward-conditioned degradation generation to synthesize hard examples targeted at the model's perceptual bottlenecks, sharpening its discrimination of subtle severity variations. To enable systematic evaluation, we construct Diag-Bench, a region-level IQA benchmark of about 25K curated samples spanning 12 distortion types and five ordinal severity levels. Extensive experiments show that GS-IQA consistently surpasses state-of-the-art methods in distortion localization, recognition, and severity estimation, and that its diagnostic representations transfer effectively to conventional global quality prediction across diverse external benchmarks. Code and data will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GS-IQA框架，将图像质量评估重构为"定位—识别—分级"的渐进式诊断过程，并构建Diag-Bench区域级基准，在失真定位、识别与严重度估计上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型IQA方法多聚焦整体质量预测，呈黑箱特性，无法说明失真发生在何处、如何影响感知质量，难以对局部且异质的退化进行细粒度分析。
AI.method: 将IQA重构为Where–What–How渐进诊断，模拟人类从一瞥到细察的感知过程；采用两阶段强化学习：一瞥阶段用感知门控奖励确定失真位置与类型，仅在两者均正确时激活严重度反馈；细察阶段引入在线奖励条件退化生成，针对模型感知瓶颈合成难例；并构建约25K样本、覆盖12种失真类型与5个有序严重度等级的Diag-Bench区域级基准。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，GS-IQA在失真定位、识别和严重度估计上持续优于最先进方法，且其诊断表示可有效迁移至多样外部基准上的常规全局质量预测。
AI.conclusion: GS-IQA将IQA从整体黑箱预测转变为可解释的渐进式诊断，验证了定位—识别—分级依赖关系的有效性，并展示了诊断表示向全局质量预测的可迁移性。代码与数据将开源。

title: Supervised Cross-Modal Feature Alignment for Zero-Wearable Freezing of Gait Detection in Parkinsonism
summary: Objective assessment of Freezing of Gait (FoG) in Parkinson's disease (PD) relies predominantly on wearable Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs). While IMUs provide optimal kinematic precision, mandatory sensor attachment restricts continuous clinical deployment. Conversely, unobtrusive vision-based alternatives suffer substantial classification errors during turning-in-place tasks, where geometric self-occlusion degrades deterministic skeletal coordinates and obscures the high-frequency precursors required for FoG detection. To resolve these physical observation limits, we propose a supervised cross-modal subspace distillation framework. During optimisation, pre-trained kinematic data from IMU sensors and contextual clinical metadata act as oracles to guide a deployable visual architecture. By incorporating joint velocity and acceleration derivatives, utilising a confidence-based gating mechanism, the visual model mitigates some of the tracking errors during occlusion events. Empirical evaluations confirm this latent alignment transfers the predictive fidelity of hardware sensors directly into the visual representation, yielding $85.5\%$ accuracy, and $82.4\%$ balanced accuracy. All the while maintaining a vision only model at inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种监督式跨模态子空间蒸馏框架，在训练阶段以IMU运动学数据和临床元数据作为“oracle”指导可部署的视觉模型，从而在推理阶段仅使用视觉模型实现帕金森病冻结步态（FoG）的客观评估，达到85.5%准确率和82.4%平衡准确率。
AI.motivation: FoG的客观评估目前主要依赖可穿戴IMU，其运动学精度最优，但必须佩戴传感器，限制了连续临床部署。非侵入式视觉方案虽便捷，却在原地转身任务中因几何自遮挡导致确定性骨架坐标退化，并掩盖FoG检测所需的高频前兆信号，产生大量分类错误。
AI.method: 提出监督式跨模态子空间蒸馏框架：优化阶段以预训练IMU运动学数据和上下文临床元数据作为oracle，引导可部署的视觉架构；引入关节速度与加速度导数特征，并采用基于置信度的门控机制，以缓解遮挡事件中的跟踪误差。推理阶段仅保留视觉模型。
AI.result: 实证评估表明，该潜在空间对齐将硬件传感器的预测保真度直接迁移至视觉表征，取得85.5%准确率和82.4%平衡准确率，同时推理时保持纯视觉模型。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态子空间蒸馏可在不依赖推理期传感器佩戴的前提下，将IMU的运动学优势迁移到视觉模型中，缓解自遮挡导致的性能退化，实现可部署且高精度的FoG评估。

title: Tracing Stereotypes from Representation to Output in Multilingual LLMs
comment: 18 pages total (9 pages main text), 13 figures. Accepted to EMNLP 2026
summary: Multilingual LLMs show stereotype-related behavior that varies across languages, but behavioral scores do not show where the relevant information is represented or how it affects the output. To investigate these internal mechanisms, we compare linear probing, attribution patching, sparse autoencoders (SAEs) and feature ablation in Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma-2-9B. Probe performance peaks substantially earlier than attribution in all three models, with a separation of 36-53% of model depth. Retained Llama-Scope features often match the social category on which they were selected and form recurring semantic families, but their lexical alignment and ablation effects vary across SAE suites. Only 6-18% of evaluated residual-stream features have language-agnostic effects under our criterion, and none are category-agnostic. Language-agnostic features have larger mean ablation effects in Llama-Scope, but this pattern does not repeat in the other SAE suites. Decodability, output influence, and cross-lingual ablation effects therefore need to be measured separately.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过线性探针、归因修补、稀疏自编码器（SAE）与特征消融，比较Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B和Gemma-2-9B中多语言刻板印象相关信息的内部表示与输出影响，发现探针可解码性峰值远早于归因峰值，且跨语言归因效应、输出影响与可解码性需分别测量。
AI.motivation: 多语言大模型表现出随语言变化的刻板印象相关行为，但行为评分无法揭示相关信息在模型内部何处表示、如何影响输出，因此需要研究其内部机制。
AI.method: 在Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B和Gemma-2-9B上比较四类方法：线性探针、归因修补、稀疏自编码器（SAEs）与特征消融；保留Llama-Scope特征并分析其语义家族、词汇对齐与消融效应；以语言无关性准则评估残差流特征。
AI.result: 三个模型中探针性能峰值均显著早于归因峰值，间隔达模型深度的36-53%；保留的Llama-Scope特征常匹配其被选择时的社会类别并形成重复语义家族，但词汇对齐与消融效应随SAE套件变化；仅6-18%的评估残差流特征符合语言无关准则，且无类别无关特征；语言无关特征在Llama-Scope中平均消融效应更大，但该模式未在其他SAE套件重现。
AI.conclusion: 可解码性、输出影响与跨语言消融效应需分别测量；行为层面的刻板印象评分不足以刻画内部表示与因果影响。

title: Do Input-Level Defenses Transfer to Observation-Level Attacks on VideoLLMs?
comment: Preprint. Under review at IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing. 13 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables
summary: Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical applications such as content moderation and video analytics. To process long videos efficiently, VideoLLMs rely on frame sampling, token compression, and modality fusion, which together form an observation pipeline that reduces the raw video to a compact internal representation. Recent observation-level attacks exploit this pipeline to prevent the model from perceiving harmful content, yet no defense has been explicitly designed for this threat. We introduce DefTEval, a controlled evaluation framework that systematically assesses whether input-level adversarial defenses, which operate on the pixel content of already-sampled frames, can mitigate observation-level attacks. Across five VideoLLMs, eleven representative defenses, and five attack types, we find that input-level defenses offer limited and inconsistent protection, with harmful detection rates frequently near zero. Critically, defenses fail even against attacks that embed harmful signals in every sampled frame, indicating that the bottleneck extends beyond sampling omission to the suppression of signals that do enter the model. Token compression discards localized features, and modality fusion systematically down-weights weakened visual signals. Furthermore, defense effectiveness is dominated by model architecture rather than by the defense method itself, and detection rates vary drastically across content categories, exposing structural weaknesses in temporal reasoning. These findings demonstrate that securing VideoLLMs requires system-level robustness mechanisms spanning sampling-aware coverage guarantees, token-level preservation of safety-relevant features, and modality-balanced fusion.

AI.tldr: 提出 DefTEval 评估框架，发现输入级对抗防御无法有效抵御视频大模型的“观测级攻击”，安全瓶颈在于采样、token压缩与模态融合构成的整条观测流水线，需系统级防御。
AI.motivation: VideoLLM 已用于内容审核等安全关键场景，其依赖帧采样、token 压缩与模态融合构成观测流水线；已有观测级攻击可阻断模型感知有害内容，但尚无针对性防御。作者需检验现成的输入级（像素级）对抗防御能否迁移解决该威胁。
AI.method: 构建 DefTEval 受控评估框架：在已采样帧的像素内容上施加输入级防御，覆盖 5 个 VideoLLM、11 种代表性防御、5 类攻击，并以有害内容检测率等指标系统衡量防御效果，同时分析失效环节（采样遗漏、token 压缩、模态融合）。
AI.result: 输入级防御保护有限且不稳定，有害检测率常接近零；即使攻击将有害信号嵌入每一采样帧，防御仍失败，说明瓶颈不止于采样遗漏，还在于进入模型的信号被抑制：token 压缩丢弃局部特征，模态融合系统性降低弱化视觉信号的权重。防御效果更多由模型架构而非防御方法决定，且检测率在不同内容类别间差异剧烈，暴露时间推理的结构性弱点。
AI.conclusion: 保障 VideoLLM 安全不能依靠输入级防御，需系统级鲁棒机制：感知采样的覆盖率保证、token 级安全相关特征保留、以及模态均衡的融合策略。

title: EdMCGS: Event-Driven Markov Chain Gaussian Splatting for Extreme-Low-Frame-Rate Dynamic Scene Reconstruction
summary: We present EdMCGS (Event-driven Markov chain Gaussian Splatting), an end-to-end method for reconstructing dynamic 3D scenes from extreme-low-frame-rate RGB together with an event stream, which can then be rendered at any intermediate timestamp. Methods relying solely on RGB images generate numerous artifacts due to the lack of evidence from between consecutive frames. To supply this missing evidence, we model the scene motion as an event-driven Markov chain, in which the sparse RGB frames anchor the state at their own timestamps while the events recorded within an interval drive the transition across it. Since the transition reads the events of the current interval, it remains active at inference and produces the in-between motion of the 3D Gaussians directly from the events rather than by interpolation, which sets our method apart from prior work that uses events only as training-time supervision. The state is carried by a compact set of control points, each driven by the events sampled in the neighborhood of its own image projection, and a temporal local isometry term keeps the propagated motion locally rigid. Experiments on synthetic and real-world scenes show that EdMCGS outperforms both RGB-based and event-based baselines, while rendering in real time with far fewer Gaussians than the strongest event-based baseline. We release our source code and a new dataset at https://github.com/joseclipse/EdMCGS.

AI.tldr: 提出EdMCGS，将场景运动建模为事件驱动的马尔可夫链，用极低帧率RGB帧锚定状态、事件流驱动状态转移，实现从RGB+事件流重建动态3D场景并在任意中间时刻实时渲染。
AI.motivation: 极低帧率RGB因缺少相邻帧之间的证据，仅靠RGB的方法会产生大量伪影；已有事件方法仅把事件当作训练时监督，无法在推理阶段提供帧间运动信息。
AI.method: 将场景运动建模为事件驱动的马尔可夫链：稀疏RGB帧锚定各自时间戳的状态，区间内事件驱动跨区间状态转移；转移在推理时读取当前区间事件，直接生成3D高斯的帧间运动而非插值。状态由一小组控制点承载，每个控制点由其图像投影邻域采样的事件驱动，并引入时间局部等距项保持传播运动的局部刚性。
AI.result: 在合成与真实场景上，EdMCGS优于基于RGB与基于事件的基线，并能实时渲染，且高斯数量远少于最强的基于事件的基线。
AI.conclusion: 事件流可在推理阶段直接驱动帧间运动生成，弥补极低帧率RGB的帧间证据缺失，兼顾渲染质量、实时性与高斯紧凑性；并开源代码与一个新数据集。

title: Distillation as Probability Transport: Routed On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher knowledge on student-generated trajectories, but efficient sampled objectives reduce the teacher distribution to scalar credit on individual tokens. Such credit indicates whether a token should gain or lose probability, yet leaves the corresponding redistribution unspecified. We recast OPD as teacher-guided probability transport and propose RouteOPD (Routed On-Policy Distillation), which decomposes local teacher--student disagreement into student-excess sources and teacher-deficit destinations and couples them into explicit transport pairs. RouteOPD optimizes pairwise log-odds toward jointly realizable targets obtained from a bounded teacher potential, while adapting the transport budget to the concentration of teacher demand. This formulation directs updates toward teacher-preferred destinations and controls their magnitude within a single transport operator. Experiments across four teacher--student settings and four mathematical-reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that RouteOPD consistently outperforms sampled reverse-KL OPD, with improvements accompanied by higher routing fidelity and lower background leakage. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of explicitly modeling probability transport in on-policy distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RouteOPD，将 on-policy distillation 重新表述为教师引导的概率传输问题，通过显式构造传输对来指引与调控学生更新，效果优于采样式 reverse-KL OPD。
AI.motivation: 现有 on-policy distillation 中高效的采样目标将教师分布约简为逐 token 的标量信用，只能指示某 token 应提升或降低概率，却未指明概率质量应如何重新分配，导致更新方向与幅度不明确。
AI.method: 将 OPD 改写为教师引导的概率传输。把局部的师生分歧分解为学生过量来源与教师亏缺目的地，并耦合为显式传输对；在受限教师势函数导出的联合可达目标上优化成对 log-odds，同时根据教师需求的集中程度自适应调整传输预算，从而在单一传输算子内确定更新方向与幅度。
AI.result: 在四种教师—学生设置与四个数学推理基准上，RouteOPD 一致优于采样式 reverse-KL OPD，并伴随更高的路由保真度与更低的背景泄漏。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明显式建模概率传输是在线策略蒸馏的有效途径。

title: VeriScene: Reconstructing Crime Scenes from Legal Evidence via World-Model Agent
summary: World models take multimodal inputs like text, photos, and diagrams to generate dynamic scenes in accordance with the laws of physics, thus opening a compelling application: fusing multimodal legal evidence to re-create a crime scene and re-enact how an offence could have been committed. However, feeding the raw, unorganized evidence into a world model fails in forensic use: it silently drops evidence, glosses over contradictory testimony, and produces motion that violates the evidentiary record. This paper presents VeriScene, an agent that orchestrates the world model: it reconstructs crime scenes from forensic photographs and witness statements of varying reliability, keeping every claim traceable to evidence and every motion physically plausible. VeriScene iteratively fuses the evidence into a cited narrative under an auditing loop, verifies the hypothesized dynamics via probe rollouts in the world model with corrective constraint injection, and renders the offence as a re-enactment video from a fused keyframe. On a benchmark of 25 crime scenarios across 7 physically-driven case types (139 forensic-style photographs and 65 statements with planted unreliability), VeriScene attains 0.9014 evidence coverage and 0.7217 factual consistency (0-1 scale) on the 20 test scenes, outperforming an end-to-end multimodal-LLM baseline by 20.35% in factual consistency and 34.88% in temporal coherence, while generalizing across four LLM orchestration backends at USD 1.82 per scene.

AI.tldr: VeriScene 是一个编排世界模型的智能体，用于从多模态法律证据重建犯罪现场并生成重演视频，兼顾证据可溯源与运动物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 直接将原始、未整理的多模态法律证据输入世界模型会失败：会静默丢弃证据、淡化矛盾证词、生成违反证据记录的物理运动，无法满足法证用途的可溯源与可靠性要求。
AI.method: VeriScene 迭代地将证据（不同可靠度的现场照片与证人陈述）在审计循环中融合为带引用的叙事；通过世界模型中的试探性 rollout 配合纠正性约束注入来验证假设的动态；最后从融合关键帧渲染犯罪重演视频。
AI.result: 在含 7 类物理驱动案件、25 个犯罪场景（139 张法证风格照片、65 条植入不可靠性的陈述）的基准上，20 个测试场景中达到 0.9014 证据覆盖率与 0.7217 事实一致性（0–1）。相较端到端多模态 LLM 基线，事实一致性提升 20.35%，时间连贯性提升 34.88%，并可跨四种 LLM 编排后端泛化，成本约 1.82 美元/场景。
AI.conclusion: 通过将世界模型置于智能体编排之下，并引入证据审计、约束注入与可溯源叙事机制，可显著提升犯罪现场重建的事实一致性、时序连贯性与证据覆盖度，且具备跨后端泛化能力。

title: CoVeR: Coverage-Based Token Pruning for Multi-View 3D Reasoning in VLMs
summary: Representing a 3D scene as multi-view images allows 2D VLMs to reason in 3D by reusing priors from pre-training, sidestepping the scarcity of annotated 3D data. However, it produces thousands of redundant visual tokens whose cost grows with every view. Existing visual token pruners fall into two families, each limited in the 3D multi-view setting. Learned importance methods rank tokens by attention or encoder features; because redundancy here is fundamentally spatial, they keep near-duplicate tokens from a few prominent regions and leave most of the scene unrepresented. Voxelization methods improve spatial coverage but cannot enforce an exact token budget and saturate as multi-view observations overlap in 3D, capping retention well below the target. We show that spatial coverage is associated with 3D reasoning performance and introduce CoVeR, a deterministic, training-free selector that uses only token coordinates, with no learned signals. CoVeR selects tokens that collectively cover every region of the scene, and solves the limitations of both families: it enforces an exact per-scene budget, breaks the voxelization saturation plateau, and avoids the near-duplicate selections of learned importance. Extensive experiments show CoVeR outperforms prior SOTAs on all three 3D reasoning benchmarks and generalizes as a plug-and-play module tested across four VLMs. Notably, with only $\approx$8% of visual tokens, it preserves 93.5% of full-token performance, surpassing SOTA by 3.9 percentage points on average across benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CoVeR是一种确定性、无需训练的视觉token选择器，仅利用token坐标，通过保证场景空间全覆盖来实现精确预算的多视图token剪枝，在三个3D推理基准上超越SOTA，仅用约8%视觉token即可保留93.5%的全token性能。
AI.motivation: 将3D场景表示为多视图图像可让2D VLM复用预训练先验进行3D推理，规避3D标注稀缺问题，但会产生大量冗余视觉token，成本随视图数量增长。现有剪枝方法存在两类局限：基于学习重要性的方法因冗余本质是空间性的，会保留少数显著区域的近重复token而遗漏大部分场景；体素化方法虽提升空间覆盖，却无法保证精确token预算，且随多视图观测在3D中重叠而饱和，保留率远低于目标。
AI.method: 作者指出空间覆盖与3D推理性能相关，提出CoVeR——一种确定性、无需训练的token选择器，仅使用token坐标、不含任何学习信号。CoVeR选择能够集体覆盖场景每个区域的token，同时解决两类方法的缺陷：强制每场景精确预算、突破体素化饱和平台、避免学习重要性方法的近重复选择。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，CoVeR在三个3D推理基准上均超越先前SOTA，并作为即插即用模块在四种VLM上验证了泛化性。仅用约8%的视觉token，CoVeR保留了全token性能的93.5%，跨基准平均超越SOTA 3.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CoVeR以纯坐标驱动的确定性空间覆盖选择，兼顾精确预算与覆盖完备性，有效替代学习重要性和体素化两类剪枝范式，在多视图3D推理中实现高效且可泛化的token剪枝。

title: The MODA General Attribute Suite: A Four-Track Evaluation Benchmark for Fashion Attribute Extraction
comment: v2: adds Section 6 (crop-track design measurements); corrects one figure in Section 8 affected by an inference preprocessing defect; see Changes in version 2
summary: Fashion attribute extraction is evaluated inconsistently: results are reported as single aggregate numbers across image types that pose different problems, fields that are not visible in an image are scored as ordinary negatives, and the effect of vocabulary mismatch between datasets is acknowledged but not measured. We release the MODA General Attribute Suite, a four-track benchmark that keeps these problems separate by construction. Each track (localized garment crops, catalogue product images, applicability-aware full-body photographs, and product text) carries its own frozen test set, input contract, metric, and leakage unit, and the tracks are never averaged. The protocol requires label-blind prediction, SHA-256 commitment of prediction files before any label is opened, a fail-closed scorer, and a 10,000-sample paired cluster bootstrap at each track's natural leakage unit; promotion requires a positive interval on every track rather than a favourable mean. We release the scorers, the split builders, our own prediction files with their hashes for every image-track system in the main results and for runs we lose, and the MODA_NER(V) model checkpoints for three of the four tracks. The text model is not distributed; its benchmark is. We report baseline results, six interventions that did not improve them, and the limitations of the evidence. On the garment-crop track we also measure how far the headline depends on the benchmark's own design: the order of the two strongest systems depends on whether fields are micro- or macro-averaged, two thirds of the cells the protocol judges carry no annotation, and disabling the applicability decision cuts attribute micro-F1 from 0.63 to 0.27, so most of that score rests on absence decisions the source labels cannot adjudicate. This version also corrects one figure in an external comparison that an inference preprocessing defect had affected.

AI.tldr: 本文发布MODA General Attribute Suite——一个按构造分离四类问题的服饰属性抽取四轨基准，每轨有独立冻结测试集、输入契约、指标与泄漏单元，禁止跨轨平均，并公开评分器、切分构建器、预测文件哈希及部分模型检查点；在服装裁剪轨还量化了头条分数对基准设计的依赖。
AI.motivation: 服饰属性抽取评估存在三类不一致：跨不同图像类型只报告单一聚合数值；图像中不可见字段被当作普通负例评分；数据集间词汇不匹配的影响被承认却未被测量。作者希望将这些问题按构造分离，使各问题可被独立观察与解释。
AI.method: 构建四轨基准（本地化服装裁剪、目录商品图、适用性感知全身照、商品文本），每轨自带冻结测试集、输入契约、指标与泄漏单元且不跨轨平均。协议要求标签盲预测、在任何标签打开前对预测文件做SHA-256承诺、fail-closed评分器，并在各轨自然泄漏单元上做10,000次配对聚类bootstrap；晋级需每轨区间为正而非均值有利。公开评分器、切分构建器、主结果与失败运行的全部图像轨系统预测文件及其哈希，以及四轨中三轨的MODA_NER(V)检查点；文本模型不发布但发布其基准。报告基线结果、六项未改善结果的干预及证据局限。在裁剪轨测量头条对基准设计的依赖。
AI.result: 在服装裁剪轨：两个最强系统的排序取决于字段采用微平均还是宏平均；协议判定单元中有三分之二不含标注；关闭适用性决策使属性micro-F1从0.63降至0.27，表明该分数主要依赖源标签无法裁决的缺省判断。本版本还修正了外部比较中受推理预处理缺陷影响的一处数值。
AI.conclusion: 通过四轨分离设计，将聚合、不可见字段误判负例与词汇不匹配三类评估问题按构造隔离，并以承诺、fail-closed评分与配对聚类bootstrap约束可信度。裁剪轨的结果显示头条分数高度依赖基准设计（平均方式、无标注单元占比、适用性决策），提示单一聚合数值具有误导性；公开预测、哈希与部分检查点支持可复现与事后审计。

title: Segment Any Motion with Radar: Robust Multimodal Moving-Object Segmentation and Tracking
summary: Moving-object perception must decide which image regions correspond to real motion and keep every instance identified over time. Methods that read motion from appearance, optical flow, or estimated trajectories lose that evidence under poor illumination, adverse weather, reflections, and occlusion. Radar is a natural remedy because it measures radial velocity directly instead of inferring it from photometric correspondence. However, existing benchmarks do not jointly provide radar measurements, dense moving-instance masks, and temporally consistent identities for surveillance. We therefore introduce RGBTR-Motion, a synchronized and calibrated fixed-camera benchmark that pairs RGB, thermal, and radar streams with dense instance masks and temporally consistent identities across diverse surveillance scenes. We also develop SAM-Radar, an RGB, thermal, and radar-based segmentation and tracking framework built on SAM 3. SAM-Radar's radar-aware detector fuses calibrated RGBT features with radar returns that are grounded at their projected image locations, and motion supervision, implemented as foreground classification of those projected returns, teaches the detector to reject clutter without any text prompt. The tracker associates accepted radar returns with individual trajectories and uses them as physical evidence that a visually degraded target remains present. This allows it to bridge short periods of low visibility or occlusion and reconnect a reappearing target to its existing identity instead of starting a new track. SAM-Radar attains 0.7027 IoU and 0.8090 F1-50, and raises MOTA, HOTA, and IDF1 by 0.2977, 0.1603, and 0.2857 over the strongest competing values.

AI.tldr: 该文提出同步标定的RGB-热成像-雷达监视基准RGBTR-Motion，并基于SAM 3构建SAM-Radar分割跟踪框架，用雷达回波作为运动物理证据，显著提升分割与多目标跟踪性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于外观、光流或估计轨迹的运动感知方法在低照度、恶劣天气、反射与遮挡下失效，且现有基准未同时提供雷达测量、稠密运动实例掩码与时间一致身份标注。
AI.method: 构建RGBTR-Motion固定相机基准，同步标定RGB、热成像与雷达流，配以稠密实例掩码和时序一致身份。开发SAM-Radar：基于SAM 3的雷达感知检测器将标定的RGBT特征与投影到图像位置的雷达回波融合；以投影回波的前景分类作为运动监督，无需文本提示即可抑制杂波；跟踪器将接受的雷达回波与轨迹关联，作为视觉退化目标仍存在的物理证据，从而跨越低可见度或遮挡并重连身份。
AI.result: SAM-Radar取得0.7027 IoU与0.8090 F1-50；MOTA、HOTA、IDF1分别比最强对比结果提升0.2977、0.1603、0.2857。
AI.conclusion: 直接测量径向速度的雷达可作为运动感知的可靠物理证据，结合RGBT融合与无需文本提示的运动监督，可有效应对遮挡与视觉退化，实现稠密分割与时间一致的多目标跟踪。

title: RepoNav: From Snippet Retrieval to File-Centered Repository Navigation for Code Agents
summary: Solving repository-level code tasks requires LLM-based agents to use code search tools to navigate large codebases and identify a small set of relevant files and functions. However, current retrieval tools typically return flat lists of isolated code snippets: such lists can surface relevant files, but provide insufficient structure for agents to distinguish the target function from semantically similar alternatives in the same file. We introduce RepoNav, a lightweight post-retrieval interface that reorganizes retrieved snippets into a file-centered navigation scaffold. By presenting compact structural cues and candidate targets, this scaffold guides on-demand file-structure browsing, helping agents compare sibling symbols before selecting a target function. Across diverse models on LocBench, RepoNav improves function-level localization and narrows the file-to-function gap. Controlled ablations demonstrate that these gains come from structured evidence organization rather than simply exposing additional file structure, and the approach also improves performance on a repository-level question-answering benchmark.

AI.tldr: RepoNav 是一种轻量级检索后接口，将代码检索返回的扁平片段列表重组为以文件为中心的导航结构，帮助智能体在仓库级任务中更好地定位目标函数。
AI.motivation: 仓库级代码任务需要基于 LLM 的智能体使用代码搜索工具在大规模代码库中定位少量相关文件与函数。但现有检索工具通常返回孤立的代码片段扁平列表，虽能呈现相关文件，却缺乏足够结构，智能体难以区分目标函数与同一文件中语义相似的候选，导致文件级定位到函数级定位之间存在差距。
AI.method: 提出 RepoNav，一种轻量级检索后接口（post-retrieval interface）。它将检索到的代码片段重组为以文件为中心的导航脚手架（file-centered navigation scaffold），通过呈现紧凑的结构线索与候选目标，引导智能体按需浏览文件结构，从而在选定目标函数前比较同级符号（sibling symbols）。
AI.result: 在 LocBench 上，跨多种模型 RepoNav 均提升了函数级定位性能，并缩小了文件到函数的定位差距。受控消融实验表明，性能提升来源于结构化证据组织，而非单纯暴露额外文件结构；此外，该方法在仓库级问答基准上也带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: RepoNav 通过结构化的检索后证据组织，有效弥补了现有检索工具在函数级定位上的不足，是一种模型无关、轻量的通用增强方案，可同时服务于定位与仓库级问答任务。

title: SentryLine: Evidence-Grounded Question Answering over Evolving Documents in Oncology Care
summary: Oncology care operates at constant pressure of absorbing rapidly evolving evidence base in biomedicine. The American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) addresses this through living guidelines, but the format introduces a new burden: any recommendation can change at any point, across multiple versioned documents. We present SENTRYLINE, a living guideline-aware clinical question answering system. SENTRYLINE retrieves guideline passages through a vectorless hierarchical RAG pipeline and returns a role-specific answer with inline citations, factual and temporal verification reports, and drift detection notes that surface when a guideline has been updated. We construct ASCOBENCH, a benchmark of 405 three-turn conversations across four question categories with gold answers from expert annotators(clinicians), and use test set to evaluate SENTRYLINE against five baselines under an LLM-as-judge framework. Experiments across three generation backbones show consistent improvements over four retrieval baselines and ASCO's guideline assistant, with particularly strong gains on Reasoning and Role-Specific questions where multi-hop synthesis and register adaptation are required

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 SENTRYLINE，一个面向“活体指南”（living guidelines）的临床问答系统，通过无向量的分层 RAG 流程检索指南段落，输出含内联引用、事实与时序验证报告、以及指南更新漂移提示的角色化答案；并构建 ASCOBENCH 基准（405 组三轮对话、四类问题、专家标注金答案），在 LLM-as-judge 框架下用测试集对比五个基线，验证其优越性。
AI.motivation: 肿瘤诊疗需要在持续压力下吸收快速演进的生物医学证据。ASCO 通过“活体指南”应对，但该格式带来新负担：任一推荐都可能在任意时间点变化，且分散于多个版本化文档中。现有系统难以处理这种动态性与版本漂移问题，因此需要能感知指南更新的临床问答系统。
AI.method: 1) 系统 SENTRYLINE：采用无向量（vectorless）分层 RAG 流程检索指南段落；2) 输出形式：角色特定（role-specific）答案 + 内联引用 + 事实验证报告 + 时序验证报告 + 漂移检测提示（当指南已更新时给出提示）；3) 基准构建 ASCOBENCH：405 组三轮对话，覆盖四类问题，金答案由临床医生专家标注；4) 评测：在测试集上以 LLM-as-judge 框架，将 SENTRYLINE 与五个基线（含四个检索基线和 ASCO 指南助手）对比，并在三种生成骨干模型上验证。
AI.result: 在三种生成骨干模型上，SENTRYLINE 相对四个检索基线和 ASCO 指南助手均取得一致提升；在需要多跳综合与语域适配的 Reasoning 与 Role-Specific 问题上增益尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: SENTRYLINE 通过无向量分层 RAG 与漂移检测、事实与时序验证机制，有效应对活体指南的动态性与版本化文档带来的挑战，并在受控基准 ASCOBENCH 上优于现有检索基线与官方指南助手，尤其擅长多跳推理与角色适配类问题。

title: ReMoMask-2: Latent Retrieval-Augmented Masked Motion Generation
summary: Text-to-motion (T2M) generation maps natural language to human joint movements, aiding gaming, VR, and robotics. Retrieval-Augmented Text-to-Motion (RAG-T2M) improves generation on complex descriptions by conditioning on retrieved motion-text pairs. However, existing RAG-T2M models face two challenges: coarse-grained retrieval and fusion mechanisms overlook the hierarchical, spatial-temporal topology of human motion, and a representation gap exists because retrieved evidence resides in a semantic space separate from the generator's latents. To address the first, we present ReMoMask, a structure-aware RAG framework coupling Hierarchical Bidirectional Momentum (HBM) contrastive learning to align global and part-level features with text; Semantic Spatial-Temporal Attention (SSTA) for topology-aware fusion; and Topology Structured Masking (TSM) to force robust part-level grounding via adaptive masking. To address the second, we introduce ReMoMask-2, which rebuilds the retrieval database directly within the generator's pre-quantization latent space and aligns text queries via a distilled lightweight projector, allowing the generator to directly consume the retrieved motion's semantic content. Extensive experiments on HumanML3D, KIT-ML, and SnapMoGen demonstrate our retriever achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, while ReMoMask-2 attains the lowest FID on KIT-ML and SnapMoGen; notably, its single mask-transformer stage surpasses ReMoMask's full two-stage pipeline and delivers the fastest inference.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ReMoMask和ReMoMask-2解决检索增强文本到动作生成中粗粒度检索与表示鸿沟两大问题。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG-T2M模型存在两个挑战：一是粗粒度的检索与融合机制忽略了人体动作的层次化、时空拓扑结构；二是检索到的证据处于语义空间，与生成器的隐空间之间存在表示鸿沟。
AI.method: 针对第一个问题提出ReMoMask框架：用层次化双向动量(HBM)对比学习对齐全局与部位级特征与文本，用语义时空注意力(SSTA)实现拓扑感知融合，用拓扑结构化掩码(TSM)通过自适应掩码强化部位级 grounding。针对第二个问题提出ReMoMask-2：在生成器量化前的隐空间中重建检索数据库，并通过蒸馏的轻量投影器对齐文本查询，使生成器直接消费检索动作的语义内容。
AI.result: 在HumanML3D、KIT-ML和SnapMoGen上的大量实验表明，检索器达到state-of-the-art精度；ReMoMask-2在KIT-ML和SnapMoGen上取得最低FID；其单阶段掩码Transformer超过ReMoMask的完整两阶段流水线，并实现最快推理。
AI.conclusion: ReMoMask通过结构感知检索与融合提升了文本到动作生成的检索精度与融合质量，ReMoMask-2通过将检索数据库迁移至生成器隐空间消除了表示鸿沟，实现了更优的生成质量与更高的推理效率。

title: To Adapt or Not to Adapt? Selective Adaptation for Vision-Language Models
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) has emerged as a prominent strategy for adapting vision-language models to distribution shifts during inference. We conduct a per-sample analysis of model predictions before and after adaptation, and observe two failure modes in existing TTA methods that echo previous work. Adaptations are frequently negligible, yielding no change in the model's predictions, and more severely, they can be detrimental by flipping previously correct predictions to incorrect ones. This naturally raises a question: Can we identify and skip such negligible or harmful adaptations? In this work, we introduce a new problem of selective adaptation, which aims to determine whether a given test sample should undergo adaptation or be skipped. To this end, we propose Cross-Augmentation Similarity (CAS), a simple baseline that performs adaptation only when predictions across augmented views exhibit low similarity. Notably, CAS not only preserves but in some cases improves overall accuracy, even when skipping nearly 85% of the adaptation process. We hope other researchers will explore this new direction and surpass the performance of our baseline. Our code is available at https://github.com/sirujiang/selective-adaptation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"选择性适配"新问题，并设计Cross-Augmentation Similarity (CAS)基线，通过衡量增强视图间预测相似度来决定是否适配，可跳过约85%的适配步骤仍保持甚至提升总体准确率。
AI.motivation: 已有TTA方法在测试时适配视觉-语言模型时存在两种失败模式：适配效果可忽略（预测不变）和适配有害（将原本正确预测翻转为错误）。作者通过逐样本分析预测前后变化发现该现象，进而思考能否识别并跳过这类无效或有害的适配。
AI.method: 提出选择性适配（selective adaptation）问题，即判断给定测试样本是否应进行适配。设计CAS（Cross-Augmentation Similarity）基线：对样本施加多种数据增强，当各增强视图的预测相似度较低时才执行适配，否则跳过。
AI.result: CAS在跳过近85%适配过程的情况下，不仅保持总体准确率，部分场景下还能提升准确率。
AI.conclusion: 选择性适配是一个有价值的新研究方向，CAS作为简单基线已取得稳健效果，作者期望后续研究在此方向上继续探索并超越该基线。

title: Miles v0.1: Production-Level Post-Training
summary: We present Miles v0.1, a full-stack, production-ready system for frontier post-training. Building upon the clean design of slime, Miles designs each stage of the reinforcement-learning (RL) training loop around a single principle: components should be verified, clean, and customizable. With accuracy, efficiency, reliability, and scalability as first-class goals, Miles aims to make frontier-scale RL accessible to researchers and enterprises alike. This report walks through the system end to end: rollout engines built on SGLang, a trainer with a choice of two backends (NVIDIA Megatron-LM and PyTorch FSDP), and three weight-synchronization transports for different deployment topologies. Beyond full-parameter RL, Miles also supports LoRA RL, on-policy distillation, supervised fine-tuning, and true-on-policy rollout-training alignment, and extends the same architecture to diffusion models. We close with an end-to-end case study: fully asynchronous agentic RL on a GLM-5.2 744B-A40B model over terminal-use coding tasks, running on 64 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs with a median step time of 263 seconds over the first 30 measured steps. Miles is open-sourced at https://github.com/radixark/miles, with the project website at https://miles.radixark.com.

AI.tldr: Miles v0.1 是一个面向前沿后训练的全栈、生产可用的强化学习训练系统，围绕"组件可验证、简洁、可定制"原则设计，支持多种后端与传输方式，并已在大规模 agentic RL 任务上完成端到端验证。
AI.motivation: 现有前沿后训练的强化学习系统在精度、效率、可靠性与可扩展性方面难以同时兼顾，且流程各环节耦合度高、不易定制。作者希望让前沿规模的 RL 训练对研究者和企业都更易获取。
AI.method: 以 slime 的简洁设计为基础，将 RL 训练循环的每个阶段都围绕"组件可验证、简洁、可定制"这一原则构建。系统包含基于 SGLang 的 rollout 引擎，以及可选 NVIDIA Megatron-LM 或 PyTorch FSDP 两种后端的 trainer，并提供三种适配不同部署拓扑的权重同步传输方式。除全参数 RL 外，还支持 LoRA RL、on-policy 蒸馏、监督微调、true-on-policy 的 rollout-training 对齐，并将同一架构扩展到扩散模型。
AI.result: 在端到端案例中，使用 64 张 NVIDIA GB300 GPU，对 GLM-5.2 744B-A40B 模型在终端使用类编程任务上实现完全异步的 agentic RL；前 30 个测量步骤的中位单步耗时为 263 秒。
AI.conclusion: Miles 提供了完整、可复现且高效的前沿后训练 RL 系统方案，代码与项目网站均已开源，便于研究者与企业直接使用和二次开发。

title: Reading a Legal Question Word by Word: Embedding Trajectories of 2,144 Vietnamese Legal Headlines
summary: A dense retriever encodes a question as one vector, but the question arrives one word at a time. We read 2,144 held-out headlines from Thu Vien Phap Luat (Vietnamese legal library) word by word with Nemotron-3-Embed 8B/1B and Qwen3-Embedding 8B/0.6B, encoding 65,444 prefixes against 20,034 articles, plus every prefix of 3,438 sub-questions from 1,112 multi-question headlines and of 168 answers. (i) The gold article becomes rank 1 after a median of 6-7 content words in every encoder, before the interrogative frame is read, and stays there to the end in 78-85% of cases. (ii) In a multi-question headline the lock is inside the first sub-question 94-98% of the time; the second leaves rank unchanged in 89-95%; encoded alone, the second reaches rank 1 in 42-58% vs 91-96% for the first, at the same lock word (95-97% identical). (iii) Numbers, dates and instrument identifiers move the embedding twice as far as content words and four times as far as interrogative words; 72-78% of steps move toward the gold article, and the closing interrogative frame moves against that direction in 95-99% of headlines. (iv) Rank/cosine clustering yields six archetypes (instant, typical, unstable, late, never-locking) that differ by legal area and form (chi-squared p < 1e-8): real-estate and litigation headlines never lock on a number; environmental and accounting headlines do so a third of the time. (v) An answer read word by word retrieves its article after 8-16 words and addresses the sub-questions in order asked in 83-89% of cases. (vi) A word's step keeps a consistent direction across headlines (cosine 0.25-0.33; 0.44-0.60 for numbers); a preceding question rotates that step by about 60 degrees and a greeting by about 30 degrees; steps shrink as i^{-0.8}; and a two-question headline is within 12-17 degrees of a linear mix of its two questions. We call this a context-modulated additive walk.

AI.tldr: 本文逐词编码2,144条越南法律新闻标题（含3,438条子问题与168条答案的前缀），考察稠密检索器在增量阅读过程中的排序动态，发现金标文章在6-7个实词后即锁定首位，且嵌入轨迹呈现"上下文调制的加性游走"特征。
AI.motivation: 稠密检索器把问题编码为单一向量，但真实问题（如法律新闻标题）是逐词到达的。现有研究缺乏对"逐词增量编码"过程中检索排序如何演变、何时锁定、受何因素影响的系统刻画。作者希望揭示这一过程的经验规律，为流式检索与查询理解提供依据。
AI.method: 对Thu Vien Phap Luat的2,144条留出标题逐词阅读，用Nemotron-3-Embed 8B/1B与Qwen3-Embedding 8B/0.6B编码65,444个前缀，对20,034篇文章进行检索；同时编码1,112条多问题标题下的3,438条子问题及168条答案的全部前缀。通过排名、余弦、步骤方向与聚类分析（含卡方检验、转角测量与i^{-0.8}缩放拟合）提取规律。
AI.result: (i)金标文章在所有编码器中位6-7个实词即达rank 1，78-85%保持至末尾；(ii)多问题标题94-98%在首个子问题内锁定，第二个子问题单独编码时仅42-58%达rank 1（首个为91-96%），锁词95-97%相同；(iii)数字、日期、文书标识步长为实词的两倍、疑问词的四倍，72-78%步朝金标移动，收尾疑问框架95-99%反向；(iv)聚类得六种原型（即时、典型、不稳定、滞后、永不锁定），按法律领域与形式显著差异（p<1e-8）；(v)答案逐词阅读8-16词即检索到文章，83-89%按序回应子问题；(vi)单步方向跨标题一致（余弦0.25-0.33，数字0.44-0.60），前置问题使步旋转约60°、问候约30°，步长按i^{-0.8}衰减，双问题标题与两问题线性混合相差12-17°。
AI.conclusion: 逐词编码并非等价于整体编码：检索排名在疑问框架出现前就已锁定，多问句中后续子问题对排序贡献甚微，数字类词汇主导嵌入位移。上述规律可由"上下文调制的加性游走"描述，即每词的步长方向近似一致但受前后文调制并按幂律衰减，为该动态过程提供了统一模型。

title: Structural Jailbreaks Generalize but Do Not Compound: A cross-provider and multilingual study of Involuntary In-Context Learning
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Pilot study. Includes a cross-family judge-agreement check (kappa=0.86) and output-language verification
summary: Aligned language models fail under two independent pressures: the structural jailbreak class recently formalized as Involuntary In-Context Learning (IICL), which reframes a harmful request as the final missing cell of a data-labeling task completed by pattern rather than judged as content; and the erosion of safety alignment outside English. A natural hypothesis is that these compound. We test it directly. Using a deterministic IICL operator and a StrongREJECT-style rubric judge, we red-team two Google Gemini models on two benchmarks, a 30 general-harm behaviours from HarmBench and 30 financial-abuse behaviours from FinProof, each under a single-shot baseline and under IICL in four languages (English, Spanish, Hindi, Arabic). First, IICL generalizes to a second provider and is worse in finance: it lifts attack success from <=6.7% to 80-90% on HarmBench and 97-100% on FinProof, an order of magnitude above the <=24% its introducing study reported on OpenAI's GPT-5.4. Second, against the hypothesis, forcing the IICL output into a non-English language does not stack the two weaknesses, it attenuates the attack. Eleven of twelve non-English conditions score below their English baseline (sign test, p~0.003), the lone exception a ceiling tie near 100%; on the stronger model's financial set Arabic collapses from 100% to 33%. We attribute this to a relevance curse: once structure has unlocked compliance, the models produce lower-quality harmful content in lower-resource languages, which a substance-grading judge scores as partial. The pattern replicates under an independent non-Google judge (Cohen's kappa=0.86, 377 paired verdicts), and 76.6% of non-English responses were verified in-language. Jailbreak vulnerabilities are therefore not additive; the dominant residual risk is the English structural attack, most acute for financial abuse, not a multilingual one.

AI.tldr: 该论文直接测试"结构性越狱（IICL）"与"非英语安全对齐退化"两种失稳压力是否会叠加，发现二者并不叠加：IICL在第二家厂商与金融滥用领域更严重，但强制输出非英语反而削弱攻击效果。
AI.motivation: 已有两类独立的安全失稳现象：一是被形式化为Involuntary In-Context Learning（IICL）的结构性越狱，将有害请求伪装成数据标注任务中按模式补全的最后一个单元格；二是非英语环境下安全对齐的侵蚀。一个自然的假设是二者会复合叠加，作者希望直接检验这一假设。
AI.method: 使用确定性的IICL算子和StrongREJECT风格的评分裁判，对两个Google Gemini模型进行红队测试。基准为HarmBench的30个一般危害行为与FinProof的30个金融滥用行为，每种行为在单次基线以及四种语言（英语、西班牙语、印地语、阿拉伯语）的IICL条件下测试。采用独立非Google裁判复核，并验证非英语回复的语言真实性。
AI.result: IICL可泛化到第二家厂商且在金融领域更严重：在HarmBench上将攻击成功率从≤6.7%提升至80–90%，在FinProof上达97–100%，比原研究在OpenAI GPT-5.4上报告的≤24%高出一个数量级。但与非叠加假设相反，强制非英语输出削弱攻击：12个非英语条件中11个低于其英语基线（符号检验p≈0.003），唯一例外是接近100%的封顶并列；较强模型金融集上阿拉伯语从100%骤降至33%。作者归因于"相关性诅咒"：结构解锁合规后，模型在低资源语言中产出的有害内容质量更低，被实质性评分裁判判为部分成立。独立裁判复现该模式（Cohen's kappa=0.86，377对判定），76.6%的非英语回复经核验为对应语言。
AI.conclusion: 越狱脆弱性并非可加性叠加；主要残余风险是英语结构性攻击，且在金融滥用领域最为突出，而非多语言风险。

title: GALoc: Gravity Aligned Wireframes for Depth-Free Monocular Floorplan Localization
summary: Floorplans are compact, appearance-invariant maps ideal for indoor localization, yet existing methods rely on depth networks that are brittle in cluttered scenes. We propose GALoc, a geometry-first framework that replaces depth prediction with gravity-aligned wireframes that satisfy verticality and coplanarity by construction. Given monocular RGB, camera intrinsics, relative poses, and IMU orientation, GALoc constructs a linear constraint matrix encoding verticality and coplanarity, and finds the camera gauge minimizing its smallest singular value via global search. The rectified wireframes are projected into bird's-eye-view layouts through a closed-form, FOV-consistent transformation and matched against the floorplan via metric-free SE(2) search. We evaluate end-to-end on Structured3D, with calibrated noise on Gibson, and on real-world author-collected sequences. When sufficient wall geometry is visible, GALoc matches or outperforms depth-based baselines -- achieving 88% sequential localization success at 0.1m over 100-step sequences on Gibson vs the baseline's 68% -- while abstaining in structure-blind scenes.

AI.tldr: GALoc：几何优先的室内定位框架，用重力对齐线框替代深度预测，通过线性约束与SE(2)搜索匹配floorplan。
AI.motivation: 现有基于floorplan的室内定位方法依赖深度网络，在杂乱场景下鲁棒性差、易失效。
AI.method: 输入单目RGB、相机内参、相对位姿与IMU朝向；构建编码垂直性与共面性的线性约束矩阵，通过全局搜索求解最小奇异值最小的相机规范；用闭式、FOV一致的变换将线框投影为鸟瞰布局；以无度量SE(2)搜索与floorplan匹配。
AI.result: 在Structured3D端到端评测、Gibson加标噪声评测及真实序列上验证。墙体几何充分可见时，GALoc匹配或超越深度基线：Gibson 100步序列0.1m成功率88% vs 基线68%；结构盲场景下则弃权。
AI.conclusion: 几何优先的线框方法可在有足够墙体几何时提升室内定位鲁棒性与精度，并在无结构场景中主动弃权。

title: From Coordinates to Candidate Regions: Temporal Change Localization via Region Selection in Remote Sensing Multimodal LLMs
summary: Remote sensing multimodal large language models (RS-MLLMs) have advanced scene understanding and visual question answering over satellite imagery, yet localizing specific objects or changed regions remains challenging. Existing approaches rely on generating bounding box coordinates as token sequences, which is fragile for the small, densely packed objects common in remote sensing and increasingly error-prone when multiple targets must be localized simultaneously. In this work, we present an RS-specific formulation of the region selection paradigm, previously explored in natural-image MLLMs, and extend it to temporal change localization over multi-image sequences. Our framework employs a text-conditioned region proposal module, encodes each candidate as special tokens carrying per-frame visual features enriched with spatial and temporal cues, and lets the LLM localize targets by selecting region tokens in its response. We construct a multi-task training and evaluation suite spanning localization, referring expression, visual grounding, and understanding tasks across single-image and multi-temporal settings. Experiments show that our approach substantially outperforms coordinate-generation baselines on temporal change localization, while improving single-image visual grounding and maintaining competitive understanding performance. Oracle analysis decomposes the contributions of the region proposer and the LLM selector, providing diagnostic insight unique to this framework. Our code will be available at https://github.com/juwan-kr/RS-RegionSelect.

AI.tldr: 该论文面向遥感多模态大模型（RS-MLLM），提出一种面向遥感场景的“区域选择”范式，并扩展到多图像时序变化定位：通过文本条件区域提议模块生成候选区域，将其编码为带有时空视觉特征的特殊token，由LLM在回答中直接选择区域token完成定位。
AI.motivation: 现有RS-MLLM在卫星图像场景理解与视觉问答上已有进展，但目标定位与变化区域定位仍困难。主流做法让模型以token序列生成边界框坐标，这种方式对遥感中普遍存在的小目标、密集目标很脆弱，且在多目标同时定位时更易出错。作者希望引入自然图像MLLM中已验证的“区域选择”范式，并针对遥感特性重新形式化，同时推广到时序多图变化定位。
AI.method: 1）提出面向遥感的区域选择范式，替代坐标生成；2）使用文本条件（text-conditioned）区域提议模块产生候选区域；3）将每个候选编码为特殊token，携带逐帧视觉特征，并融入空间与时序线索；4）LLM通过在其响应中选择区域token来实现目标定位，并支持多图像序列上的时序变化定位；5）构建覆盖定位、指代表达、视觉定位与理解任务的多任务训练与评测套件，涵盖单图与多时相设置。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在时序变化定位上显著优于坐标生成基线；在单图视觉定位上也有提升，同时保持具有竞争力的理解性能。此外，oracle分析对区域提议器与LLM选择器各自的贡献进行分解，提供了该框架特有的诊断性洞察。
AI.conclusion: 区域选择范式可有效缓解遥感MLLM中坐标生成定位的脆弱性问题，并自然扩展到多时相变化定位；通过多任务评测与oracle分解，验证了区域提议与LLM选择两部分的互补作用。代码将开源。

title: Towards Embodied Air-Ground Cooperative Object Search: Benchmark, Dataset and Agentic Method
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables; includes an appendix
summary: Air-Ground Object Search (AGOS) in urban environments is a challenging embodied task, which requires an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) and an Unmanned Ground Vehicle (UGV) to jointly search for and verify a specified target vehicle from multi-view visual references. To study this underexplored problem, we introduce AGOS-Bench, the first dedicated benchmark for evaluating whether general-purpose Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can integrate aerial discoveries and ground-level verification through UAV-UGV cooperation. We further provide AGOS-Dataset as the companion resource of exemplary trajectories constructed by an automatic pipeline. It consists of 7.7k episodes for searching objects of diverse categories and attributes, spanning three difficulty levels. To address the AGOS task, we propose AGOS-Agent, a training-free and tool-augmented approach. The agentic method relieves VLMs from complex and dynamic coordination via a deliberate search-handoff-verify cooperation protocol, only demanding VLMs for scene understanding and decision-making. Extensive experiments on nine VLMs show that AGOS-Agent improves overall success rate for eight of the nine evaluated backbones while reducing decision steps for all nine. On the hard split, the SR and SPL of Gemini-3.6-Flash increase from 8.6% to 55.7% and from 7.6% to 44.0%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出城市环境空地协同目标搜索任务AGOS，并构建首个专用基准AGOS-Bench与配套数据集，提出免训练、工具增强的AGOS-Agent方法，显著提升多种VLM的成功率与效率。
AI.motivation: 空地协同目标搜索（AGOS）是具身智能中的挑战性任务，需UAV与UGV联合完成目标搜索与验证，但该问题尚缺乏系统研究，也缺少评估通用VLM能否胜任空地协同的专用基准。
AI.method: 作者提出AGOS-Bench基准与AGOS-Dataset数据集（含7.7k条自动生成轨迹，覆盖多类别属性目标与三级难度）；并提出AGOS-Agent，一种免训练、工具增强的智能体方法，通过"搜索-交接-验证"协作协议将复杂动态协调从VLM中剥离，仅由VLM负责场景理解与决策。
AI.result: 在九种VLM上实验显示，AGOS-Agent使其中八种整体成功率提升，并使全部九种模型的决策步数减少；在困难划分上，Gemini-3.6-Flash的SR由8.6%提升至55.7%，SPL由7.6%提升至44.0%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了空地协同目标搜索基准的空白，验证了免训练工具增强智能体在跨空地基座协同任务中的有效性，为通用VLM的具身协同能力提供了新评估范式与解决思路。

title: Environments as Scaffold: Enriching Feedback to Bootstrap Self-Evolving Agents in Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: Large Language Models demonstrate remarkable proficiency in static reasoning, yet training them as autonomous agents through Reinforcement Learning (RL) for long-horizon tasks is often hindered by severe reward sparsity. While conventional \textit{agent-side warming} up via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can alleviate this, it is frequently limited by data scarcity and constrained exploration. To address this, we propose a paradigm shift to \textit{environment-side adaptation} by constructing \textbf{F}eedback-\textbf{E}nriched \textbf{E}nvironments (\textbf{FEEs}). Through a pilot study, we establish a feedback design strategy that reformulates environments by transitioning from action guidance to observation enrichment during the later stages of both intra-episode exploration and inter-episode evolution. Large-scale experiments on SciWorld and BFCL benchmarks using various Qwen3 model scales and RL algorithms such as GRPO, GSPO, and DAPO demonstrate that FEEs consistently yield performance improvements over standard settings. Furthermore, our analysis reveals that training with FEEs \textbf{(1)} stabilizes training dynamics by reducing entropy volatility, \textbf{(2)} facilitates proactive state-space exploration in difficult tasks, \textbf{(3) }ensures the internalization of environmental guidance into policy weights rather than acting as a mere inference-time prior, and \textbf{(4) }identifies intra-group feedback consistency as a critical boundary for stable optimization.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"环境侧适配"新范式，通过构建反馈丰富环境（FEEs）缓解LLM智能体RL训练中的奖励稀疏问题，在多基准和多算法上取得稳定提升。
AI.motivation: LLM虽具备强静态推理能力，但用RL训练其为长程自主智能体时面临严重奖励稀疏；传统"智能体侧预热"（SFT）受限于数据稀缺与探索受限。
AI.method: 转向环境侧适配，构建反馈丰富环境（FEEs）。通过试点研究确立反馈设计策略：在回合内探索与回合间演化的后期阶段，将环境反馈从动作引导转变为观测丰富。
AI.result: 在SciWorld与BFCL基准上，使用多规模Qwen3模型及GRPO、GSPO、DAPO等RL算法，FEEs相较标准设置持续带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: FEEs训练可：(1)降低熵波动、稳定训练动态；(2)促进困难任务中的主动状态空间探索；(3)将环境引导内化到策略权重而非仅作推理时先验；(4)确认组内反馈一致性是稳定优化的关键边界。

title: Compositional Multilingual and Behavioral Attribute Steering
summary: This study examines the compositionality of steering vectors for language and behavioral control in large language models. Focusing on language, jailbreak, and conciseness, we investigate whether additive, training-free composition of attribute steering vectors can preserve the intended steering effect of each attribute, across four instruction-tuned models from two model families and two size scales. We find that single-attribute steering is reliable for all three attributes, but only within an appropriate combination of intervention layer and steering strength, with abstract behaviors (jailbreak, conciseness) favoring middle layers and language favoring earlier layers. We show that additive composition of two attribute vectors succeeds in steering both attributes simultaneously when each is injected at its own best-performing layer, and that this partially extends to three simultaneously composed attributes, addressing an inconsistency left open by prior work on training-free composition. We further analyze the geometric properties of these steering vectors, finding that they are approximately orthogonal in the residual stream, consistent with their compositional behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型中用于语言和行为控制的引导向量的可组合性，发现加性、免训练的组合方式在各自最佳层注入时可同时生效，并给出几何解释。
AI.motivation: 先前关于免训练组合的工作对加性组合引导向量是否可行存在不一致结论，本文旨在厘清多属性引导向量能否通过简单加性组合同时保持各属性的引导效果。
AI.method: 针对语言、越狱、简洁三种属性，在来自两个模型家族、两种参数规模的四个指令微调模型上，考察加性、免训练的引导向量组合；分析干预层与引导强度的最佳搭配，并在各属性各自最佳层注入进行两属性及三属性同时组合，同时分析引导向量在残差流中的几何性质。
AI.result: 单属性引导对三种属性均可靠，但仅在合适的干预层与引导强度组合下有效：抽象行为（越狱、简洁）偏好中间层，语言偏好较早层；两属性加性组合在各属性最佳层注入时可同时引导二者，三属性同时组合部分有效；引导向量在残差流中近似正交，与其可组合行为一致。
AI.conclusion: 加性、免训练的多属性引导向量组合具有可行性，最佳层选择对效果至关重要，向量的近似正交性为其可组合性提供了几何支撑，部分解答了先前工作中的分歧。

title: CAR-MIL: Counterfactual Attention Regularization for Multiple Instance Learning
summary: Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) is widely used for weakly supervised learning, particularly in digital pathology, where fine-grained annotations are costly. Most MIL methods aggregate instance features via attention mechanisms. However, attention weights do not always faithfully reflect instance importance and may focus on spuriously correlated regions. In this work, we propose CAR-MIL, a framework that explicitly guides attention learning through a counterfactual attention regularization objective inspired by counterfactual explanations. Built on a standard attention-based MIL architecture, our approach introduces a lightweight counterfactual attention branch trained to produce an alternative prediction while remaining close to the factual attention distribution. This encourages prediction changes to arise from minimal, structured redistributions of attention, leading to more informative evidence allocation. The resulting factual and counterfactual attention maps capture complementary evidence: the former highlights regions supporting the prediction, while the latter reveals regions whose reweighting would challenge it. We evaluate our method on synthetic MIL benchmarks with instance-level ground truth enabling controlled analysis of attention behavior and on five digital pathology datasets across four tasks. CAR-MIL maintains competitive classification performance, with the largest gains observed on more challenging tasks, while improving attention reliability, demonstrating the benefits of integrating counterfactual explainability reasoning into attention learning. Code is available at: https://github.com/ImaneCR/CAR-MIL/.

AI.tldr: 提出CAR-MIL框架，通过反事实注意力正则化显式引导MIL中的注意力学习，在保持竞争性分类性能的同时提升注意力可靠性。
AI.motivation: 多示例学习广泛用于弱监督学习，尤其在数字病理领域因细粒度标注代价高昂。现有MIL方法多通过注意力机制聚合示例特征，但注意力权重并不总能忠实反映示例重要性，可能聚焦于伪相关区域，导致证据分配不可靠。
AI.method: 在标准注意力MIL架构基础上，引入一个轻量级反事实注意力分支。该分支被训练为在保持与事实注意力分布接近的同时产生替代预测，从而通过反事实注意力正则化目标显式引导注意力学习，促使预测改变源自最小化、结构化的注意力重分布。
AI.result: 在具备示例级真值的合成MIL基准上进行受控注意力行为分析，并在四个任务的五个数字病理数据集上评估。CAR-MIL保持竞争性分类性能，在更具挑战性的任务上增益最大，同时提升注意力可靠性。事实与反事实注意力图捕获互补证据。
AI.conclusion: 将反事实可解释性推理引入注意力学习可带来收益，CAR-MIL验证了该思路在提升注意力可靠性和困难任务性能方面的有效性。

title: In RAG We Trust? Measuring Robustness of Retrieval-Augmented Generation Under Post-Retrieval Context Tampering
comment: 4 figures. Preprint also available on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22980485
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds a language model in retrieved documents, which reduces hallucination but creates a new attack surface: if retrieved text is tampered with, the model may repeat the falsehood. We study how much a small quantized model, Llama 3.1 8B, degrades when a fraction of its retrieved context is poisoned. Three corruption strategies are tested, entity swap, number swap, and negation, each applied to zero, one, two, or three of the three retrieved passages, over a factorial sweep of 588 runs on a fact-checking task built from FEVER. Accuracy falls from 77.9% on clean context to 43.5% when all three passages are corrupted. Entity swap flips the largest share of answers that were correct on clean context. Number-based corruption stays flat while poisoned passages are a minority and jumps once they form a majority, a pattern we re-check with query-level bootstrap intervals. The model rarely invents new falsehoods; its dominant reaction is to abstain, and a lexical overlap proxy of unsupported generation falls under attack rather than rising. The study is a small-scale measurement with coarse automated labels; we treat the strategy contrasts as suggestive until decoding is controlled and stronger adjudication is in place.

AI.tldr: 通过 588 次因子实验，测量 Llama 3.1 8B 在检索上下文被部分投毒时的性能退化：全污染时准确率从 77.9% 降至 43.5%，主要反应是弃答而非生成新虚假信息。
AI.motivation: RAG 通过检索文档为语言模型提供依据，可减少幻觉，但也引入了新的攻击面：若检索文本被篡改，模型可能复述其中的虚假内容。本文旨在量化小规模量化模型在检索上下文部分被投毒时的性能退化程度。
AI.method: 在基于 FEVER 构建的事实核查任务上，对 Llama 3.1 8B（量化版）的三段检索段落实施三类污染策略——实体替换、数字替换、否定，每类分别污染 0/1/2/3 段，开展 588 次因子扫描实验，并用查询级 bootstrap 区间复核数字污染的模式。
AI.result: 干净上下文准确率为 77.9%，三段全部被污染时降至 43.5%。实体替换导致最多原本正确的答案翻转。数字污染在污染段落占少数时保持平稳，一旦成为多数便骤升（经查询级 bootstrap 区间复核）。模型很少编造新的虚假信息，其主导反应是弃答；用于衡量无支撑生成的词面重叠代理指标在攻击下反而下降而非上升。
AI.conclusion: 该研究属于小规模测量，标签为粗粒度自动标注；在解码过程得到控制、更严格的裁定机制到位之前，策略间的对比应视为提示性结论。

title: AirAnchor: Bridging Local and Global Spatial Information for Zero-Shot Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation requires drones to follow natural-language instructions and navigate through complex urban environments. Accurate navigation relies on both local and global spatial information, which support immediate action grounding and long-horizon path planning, respectively. However, existing zero-shot methods typically operate at a single spatial scale, relying either on local representations constructed online from current observations or on global memories built offline from historical experience. To address this limitation, we propose AirAnchor, a new paradigm that bridges local and global spatial information through spatial anchors and integrates both into a shared navigation framework, enabling comprehensive spatial grounding for decision-making. AirAnchor consists of three core components: (1) Query-Driven Spatial Anchor Grounding, which identifies decision-relevant anchors from visual observations and organizes them into local spatial representations; (2) Persistent Object Spatial Memory, which incrementally maintains an object knowledge base as persistent global spatial memory and retrieves landmark-related spatial priors; and (3) a Spatially-Informed Navigation Agent, which explicitly integrates both local and global spatial information into an agentic framework for decision-making. Extensive experiments on AerialVLN demonstrate that AirAnchor substantially outperforms existing zero-shot baselines, validating the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed paradigm.

AI.tldr: 提出AirAnchor范式，通过空间锚点桥接局部与全局空间信息，统一融入零样本空中视觉语言导航框架，在AerialVLN上显著超越现有零样本基线。
AI.motivation: 空中视觉语言导航需同时依赖局部空间信息（即时动作接地）与全局空间信息（长程路径规划），但现有零样本方法通常只在单一空间尺度上操作：或依赖在线构建的局部表征，或依赖离线构建的全局记忆，缺乏二者的融合。
AI.method: AirAnchor包含三个核心组件：(1) Query-Driven Spatial Anchor Grounding，从视觉观测中识别与决策相关的锚点并组织为局部空间表征；(2) Persistent Object Spatial Memory，增量维护物体知识库作为持久全局空间记忆，并检索地标相关的空间先验；(3) Spatially-Informed Navigation Agent，将局部与全局空间信息显式集成到智能体框架中进行决策。
AI.result: 在AerialVLN上的大量实验表明，AirAnchor大幅优于现有零样本基线，验证了所提范式的有效性与高效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过空间锚点桥接并统一局部与全局空间信息，可为零样本空中视觉语言导航提供更全面的空间接地，是一种有效且高效的导航范式。

title: GSComplete: Gaussian Splat Completion with 2D Diffusion Priors
summary: Gaussian splats provide a fast, high-fidelity representation for 3D objects but are often constructed from incomplete input data in practice, leaving missing regions. Existing completion methods either do not preserve the original splats or require scarcely available 3D training data. We propose GSComplete, which combines 3D generation based on Score Distillation Sampling with a novel preservation loss that encourages the original splats to be preserved where they should be visible. This effectively completes the Gaussian splat object using only 2D diffusion priors while fully preserving existing splats and generating new splats only in missing regions, without occluding the input. To evaluate our approach, we introduce a new dataset of partial Gaussian splat objects and show that GSComplete achieves significantly more accurate preservation of the input than existing methods with comparable plausibility of the completed result. Our code and dataset will be made available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GSComplete，结合基于 Score Distillation Sampling 的 3D 生成与新颖的保留损失，仅用 2D 扩散先验补全高斯溅射的缺失区域，同时完整保留原始溅射且不遮挡输入。
AI.motivation: 高斯溅射能快速高保真地表示 3D 物体，但实际中常由不完整输入构建而留下缺失区域。现有补全方法要么无法保留原始溅射，要么依赖稀缺的 3D 训练数据，因此需要一种既保留原有溅射又仅依赖 2D 先验的补全方案。
AI.method: 提出 GSComplete：将基于 Score Distillation Sampling 的 3D 生成与新颖的保留损失（preservation loss）相结合。该损失鼓励在应当可见的位置保留原始溅射，从而在仅使用 2D 扩散先验的情况下，完整保留已有溅射，且仅在缺失区域生成新溅射，避免遮挡输入。
AI.result: 引入一个新的部分高斯溅射物体数据集进行评估。实验表明，在与现有方法相当的补全合理性下，GSComplete 对输入的保留显著更准确。
AI.conclusion: GSComplete 有效利用 2D 扩散先验补全高斯溅射物体，在保持补全合理性的同时实现对原始输入的高精度保留；代码与数据集将在论文被接收后公开。

title: Detecting Authorship in Political Texts with Inductive Stylometry
comment: 34 pages, 17 figures, 3 tables. Includes appendices A-D (validation materials and discriminant validity checks). Under review
summary: Political texts are rarely authored by the nominal speaker alone. Tweets, speeches, reports, and official statements are drafted, edited, or harmonized by staff, yet political science has paid limited attention to the stylistic traces these hidden authors leave behind. This paper develops and stress-tests an inductive stylometric approach for recovering latent authorship structure in political communication, combining character 3-gram features with UMAP dimensionality reduction, and Burrows' Delta. We apply the approach to six corpora that vary in length (from tweets to long documents), in mode (written and oral), and in language (English and Hungarian). The approach recovers near-disjoint analyst fingerprints in formal legal prose in both languages, sorts a politician's tweets into validated subsets while uncovering additional insights, and distinguishes scripted from improvised speech.
