It fails, however, to resolve individual speechwriters within scripted corpora. Frequency-based stylometry is thus a powerful tool that, depending on authorial signal strength and institutional editing, can uncover authorship traces relevant to legislative studies, political communication, and policy research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并压力测试了一种归纳式文体计量方法，结合字符3-gram特征、UMAP降维与Burrows' Delta，用于在政治传播文本中还原隐藏的作者结构，并在六个多语言、多体裁语料上进行验证。
AI.motivation: 政治文本往往并非由名义发言者独立撰写，而是由幕僚起草、编辑或统一润色，但政治学对这些"隐藏作者"留下的文体痕迹关注有限，缺乏系统识别潜在作者结构的工具。
AI.method: 采用归纳式文体计量路径：提取字符3-gram特征，使用UMAP进行降维，并结合Burrows' Delta距离度量；在长度（推文到长文档）、模态（书面与口头）和语言（英语与匈牙利语）各异的六个语料上进行压力测试。
AI.result: 在英、匈两种语言的形式法律文本中能还原近乎互斥的分析者指纹；可将某政治人物的推文划分为经校验的子集并发现额外规律；能区分照稿演讲与即兴发言；但无法在照稿语料中区分出个体撰稿人。
AI.conclusion: 基于频率的文体计量学取决于作者信号强度与机构编辑程度，是一种可揭示作者痕迹的有力工具，对立法研究、政治传播与政策研究具有应用价值。

title: Do Reviewers Still Reward Lexical Complexity? A Frozen-Rater Study of Preference Drift in 124K ICLR Reviews
comment: 23 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables. Code and the machine-readable records behind every number: https://github.com/Biajin-PKU/frozen-rater-drift
summary: Large language models have collapsed the cost of producing lexically elaborate prose, and whether peer reviewers still reward it is a question about the evaluator, not about the text. When the association between a writing cue and review scores moves across years, the reviewers may have changed, the submissions may have changed, or both, and a regression of scores on text cannot say which. We separate the two with a frozen rater: 81,850 machine reviews of ICLR submissions from 2018 to 2025, all generated in one February-April 2025 window with one model family and one prompt, so that its year-to-year coefficients track submission composition alone and the human-minus-frozen trend difference identifies reviewer preference drift. On 32,638 submissions with 124,615 human reviews, the human coefficient on non-domain lexical complexity falls from +0.142 to -0.015 while the frozen rater moves from +0.080 to +0.082; the three-way difference-in-differences is -0.0100 (q=0.013), and forty random-wordlist placebos through the same specification centre on zero. Humans still reward sentence-length variability, which the frozen rater never registers, while the frozen rater still pays for lexical complexity at its earlier rate. Every claim is held to a double gate of false-discovery control and interval exclusion, and the findings that failed adversarial re-testing are reported. Reviewers discounted a cue whose production cost collapsed, as models of manipulable signals prescribe; an LLM judge calibrated to historical human preferences inherits the earlier schedule and drifts out of alignment while its agreement with humans on totals stays ordinary.

AI.tldr: 通过"冻结评审器"(2025年单一模型统一生成的81,850条机器评审)与人类评审对比，分离投稿构成变化与审稿人偏好漂移：人类对非领域词汇复杂度的评分系数从+0.142降至-0.015，而冻结评审器保持稳定(+0.080→+0.082)，三重差分-0.0100(q=0.013)，说明审稿人确实降低了对"生成成本崩塌型"写作线索的奖励。
AI.motivation: LLM大幅降低了华丽辞藻的生产成本，但"审稿人是否仍为此付费"本质上是评估者的问题而非文本的问题。当某个写作线索与评审分数的关联跨年变化时，可能是审稿人变了、投稿变了，或两者兼有，而单纯把分数回归到文本上无法区分。作者需要一个能"冻结"评审者这一侧、从而让年度系数只反映投稿构成变化的设计。
AI.method: 以81,850条ICLR投稿(2018–2025)的机器评审作为"冻结评审器"：全部在2025年2–4月同一时间窗口、同一模型家族、同一提示下生成，因此其年度系数只追踪投稿构成；用人类评审减去冻结评审器的趋势差来识别审稿人偏好漂移。样本涵盖32,638篇投稿、124,615条人类评审。采用三重差分识别，并设置40个随机词表安慰剂检验；所有结论通过错误发现率控制与区间排除的"双重门"检验，并报告未通过对抗性重测的发现。
AI.result: 人类评审对非领域词汇复杂度的系数由+0.142降至-0.015，冻结评审器则由+0.080升至+0.082；三重差分-0.0100(q=0.013)。40个随机词表安慰剂经同一设定后集中于零。人类仍奖励句长变异性(冻结评审器从未捕捉到该信号)，而冻结评审器仍按早期费率奖励词汇复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 审稿人确实折价了一个生产成本已崩塌的线索，与"可操纵信号"理论模型的预测一致；而以历史人类偏好校准的LLM评审器会继承旧的评分规则，在总量一致性看似正常的同时逐渐与人类偏好脱节。

title: AURORA: Active Uncertainty-Driven Re-Orientation for In-Hand Reconstruction
comment: 23 pages, 11 figures, 6 tables. Accepted to the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026)
summary: Observing objects grasped by a robot hand is challenging due to severe visual occlusions. Although in-hand manipulation can expose hidden surfaces, existing approaches often rely on predefined or open-loop reorientation strategies that do not explicitly target under-observed regions. We propose AURORA, an active 3D reconstruction framework that closes the loop between online object-centric reconstruction and in-hand reorientation. At its core, Ray-GPIS estimates direction-wise reconstruction uncertainty along candidate viewing rays and selects next-best-view targets using an uncertainty--novelty objective, which are realized through an axis-conditioned in-hand rotation policy. The resulting RGB-D observations are fused incrementally using CAD-free 6D pose tracking and lightweight geometric reconstruction. Experiments demonstrate that AURORA improves reconstruction quality and information-acquisition efficiency over non-active rotation strategies, while Ray-GPIS also outperforms active view-planning baselines in reconstruction performance, action-ranking quality, and planning efficiency. Targeted ablations further validate its robustness to hand occlusion and pose errors. The project webpage is available at https://aurorahand.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出AURORA主动式3D重建框架，通过Ray-GPIS不确定性引导的臂内旋转实现闭环重建，提升重建质量与信息获取效率。
AI.motivation: 机器人抓取物体时视觉遮挡严重，现有臂内操作方法多依赖预定义或开环重定向策略，不显式针对观察不足区域，难以暴露被遮挡表面。
AI.method: AURORA将在线物体中心重建与手内重定向闭环耦合；核心Ray-GPIS沿候选视线估计方向性重建不确定性，用不确定性-新颖性目标选择下一最佳视角，并经轴条件化的手内旋转策略实现；RGB-D观测通过无CAD的6D位姿跟踪与轻量几何重建增量融合。
AI.result: 实验表明AURORA在重建质量和信息获取效率上优于非主动旋转策略；Ray-GPIS在重建性能、动作排序质量和规划效率上优于主动视角规划基线；针对性消融验证了对抓取遮挡与位姿误差的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 闭环耦合不确定性与手内重定向可有效提升遮挡下的主动3D重建性能与效率。

title: SignRefine: Adapting Foundational Video Models for Sign Language Generation
summary: Sign language video generation demands precise hand and facial articulation, yet modern video diffusion models, trained predominantly on spoken-language video, produce artifacts that render signing unintelligible. We propose SignRefine, a sign language video generation model that produces comprehensible signing from 2D keypoint conditioning alone, generalizing across appearances and visual conditions. Our approach builds on a pretrained video diffusion transformer and introduces local adapters with spatial grounding to selectively refine hand and face regions, steering the strong base model's prior toward accurate articulation. To enable this work and support broader sign language research, we present NVSign, a large-scale dataset of video content natively produced in sign language, offering diverse signer appearances, environments, and natural conversational settings. Trained on this data, our model shows up to 30% improvement in hand pose precision metrics over the strongest baseline and is preferred by sign language users for visual quality and comprehensibility in more than 80% of comparisons.

AI.tldr: SignRefine：基于预训练视频扩散Transformer，仅用2D关键点条件生成手语视频，通过空间定位的局部适配器精修手部与面部区域；同时发布原生态手语数据集NVSign，手部姿态精度提升达30%，80%以上对比中被手语使用者偏好。
AI.motivation: 现代视频扩散模型主要在口语视频上训练，生成手语时会产生伪影，导致手势不可理解；而手语视频生成对精细的手部与面部articulation要求极高，现有模型难以满足。此外，缺乏原生手语视频数据也制约了该领域研究。
AI.method: 构建在预训练视频扩散Transformer之上的SignRefine：引入带空间定位（spatial grounding）的局部适配器（local adapters），选择性地精修手部与面部区域，将强基座模型的先验引导至准确articulation；仅依赖2D关键点条件，实现跨外观与视觉条件的泛化。同时构建大规模原生手语视频数据集NVSign，涵盖多样化的手语者外观、环境与自然对话场景，并在此数据上训练模型。
AI.result: 相比最强基线，手部姿态精度指标提升最高达30%；在超过80%的对比中，手语使用者更偏好该模型在视觉质量与可理解性上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 利用空间定位的局部适配器精修基座扩散模型的关键区域，可有效提升手语视频的可理解性，且仅需2D关键点条件即可泛化；原生手语数据集NVSign为该任务及更广泛的手语研究提供了支撑。

title: Unlabeled Echoes: Pseudo-Labels and Genus-Aware Smoothing for Bat Call Recognition
summary: Passive acoustic monitoring produces far more bat recordings than experts can label. We show that simple model-generated pseudo-labels turn this surplus into effective supervision. We compare pseudo-labeling with other semi-supervised learning methods on an 18-species European corpus using only 10% of its training labels, then transfer the strongest approaches to South African field audio containing nine bat taxa and a nuisance class. Pseudo-labeling outperforms the other semi-supervised learning methods on every European measure, recovering up to 61.5% of the gap to full supervision. It transfers to field audio with gains of 10.69 points in species accuracy and 4.96 points in species macro-F1. We also introduce genus-aware smoothing, which directs uncertain target mass toward congeneric species. Combined with uniform smoothing, it reaches 79.16 species macro-F1, 4.73 points above hard targets. Simple pseudo-labels are therefore highly effective at this ecological data scale, while genus-aware targets inject useful biological structure at no annotation cost. https://code4conservation.github.io/UnlabeledEchoes/

AI.tldr: 简单的模型伪标签可将大量未标注蝙蝠录音转化为有效监督信号：在欧洲18物种语料上仅用10%训练标签即优于其他半监督方法，并在南非野外音频中实现稳健迁移。
AI.motivation: 被动声学监测产生的蝙蝠录音远超专家标注能力，如何利用海量无标签数据、降低标注成本是核心问题。
AI.method: 以10%训练标签的欧洲18物种语料为基准，将伪标签与其他半监督学习方法对比，并将最优方法迁移至含9个蝙蝠类群及1个干扰类的南非野外音频；同时提出属级感知平滑（genus-aware smoothing），将不确定的目标质量导向同属物种，并与均匀平滑结合使用。
AI.result: 伪标签在欧洲所有评价指标上均优于其他半监督方法，最多弥补至全监督差距的61.5%；迁移至野外音频后物种准确率提升10.69个点、物种宏F1提升4.96个点。属感知平滑结合均匀平滑达到79.16的物种宏F1，比硬目标高4.73个点。
AI.conclusion: 在此生态数据规模下，简单伪标签极为有效；属级感知目标在不增加标注成本的前提下引入了有用的生物学结构。

title: Temporal State Transport in Video Generation: Diagnosing and Correcting Spectral Imbalance
summary: Reliable video generation requires more than high-quality frames to form a coherent story: a model must maintain a persistent state, transporting visual attributes such as identity, scene layout, motion, and fine details across time. Existing training-free methods mainly strengthen cross-frame attention or analyze local attention entropy, but these views do not reveal whether temporal interactions stay in a healthy transport regime. In this work, we study video generation through the perspective of Temporal State Transport. We introduce Spectral Tension, a signed diagnostic that compares local attention diffuseness with global spectral diversity, and use it to identify two opposite temporal failures: fragmented transport and over-mixing hotspots. Based on this diagnosis, we propose Spectral Transport Homeostasis, a training-free regulator that softly corrects pathological temporal states while largely preserving balanced ones. Experiments on pretrained video generation models show that the original model often occupies imbalanced temporal regimes, whereas our method selectively applies larger corrections to the worst temporal hotspots and improves temporal consistency and visual quality without finetuning. Code: https://github.com/lytang63/temporal-state-transport

AI.tldr: 该论文从"时间状态传输"视角研究视频生成，提出谱张力诊断指标并据此设计无需训练的动态调节器，改善时间一致性与视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 可靠的视频生成不仅需要高质量单帧，还需模型维持持久状态，将身份、场景布局、运动、细节等视觉属性跨时间传递。现有免训练方法多聚焦于增强跨帧注意力或分析局部注意力熵，但这些视角无法揭示时间交互是否处于健康的传输状态。
AI.method: 提出 Temporal State Transport（时间状态传输）视角，引入 Spectral Tension（谱张力）作为有符号诊断量，比较局部注意力扩散度与全局谱多样性，用于识别两类相反的时间失效：碎片化传输与过度混合热点。基于该诊断提出 Spectral Transport Homeostasis，一种无需训练的动态调节器，对病态时间状态进行温和校正，同时基本保留平衡状态。
AI.result: 在预训练视频生成模型上的实验表明，原始模型常处于不平衡的时间状态；所提方法能选择性对最差的时间热点施加更大幅度的校正，在无需微调的情况下提升时间一致性与视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过谱张力诊断时间状态传输是否健康，并施加自适应的免训练调节，可有效纠正视频生成中失衡的时间动力学，实现更连贯的视频生成。

title: Same Values, Different Languages? From Multilingual Probing to Steering LLMs Toward Chinese Social Values
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into human society, aligning them with pluralistic social values has become a critical priority. However, whether LLMs exhibit consistent value preferences across languages remains underexplored, particularly for culturally grounded values, which are more abstract and difficult to evaluate and align than safety-centric principles. We investigate this issue through Chinese Social Values (CSV), a value system rooted in Chinese culture and comprising $12$ dimensions across national, societal, and personal levels. We construct C-Voices, the first comprehensive multilingual contrastive probe dataset for CSV, with 86,400 dilemma-based instances in six languages, each pairing a CSV-aligned action with a value-conflicting alternative. Building on the contrastive probes of C-Voices, we then propose a fine-tuning-free value vector steering method that derives value directions from hidden-state discrepancies and selectively intervenes on value-sensitive layers during inference. Experiments on six languages show that CSV-oriented preferences are model-dependent and language-sensitive, with the same dilemma eliciting divergent responses across languages. Our method achieves effective CSV steering, supports cross-lingual transfer of value vectors, and generalizes to existing FLAMES and ValuePrism.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了首个面向中国文化社会价值观（CSV）的多语言对比探针数据集C-Voices（6种语言、86,400条困境实例），并提出免微调的价值向量引导方法，通过隐状态差异导出价值方向并在推理时干预价值敏感层，实现有效的跨语言价值对齐。
AI.motivation: LLM日益融入人类社会，与其对齐多元社会价值成为关键议题；但LLM是否在不同语言间表现出一致的价值偏好尚缺乏研究，尤其对于比安全原则更抽象、更难评估与对齐的文化根植型价值观。因此需要系统考察跨语言的价值偏好一致性及其可对齐性。
AI.method: 1) 以植根中国文化、涵盖国家/社会/个人三个层面共12个维度的CSV（中国社会价值观）体系为对象；2) 构建C-Voices数据集，包含6种语言、86,400条困境式实例，每条将一个符合CSV的行为与一个价值冲突选项配对，形成多语言对比探针；3) 基于对比探针，提出免微调的价值向量引导方法：从隐状态差异中导出价值方向，并在推理时对价值敏感层进行选择性干预。
AI.result: 在6种语言上的实验表明：CSV导向的价值偏好具有模型依赖性和语言敏感性，同一困境在不同语言下会引发不一致的回答；所提方法能有效实现CSV引导，支持价值向量的跨语言迁移，并可泛化到现有FLAMES与ValuePrism基准。
AI.conclusion: LLM的文化根植型价值偏好并不跨语言一致，需以多语言对比方式评估与干预；基于对比探针的价值向量引导为免微调、可跨语言迁移且具泛化性的价值对齐提供了有效路径。

title: ICDAR2026 Competition on Multimodal Reasoning over Documents in Multiple Domains
summary: In this report we present results of the ICDAR2026 Competition on Multimodal Reasoning over Documents in Multiple Domains. This competition aimed to advance research in document understanding through the task of Visual Question Answering (VQA). Building upon previous DocVQA benchmarks, this competition introduces challenging reasoning questions over a diverse collection of documents spanning eight domains, including business reports, scientific papers, slides, posters, maps, comics, infographics, and engineering drawings. The competition concluded with 20 valid submissions from 8 teams spanning zero-shot VLMs, OCR and parser-augmented pipelines, agentic retrieval systems, multi-agent ensembles, and fine-tuned multimodal models. The results show that the strongest systems move beyond single-pass prompting and instead rely on structured evidence extraction, retrieval, verification, and orchestration across multiple components.

AI.tldr: 本报告总结了ICDAR2026多领域文档多模态推理竞赛，基于VQA任务，覆盖八个文档领域，最终收到8支团队20份有效提交，结果表明靠单次提示不够，需结构化证据抽取、检索、验证与多组件编排。
AI.motivation: 推动文档理解研究，通过视觉问答（VQA）任务提升对多领域复杂文档的推理能力，并在既有DocVQA基准基础上引入更具挑战性的推理型问题。
AI.method: 竞赛以多领域文档集合上的VQA为核心任务，文档涵盖商业报告、科学论文、幻灯片、海报、地图、漫画、信息图和工程图纸八个领域；参赛系统包括零样本VLM、OCR与解析器增强流程、智能体检索系统、多智能体集成以及微调多模态模型。
AI.result: 竞赛共收到来自8支团队的20份有效提交；表现最强的系统不再依赖单次提示，而是采用结构化证据抽取、检索、验证和多组件编排。
AI.conclusion: 多领域文档多模态推理的最优方案正从单一模型单轮提示转向包含证据抽取、检索、验证与编排的多组件系统，这为未来文档理解研究提供了方向。

title: Layer Selection in VLMs for Zero-Shot OOD Detection via Multi-Resolution Entropy Estimation
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is crucial for safe deployment of medical AI systems, where domain shifts arise across institutions, acquisition protocols, and patient populations. VLMs enable zero-shot OOD detection by embedding images into a language-aligned latent space, where cross-modal similarity serves as a non-parametric confidence signal for identifying in-distribution samples. Yet existing methods rely almost exclusively on final-layer embeddings, implicitly assuming that the deepest representations are universally optimal. We first show that this assumption does not hold in medical imaging: intermediate layers provide complementary OOD signals, and the optimal representational depth depends on the respective image modality. While prior work selects layer combinations via entropy minimization of normalized histograms, we demonstrate that single-resolution entropy estimation is highly sensitive to binning choices, leading to performance variations of up to 19.3% AUROC. To address this instability, we propose a multi-resolution entropy estimation strategy that aggregates histogram statistics across multiple discretization scales, enabling robust and stable intermediate-layer selection. Across two medical OOD benchmarks, namely MIDOG and OASIS, covering distinct imaging modalities, diverse shift types, and different VLM backbones, our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, offering a lightweight and stable solution for zero-shot OOD detection.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了VLM零样本OOD检测中"最深嵌入最优"的隐含假设，指出医学影像中中间层能提供互补的OOD信号且最优深度与模态相关；并提出多分辨率熵估计策略以解决单分辨率熵对分箱敏感的问题，在MIDOG与OASIS上取得稳定且优于SOTA的效果。
AI.motivation: 医学AI在多机构、不同采集协议与人群间存在域偏移，OOD检测对安全部署至关重要。VLM可通过语言对齐的隐空间实现零样本OOD检测，以跨模态相似度作为置信信号。然而现有方法几乎只依赖末层嵌入，隐含假定最深表征普遍最优，这一假设在医学影像中可能不成立。
AI.method: 首先验证假设不成立：中间层提供互补的OOD信号，最优表征深度依赖于具体影像模态。针对已有工作通过归一化直方图熵最小化选择层组合的做法，指出单分辨率熵估计对分箱选择高度敏感，可导致AUROC波动达19.3%。为此提出多分辨率熵估计策略，在多个离散化尺度上聚合直方图统计量，实现稳健且稳定的中间层选择。
AI.result: 在MIDOG与OASIS两个医学OOD基准上（涵盖不同成像模态、多种偏移类型与不同VLM骨干网络），所提方法一致优于现有最先进方法，并保持轻量与稳定的特性。
AI.conclusion: 末层嵌入普遍最优的假设在医学影像中不成立，中间层具有互补价值；单分辨率熵估计不稳定，多分辨率熵估计可提供稳健的层选择，为医学零样本OOD检测提供轻量稳定的解决方案。

title: Graph-Based Inference for Feedback-Driven Word Deduction: A Scalable Framework for the Jotto Problem
summary: A feedback-based word deduction framework based on the Jotto problem is proposed, and the problem space is represented as a weighted graph where all valid words correspond to nodes, and the edge weight is defined by the number of common letters between the two words. Finally, the gameplay is defined as an iterative constraint propagation mechanism where feedback is used to iteratively narrow the incompatible space of the graph, facilitating the reduction of the hypothesis space in a structured and interpretable manner. In contrast to existing approaches, where the problem space is typically defined for fixed-length isograms, the proposed framework generalizes to variable-length words (between 3 and 8 letters) and naturally extends to repeated letter cases, facilitating the treatment of realistic Jotto problem instances within a unified framework for the first time. The proposed framework's applicability and solver dynamics are also discussed through an interactive implementation and a qualitative case study, respectively. Significant automated tests on approximately 3,000 simulated gameplay scenarios identify a novel convergence behavior: the expected number of iterations diminishes with increasing word length. A strong relationship is confirmed using statistical tests to verify a logarithmic relationship, which is also verified using regression modeling and goodness-of-fit tests. In addition to the initial problem statement, this formulation introduces graph pruning as a viable paradigm for feedback-driven inference with interpretability and its association with symbolic reasoning and interactive intelligent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于反馈的Jotto猜词框架，将问题空间建模为加权图（节点为合法词，边权为共同字母数），把游戏过程定义为迭代约束传播机制，首次统一支持3–8字母的可变长度及重复字母情形，并通过约3000次模拟实验发现迭代次数随词长增加而下降的对数关系。
AI.motivation: 现有Jotto类方法通常只针对固定长度的同构异位词（isogram）定义问题空间，无法处理可变长度词与重复字母的真实情形，缺乏统一、可解释的推理框架。
AI.method: 构建加权图表示问题空间：合法词为节点，边权为两词共同字母数；将玩法定义为迭代约束传播机制，利用反馈逐步收缩图中不相容空间，实现假设空间的结构化、可解释约简；并以交互式实现和定性案例研究讨论框架适用性与求解器动态。
AI.result: 在约3000个模拟对局场景的大规模自动化测试中，发现新的收敛行为：期望迭代次数随词长增加而减少；通过统计检验确认其近似对数关系，并用回归建模与拟合优度检验予以验证。
AI.conclusion: 该形式化把图剪枝确立为一种可解释的反馈驱动推理范式，并与符号推理及交互式智能系统相关联，为真实Jotto问题实例提供首个统一处理框架。

title: STSG-VQA: Evidence-Grounded Temporal Question Answering from Surgical Spatio-Temporal Scene Graphs
summary: Despite recent advances in surgical vision-language models (VLMs), temporal reasoning remains limited because existing supervision is largely frame-centric. Frame-level scene graphs (SGs) have proven effective in providing structured representations of surgical environments but do not explicitly model the dynamics of surgical workflows. To explicitly model how surgical states evolve across time, we introduce a multi-level structured temporal supervision methodology that augments frame-level surgical SGs with object-level continuity, event-level interaction continuity, and procedure-level connectivity. We then execute temporal queries over the resulting spatio-temporal scene graphs (STSGs) to generate evidence-grounded question-answer pairs, which together form the STSG-VQA benchmark. Each question is linked to the temporal interval and STSG evidence used to derive its reference answer, enabling traceable verification. The benchmark contains 18,458 question-answer pairs across seven temporal categories. Fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-4B and Hulu-Med-4B with STSG-derived supervision improves question-level micro accuracy by 24.39 and 19.56 percentage points over their zero-shot baselines and by 16.50 and 14.25 points over static scene-graph supervision, respectively. These gains span all temporal categories, indicating that STSG-derived supervision helps surgical VLMs reason over temporally grounded interactions rather than isolated frames. The code and dataset will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出多层次结构化时序监督方法，将帧级手术场景图扩展为时空场景图（STSG），并据此构建可追溯的STSG-VQA基准，显著提升手术视觉语言模型的时序推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有手术视觉语言模型的监督以帧为中心，时序推理能力受限；帧级场景图虽能提供结构化表示，却未显式建模手术工作流的动态演化过程。
AI.method: 引入多层次结构化时序监督：在帧级手术场景图上增加对象级连续性、事件级交互连续性和流程级连接性，构建时空场景图（STSG）；随后在STSG上执行时序查询，生成有证据支撑的问答对，形成STSG-VQA基准，每个问题关联其推导答案所用的时间区间与STSG证据。
AI.result: 基准包含七类时序任务、18,458个问答对。用STSG监督微调Qwen3-VL-4B和Hulu-Med-4B后，问题级micro准确率较零样本基线分别提升24.39和19.56个百分点，较静态场景图监督分别提升16.50和14.25个百分点，且提升覆盖所有时序类别。
AI.conclusion: STSG衍生的监督能促使手术视觉语言模型基于时序接地的交互进行推理，而非依赖孤立帧；代码与数据集将在录用后公开。

title: CreaMem: A Scene-Aware Memory Architecture for Personalized Agents
summary: Long-term memory is a core capability for personalized LLM agents. To support it, existing memory systems organize information using various criteria such as topic segments or summary hierarchies. However, we identify two major limitations in these designs. First, they lack scene awareness: memories from unrelated life scenes share the same retrieval space, which inflates the search space and introduces cross-scene interference. Second, they encode each memory from a single perspective, making it difficult to retrieve complementary views of the same event. In this paper, we propose the CreaMem architecture, which enables scene-aware memory organization by partitioning memory into several Life Scene Memories to reduce cross-scene interference at retrieval. To go beyond the single perspective and achieve cross-memory synergy, entries are dual-coded from both episodic and trait-based perspectives within each memory. We further devise a permemory balanced sampling strategy at retrieval time. Extensive experiments on two long-term memory benchmarks show that CreaMem improves QA accuracy across all evaluation metrics, with particularly large gains on multi-hop reasoning performance, validating scene-aware partitioning and cross-memory synergy. To enhance reproducibility, we release our code in a public GitHub repository.

AI.tldr: 提出CreaMem架构，通过生活场景划分与情景/特质双视角编码，缓解长时记忆检索中的跨场景干扰与单视角局限，并配合平衡采样策略，在两个长时记忆基准上提升QA准确率，多跳推理增益尤为显著。
AI.motivation: 现有面向个性化LLM智能体的长时记忆系统按话题分段或摘要层级组织信息，存在两大缺陷：一是缺乏场景意识，不同生活场景的记忆共享同一检索空间，扩大搜索范围并引入跨场景干扰；二是每条记忆仅从单一视角编码，难以检索同一事件的互补视角。
AI.method: CreaMem将记忆划分为多个Life Scene Memories以实现场景感知组织，在检索阶段降低跨场景干扰；在每个记忆内部对条目进行情景式与特质式双视角编码，实现跨记忆协同；并在检索时设计permemory平衡采样策略。
AI.result: 在两个长时记忆基准上的大量实验表明，CreaMem在所有评价指标上均提升QA准确率，其中多跳推理性能增益尤为突出，验证了场景感知划分与跨记忆协同的有效性。代码已在公开GitHub仓库发布以增强可复现性。
AI.conclusion: 场景感知的记忆划分与双视角编码、配合平衡采样，能有效提升长时记忆智能体的检索与推理表现，尤其利于多跳问答；代码开源有助于复现与后续研究。

title: Effects of model architecture and learning strategies on deep learning-based recognition of activated sludge microscopic images and comparison with quantitative image analysis
summary: Microscopic image analysis has long been recognized as a promising approach for monitoring activated sludge. In recent years, deep learning-based image analysis has been increasingly adopted in this field because of its high performance. However, previous studies on microscopic image analysis of activated sludge have rarely explored transformer-based models or self-supervised foundation models and have instead relied on CNNs and supervised ImageNet pretraining. In addition, previous studies often downsampled image sizes, but the effects of downsampling have not been sufficiently investigated, and the relationship between downsampling strategies and image analysis performance remains unclear. Furthermore, no study has quantitatively compared deep learning performance with quantitative image analysis (QIA), which was widely used before the emergence of deep learning. In this study, to examine how model architecture and learning strategies affect performance in microscopic image analysis of activated sludge and to quantitatively determine whether deep learning outperforms QIA, we prepared three types of activated sludge samples, classified their microscopic images, and evaluated classification accuracy. Our results showed that transformer-based architectures and alternative pretraining methods were effective in terms of classification accuracy. Our downsampling analysis showed that using overly small images reduced accuracy, but increasing image size beyond a certain point did not improve it further. In addition, the analysis indicated that, to achieve high classification accuracy, maintaining the field of view was a more effective downsampling strategy than maintaining resolution. Finally, our comparison between deep learning and QIA showed that deep learning outperformed QIA in terms of accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统考察模型架构、预训练策略与降采样方式对活性污泥显微图像分类的影响，并首次定量对比深度学习与定量图像分析(QIA)，结果表明Transformer与替代预训练方法有效，降采样需权衡视野与分辨率，且深度学习精度优于QIA。
AI.motivation: 活性污泥显微图像分析是极具潜力的监测手段，深度学习方法近年因高性能而被广泛采用。但既有研究存在三方面空白：一是几乎只依赖CNN与ImageNet监督预训练，未探索Transformer与自监督基础模型；二是常对图像降采样却缺乏对降采样影响及策略—性能关系的充分研究；三是尚无研究将深度学习与深度学习出现前广泛使用的定量图像分析(QIA)进行定量比较。因此有必要厘清架构与学习策略的作用，并量化验证深度学习是否优于QIA。
AI.method: 制备三类活性污泥样本，对其显微图像进行分类任务，以分类准确率为评价指标。实验对比不同模型架构（CNN与Transformer）与不同预训练/学习策略（含监督ImageNet预训练与替代预训练方式），并系统分析不同降采样策略（图像尺寸大小、保持视野 vs 保持分辨率）对性能的影响，同时将深度学习结果与QIA进行定量对比。
AI.result: Transformer类架构与替代预训练方法在分类准确率上表现有效；降采样分析显示图像过小会降低准确率，但超过某一尺寸后继续增大图像不再带来提升；在降采样策略上，保持视野比保持分辨率更有利于获得高分类准确率；深度学习在准确率上优于QIA。
AI.conclusion: 模型架构与学习策略显著影响活性污泥显微图像分析性能，Transformer与替代预训练值得采用；降采样存在收益拐点，应优先保持视野而非单纯保留分辨率；深度学习在分类准确率上已超越传统QIA，为活性污泥监测提供了更优方案。

title: Do New Attention Mechanisms Actually Fix Attention Sinks at Million-Token Context?
comment: Experimental study of attention sinks, long-context recall, and million-token context behavior. Code and measurement protocol are available at https://github.com/sararizwan7/Attention-Mechanisms-in-1M-Context-Window
summary: Long context language models now advertise windows of one million tokens, but two habits limit how much of that window is used. Attention heads with nothing useful to read still spend their budget on the first token, which is called the attention sink, and where a fact sits in the context changes whether the model finds it. Gated attention cut first token attention from 46.7 percent to 4.8 percent at NeurIPS 2025, and Kimi K3 pairs that idea with Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals behind a one million token window, eight times past the range where these diagnostics have been reported. This paper asks whether the fix survives that jump. We build SinkProbe, a suite that measures sink mass, massive activation, position resolved recall and the recency gap, and apply it to four small models that differ only in how they mix tokens and depth. Three results follow. The training objective produces the sink, not the architecture. Gating did not reproduce its published effect at our scale. Sink mass, activations and position bias moved independently. Code, data and the measurement protocol are released at https://github.com/sararizwan7/Attention-Mechanisms-in-1M-Context-Window

AI.tldr: 该论文构建 SinkProbe 评测套件，检验门控注意力等机制在 100 万 token 长上下文下对注意力汇、位置偏差的修复是否依然成立，发现汇主要由训练目标产生而非架构，门控效应未能复现。
AI.motivation: 长上下文语言模型虽宣称支持百万 token 窗口，但注意力汇（无用注意力头把预算耗在首个 token 上）与事实位置影响召回的问题限制了窗口的实际利用率。已有修复方案（如 Gated Attention）仅在较短范围被验证，作者想检验这些修复在百万 token 规模下是否仍然有效。
AI.method: 构建 SinkProbe 评测套件，测量四项指标：注意力汇质量（sink mass）、大规模激活（massive activation）、位置解析召回（position resolved recall）与近因差距（recency gap）；在四个仅在 token 混合方式与深度上不同的小模型上进行对比实验。
AI.result: 三项主要结果：(1) 注意力汇由训练目标产生，而非架构决定；(2) 门控注意力在作者所在实验规模下未能复现已发表的效果；(3) 汇质量、激活强度与位置偏差三者相互独立变化。代码、数据与测量协议已开源于 https://github.com/sararizwan7/Attention-Mechanisms-in-1M-Context-Window。
AI.conclusion: 针对注意力汇与位置偏差的架构级修复在扩展到百万 token 窗口时并不可靠，这些诊断量受训练目标主导且彼此解耦，提示长上下文机制的有效性需要在新规模下重新验证。

title: Which Forms of Caregiver Feedback Support Grammar Learning? A Reinforcement-Learning Study of Child-Like Language Models
summary: Social interaction is central to children's language learning, but the effects of different forms of caregiver feedback are difficult to isolate in naturalistic data. We use child-like language models as controlled learners to test which forms of feedback support grammatical development. Small GPT-2-style models are pretrained on child-directed language from CHILDES, then fine-tuned with reinforcement learning using reward models trained to capture four feedback types: communicative feedback, structural alignment, semantic contingency, and affective feedback. Reward fine-tuning yields limited gains on minimal-pair evaluations, but clearer effects in free generation. Structural alignment produces the strongest improvements in grammaticality, providing a novel, plausible mechanistic account of how this feedback can support grammar learning. Communicative feedback yields more moderate gains. In contrast, semantic contingency and affective feedback do not improve grammaticality, although further analyses suggest that they may support other aspects of language learning beyond grammar. These results suggest that different forms of caregiver feedback make complementary contributions to language learning.

AI.tldr: 该研究用类儿童语言模型作为可控学习者，比较四类照料者反馈对语法发展的作用。结果显示结构对齐反馈对语法性提升最强，交际反馈中等，而语义关联与情感反馈不提升语法但可能支持其他语言学习方面，表明不同反馈形式具有互补贡献。
AI.motivation: 社会互动对儿童语言学习至关重要，但在自然istic数据中难以分离不同形式照料者反馈的独立效应，因此需要可控实验范式来检验哪种反馈支持语法发展。
AI.method: 以CHILDES的儿童导向语言预训练小型GPT-2风格模型，再用强化学习微调；奖励模型分别捕捉四类反馈：交际反馈、结构对齐、语义关联、情感反馈；通过最小对立对评估与自由生成评估检验语法性。
AI.result: 奖励微调在最小对立对评估上增益有限，但在自由生成中效果更清晰：结构对齐反馈对语法性提升最强，交际反馈中等增益；语义关联与情感反馈未提升语法性，但进一步分析提示其可能支持语法之外的其他语言学习方面。
AI.conclusion: 不同形式的照料者反馈对语言学习作出互补贡献；结构对齐可作为一种新的、合理的机制性解释来支持语法学习，而语义关联与情感反馈可能作用于其他语言能力维度。

title: Limitations of Automated Simulatability: LLM Simulators Can Bypass Explanations
comment: Accepted to the BlackboxNLP 2026 Reproducibility Challenge (Special Track), EMNLP 2026
summary: Simulatability is an evaluation protocol for explanations that quantifies their usefulness by how well they help a user predict a task model's outputs. Since human evaluation is costly, automated simulatability replaces human explainees with LLM simulators, as proposed in ConSim (Poché et al., 2025) for large-scale experiments. We qualitatively replicate and extend ConSim's ranking of explanation methods across the tested datasets, explanation families, and simulator LLMs, and identify two limitations. First, when class names are meaningful, simulators can obtain high simulatability by solving the classification task directly, without relying on the explanations. Second, class anonymization can reward explanations for leaking the hidden label mapping, a limitation we expose with a new classes-as-concepts baseline. These results are consistent with a shortcut hypothesis: in the tested settings, simulator predictions mainly rely on task priors, while explanations produce small changes. We derive recommendations for more robust automated simulatability evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文对ConSim提出的自动化可模拟性评估协议进行定性复现与扩展，并揭示其两个局限：类别名有意义时模拟器可绕过解释直接完成任务；类别匿名化会奖励泄露隐藏标签映射的解释。结果支持"捷径假设"，并给出更稳健评估的建议。
AI.motivation: 人工评估可模拟性成本高昂，ConSim用LLM模拟器替代人类评估者以实现大规模实验。但该协议是否稳健、其结论是否可靠尚不明确，需要复现检验并识别潜在偏差。
AI.method: 定性复现并扩展ConSim对解释方法在多个数据集、解释家族和模拟器LLM上的排序；通过构造"类别即概念"（classes-as-concepts）新基线，检验类别匿名化情形下的评估偏差；并分析模拟器预测对任务先验与解释的依赖程度。
AI.result: 复现并扩展了ConSim的排序结果，同时发现两个局限：一是有意义类别名使模拟器无需解释即可通过直接分类获得高可模拟性；二是类别匿名化会奖励那些泄露隐藏标签映射的解释，新增基线证实了这一现象。结果与捷径假设一致——模拟器预测主要依赖任务先验，解释带来的变化较小。
AI.conclusion: 自动化可模拟性评估存在捷径问题，可能高估解释方法的价值。作者据此提出若干建议，以构建更稳健的自动化可模拟性评估。

title: The Unreliable Progress Bar: Can LLM Agents Reliably Report Task Progress Throughout Execution?
summary: Recent large language models can emit task-progress signals that agent frameworks use to decide whether a task should continue or stop, yet whether a model can reliably report its task progress at every stage of a task, and where and how its reports fail, has not been studied systematically. We evaluate this ability on the public benchmark $τ^2$-bench and on StageIF, a controlled testbed in which reporting checkpoints are placed across the task's lifecycle. Both settings require reports at multiple task stages. We find that reporting reliability depends on the stage a task has reached, and that almost every deployed model we test is reliable at some stages and unreliable at others. Where reporting breaks down is not the same everywhere. Most deployed models lose accuracy once work is under way and recover once the task is done. The newest generation closes that mid-task drop and instead grows conservative at the finish line. Our study exposes a capability gap in task-progress reporting and provides an evaluation protocol that spans the whole course of task execution for this ability on which agent operation depends. The findings indicate that agent frameworks should not control task flow on the strength of the model's state reports alone.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估了LLM在任务各阶段报告任务进度信号的可靠性，发现可靠性随任务阶段变化，模型通常任务进行中失准、完成时恢复，而最新一代模型则在中途改善但在终点趋于保守，据此提出覆盖全任务周期的评估协议，并建议agent框架不应仅凭模型状态报告控制任务流。
AI.motivation: Agent框架依赖LLM输出的任务进度信号来决定任务继续或停止，但模型能否在任务每个阶段可靠报告进度、以及报告在哪里、如何失败，此前缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 在公开基准τ²-bench及受控测试平台StageIF上评估该能力，后者将报告检查点分布在任务生命周期各阶段，两种设置均要求模型在多个任务阶段给出报告。
AI.result: 报告可靠性取决于任务所处阶段；几乎所有被测部署模型都在某些阶段可靠、另一些阶段不可靠。失败位置并不统一：多数部署模型在工作进行中准确率下降、任务完成后恢复；最新一代模型消除了中途下降，反而在临近终点时趋于保守。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了任务进度报告方面的能力缺口，并提供了覆盖整个任务执行过程的评估协议；结论指出agent框架不应仅依据模型的状态报告来控制任务流程。

title: A Three-Tier Persona Vector for Controllable User Simulation in Agentic Evaluation
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Extended treatment of the persona component of StateGen (arXiv:2606.16307)
summary: Evaluating tool-augmented LLM agents requires diverse, realistic user inputs yet most evaluation frameworks use flat role descriptions ("you are an angry customer") that produce near-identical conversations regardless of the underlying scenario. In this paper, we propose a three-tier persona vector with 23 operationalized dimensions: 6 categorical demographics (jurisdiction, age, channel, device, language proficiency, time availability), 12 continuous behavioral traits (patience, assertiveness, digital literacy, etc.) sampled with Gaussian noise around curated profile base vectors, and 5 continuous emotional states (frustration, anxiety, trust, confidence, stress) that shift in response to scenario context. Orthogonal to the persona, a 4-level query-complexity overlay controls utterance phrasing from direct to deliberately vague. We evaluate the persona model inside a synthetic data generation pipeline across 64,698 multi-turn conversations spanning 8 named profiles and 3 production corpora. Key findings: (i) a 15.8 percentage-point spread in agent goal-achievement across personas confirms trait vectors produce measurably different user behavior; (ii) the same persona behaves differently across scenarios due to scenario-reactive emotional state shifts, validating the scenario-reactive design; (iii) domain-specific projects show persona sensitivity on booking-flow compliance (~15-20 percentage points gap between tier-aware and pressure-test personas), demonstrating the model faithfully reproduces real-world difficulty distributions; (iv) seven rule-described trait correlations produce auditable co-occurrence patterns without requiring learned covariance matrices. The persona model is fully specified for reproduction.

AI.tldr: 提出三层人物画像向量（23个维度）用于工具增强LLM智能体的多样化用户模拟，在64,698段多轮对话中验证其能产生可测量的行为差异。
AI.motivation: 现有评估框架多采用扁平角色描述（如"你是个愤怒的顾客"），导致不同场景下生成近乎相同的对话，无法真实反映用户多样性，因此需要结构化、可操作的人物画像建模方法。
AI.method: 设计三层人物画像向量：6个分类型人口统计维度、12个连续行为特质（围绕策划好的画像基础向量加高斯噪声采样）、5个随场景上下文变化的连续情绪状态；另设与画像正交的4级查询复杂度覆盖层控制措辞（从直接到刻意含糊）。在合成数据生成流程中评估，覆盖8个命名画像、3个生产语料库、共64,698段多轮对话。
AI.result: (i) 智能体目标达成率在不同画像间跨度达15.8个百分点，证明特质向量可产生可测量的用户行为差异；(ii) 同一画像在不同场景中因情绪状态转变而表现不同，验证了场景响应式设计；(iii) 领域特定项目在预约流程合规性上显示约15-20个百分点的画像敏感度差距（tier-aware与pressure-test画像之间）；(iv) 7条规则描述的特质相关性产生可审计的共现模式，无需学习协方差矩阵。
AI.conclusion: 三层人物画像模型能忠实复现真实世界的难度分布，且完全可指定、可复现，为工具增强LLM智能体评估提供了可行的多样化用户模拟方案。

title: RxScribe Bench: A Multi-Axis Benchmark for Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Indian Outpatient Prescriptions
summary: Prescription transcription errors are not interchangeable. A model that fabricates a drug and a model that misreads a legible dose pose very different clinical risks, yet prescription-transcription accuracy is typically reported as a single blended figure that treats the two as equivalent. We introduce RxScribe Bench, a benchmark for evaluating vision-language models on handwritten prescription digitization that decomposes performance into four axes tied to clinical severity, rather than folding everything into a single aggregated score. Given only a prescription image and an output schema, a model produces a structured record, which is then compared field by field against a human-authored ground truth of identical shape, with each field also labeled for visibility and legibility. The four axes isolate distinct failure modes, namely Correctness, Hallucination, Engagement, and Robustness. The Robustness axis withholds its hard-field results rather than reporting one when the supporting sample falls below a minimum-evidence threshold. We evaluate frontier vision-language models on real prescriptions across independent cold runs per image, and find that no single model wins across all four axes.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 RxScribe Bench，一个将手写处方数字化评估分解为四个与临床严重程度相关的维度的基准，避免以单一聚合分数掩盖不同性质的错误。
AI.motivation: 处方转录错误并非等价的：模型凭空捏造药物与误读清晰剂量所对应的临床风险完全不同，但传统上处方转录准确率往往以单一混合指标报告，将两者视为等同。
AI.method: 仅给定处方图像与输出模式，模型生成结构化记录，随后与形状相同的人工撰写真值逐字段比对；每个字段还标注了可见性与可读性。四个评估轴分别为正确性、幻觉、参与度与鲁棒性；其中鲁棒性轴在支撑样本低于最小证据阈值时，不报告硬字段结果。
AI.result: 在真实处方上对前沿视觉语言模型进行独立冷启动运行评估，发现没有任何单一模型能在全部四个轴上取得最优表现。
AI.conclusion: 多维度、与临床严重程度对齐的评估方式比单一聚合分数更能揭示模型在手写处方数字化中的差异化失败模式，单一模型难以全面胜任。

title: GOLF: Global Observation with Local Focus for Calibration-Aware Stereo Interaction Field Estimation
comment: First-Place Solution for the HANDS@ECCV 2026 SHOW3D Challenge
summary: We present GOLF, the first-place solution to the SHOW3D Interaction Field Estimation Challenge at HANDS@ECCV 2026. Given synchronized egocentric stereo views, the task is to predict a 3D vector from each of 21 hand joints to the closest point on the manipulated object. GOLF combines dense global context, locally sampled hand/object evidence, and common-frame Plücker-ray geometry. We adapt DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 with LoRA and trainable LayerNorm parameters, then jointly decode both interaction fields. Our primary model achieves an official score of 27.61 and a mean ADE of 27.96 mm on the hidden test set. An equal-weight ensemble with a complementary directly fine-tuned variant improves these results to an official score of 27.47 and a mean ADE of 27.82 mm, securing first place.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GOLF，在HANDS@ECCV 2026的SHOW3D交互场估计挑战赛中获得第一名。该模型融合全局上下文、局部采样证据与Plücker射线几何，基于DINOv3 ViT-H+/16进行LoRA微调，预测21个手部关节指向物体最近点的3D向量。
AI.motivation: 从同步的自中心立体视角估计手与物体的3D交互场（每个关节到物体最近点的3D向量）具有挑战性，需要同时利用全局场景上下文与局部手物接触证据，并保持跨视角一致的几何表征。
AI.method: GOLF结合三类信息：（1）稠密全局上下文；（2）局部采样的手部/物体证据；（3）共同坐标系下的Plücker射线几何。模型基于DINOv3 ViT-H+/16，采用LoRA与可训练LayerNorm参数进行适配，并联合解码双手的交互场。此外训练了一个直接微调的互补变体，与其等权重集成。
AI.result: 主模型在隐藏测试集上取得官方得分27.61、平均ADE 27.96 mm；与互补的直接微调变体等权重集成后，官方得分提升至27.47、平均ADE降至27.82 mm，最终获得第一名。
AI.conclusion: 融合全局上下文、局部证据与Plücker射线几何，并配合LoRA高效微调与模型集成，可有效提升3D手物交互场估计精度，GOLF方案在挑战赛中取得领先成绩。

title: Dynamics of Meaning: Towards the Evaluation of Diachronic Semantic Change in Sinhala
comment: 31 pages, 5 figures, 18 tables, Accepted paper at the 5th Asia-Pacific Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics (AACL) & the 15th International Joint Conference on Natural Language Processing (IJCNLP) 2026
summary: Tracking semantic change in low-resource languages across extensive historical timelines presents significant challenges due to data scarcity and the limitations of static embedding alignments. This study investigates the diachronic evolution of the Sinhala language from the 13th to the 20th century using a multi-stage computational framework. We first align century-specific Word2Vec and FastText embeddings using Similarity Matrix Based Alignment (SMA) and Orthogonal Procrustes (OP) techniques, finding that OP alignment provides more stable neighbourhood tracking for identifying temporal similarity dips. To move beyond aggregate measures, we introduce a Bidirectional Semantic Impact Pruning approach using contextualised embeddings from a fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B. By applying Leave-One-Out (LOO) diagnostics, we attempt to isolate influential sentences to distinguish between systemic semantic shifts and transient polysemic expansion. Our results show that semantic drift in the fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B is not evenly distributed across all usages. Instead, a significant part of the change is driven by a smaller set of high-impact contextual instances, rather than gradual and uniform change across all occurrences. This work provides a preliminary framework for low-resource Sinhala diachronic analysis, highlighting the trade-offs between model sensitivity and data availability.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出多阶段计算框架，追踪13—20世纪僧伽罗语的低资源历时语义演变，结合SMA/OP对齐与基于Llama-3.1-8B的语义影响剪枝，发现语义漂移由少数高影响语境实例驱动而非均匀渐变。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言在长时段历时语义变化研究中面临数据稀缺、静态词嵌入对齐局限等问题，作者希望超越传统聚合式度量，识别系统性语义漂移与临时性多义扩展之间的差异。
AI.method: 构建多阶段计算框架：先分别训练各世纪的Word2Vec与FastText嵌入，采用相似矩阵对齐（SMA）与正交Procrustes（OP）进行跨世纪对齐；随后基于微调的Llama-3.1-8B上下文嵌入，提出双向语义影响剪枝，并结合留一法（LOO）诊断，定位高影响句子以分离系统性语义漂移与短时多义扩展。
AI.result: OP对齐在识别时间相似性下跌方面提供更稳定的邻域追踪；在微调Llama-3.1-8B中语义漂移分布不均，主要由少量高影响语境实例驱动，而非所有用法上的渐进、均匀变化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为低资源僧伽罗语历时分析提供了初步框架，强调模型敏感性与数据可得性之间的权衡，并表明语境级影响分析有助于区分不同类型的语义变化。

title: MFVINS: Multiple Fisheye Camera-Based Visual Inertial System
summary: A simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) method using a monocular camera and a low-cost inertial measurement unit (IMU) sensor is an effective way to fulfill a low-cost sensor configuration. Using this sensor configuration, visual-inertial system (VINS) focuses on fusing data from a camera and an IMU sensor to estimate the six degrees-of-freedom (DOF) of the sensor pose. Typically, VINS uses only a single camera as visual input, which lead to problems such as error accumulation due to occlusion, various illumination, and textureless environments. In this paper, we propose a new multiple fisheye camera-based visual-inertial system called MFVINS. We present an IMU-aided FAST feature tracker for multiple cameras that enables efficient extraction and robust matching of local features. Then, the proposed method filters out outliers caused by fisheye distortion on the normalized image plane. Subsequently, a new reprojection error with physical validity constraints is proposed for bundle adjustment using learning-based depth estimation. The proposed method is applied to various scenarios, and its effectiveness is demonstrated by comparing previous VINS methods. In particular, MFVINS is implemented in real-time process to leverage the advantages of using multiple cameras -- robustness against occlusion and textureless regions -- while reducing the computational burden.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多鱼眼相机视觉惯性系统MFVINS，通过IMU辅助FAST特征跟踪、归一化平面去畸变离群点滤除及带物理有效性约束的重投影误差，实现实时、抗遮挡与抗弱纹理的鲁棒位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 单目相机加低成本IMU的VINS方案成本低，但仅用单一相机作为视觉输入，在遮挡、光照变化和弱纹理环境下易产生误差累积。为在保持低计算负担的同时提升鲁棒性，需要引入多相机（鱼眼）视觉输入并解决其带来的畸变与匹配难题。
AI.method: 提出MFVINS多鱼眼相机视觉惯性系统：1）设计IMU辅助的FAST特征跟踪器，实现多相机局部特征的高效提取与鲁棒匹配；2）在归一化像平面上滤除由鱼眼畸变引起的离群点；3）结合基于学习的深度估计，提出具有物理有效性约束的新重投影误差用于光束法平差。
AI.result: 在多种场景下验证了方法有效性，并与已有VINS方法进行对比，表明MFVINS性能优越。系统实现了实时处理，在发挥多相机抗遮挡、抗弱纹理优势的同时降低了计算负担。
AI.conclusion: MFVINS通过多鱼眼相机与IMU融合及针对鱼眼畸变的特征处理与重投影误差设计，兼顾鲁棒性与实时性，为低成本多相机视觉惯性SLAM提供了有效方案。

title: SynthRCT: Scalable Conditional Deformation Synthesis for Synthetic Repeat CT Generation
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the MIART Workshop, MICCAI 2026. This preprint corresponds to the initial submission prior to peer review
summary: In proton therapy, plans are typically optimized on a single planning CT, making robustness evaluation essential under anatomical changes. However, current scenarios often rely on simplified perturbations that poorly capture complex, patient-specific variability. We propose SynthRCT, a scalable conditional generative framework for 3D anatomical deformation synthesis. Based on a conditional variational autoencoder, SynthRCT learns a latent deformation space and decodes sampled latent codes into local stationary velocity fields conditioned on an input anatomy. Local fields are assembled into coherent full-volume transformations, enabling memory-scalable generation for large field-of-view CT data. We validate the approach on respiratory 4DCT data with multiple breathing-phase anatomies per subject. SynthRCT enables patient-specific sampling of plausible anatomical transformations beyond predefined robustness scenarios. Code available at: https://github.com/TomasGuija/SynthRCT.

AI.tldr: 提出SynthRCT，一种基于条件变分自编码器的可扩展生成框架，用于3D解剖形变合成，可为质子治疗的鲁棒性评估生成患者特异性的合理解剖变换。
AI.motivation: 质子治疗计划通常仅在单一规划CT上优化，因此解剖变化下的鲁棒性评估至关重要。然而现有评估场景多依赖简化扰动，难以刻画复杂且患者特异性的解剖变异性。
AI.method: 基于条件变分自编码器（CVAE）学习潜在形变空间，将采样的潜在编码在输入解剖条件下解码为局部平稳速度场（stationary velocity field），再把局部场拼装成连贯的全容积变换，实现大视野CT数据的可内存扩展生成。
AI.result: 在呼吸4DCT数据（每名受试者含多个呼吸相位解剖）上完成验证，能够实现患者特异性的合理解剖变换采样，超越预定义的鲁棒性场景。
AI.conclusion: SynthRCT提供了一种可扩展、患者特异性的3D解剖形变合成方法，有助于更真实地评估质子治疗计划在解剖变化下的鲁棒性；代码已开源。

title: From Where to How: Continuous 4D Interaction Forecasting from Egocentric Video
summary: Egocentric 4D interaction forecasting aims to anticipate both where future interactions will occur in 3D and how the human body will move to realize them, providing an important capability for assistive robotics and human-computer interaction. Existing methods struggle to translate semantic understanding into precise continuous 3D localization and to balance motion diversity with structural consistency in pose forecasting. More fundamentally, these tasks are often modeled separately, leaving the continuous geometric and temporal correspondence between interaction locations and body motion insufficiently captured. To address these challenges, we introduce Coherent4D, a large-scale egocentric dataset for continuous 4D interaction forecasting, comprising approximately 233K samples across three domains. Each sample pairs a sequence of future 3D interaction locations with corresponding full-body poses, aligned in time and expressed in a shared coordinate system. We also provide evaluation metrics in continuous space. Building on this formulation, we propose HIGFlow, a Hand Interaction Guided Residual Flow framework that models forecasting as a cascaded where-to-how process. HIGFlow first forecasts continuous future interaction locations by combining semantic grounding with short-horizon visual dynamics, and then uses the predicted location sequence to condition a deterministic motion anchor and residual Flow Matching for diverse yet structurally consistent full-body motion forecasting. Extensive experiments across all three domains demonstrate consistent improvements over representative baselines on both location and pose forecasting, while ablations validate the contributions of the proposed components. The project page is available at https://corrineqiu.github.io/from-where-to-how/.

AI.tldr: 提出大规模自我中心4D交互预测数据集Coherent4D与HIGFlow框架，将预测建模为"先定位后动作"的级联流程，在三个域上均优于代表性基线。
AI.motivation: 现有自我中心4D交互预测方法难以将语义理解转化为精确连续的3D定位，且难以在姿态预测中兼顾运动多样性与结构一致性；更根本的问题是交互位置预测与身体运动预测常被分开建模，未能充分捕捉两者之间连续的几何与时间对应关系。
AI.method: 构建Coherent4D数据集，约233K样本、覆盖三个域，每个样本将未来3D交互位置序列与对应的全身姿态在时间上对齐、并表达于统一坐标系，同时提供连续空间评估指标。基于该建模方式提出HIGFlow（Hand Interaction Guided Residual Flow）框架，将预测视为级联的where-to-how过程：先结合语义接地与短时视觉动态预测连续未来交互位置，再以预测的位置序列为条件，引导确定性运动锚点与残差Flow Matching，实现多样且结构一致的全身运动预测。
AI.result: 在三个域上，位置预测与姿态预测两方面均相较代表性基线取得一致性提升；消融实验验证了各提出组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 将交互位置与身体运动在统一坐标与时间对齐下联合建模，并以级联where-to-how方式结合语义接地、视觉动态与残差Flow Matching，可有效提升4D交互预测的定位精度与运动多样性和结构一致性。

title: Navigating the digital spectrum: Assessing political bias, stability, and downstream fairness in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models are increasingly deployed as information intermediaries, yet measuring their political behavior remains fragile because questionnaire results mix model dispositions with measurement artifacts and response-elicitation biases. We introduce a robust Political Compass Test evaluation framework that samples 300 configurations across an eight-dimensional perturbation space varying language, framing, instructions, answer format, option order, and persona wording. We evaluate eight Gemma 3 and Qwen 3 models across 14 languages and three quantization levels, obtaining design-averaged political coordinates with quantified uncertainty. Most models lean Libertarian-Left on average, but instruction phrasing, language, and answer format significantly affect recovered coordinates. Cross-lingual differences primarily reflect coordinate drift rather than distinct cultural reasoning. Reverse-engineering the test also exposes axis-weighting imbalances and the collapse of degenerate responses toward the center, so near-origin estimates for the smallest models can reflect weak signal rather than centrism. Free-text reasoning and chat-then-classify elicitation alter recovered coordinates, and larger models show clearer persona separation, with a specific failure of the Authoritarian-Left persona to move most models in the intended social direction. In downstream tasks, persona effects are modest relative to model size and target group for hate-speech detection, while base and centrist prompts give the highest agreement for topic-level sentiment. Political role prompting therefore has measurable but task- and dataset-specific downstream effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个稳健的"政治罗盘"评测框架，在八维扰动空间采样300种配置，跨14种语言、3种量化水平评测8个Gemma 3与Qwen 3模型，发现模型平均偏自由意志-左翼，但测量结果受指令措辞、语言与答案格式显著影响，且下游任务中人格提示效应有限且依赖具体任务。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型日益充当信息中介，但其政治行为测量十分脆弱：问卷结果混杂了模型自身倾向、测量伪影与应答诱导偏差，难以区分真实的政治立场与文化推理差异。
AI.method: 构建稳健的政治罗盘测试评测框架：在涵盖语言、框架、指令、答案格式、选项顺序、人格措辞的八维扰动空间采样300种配置；对8个Gemma 3与Qwen 3模型、14种语言、3种量化水平进行评测，得到带量化不确定性的设计平均政治坐标；并对测试本身进行逆向工程分析。
AI.result: 多数模型平均呈自由意志-左翼倾向，但指令措辞、语言与答案格式显著影响坐标；跨语言差异主要是坐标漂移而非不同文化推理；测试存在轴权重失衡与退化回答向中心坍缩的问题，最小模型的近原点估计可能反映弱信号而非中间立场；自由文本推理与"先对话后分类"的诱导方式会改变坐标，大模型人格分离更清晰，但极权-左翼人格未能按预期推动多数模型的社会维度；下游任务中人格效应相对模型规模与目标群体较小，基础与中间派提示在主题级情感任务中一致性最高。
AI.conclusion: 政治角色提示的下游效应可测量，但具有任务与数据集特异性；政治行为测量必须纳入扰动设计与不确定性量化，否则坐标解读可能被测量伪影所主导。

title: Combating Instruction Conflict via Energy-Driven Latent Conflict Detection

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed with hierarchical instructions, yet they remain vulnerable to conflicts in which user directives override system-level constraints. Existing defense mechanisms predominantly focus on static input inspection and therefore fail to detect Response Drift, a phenomenon in which the model's final response violates system-level constraints despite seemingly compliant inputs. To bridge this gap, we introduce ELCD, a response-level latent conflict detector for post-generation, pre-delivery verification. Given the full generated output, ELCD constructs a composite hidden-state representation by concatenating the final-token embedding with the mean-pooled response embedding. It then optimizes a pairwise margin ranking objective to separate compliant and drifting responses in latent space. Extensive experiments across five mainstream LLMs ranging from 1.5B to 14B parameters demonstrate that ELCD significantly outperforms competitive baselines. Notably, it improves the PR-AUC on Llama-2-7B by approximately 30 percentage points and reduces the False Positive Rate at 95% TPR (FPR95) on Mistral-7B to 2.67%. These results suggest that ELCD provides a promising approach for latent instruction-conflict detection in open-weight or self-hosted LLM deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ELCD，一种面向生成后、交付前阶段的响应级潜在冲突检测器，通过隐状态表示与成对边际排序目标区分合规响应与“响应漂移”，在五个主流LLM上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: LLM在层级指令部署中易受用户指令覆盖系统级约束的冲突影响；现有防御多聚焦静态输入检查，无法检测“响应漂移”——即输入看似合规但最终响应违反系统级约束的现象。
AI.method: ELCD在生成完整输出后进行响应级检测：将最终token嵌入与均值池化的响应嵌入拼接，构建复合隐状态表示，并优化成对边际排序（pairwise margin ranking）目标，在隐空间中分离合规响应与漂移响应。
AI.result: 在1.5B至14B参数的五个主流LLM上，ELCD显著优于竞争基线；在Llama-2-7B上将PR-AUC提升约30个百分点，在Mistral-7B上将95% TPR下的假阳性率（FPR95）降至2.67%。
AI.conclusion: ELCD为开放权重或自托管LLM部署中的潜在指令冲突检测提供了有前景的方案。

title: Difficulty-Adaptive Tree-Structured Policy Optimization for Expanding Reasoning Coverage in RLVR
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has been central to the recent success of Large Reasoning Models. However, while RLVR significantly improves single-sample accuracy, it often fails to expand the model's intrinsic reasoning coverage (pass@k) due to limited exploration during training. To address this, we optimize the structural design of train-time rollouts to enhance pass@k. Our analysis identifies three key design principles: (1) difficulty-adaptive rollout can play an important role in expanding pass@k, beyond serving as an efficiency heuristic; (2) tree-based rollout outperforms parallel sampling in discovering correct answers; and (3) sentence-entropy-guided forking overcomes the localization phenomenon of token-level branching to maximize semantic diversity. Building on these insights, we propose DATPO (Difficulty-Adaptive Sentence-entropy-guided Tree-structured Policy Optimization). DATPO integrates difficulty-adaptive tree search with a sibling-diversity advantage term, explicitly promoting semantic diversity to expand reasoning coverage during training. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that DATPO outperforms baselines especially in pass@k, which directly translates to superior test-time scaling performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 DATPO，通过难度自适应、句子熵引导的树状 rollout 与兄弟多样性优势项，提升 RLVR 的推理覆盖（pass@k）与测试时扩展性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 RLVR 虽显著提升单样本准确率，但因训练中探索不足，难以扩展模型内在推理覆盖（pass@k）。因此本文从训练时 rollout 的结构设计入手，以提升 pass@k。
AI.method: 分析得出三条设计准则：（1）难度自适应 rollout 不仅是效率启发式，还对扩展 pass@k 有重要作用；（2）树状 rollout 在发现正确答案上优于并行采样；（3）句子熵引导分叉可克服 token 级分支的定位局限，最大化语义多样性。基于此提出 DATPO，将难度自适应树搜索与兄弟多样性优势项相结合，显式促进语义多样性以扩展训练中的推理覆盖。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准上，DATPO 优于基线，尤其在 pass@k 上表现突出，并直接转化为更优的测试时扩展性能。
AI.conclusion: 优化训练时 rollout 的结构设计（难度自适应、树状搜索、句子熵引导分叉及多样性优势）可有效扩展推理覆盖，进而提升测试时扩展能力。

title: Charts Are Beyond Pixels: Probing for Layer-Wise Chart Understanding and Editing
summary: Charts are structured visual compositions whose elements have distinct functional roles, semantic correspondences, and visibility relations. This structural view motivates evaluating whether models can understand and manipulate charts at the layer level. Existing chart benchmarks, however, primarily assess the correctness or fidelity of final outputs and do not directly evaluate these layer-wise behaviors. We present LayerWiseBench, a benchmark organized around three core concepts, layer attribution, layer binding, and visibility ordering, that structure its chart-understanding and chart-editing evaluations. Generated from executable chart programs, LayerWiseBench pairs each rendered chart with spatially aligned per-layer RGBA assets and construction-derived labels for functional roles, semantic bindings, and visibility relations. From this layer-wise representation, we derive controlled understanding questions, editing targets, reference images, and evaluation regions. It contains 2,800 source charts across 14 chart paradigms, from which we derive 7,329 layer-wise understanding questions and 53,791 instruction-guided editing variants. Among the evaluated VLMs, Qwen3.5-27B, which achieves the highest QA macro-average, obtains 93.04% accuracy on layer attribution and 97.46% on layer binding, but only 61.46% on visibility ordering. Across the four evaluated image editors, overall mIoU ranges from 1.49% to 4.93%, and visibility-constrained edits have the lowest mIoU for every editor, ranging from 0.37% to 2.00%. Taken together, these results identify tasks involving front-to-back relations between overlapping components as a recurring challenge across understanding and editing, motivating more explicit modeling of component identity and visibility relations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LayerWiseBench，一个从图层视角评估图表理解与编辑能力的基准，围绕图层归属、图层绑定和可见性排序三个核心概念构建，揭示重叠组件的前后关系是当前VLM与图像编辑器的共同难点。
AI.motivation: 图表是由具有不同功能角色、语义对应和可见性关系的元素构成的结构化视觉组合。现有图表基准主要评估最终输出的正确性或保真度，无法直接评估这种图层级别的行为，因此需要一个能够在图层层面评估模型理解与操作能力的基准。
AI.method: LayerWiseBench 围绕图层归属（layer attribution）、图层绑定（layer binding）和可见性排序（visibility ordering）三个核心概念组织图表理解与编辑评估。该基准由可执行图表程序生成，为每张渲染图表配对空间对齐的逐层 RGBA 素材，以及由构建过程导出的功能角色、语义绑定和可见性关系标签。基于这种逐层表示，进一步导出受控的理解问题、编辑目标、参考图像和评估区域。基准包含 14 种图表范式下的 2,800 张源图表，并由此衍生出 7,329 个图层级理解问题和 53,791 个指令引导的编辑变体。
AI.result: 在评估的 VLM 中，QA 宏平均最高的 Qwen3.5-27B 在图层归属上达到 93.04% 准确率，图层绑定达 97.46%，但可见性排序仅 61.46%。四个评估图像编辑器的整体 mIoU 为 1.49%–4.93%，且对每个编辑器而言，可见性约束编辑的 mIoU 最低，为 0.37%–2.00%。
AI.conclusion: 结果共同表明，涉及重叠组件前后关系的任务在理解与编辑两方面都是反复出现的挑战，因此需要更显式地对组件身份与可见性关系进行建模。

title: TriCCOT: Tri-part Convolutional Conformal Transformer for Onboard Space Object Detection
summary: Onboard object detection in Earth observation is constrained by limited computational resources and the absence of fully corrected imagery. While convolutional detectors are hardware-efficient, they often struggle to extract robust representations from raw and noisy data. Conversely, transformer-based models provide stronger global reasoning capabilities but remain difficult to deploy on FPGA accelerators due to quadratic attention complexity and non-compatible operations. We introduce TriCCOT, a tri-part architecture for robust and deployable onboard object detection. TriCCOT combines a convolutional region proposal network, a conformal prediction stage, and Aper-GATES, our hardware-friendly attention-based classifier. The region proposal network generates candidate bounding boxes, which are subsequently enlarged via conformal prediction, providing a distribution-free probabilistic coverage guarantee. The resulting crops are processed by Aper-GATES, which reformulates self-attention through convolutional projections, global channel statistics, and hardware-friendly gating operations, avoiding standard transformer operations that are poorly suited to CNN-oriented accelerators. Experiments on the DIOR and VDVRaw datasets demonstrate competitive detection performance and improved robustness to spatial blur and signal-dependent noise when compared to FPGA-compatible architectures. Finally, we report full deployment on a Xilinx Versal VCK190 FPGA without modifying the underlying DPU architecture, enabling unified CNN-Transformer inference for spaceborne embedded applications.

AI.tldr: TriCCOT：一种三分支架构，通过卷积RPN、保形预测与硬件友好注意力分类器Aper-GATES，实现鲁棒且可部署的星载目标检测，并在Xilinx Versal VCK190 FPGA上完成部署。
AI.motivation: 地球观测中的星载目标检测受限于有限算力与缺乏完全校正的影像。卷积检测器硬件效率高但难以从原始噪声数据中提取鲁棒表征；Transformer模型具备更强的全局推理能力，却因二次注意力复杂度和不兼容操作而难以部署到FPGA加速器。
AI.method: 提出TriCCOT三分支架构：1）卷积区域提议网络生成候选边界框；2）保形预测阶段对候选框进行扩展，提供无分布假设的概率覆盖保证；3）Aper-GATES硬件友好注意力分类器，通过卷积投影、全局通道统计与硬件友好门控操作重构自注意力，规避不适合CNN导向加速器的标准Transformer操作。
AI.result: 在DIOR和VDVRaw数据集上，相比FPGA兼容架构，取得有竞争力的检测性能，并在空间模糊和信号相关噪声下表现出更强的鲁棒性；在Xilinx Versal VCK190 FPGA上完成完整部署，无需修改底层DPU架构，实现统一的CNN-Transformer推理。
AI.conclusion: TriCCOT通过结合卷积提议、保形预测与硬件友好注意力机制，在保持检测性能与鲁棒性的同时，实现了面向星载嵌入式应用的CNN-Transformer统一FPGA部署。

title: CoordFormer: Give Me Any Coordinates and I Will Give You Labels
summary: Semantic segmentation on very-high-resolution images remains challenging due to the high computational cost and the difficulty of capturing fine-grained details. We propose CoordFormer, a novel coordinate-based architecture for semantic segmentation that predicts labels at arbitrary spatial locations through a Coordinate Decoder equipped with a Localized Cross-Attention mechanism. The decoder combines coordinate embeddings with high-resolution local patch features and interacts with global tokens extracted from a downsampled image processed by a ViT foundation encoder, enabling rich semantic context while preserving pixel-level precision. This design enables flexible inference at arbitrary resolutions while keeping memory low on very-high-resolution inputs, and supports an efficient semantic-edge-focused strategy that concentrates computation along boundaries, maintaining fine-grained accuracy while reducing latency and computational cost. CoordFormer achieves state-of-the-art performance on MaSS13K and outperforms comparably sized and higher-parameter methods on DIS5K and KPIs, demonstrating its effectiveness for high-quality, very-high-resolution semantic segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出CoordFormer，一种基于坐标的语义分割架构，通过坐标解码器与局部化交叉注意力在任意空间位置预测标签，实现高分辨率图像的高效高精度分割。
AI.motivation: 超高分辨率图像的语义分割面临计算成本高和难以捕捉细粒度细节的双重挑战。现有方法在保持像素级精度的同时难以兼顾语义上下文与低内存开销。
AI.method: 设计坐标解码器（Coordinate Decoder），配备局部化交叉注意力（Localized Cross-Attention）：将坐标嵌入与高分辨率局部块特征结合，并与由ViT基础编码器处理的下采样图像提取的全局token交互。该设计支持任意分辨率灵活推理，并支持聚焦语义边缘的高效策略，将计算集中在边界处。
AI.result: 在MaSS13K上达到最先进性能，在DIS5K和KPIs上超越同等规模及更高参数量的方法。
AI.conclusion: CoordFormer对高质量超高分辨率语义分割有效，兼顾精度、内存与计算效率。

title: Did You Steal My Shot? Pioneering Camera Motion Plagiarism Detection in Generative Videos
summary: Camera motion often reflects directorial intent and requires professional equipment, making it a high value form of intellectual property. However, generative video models can imitate such high value camera motions with simple prompts, while existing similarity detection methods mainly operate on visual content and fail to capture deeper motion similarity. This is mainly because their training data entangles camera motion with visual content. Moreover, traditional optical flow is insufficient to represent complex camera motions. We therefore build the first benchmark for camera motion analysis, including a motion dataset with \textbf{11} motion styles and evaluation protocols. Furthermore, we propose a motion representation that augments optical flow with vorticity cues from fluid dynamics, thereby better capturing motions. Experiments show that our detector achieves a \textbf{3.02*} improvement in plagiarism detection over the strongest baseline and remains effective on generative videos. We believe our work extends copyright protection beyond static content to dynamic camera motion.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次构建了镜头运动分析基准（含11种运动风格的数据集与评测协议），并提出一种用流体力学涡量线索增强光流的运动表征，使抄袭检测性能较最强基线提升3.02倍，并能有效识别生成视频中的镜头运动抄袭，将版权保护从静态内容扩展到动态镜头运动。
AI.motivation: 镜头运动体现导演意图且依赖专业设备，是高价值知识产权。但生成式视频模型仅靠简单提示即可模仿此类运动，而现有相似度检测方法主要针对视觉内容，难以捕捉更深层的运动相似性：一是训练数据将镜头运动与视觉内容纠缠在一起，二是传统光流不足以表征复杂镜头运动。
AI.method: 构建首个镜头运动分析基准，包括含11种运动风格的运动数据集及评测协议；提出一种运动表征方法，在光流基础上引入流体力学中的涡量（vorticity）线索，以更好地刻画复杂镜头运动，并据此设计抄袭检测器。
AI.result: 所提检测器在抄袭检测任务上较最强基线取得3.02倍提升，且在生成视频上依然有效。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将版权保护从静态内容拓展到动态镜头运动，为镜头运动这一高价值知识产权的识别与保护提供了基准与方法支撑。

title: CausalChapter: Improving Long-Video Chaptering with Interventional Dependency Modeling
summary: Long-form instructional videos require automatic chaptering to support browsing, navigation, and knowledge access. Recent long-context language models can perform chaptering from textualized video inputs, but they remain costly and brittle for content-dense lecture videos with long transcripts, smooth topic transitions, and detailed chapter outputs. A scalable segment-then-caption paradigm reduces this cost, but introduces two new challenges: boundary error propagation and fragmented cross-chapter context. We propose \textbf{CausalChapter}, an intervention-inspired framework for long-video chaptering that estimates prediction-level influence through lightweight masking and removal interventions. For boundary localization, our Local Dependency Shift module detects drops in predictive dependency between adjacent temporal windows; for chapter description generation, our Cross-Segment Support Selection module reranks historical contexts according to their support for the current prediction. Experiments on long-video chaptering benchmarks show that CausalChapter improves boundary localization, chapter description quality, and cross-chapter coherence.

AI.tldr: 提出CausalChapter框架，通过轻量级掩码与移除干预估计预测级影响力，解决长视频章节切分中的边界误差传播与跨章节上下文碎片化问题。
AI.motivation: 长视频自动章节切分对浏览、导航和知识获取很重要。长上下文语言模型虽可从文本化视频输入完成章节切分，但成本高且在内容密集、话题过渡平滑、章节输出细粒度的讲座视频上表现脆弱。分段再描述（segment-then-caption）范式可降低成本，但引入边界误差传播和跨章节上下文碎片化两个新挑战。
AI.method: 受干预思想启发的框架。边界定位方面，设计Local Dependency Shift模块，检测相邻时间窗口间预测依赖的下降；章节描述生成方面，设计Cross-Segment Support Selection模块，依据历史上下文对当前预测的支持度进行重排序。
AI.result: 在长视频章节切分基准上，CausalChapter在边界定位、章节描述质量和跨章节连贯性方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过预测级影响力的干预估计，CausalChapter有效缓解了分段范式的边界误差传播与上下文碎片化，验证了因果/干预视角在长视频章节切分任务中的有效性。

title: When Victorian Becomes a Prompt: Literary Periodization as a Generative Constraint in 100 AI-Generated Novels
summary: Generative AI inverts the typical periodization of literary history: the periodizing tag Victorian can now come first and influence what is written. Generative periodization, defined and tested here, describes the use of literary-period designations in generating texts. I test this approach on 100 book-length novels produced under Victorian and Zero-Style conditions using GPT, Qwen, and Llama workflows. The Period Alignment Score (PAS), trained on nineteenth-century literature and benchmarked against human Zero-Style prose, assesses alignment using topic-reduced grammatical features. Victorian prompts produce consistent historical-direction shifts in GPT and Qwen, but not robustly in Llama. Victorian-only recalibration and harder comparison corpora preserve the GPT and Qwen effects. Cross-model transfer also shows a shared direction of grammatical change. The measurable target is the broader nineteenth century rather than the Victorian period per se.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"生成式分期"（generative periodization）概念：文学时期标签（如Victorian）可前置并影响生成文本。基于GPT、Qwen、Llama三种工作流各生成100部长篇小说（Victorian与Zero-Style两种条件），并构建以19世纪文学训练的"时期对齐分数"（PAS）进行度量。结果显示GPT与Qwen出现一致的历史方向性语法偏移，Llama则不稳定。
AI.motivation: 传统文学史分期是事后归类，而生成式AI反转了这一逻辑：分期标签先于文本并塑造文本。作者希望定义并检验这一新现象，即"生成式分期"，并探究文学时期标签能否作为生成条件产生可测量的文体影响。
AI.method: 以GPT、Qwen、Llama三种工作流为生成引擎，在Victorian条件与Zero-Style条件下各生成100部长篇小说。构建"时期对齐分数"（PAS），基于主题降维后的语法特征，以19世纪文学训练并对照人类Zero-Style散文进行基准校准。辅以仅用Victorian数据的重校准与更严格的比较语料库，并检验跨模型迁移。
AI.result: Victorain提示在GPT与Qwen中产生一致的历史方向性转变，但在Llama中不稳健。Victorian-only重校准与更难比较语料仍保留GPT、Qwen效应。跨模型迁移显示存在共享的语法变化方向。可测量的目标实为广义19世纪而非狭义Victorian时期。
AI.conclusion: 生成式分期是有效且可测量的现象：时期标签作为提示条件可系统性地引导语法层面的历史风格偏移。但该效应依赖模型（GPT、Qwen显著，Llama不显著），且对齐指向的是更宽泛的19世纪文体范式，而非严格的Victorian特征。

title: Hyperparameter Scaling Laws Across MoE Sparsity
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models expand model capacity without a proportional increase in training compute, but increasing sparsity makes reliable hyperparameter transfer challenging. In this work, we show that conventional hyperparameter scaling laws are insufficient for ultra-sparse MoEs: the optimal learning rate and batch size vary with activation ratio, and these shifts cannot be explained by either total or activated parameter count alone. To characterize this dependence, we conduct 1,800 pre-training runs spanning six activated-parameter scales and models with up to 6B total non-embedding parameters, processing approximately 20 trillion tokens at a cost of 200,000 equivalent H800 GPU-hours. Our results reconcile conflicting findings in prior work by revealing two scaling regimes. At fixed sparsity, the optimal batch size follows a power-law relationship with training tokens $D$, whereas the optimal learning rate scales with training compute $C$ and remains robust to the allocation between model size and data. Across sparsity levels, the activation ratio $A$ enters both relationships as an additional multiplicative power-law factor. These observations lead to unified hyperparameter scaling laws that transfer across MoE sparsity levels. Large-scale evaluation shows that the scaling form outperforms alternative functional forms. On a held-out ultra-sparse MoE with 12B total parameters and only 1/64 of its experts activated, the predicted hyperparameters remain close to the observed optima, supporting joint extrapolation across model scale and sparsity. Further experiments demonstrate transfer across expert granularities and isolate the effect of activation ratio from that of total expert count.

AI.tldr: 本文通过1800次预训练实验，揭示了超稀疏MoE中学习率与批量大小随激活比例变化的双标度律，并提出统一的超参数标度律。
AI.motivation: MoE模型在扩大容量的同时不显著增加训练算力，但稀疏度提高使超参数迁移变得困难；传统超参数标度律对超稀疏MoE不适用，最优学习率与批量大小随激活比例变化，且无法仅由总参数量或激活参数量解释。
AI.method: 开展1800次预训练实验，覆盖六个激活参数规模、总非嵌入参数量最高6B的模型，处理约20万亿token，消耗约20万等效H800 GPU小时；分析固定稀疏度下最优批量大小与训练token D的幂律关系、最优学习率与训练算力C的标度关系，以及激活比例A作为额外乘性幂律因子的作用，并拟合统一的超参数标度律。
AI.result: 发现两个标度区间：固定稀疏度时，最优批量大小随训练token D呈幂律关系，最优学习率随训练算力C标度且对模型规模与数据分配稳健；跨稀疏度时激活比例A以乘性幂律因子进入两关系。统一标度律在大规模评估中优于其他函数形式；在12B总参数、仅1/64专家激活的留出超稀疏MoE上预测超参数接近观测最优值，并展示跨专家粒度迁移及激活比例与专家总数效应的分离。
AI.conclusion: 传统超参数标度律不足以描述超稀疏MoE；将激活比例A纳入幂律因子可得到跨稀疏度统一的超参数标度律，并支持模型规模与稀疏度的联合外推，同时可迁移到不同专家粒度。

title: Global Divergence, Local Convergence: Representation Geometry in SSMs and Transformers
summary: Recent state-space models (SSMs) such as Mamba achieve language modeling performance comparable to transformers despite relying on fundamentally different architectures. This raises an important question: how do these structural differences influence the geometry and functional nature of their internal representations? We study this question through a multi-scale analysis of representations in transformers, SSMs, and hybrid architecture. First, we find that SSMs distribute their representational information evenly across all dimensions, whereas transformer representations are heavily dominated by a single principal direction. By evaluating hybrid architectures, we observe that the representation space becomes increasingly skewed toward a single dominant direction after each attention layer. Next, we explore how the different geometric spread of representations impacts representational capacity through compressibility. Surprisingly, we find that despite their contrasting geometric structures, both architectures exhibit tightly matched effective capacities. We further investigate whether this skewed geometry affects how concepts are encoded. Using rank-constrained probes, we demonstrate that both architectures encode concepts in subspaces of surprisingly similar dimensionality. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the transformers' dominant principal direction does not inherently encode more conceptual information. Finally, we zoom in and examine the alignment between manifolds, either by analyzing representations of specific topics or by looking at the nearest neighborhoods of tokens, and find that they are highly aligned. Ultimately, our analysis suggests that while transformers and SSMs induce different usage of latent space, they display a striking functional convergence at the level of local semantic manifolds.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过多尺度表征分析，比较Transformer、状态空间模型（SSM，如Mamba）及混合架构的内部表征几何与功能特性，发现两者虽在潜空间使用方式上不同，但在局部语义流形层面呈现显著功能收敛。
AI.motivation: Mamba等状态空间模型在语言建模性能上可与Transformer媲美，但架构根本不同。这引出关键问题：这些结构差异如何影响其内部表征的几何形态与功能性质？
AI.method: 采用多尺度表征分析：1）分析表征在各维度上的分布（主轴方向性）；2）通过混合架构观察注意力层对表征偏斜的影响；3）利用压缩性评估表征容量；4）使用秩约束探针（rank-constrained probes）分析概念编码的子空间维度；5）通过主题表征及token最近邻分析流形对齐。
AI.result: SSM将表征信息均匀分布于所有维度，而Transformer表征被单一主方向主导；每经过一个注意力层，混合架构表征空间更偏向单一主导方向。尽管几何结构迥异，两者有效容量高度匹配；概念编码子空间维度相似；Transformer主导主方向并不固有编码更多概念信息；两者局部语义流形高度对齐。
AI.conclusion: Transformer与SSM以不同方式使用潜空间，但在局部语义流形层面表现出惊人的功能收敛。

title: MorphoOrgaAgent: A Foundation-Model-Based Multi-Agent System for Autonomous Organoid Analysis
comment: Accepted at the 2nd Agentic AI for Medicine Workshop, MICCAI 2026. 15 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables
summary: Organoids are three-dimensional tissue models whose morphology provides important insights into tumor development, disease progression, and drug testing. Extracting these morphological features relies heavily on manual segmentation, which is time-consuming and labor-intensive. Furthermore, performing quantitative statistical analysis typically requires custom coding skills and a mathematical background, presenting a major barrier for experimental biologists. To address these challenges, we introduce MorphoOrgaAgent, a multi-agent framework that achieves zero-shot organoid segmentation, automated data analysis, and report generation based on natural language input. The framework consists mainly of three core components: a TaskUnderstandingAgent that identifies requested measurements and visualization types; a hybrid segmentation module that combines Cellpose-derived geometric prompts with text prompts to guide SAM3 for zero-shot organoid instance segmentation; and a ReportAgent that computes quantitative metrics and compiles them alongside generated visualizations into a structured report. We further introduce MorphoOrgaVQA, a benchmark designed for quantitative evaluation of agent systems in organoid morphology analysis. Experimental results demonstrate that MorphoOrgaAgent handles both explicit and descriptive user requests, produces measurements closely matching ground truth, and generates complete analysis reports without requiring manual programming. The complete source code and MorphoOrgaVQA benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/peng-lab/MorphoOrgaAgent.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MorphoOrgaAgent多智能体框架，实现类器官零样本分割、自动化数据分析与报告生成，并发布MorphoOrgaVQA基准，实验表明其测量结果接近真值且无需人工编程。
AI.motivation: 类器官形态学特征对肿瘤发展、疾病进程和药物测试研究至关重要，但其形态特征提取严重依赖人工分割，耗时耗力；定量统计分析还需要编程技能和数学背景，对实验生物学家构成较高门槛。
AI.method: 框架包含三个核心组件：TaskUnderstandingAgent识别所需测量指标与可视化类型；混合分割模块结合Cellpose生成的几何提示与文本提示引导SAM3实现类器官零样本实例分割；ReportAgent计算定量指标并连同可视化结果汇编为结构化报告。此外提出MorphoOrgaVQA基准用于智能体系统的定量评估。
AI.result: 实验表明MorphoOrgaAgent能够处理显式和描述性用户请求，产生的测量结果与真值高度接近，并能生成完整的分析报告，且无需人工编程。源代码与基准已公开。
AI.conclusion: MorphoOrgaAgent通过多智能体框架降低类器官形态分析的门槛，实现零样本分割、自动分析与报告生成的一体化流程，为实验生物学家提供便捷工具。

title: Record Grouping Controls Evidence Weight in Language Models
summary: Retrieved records are presentation units; a supplied partition determines which records enter a language model as one evidential contribution. We characterize the invariant group-content state that removes within-group copies while retaining complementary canonical content, show that equal group counts can encode different evidence states, and derive a sharp content-aware partition-error bound. Given a supplied partition, our pre-generation representation deduplicates and aggregates content within groups and bounds each group's contribution. Across 104,402 trials and 6 public checkpoints, a central natural-text intervention finds that content-fixed false splits add 10.27-32.66 percentage points and false merges remove 9.13-31.79 points; a matched six-slot control retains the positive direction in all 16 cells. In a new 48-item controlled campaign panel, changing the supplied partition produces measurable, checkpoint-dependent decision shifts across all four models, and the balanced mirror design exposes substantial order interactions. Together, the theory and experiments establish the supplied partition as a controllable pre-generation representation variable and characterize its checkpoint-dependent behavioral effects.

AI.tldr: 该论文将检索记录的"供给划分"（partition）定义为生成前表征变量，刻画了组内去重聚合的不变组内容状态，给出内容感知的划分误差界，并通过大规模实验证明划分错误会显著且依赖检查点地改变模型决策。
AI.motivation: 检索记录通常作为呈现单元进入语言模型，而划分方式决定哪些记录构成一个证据贡献。作者希望厘清划分在何种意义上是可控制的前生成表征变量，以及划分错误如何影响模型行为。
AI.method: 理论上：刻画消除组内副本、保留互补规范内容的不变组内容状态；说明相同组数可编码不同证据状态；推导内容感知的划分误差紧界。生成前对组内内容去重聚合并约束每组贡献。实验上：104,402 次试验、6 个公开检查点，使用内容固定的中心自然文本干预；匹配的六槽位对照；新建 48 项受控 campaign 面板，采用平衡镜像设计。
AI.result: 内容固定的错误拆分使指标增加 10.27–32.66 个百分点，错误合并且使其下降 9.13–31.79 个百分点；匹配六槽位对照在全部 16 个单元中保持正向。在 48 项面板中，改变供给划分在四个模型上均产生可测且依赖检查点的决策偏移，平衡镜像设计揭示显著的顺序交互。
AI.conclusion: 供给划分可被视为可控制的前生成表征变量，其行为效应依赖检查点，理论界与实验共同刻画了这种划分错误的影响。

title: TontaubeV1: Streaming Text-to-Speech with Hierarchical Codec Modeling and Bounded Context
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Both authors contributed equally
summary: Text-to-speech systems often face a trade-off between natural prosody and efficient inference: higher perceptual quality typically comes at increased computational cost and latency. We present TontaubeV1, a model that preserves natural prosody while enabling streaming from a single consumer GPU. Speech is encoded by the hierarchical DualCodec representation at 12.5 Hz, which separates a semantic stream from successive acoustic refinements. Our design assumes that prosodic structure is largely established when the semantic stream is generated, and allocates capacity accordingly: a Qwen3-1.7B-derived transformer predicts that stream and thereby the utterance duration, while three progressively smaller Qwen3-0.6B-derived transformers each add one acoustic refinement. Text is tokenized per character rather than by subword. Paired text and audio markers at shared positions support long-form generation with bounded context, and overlapping DualCodec reconstructions are mapped into the VibeVoice acoustic latent space and decoded causally, enabling streaming despite DualCodec's noncausal decoder. The model accepts up to one minute of reference audio for voice conditioning and is designed primarily for English and German, with additional multilingual support. The four predictors total 2.9B parameters; on a single RTX 5090 the streaming path reaches approximately 200 ms to first audio. In separate non-streaming measurements, the end-to-end real-time factor (RTF) is 0.08 for one input and the aggregate RTF is 0.02 across eight concurrent inputs. On our LLM-as-a-judge audiobook-reading benchmark, TontaubeV1 matches ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 and outperforms Fish Audio S2 Pro, the April 2026 Gradium API, and Cartesia Sonic 3 on prosody. The model weights are released on Hugging Face under the Tontaube Community Model License 1.0.

AI.tldr: TontaubeV1 通过分层 DualCodec 表示与四级预测器设计，在单张消费级 GPU 上实现兼顾自然韵律的流式文本转语音。
AI.motivation: 文本转语音系统普遍存在自然韵律与推理效率之间的权衡：感知质量越高，计算成本与延迟通常越大。作者希望在保持自然韵律的同时实现低延迟流式推理。
AI.method: 语音由 12.5 Hz 的分层 DualCodec 表示编码，将语义流与逐级声学细化分离。假设韵律结构在语义流生成时基本确定，据此分配容量：一个基于 Qwen3-1.7B 的 transformer 预测语义流及话语时长，三个逐级变小的基于 Qwen3-0.6B 的 transformer 各添加一层声学细化。文本按字符而非子词分词。共享位置的成对文本与音频标记支持有界上下文的长文本生成；重叠的 DualCodec 重建被映射到 VibeVoice 声学潜空间并因果解码，从而在 DualCodec 非因果解码器下实现流式。支持最多一分钟参考音频进行音色条件化，主要面向英语和德语，并具备额外多语言支持。
AI.result: 四个预测器共 2.9B 参数；单张 RTX 5090 上流式路径首音频约 200 ms。非流式测量中，单输入端到端实时因子（RTF）为 0.08，八个并发输入的聚合 RTF 为 0.02。在 LLM-as-a-judge 有声书朗读基准上，韵律表现与 ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 相当，并优于 Fish Audio S2 Pro、2026 年 4 月的 Gradium API 和 Cartesia Sonic 3。
AI.conclusion: TontaubeV1 通过语义优先的容量分配与声学细化解耦，在消费级单卡上实现了低延迟流式合成与有竞争力的韵律质量，模型权重以 Tontaube Community Model License 1.0 在 Hugging Face 发布。

title: Enhancing Table Structure Recognition via Bounding Box Guidance
summary: Table Structure Recognition (TSR) aims to extract the bounding boxes of cells and table structure (e.g., HTML) from table images. Although current approaches have made significant progress, the latest image-to-sequence methods overlook the explicit utilization of the bounding box information when predicting HTML sequences, leading to error predictions in complex scenes. In this paper, we introduce a novel framework BGTR (Bounding Box-Guided Table Recognizer). To more effectively utilize bounding box information, we first predict the bounding boxes of cells and then use this information to guide the generation of HTML sequences. While utilizing bounding box information can enhance the accuracy of HTML sequences, for natural scene tables, the data volume is too small to allow for sufficient training of bbox-guided HTML generation. In response, we adopt a progressive training method for natural scene tables and introduce SNSTab, a synthetically generated natural scene table dataset. Our experiments on five benchmark datasets demonstrate SOTA performance.
