AI.tldr: 提出BGTR框架，先预测单元格边界框，再用其引导HTML序列生成，并引入合成自然场景表格数据集SNSTab与渐进训练策略。
AI.motivation: 现有图像到序列方法在预测HTML序列时未显式利用边界框信息，导致复杂场景下预测错误；同时自然场景表格数据量过小，难以充分训练边界框引导的HTML生成模型。
AI.method: 提出BGTR（Bounding Box-Guided Table Recognizer）框架：首先预测单元格边界框，然后利用该信息引导HTML序列生成；针对自然场景表格采用渐进训练方法，并引入合成自然场景表格数据集SNSTab。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用边界框信息引导HTML生成可提升表格结构识别准确率，配合渐进训练与合成数据集SNSTab能有效缓解自然场景表格数据不足问题。

title: TBR: Transport-Based Rendering with Deposition Strokes for Inverse Graphics
summary: We present a stroke design in which strokes are transport-coupled: each stroke deposits material of its own area and moves every earlier mark without changing its area, so later strokes deform earlier ones. We then solve the inverse problem under this design: given a target image, we optimise an ordered program of such strokes whose replay approximates it, with digital marbling as the motivating medium. The stroke is a capsule that continuously joins circular drops to drawn deposits; its transport is exactly area-preserving, with a closed-form inverse outside the deposit, and a variant with the same inverse differs from line-source potential flow by 8% of the mean displacement. A replay adjoint regenerates intermediate states instead of storing them and uses 8.7x less memory than checkpointed automatic differentiation; a fused implementation fits a 2000-stroke program at 1024x1024 in about four minutes on one GPU. On five marbled sheets the recovered programs are level with a published stroke-based fitter as rasters, replay across a fourfold resolution range, and support edits in program order and palette space that stay valid under transport.

AI.tldr: 提出"运输耦合"笔触设计：每笔在不改变自身面积的前提下搬运先前所有笔迹，并将其逆问题求解为有序笔画程序的优化，用于数字大理石纹绘制。
AI.motivation: 传统笔触彼此独立，后画笔触只覆盖已有笔迹而不改变其形状；作者希望笔触之间具有"运输耦合"关系，使后画笔触会形变已有笔迹，从而更真实地模拟大理石纹（marbling）这类流体介质中颜料被拖动、拉伸的过程，并据此求解逆问题——从目标图像反推可重放的有序笔触程序。
AI.method: 1) 笔触模型：将笔触定义为"胶囊"（capsule），由圆形液滴连续连接至已绘制沉积区，其运输严格保面积；在沉积区外存在闭式逆映射，其变体与线源势流相差平均位移的8%。2) 逆问题求解：给定目标图像，优化一个有序笔触程序使其重放结果逼近目标。3) 重放伴随（replay adjoint）：不存储中间状态而是重新生成，相比检查点式自动微分节省8.7倍内存。4) 融合实现：在单张GPU上约4分钟拟合1024×1024分辨率下的2000笔程序。
AI.result: 在五张大理石纹纸张上，恢复的笔触程序作为栅格图像与已发表的基于笔触的拟合方法相当；在四倍分辨率范围内重放一致；支持按程序顺序和调色板空间的编辑，且编辑在运输下保持有效。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明运输耦合笔触可用于求解逆问题，为数字大理石纹提供了一种兼具保面积运输、闭式逆映射与高效内存重放的可优化笔触表示，并支持保持运输有效性的顺序与调色板编辑。

title: CVT-GS: Learning to Simplify 3D Gaussian Splatting with Centroidal Voronoi Tessellation
summary: While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a powerful representation for real-time novel view synthesis, rendering high-fidelity scenes often relies on a massive number of Gaussian primitives, incurring substantial storage and computational overhead. Existing simplification techniques are largely intrusive, requiring training-time pruning, architectural modifications, or computationally expensive per-scene fine-tuning. These drawbacks limit their deployment on off-the-shelf pretrained models. In this paper, we propose CVT-GS, a novel optimization-free post-hoc simplification framework that directly compresses trained 3DGS scenes without sacrificing visual fidelity. Our approach first constructs spatially coherent cells over Gaussian centers via a geometry-aware Centroidal Voronoi Tessellation (CVT). Subsequently, a lightweight neural cell merger predicts the geometry and appearance of a single, highly representative Gaussian primitive for each cell under differentiable rendering supervision. By formulating simplification as a rendering-aware many-to-one merging process rather than naive primitive pruning, CVT-GS outputs a standard 3DGS scene that is seamlessly compatible with existing renderers. Experiments on various datasets demonstrate the superiority of our method. Notably, when achieving a 100-fold reduction in Gaussian points, our method operates 12 times faster than state-of-the-art methods while improving the PSNR by 1.3 dB.

AI.tldr: CVT-GS：一种免优化、后处理式的3DGS压缩框架，通过几何感知CVT划分空间单元并用轻量神经单元合并器生成代表性高斯，实现即插即用的高效简化。
AI.motivation: 3DGS实现高保真渲染依赖海量高斯原语，带来存储与计算开销。现有简化方法多为侵入式，需训练期剪枝、修改架构或昂贵的逐场景微调，难以应用于现成预训练模型。
AI.method: 首先基于高斯中心构建几何感知的质心Voronoi划分（CVT），得到空间连贯的单元；随后用轻量级神经单元合并器，在可微渲染监督下为每个单元预测单个高代表性高斯的几何与外观。将简化建模为渲染感知的多对一合并，而非朴素剪枝，输出标准3DGS场景。
AI.result: 在多数据集上验证优越性：高斯点数减少100倍时，运行速度比SOTA方法快12倍，同时PSNR提升1.3 dB。
AI.conclusion: CVT-GS提供了免优化、后处理、与现有渲染器无缝兼容的3DGS简化方案，兼顾压缩率、速度与视觉保真度。

title: GaugeDefect: Detecting Surface Anomalies by Curvature of Feature Transport
comment: Accepted at the 9th Chinese Conference on Pattern Recognition and Computer Vision (PRCV 2026)
summary: Industrial anomaly localization has advanced rapidly with feature-based, reconstruction-based, and distillation-based methods. Most of these methods score a region by asking how unusual its local appearance or feature representation is with respect to normal training images. This is a strong and practical formulation. In this work, we study a complementary geometric cue for cases where an abnormal region may still contain locally plausible visual features. Thin scratches, small dents, and disrupted repeated patterns often do not make every local patch individually abnormal; instead, they disturb how nearby features vary and connect across the surface. We propose GaugeDefect, a geometric method for surface anomaly localization based on the curvature of feature transport. Given a feature lattice, we estimate a local feature frame at each node and compute orthogonal transports between neighboring frames. The accumulated transport around a small closed loop gives a holonomy matrix, whose deviation from identity measures feature-transport curvature. After calibration on normal training images, unusually large curvature indicates a local inconsistency in the feature field. The curvature here is not the physical curvature of the inspected object, but a representation-space measure of neighborhood inconsistency. This makes the method applicable to curved surfaces, textured materials, and non-planar industrial objects. Its main role is to improve localization of subtle surface disruptions, while often producing sharper responses near defect boundaries as a natural consequence of the curvature signal.

AI.tldr: 提出 GaugeDefect，一种基于特征传输曲率的几何方法，用于工业表面异常定位，补充现有局部外观/表征打分范式。
AI.motivation: 现有基于特征、重建、蒸馏的方法多依赖“局部外观或表征是否异常”来打分，对细划痕、小凹坑、重复纹理被打断等缺陷不敏感——这类缺陷的局部 patch 往往仍显得正常，异常体现在邻域特征如何变化与连接上，因此需要互补的几何线索。
AI.method: 在特征格点上为每个节点估计局部特征标架，计算相邻标架间的正交传输；沿小闭环累积传输得到 holonomy 矩阵，其与单位矩阵的偏差即特征传输曲率。该曲率衡量表征空间中邻域一致性，而非物体物理曲率；在正常训练图像上校准阈值，曲率异常大者判为局部不一致。可适用于曲面、纹理材料与非平面工件。
AI.result: 在正常图像校准后，异常大的曲率可指示缺陷位置；主要提升细微表面破坏的定位效果，并因曲率信号特性常在缺陷边界附近产生更锐利的响应。
AI.conclusion: 几何曲率信号可作为现有异常定位范式的互补线索，对局部特征仍合理的破坏型缺陷有效，且不依赖物体物理几何，具备材料与曲面泛化性。

title: Kairos: A Dataset for Fine-Grained Video-Language Modeling over Space, Time, and Dynamics
summary: Many emerging video language modeling tasks require systems to move beyond clip-level abstraction and model visual content as it unfolds over extended time horizons. However, most existing video datasets rely on coarse or sparsely aligned supervision, which compresses temporal variation and limits the ability of models to learn reusable representations of continuous visual dynamics. We introduce Kairos, a video dataset for video-language modeling with time-resolved annotations. Kairos consists of long-duration videos, ranging from ten minutes to half an hour, annotated with fine-grained temporal alignment. The annotations capture ongoing actions, entity appearances and attributes, interactions, and evolving contextual cues along the video timeline. This time-resolved structure supports fine-grained evaluation, long-range modeling and reasoning, instruction data construction, representation learning, and video generation. Kairos provides a general-purpose foundation for modeling visual experiences over time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Kairos——一个具有时间分辨标注的长时视频语言数据集，旨在支持连续视觉动态的建模与跨时间推理。
AI.motivation: 现有视频语言任务要求系统超越片段级抽象，建模长时间跨度下展开的视觉内容；但多数现有视频数据集依赖粗糙或稀疏对齐的监督，压缩了时间变化，限制了模型学习可复用的连续视觉动态表征的能力。
AI.method: 构建Kairos数据集：收录时长为10分钟至半小时的长视频，并提供细粒度时间对齐标注；标注内容涵盖进行中的动作、实体出现与属性、交互以及随视频时间线演变的上下文线索。
AI.result: Kairos的时间分辨结构支持细粒度评估、长程建模与推理、指令数据构建、表征学习以及视频生成等多种用途。
AI.conclusion: Kairos为随时间建模视觉经验提供了通用基础。

title: No Free Checker: A Survey of Verifiers for Robot Policies
comment: Survey. 33 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables, 202 references. Covers reward models, success and failure detection, temporal-logic and formal verification, world-model evaluation, and reward hacking. Project page: https://github.com/ZJUSCL/Awesome-Robot-Verifier
summary: A verifier for robot policies reads a candidate behavior and returns a score for how well it did, used both to evaluate vision-language-action policies and to train them. Verifiers range from success detectors and reward models to runtime monitors, safety filters, and temporal-logic specifications. We survey roughly 150 verifiers and compare them along two properties. Availability is how much a verdict costs, how early in a rollout the verdict arrives, and how often a verdict can be asked for. Availability rises as verdicts get cheaper, earlier, and denser. Credibility is how much a high score tells us about the task. Credibility falls as the judgment becomes gameable and self-serving. We group the verifiers by who supplies the judgment: human verifiers, rule-based and formal verifiers, learned and pretrained verifiers, and model-intrinsic verifiers. Across the four families, we find that credibility falls as availability rises. Regardless of who supplies the judgment, there is no free checker. We then examine what validates a verifier itself, and how much a high score tells us. Three measures appear in the literature: agreement with human labels, the performance of the policy it trains, and behavior under reward hacking. We close with nine metrics that make a verifier claim checkable, and coordinates for the verifiers still to be built.

AI.tldr: 该综述调研约150个机器人策略验证器，沿"可用性"与"可信度"两个维度进行比较，发现二者存在此消彼长的权衡关系，并提出验证器自身的评估方法与九项可核查指标。
AI.motivation: 机器人策略验证器被广泛用于评估和训练视觉-语言-动作策略，涵盖成功检测器、奖励模型、运行时监控、安全过滤器、时序逻辑规范等多种形式。然而这些验证器在设计理念与判断来源上差异巨大，缺乏统一的比较框架，也缺乏对"验证器本身如何被验证"这一元问题的系统梳理。
AI.method: 作者综述约150个验证器，将其沿两个属性刻画：可用性（判定成本、判定在rollout中到达的早晚、判定可被请求的密集程度）与可信度（高分对任务完成情况的指示强度、可被博弈与自利利用的程度）。随后按判定供给者将验证器分为四类：人类验证器、规则与形式化验证器、学习与预训练验证器、模型内在验证器。此外梳理文献中验证验证器本身的三类度量：与人类标注的一致性、其所训练策略的性能、奖励黑客下的行为表现。
AI.result: 跨四类验证器家族观察到一致规律：可用性上升时可信度下降；无论判定由谁提供，都不存在"免费检查器"（no free checker）。在验证器自身有效性方面，文献主要使用三类验证手段。最后给出九项指标使验证器主张可被核查，并给出尚待构建的验证器的坐标方向。
AI.conclusion: 验证器设计中可用性与可信度之间存在本质权衡，不存在同时廉价、及时、密集且高度可信的判定来源。作者通过九项可核查指标与待构建验证器的坐标，为后续研究提供了统一评估与设计框架。

title: Benchmark Scores Are Pipeline-Dependent: A Reliability Audit of Cybersecurity LLM Benchmarks
summary: Large language model (LLM) benchmarks are often treated as fixed datasets with stable scores, yet their outcomes depend on configurable evaluation pipelines. We audit eight cybersecurity benchmarks across 10 proprietary, open-weight, and cybersecurity-specialized LLMs. By modeling benchmarks as measurement pipelines, we identify 15 systematic failure modes and show that a single pipeline choice can change a model's score by more than 80 percentage points and substantially alter model rankings. At the cross-benchmark level, two semantically similar task pairs rank the same models differently because of incompatible evaluation conventions. Under an evaluation harness that standardizes pipeline choices while preserving task semantics, nine of 10 models shift by at least three ranks on at least one benchmark. These results show that cybersecurity LLM benchmark scores are pipeline-dependent and motivate pipeline-aware auditing as a core requirement for reliable model evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文将网络安全领域的LLM基准测试建模为可配置的测量流水线，审计了8个基准与10个模型，发现15种系统性失效模式。单一流水线选择可使分数变化超过80个百分点并改变模型排名；在标准化流水线下，10个模型中有9个至少在一个基准上排名变动≥3位。结论是网络安全LLM基准分数高度依赖流水线配置，需将流水线感知审计作为可靠评估的核心要求。
AI.motivation: LLM基准通常被当作固定数据集与稳定分数使用，但其结果实际取决于可配置的评估流水线。作者关注这种“分数稳定性”假设的脆弱性，尤其在网络安全这一高风险领域，评估结论可能因流水线设计差异而严重失真，因此有必要系统审计其影响。
AI.method: 作者将基准测试形式化为测量流水线（measurement pipeline），对8个网络安全基准和10个模型（包括闭源专有、开放权重以及网络安全专用LLM）进行审计。通过改变流水线中的配置选择来识别系统性失效模式，并在跨基准层面比较语义相似任务对在不同评估惯例下的排名一致性。随后构建一个在保持任务语义不变的前提下标准化流水线选择的评估框架（evaluation harness），检验模型排名稳定性。
AI.result: 识别出15种系统性失效模式；单一流水线选择可导致模型分数变化超过80个百分点，并显著改变模型排名。跨基准上，两个语义相似的任务对因评估惯例不兼容而给出不同的模型排序。在标准化流水线的评估框架下，10个模型中有9个至少在一个基准上排名移动至少3位。
AI.conclusion: 网络安全LLM基准分数是流水线依赖（pipeline-dependent）的，而非固定不变的模型属性。因此，可靠模型评估必须把流水线感知审计（pipeline-aware auditing）作为核心要求，否则基于基准的模型比较与选型结论可能不可靠。

title: Compensating for Scarce Historical Images in Cross-Domain Cultural Heritage Retrieval Using Synthetic Aging
summary: Cultural heritage collections often contain contemporary and historical visual records of the same physical object. Linking these records is difficult because corresponding images may differ in viewpoint, acquisition conditions, color reproduction, framing, resolution, and degradation, while genuine historical images are frequently scarce. This study investigates whether synthetically aged contemporary images can replace or complement missing historical training data in bidirectional instance-level retrieval. Synthetic old-domain images are generated using degradation-oriented transformations. An EfficientNetV2-M model is evaluated on identity-disjoint training, validation, and test sets across three dataset partitions and three training seeds. Mixed real-synthetic training is compared with real-only baselines using proportionally scaled and fixed 300-batch-per-epoch schedules. Complete replacement of genuine historical images reduced bidirectional mean R@1 from 86.56% to 81.27%, showing that synthetic aging does not reproduce the full genuine old-domain variability. Increasing the number of independently generated synthetic variants provided no consistent improvement. Under controlled scarcity, however, synthetic completion improved mean R@1 by 3.69 percentage points at 25% genuine historical coverage and by 2.92 points at 50%, relative to the proportionally scaled real-only baselines. At 75%, the gain decreased to 2.00 points, while performance remained comparable to the complete-real-data reference. Fixed-schedule real-only controls did not reproduce these improvements. The results indicate that genuine and synthetic observations are complementary. Synthetic completion primarily benefits retrieval by extending cross-domain identity coverage rather than by increasing training exposure, with its contribution gradually decreasing as genuine historical coverage increases.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验合成老化图像能否替代或补充缺失的历史训练数据，用于双向实例级检索。实验表明合成图像无法完全替代真实历史图像，但在真实历史数据稀缺时能带来显著增益。
AI.motivation: 文化遗产藏品中常同时包含同一实物的当代与历史视觉记录，但对应图像在视角、采集条件、色彩还原、构图、分辨率与退化方面存在差异，且真实历史图像往往稀缺，导致跨域实例级链接困难。作者因此探究合成老化图像能否替代或补充缺失的历史训练数据。
AI.method: 使用面向退化的变换生成合成"旧域"图像；采用EfficientNetV2-M模型，在身份不相交的训练、验证与测试集上评估；覆盖3种数据集划分与3个训练随机种子；对比"真实+合成"混合训练与仅真实数据基线，并采用按比例缩放的调度与每epoch固定300批次的调度。
AI.result: 完全用合成图像替代真实历史图像使双向平均R@1由86.56%降至81.27%，说明合成老化无法复现真实旧域的全部多样性；增加独立生成的合成变体数量未带来一致提升。在受控稀缺条件下，合成补全在25%真实历史覆盖率下使平均R@1提升3.69个百分点，50%时提升2.92个百分点，75%时收益降至2.00个百分点，但性能仍与完整真实数据参照相当。固定批次数调度的仅真实数据对照未能复现上述提升。
AI.conclusion: 真实与合成观测具有互补性。合成补全主要通过扩展跨域身份覆盖而非增加训练曝光量来提升检索性能，且其贡献随真实历史覆盖率提高而逐渐减小。

title: AXS-Net: Interpretable Deep Unfolding for Hyperspectral Image Denoising via Spectral Basis Unmixing and Structured Noise Refinement
comment: 15 pages. Accepted to The 14th International Conference on Image and Graphics (ICIG2026), July 31, 2026
summary: Hyperspectral images (HSIs) are often degraded by mixed noise, including band-dependent Gaussian perturbations and structured artifacts such as stripes, dead-lines, and impulse noise. Most deep denoisers regress the clean image directly, entangling signal and structured noise. We instead model HSI denoising as $\Y=\A\X+\Snoise+\Nnoise$, where $\A\X$ is a low-rank spectral-subspace (unmixing) reconstruction, $\Snoise$ is structured sparse noise and $\Nnoise$ is residual Gaussian noise. The resulting regularized optimization problem is unrolled into AXS-Net, a $K$-stage alternating proximal-point framework. Each stage combines an analytic spectral-basis gradient step, an SSX-Block proximal operator for abundance coefficients, and an SBlock proximal operator for the structured residual with column-consistent and sparse priors. This optimization correspondence exposes interpretable endmembers, abundance maps, and structured-noise estimates. Across ICVL, CAVE, and Harvard datasets and five noise configurations, the proposed AXS-Net achieves strong in-domain accuracy and competitive zero-shot transfer, with consistent gains across all five noise regimes on ICVL and Harvard. The recovered structured-noise closely follows the synthetic reference, and the recovered spectral basis is smooth and band-ordered rather than an arbitrary set of latent channels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AXS-Net，将高光谱图像去噪建模为低秩光谱子空间重构、结构化稀疏噪声与残差高斯噪声的加性分解，并通过K阶段交替近端算法展开为可解释网络。
AI.motivation: 高光谱图像常受混合噪声退化（波段相关高斯扰动及条纹、坏线、脉冲等结构化伪影）。现有深度去噪器直接回归干净图像，导致信号与结构化噪声耦合，缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 将去噪建模为 Y=AX+S+N，其中AX为低秩光谱子空间（解混）重构，S为结构化稀疏噪声，N为残差高斯噪声；将正则化优化问题展开为K阶段交替近端框架AXS-Net。每阶段包含解析光谱基梯度步、面向丰度系数的SSX-Block近端算子，以及面向结构化残差的SBlock近端算子（列一致性与稀疏先验）。
AI.result: 在ICVL、CAVE与Harvard数据集及五种噪声配置下，AXS-Net取得较强域内精度与有竞争力的零样本迁移，在ICVL与Harvard的五种噪声情形下均有稳定增益；恢复的结构化噪声接近合成参考，恢复光谱基平滑且按波段有序，而非任意潜通道。
AI.conclusion: 该优化对应关系带来了可解释的端元、丰度图与结构化噪声估计，表明基于物理分解的展开网络在HSI去噪中兼具精度与可解释性。

title: Improving Term Evaluation in Machine Translation: Variation Matters
summary: Terminology evaluation in machine translation (MT) usually assumes a single correct target form per source term. However, human translators routinely introduce variation that current metrics penalize as inconsistency. We examine how to account for this variation in document-level MT evaluation of English-French scientific translation, combining glossary-based accuracy, translation consistency, and a new cross-term variation (CTV) diagnostic measure that tests whether variation relationships are preserved across languages. Based on analyses of two parallel corpora, translated by four MT systems, we find that (1) MT systems generate less target-side variation than human translators; (2) transfer patterns strongly depend on the variation type; (3) consistency rankings vary with the choice of metric; and (4) constraining MT with a glossary improves accuracy and consistency but degrades CTV by suppressing valid variation. We argue for variation-aware evaluation that conditions consistency penalties on whether target-side variation mirrors source-side variation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对机器翻译术语评价中"单一正确译法"假设的不足，提出纳入译者术语变异的评价框架，结合术语表准确率、翻译一致性与新的跨术语变异（CTV）诊断指标，在英法科学翻译的文档级评价中进行分析。
AI.motivation: 现有机器翻译术语评价通常假定每个源术语只有一个正确目标形式，而人类译者实际会产生变异，当前指标会将其错误地惩罚为"不一致"。本文旨在解决如何在文档级机器翻译评价中合理考虑这种变异。
AI.method: 基于两个平行语料库、四个机器翻译系统的译文，结合术语表准确率、翻译一致性，以及新提出的跨术语变异（CTV）诊断指标，检验跨语言变异关系是否被保留。
AI.result: （1）机器翻译系统产生的目标端变异少于人类译者；（2）迁移模式强烈依赖变异类型；（3）一致性排名随指标选择而变化；（4）使用术语表约束可提升准确率和一致性，但会通过抑制合理变异而降低CTV。
AI.conclusion: 主张采用"变异感知"的评价方法，即根据目标端变异是否镜像源端变异来决定是否施加一致性惩罚。

title: Interpretable Hyperspectral Unmixing Framework with Fixed Endmember Prior and Structured Residual Refinement
comment: 16 pages.Accepted to 23rd Pacific Rim International Conference on Artificial Intelligence (PRICAI 2026)
summary: Hyperspectral unmixing decomposes mixed pixels into material endmembers and their abundances from contiguous spectral observations. In modular sensing pipelines, endmembers are often first identified and then treated as fixed during abundance estimation. When this fixed endmember prior is inaccurate, spatially structured mismatch arising from illumination changes, sensor artifacts, or material boundaries may be incorrectly captured by the abundance variables, leading to unstable decompositions. This study presents an interpretable stage-wise hyperspectral unmixing framework (I-HyperSU) under fixed endmember priors, which is explicitly decomposed into a fixed endmember matrix $\mathbf{A}$, an abundance block $\mathbf{X}$, and a structural residual refinement block $\mathbf{S}$. The X-block estimates abundances using FISTA with nonnegativity and sparsity enhancement, and a soft penalty that approximately enforces sum-to-one constraints. The S-block jointly applies low-rank SVD structural regularization and a lightweight deep image prior (DIP) to refine structured residuals. This staged design makes the interaction between abundance and residual components transparent and interpretable. Experiments on Samson, Urban, and Jasper Ridge datasets demonstrate that, under fixed and imperfect endmember priors, soft abundance relaxation consistently outperforms hard simplex projection. Under the default N-FINDR endmember prior, the proposed framework reduces the joint reconstruction error by 61.7\%--69.5\% compared with a fixed-$\mathbf{A}$ UCLS baseline, while keeping the abundance RMSE nearly unchanged, indicating that the residual refinement branch accounts for structured model mismatch without degrading the abundance estimates. For example, on Urban, the reconstruction SAM decreases from $5.99^\circ$ for the X-only model to $1.92^\circ$ for the full model.

AI.tldr: 提出可解释的分阶段高光谱解混框架I-HyperSU，在固定端元先验下将解混显式分解为端元矩阵A、丰度块X与结构残差修正块S，结合FISTA软松弛与低秩SVD+DIP残差修正，在三个数据集上显著降低重构误差而不损害丰度精度。
AI.motivation: 模块化感知流程中端元先验常被固定，若先验不准确，光照变化、传感器伪影或材料边界导致的空间结构失配会被错误地归入丰度变量，造成分解不稳定。现有方法缺乏对丰度与残差成分交互的可解释建模。
AI.method: 构建分阶段可解释框架I-HyperSU，显式分解为固定端元矩阵A、丰度块X和结构残差修正块S。X块采用FISTA并施加非负性、稀疏增强及近似和为一约束的软惩罚；S块联合低秩SVD结构正则与轻量深度图像先验（DIP）修正结构化残差。
AI.result: 在Samson、Urban、Jasper Ridge数据集上，固定且不完美端元先验下，软丰度松弛持续优于硬单纯形投影。默认N-FINDR端元先验下，相比固定A的UCLS基线，联合重构误差降低61.7%--69.5%，丰度RMSE几乎不变。Urban上重构SAM从仅X模型的5.99°降至完整模型的1.92°。
AI.conclusion: 分阶段设计使丰度与残差成分的交互透明可解释；残差修正分支可吸收结构化模型失配，在不降低丰度估计精度的前提下大幅改善重构质量。

title: Hi-FLoop: Hierarchical State-Feedback Loops for Multi-Timescale World Modeling
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, and 6 tables. Revised abstract, results, and branch-consistency presentation
summary: Multi-agent traffic simulation seeks diverse, coordinated, and physically realistic futures from maps and observed history. Long-horizon closed-loop generation must reconcile multiple decision time scales while its context evolves with generated states. Existing methods often unfold long futures from an initial scene and resolve intent, interaction, and motion monolithically, weakening cross-scale consistency and adaptation. Multimodal rollout poses a further consistency problem: independently reselecting modes across agents or commits can stitch together incompatible futures instead of preserving a coherent joint branch. We present Hi-FLoop, a branch-consistent multi-timescale state-feedback framework. Eight scene-level Worlds represent joint hypotheses; all agents share one selected World identity throughout all 16 commits of an 8-second rollout, while Goal, Preview, and Control states adapt within that branch. An 8-second Goal anchors intent, a 2-second Preview coordinates interactions, and 1-second Control produces physical motion. Every 0.5-second commit feeds back only its executed prefix as new facts, while unexecuted hypotheses never enter factual memory. Joint Preview Interaction induces a sparse directed future graph and uses conflict probabilities and signed arrival-time differences to refine interaction-aware motion. For generated-state recovery, a prefix-frozen A-to-B cascade transfers typed physical state and the branch index--but no latent state--from a frozen prefix model to an independently parameterized recovery model. On the full H-D public-validation split of 955 scenarios, the S2.1 cascade obtains an 8-second scene-joint ADE-at-joint-minFDE@8/joint-minFDE@8 of 2.048/6.384 m when one World must explain all evaluated agents. Agent-centric oracle-minADE@8 is 0.526 m at 6 seconds and 0.875 m at 8 seconds.

AI.tldr: Hi-FLoop是一种分支一致的多时间尺度状态反馈框架，用于多智能体交通仿真，通过8个场景级Worlds、8秒/2秒/1秒三层时间尺度状态与0.5秒提交反馈，实现长时程闭环生成中的跨尺度一致性与多模态联合分支一致性。
AI.motivation: 长时程闭环交通仿真需协调多个决策时间尺度，且上下文随生成状态不断演化。现有方法多从初始场景一次性展开长未来，将意图、交互与运动单体化求解，削弱跨尺度一致性与适应性；多模态rollout还存在独立重选模式导致不兼容未来拼接的一致性难题。
AI.method: 提出Hi-FLoop分支一致多时间尺度状态反馈框架：8个场景级Worlds表示联合假设，所有智能体在8秒16个commit中共享同一World身份；8秒Goal锚定意图、2秒Preview协调交互、1秒Control生成物理运动。每0.5秒commit仅将已执行前缀作为新事实反馈，未执行假设不进入事实记忆。Joint Preview Interaction构建稀疏有向未来图，利用冲突概率与带符号到达时间差细化交互感知运动。采用前缀冻结的A-to-B级联，将类型化物理状态与分支索引（无隐状态）从冻结前缀模型迁移至独立参数化的恢复模型。
AI.result: 在H-D公共验证集全部955个场景上，S2.1级联在单一World须解释所有评估智能体时取得8秒scene-joint ADE-at-joint-minFDE@8/joint-minFDE@8为2.048/6.384 m；智能体中心oracle-minADE@8在6秒为0.526 m，8秒为0.875 m。
AI.conclusion: Hi-FLoop通过分支一致的World身份共享、多时间尺度状态分解与仅反馈已执行前缀的机制，解决了长时程闭环仿真中的跨尺度一致性、多模态联合分支一致性与生成状态恢复问题，并在大规模验证集上取得良好精度。

title: Bridging Network Psychometrics and Artificial Intelligence: An Ising-Potts Model with LLM-Derived Weights
summary: The Potts model extends the Ising model to multinomial data. We introduce a Rater Ising-Potts model that uses agreement indicators between pairs of ratings and category labels, with weights derived from LLM embeddings. The model does not presuppose ordered category thresholds or equidistant scoring; instead, it focuses on pairwise agreement among ratings and assigns category-specific positive weights, making it suited for multi-category scoring reliability. We evaluate the model on three constructed-response datasets spanning a corpus of K=14,466 short answers on a three-level rubric and two AERA essay prompts of roughly 1,200-1,400 responses on four-point rubrics. We compare three strategies for sharpening the similarity signal: top-K pruning, min-max normalization with a power transformation, and ColBERT late-interaction similarities. Top-K pruning, which replaces the dense similarity graph with a sparse local network of strongest semantic neighbors, consistently yields the highest accuracy and Cohen's kappa, and the selected neighborhoods are always a small fraction of the corpus. Power tuning consistently ranks second, while ColBERT is competitive on longer essay prompts and adds little on short answers. Across all settings, most misclassifications occur between adjacent score levels, confirming that the model preserves the ordinal structure of scoring rubrics without imposing rigid assumptions. These findings suggest that LLM-derived similarities, combined with a parsimonious Potts formulation and a sparse local graph, offer a robust and interpretable framework for reliability auditing in educational assessment. We discuss extensions to multiple raters and hierarchical rating designs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Rater Ising-Potts 模型，用 LLM 嵌入导出的配对一致性权重对多类别评分进行信度建模，并通过稀疏化策略提升准确率与 kappa。
AI.motivation: 将 Ising 模型推广到多类别（Potts）评分信度分析，避免预设有序阈值或等距计分假设，适配多分类评分场景。
AI.method: 基于评分对之间的一致性指标与类别标签构建 Rater Ising-Potts 模型，权重由 LLM 嵌入导出，并为各评分类别赋予正权重；比较三种相似度增强策略：top-K 剪枝、带幂变换的 min-max 归一化、ColBERT 延迟交互相似度。
AI.result: 在三个构答数据集上（K=14,466 道三级评分短答；两个 AERA 作文提示，约 1,200–1,400 份四点评分作答）评估：top-K 剪枝在准确率和 Cohen's kappa 上最高，且所选邻域仅占语料很小比例；幂变换调参稳定居第二；ColBERT 在长作文上有竞争力，短答上增益有限。多数误分类发生在相邻分数等级之间。
AI.conclusion: LLM 导出相似度结合简约 Potts 表述与稀疏局部图，可为教育评估信度审计提供稳健且可解释的框架，并讨论了向多评分者与层级评分设计的扩展。

title: Eliciting Weak-to-Strong Generalization with On-Policy Reverse Distillation
summary: Weak-to-strong generalization asks whether stronger models can learn from weaker supervisors and surpass them. This question is particularly important for successive model generations and multi-domain consolidation, where repeating frontier-scale post-training from scratch can be prohibitively expensive. Yet conventional distillation treats the weak teacher as an optimization target, potentially imposing its capacity ceiling on the student. We introduce On-Policy Reverse Distillation (OPRD), which evaluates the teacher's policy shift relative to its reference policy on student rollouts and amplifies the component of the student's verifier-driven policy gradient along that direction. By rescaling only verifier-supported updates, OPRD preserves the stationary points of policy optimization while accelerating learning beyond the teacher. In both successive model transfer and multi-teacher distillation, OPRD achieves higher performance with fewer student updates than existing RL and distillation approaches. Response-style analysis shows that OPRD students remain closer to models trained with verifier-based RL alone than to their weak teachers, suggesting that teacher guidance accelerates rather than redirects the student's own optimization. Results in conventional strong-to-weak distillation further demonstrate that OPRD effectively combines verifier-driven policy optimization with teacher guidance regardless of capacity ordering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出On-Policy Reverse Distillation (OPRD)，通过在学生rollout上评估教师策略相对其参考策略的偏移，并沿该方向放大由验证器驱动的学生策略梯度，实现弱到强泛化，在更少更新下超越教师。
AI.motivation: 连续模型代际更新与多领域整合中，从零进行前沿规模后训练成本高昂，因此需要更强模型从较弱监督者学习并超越它（weak-to-strong generalization）。然而传统蒸馏将弱教师视为优化目标，会把其能力上限施加给学生。
AI.method: OPRD在学生rollout上评估教师策略相对其参考策略的策略偏移，并沿该方向放大学生的验证器驱动策略梯度；仅对验证器支持的更新进行重缩放，从而保留策略优化的驻点。
AI.result: 在连续模型迁移和多教师蒸馏中，OPRD以更少的学生更新次数取得比现有RL和蒸馏方法更高的性能。响应风格分析显示，OPRD学生更接近仅用验证器RL训练的模型而非弱教师，表明教师指导加速而非改变学生自身优化。在传统强到弱蒸馏中，OPRD同样有效结合验证器驱动策略优化与教师指导，且不受能力排序影响。
AI.conclusion: OPRD通过放大验证器支持方向上的策略梯度，加速学生超越教师，且不改变策略优化的驻点，能够无论能力排序如何都有效融合验证器驱动优化与教师指导。

title: Evaluation Principles for MRI-MRA Registration in Trigeminal Neuralgia: An ROI-Centered Neurovascular Benchmark
summary: Preoperative evaluation of trigeminal neuralgia (TN) often requires joint interpretation of structural MRI, which depicts the trigeminal nerve and surrounding cisternal anatomy, and time-of-flight MRA, which highlights vascular structures. Although MRI-MRA fusion is clinically attractive for visualizing neurovascular compression, this task is poorly captured by conventional whole-brain registration evaluation because the clinically relevant target is a small trigeminal ROI, vessel annotations are partial and clinically focused, local TOF-MRA contrast is variable, and field-of-view mismatch can limit deformable alignment. We formulate TN MRI-MRA fusion as an ROI-centered neurovascular registration-evaluation problem and construct a benchmark from 149 patients with clinician-annotated bilateral trigeminal ROIs. Six representative registration pipelines were evaluated using local image-based metrics, segmentation-derived vessel-localization metrics, prediction-volume analysis, and contrast- and FOV-stratified comparisons. Conventional evaluation summaries were often misleading: local image similarity, vessel-background separability, and downstream vessel localization did not co-rank methods; one-sided vessel distances were strongly affected by predicted vessel extent under partial annotations; and local MRA contrast determined when vessel-separability metrics were informative. Deformable refinement provided only a small, FOV-dependent benefit over affine alignment, while reader review showed that locally favorable vessel distances could coexist with globally implausible registrations. These findings indicate that TN MRI-MRA registration should be evaluated as a local, vessel-aware, contrast-sensitive, and FOV-aware visualization task rather than as generic multimodal brain registration. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/jhuldr/TN-Reg-Benchmark.

AI.tldr: 该研究将三叉神经痛(TN)的MRI-MRA融合重新定义为以三叉神经ROI为中心的神经血管配准评估问题，基于149例患者构建基准，系统评估6种配准流程，发现常规全脑配准评价指标常产生误导。
AI.motivation: TN术前评估需联合解读显示神经及脑池解剖的MRI与显示血管的TOF-MRA，MRI-MRA融合在临床上有利于观察神经血管压迫，但该任务无法被常规全脑配准评估有效刻画：临床相关靶区是小的三叉神经ROI，血管标注部分且具临床倾向性，局部TOF-MRA对比度可变，视野(FOV)不匹配会限制形变对齐。
AI.method: 将TN MRI-MRA融合建模为以ROI为中心的神经血管配准评估问题，基于149例患者的临床医师标注双侧三叉神经ROI构建基准。评估6种代表性配准流程，采用局部图像相似度指标、分割导出的血管定位指标、预测体积分析以及按对比度和FOV分层的比较。
AI.result: 常规评估汇总常具误导性：局部图像相似度、血管-背景可分性与下游血管定位对方法排序不一致；在部分标注下，单侧血管距离强烈受预测血管范围影响；局部MRA对比度决定血管可分性指标何时具有信息量；形变细化相对仿射对齐仅带来小幅、依赖FOV的增益；阅片者复核显示局部良好的血管距离可与全局不合理的配准并存。
AI.conclusion: TN MRI-MRA配准应作为局部、血管感知、对比度敏感且FOV敏感的显像任务来评估，而非通用多模态脑配准。代码已公开于https://github.com/jhuldr/TN-Reg-Benchmark。

title: ArmPoser: Real-Time, Calibration-Free Arm Pose Estimation from Smartwatch IMU
summary: Arm pose estimation enables applications in fitness, extended reality input, rehabilitation, and life logging. Prior smartwatch-based approaches rely on calibration poses and preprocessing pipelines that transform raw IMU measurements into standardized training formats. These steps hinder deployment in everyday settings and introduce errors due to imperfect calibration and sensor drift. We present ArmPoser, a calibration-free arm pose estimation system using a single smartwatch IMU. Our central contribution is training models directly in the reference frame native to consumer smartwatches, aligning learning with how IMU data is produced by deployed devices. By operating on device-native axes, ArmPoser removes the need for coordinate transformations, explicit alignment, and bone-offset calibration used in prior work. We further augment training with physically grounded variations in watch placement and arm morphology to account for user-specific variability. ArmPoser also includes a wear-configuration module that infers anterior or posterior forearm placement and crown orientation. We evaluate pose estimation on public benchmarks and on a 10-participant, 30-activity study using watchOS and Android smartwatches, where ArmPoser matches or exceeds calibrated baselines without any user calibration.

AI.tldr: 提出 ArmPoser，一种免校准的单智能手表 IMU 手臂姿态估计系统，通过直接在手表的设备原生坐标系中训练模型，消除坐标变换与骨骼偏移校准，在公开基准与自采数据上无需用户校准即可达到或超过需校准的基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于智能手表的手臂姿态估计依赖校准姿势与预处理流程，将原始 IMU 测量转换为标准化训练格式。这些步骤阻碍了日常场景部署，并因校准不完美与传感器漂移引入误差。
AI.method: 核心是直接在消费级智能手表的原生参考系中训练模型，使学习与设备产生 IMU 数据的方式一致；在设备原生轴向上操作，免除坐标变换、显式对齐与骨骼偏移校准。此外引入具有物理依据的手表佩戴位置与手臂形态变化进行训练增强，并设计佩戴配置模块，推断前臂前侧/后侧佩戴及表冠朝向。
AI.result: 在公开基准以及一项 10 名参与者、30 种活动、涵盖 watchOS 与 Android 智能手表的研究中进行评估，ArmPoser 在无任何用户校准的情况下达到或超过需校准的基线。
AI.conclusion: 免校准、设备原生坐标系建模可在真实日常条件下实现可部署且准确的手臂姿态估计，减少对手工校准与预处理管线的依赖。

title: Beyond Gait: Person Identification from Millimeter-Wave Point Clouds Across Activities of Daily Living
summary: Person identification from millimeter-wave (mmWave) point clouds has mainly relied on gait. Indoor walking, however, is often brief and interrupted, while other activities of daily living (ADLs) may provide complementary identity information. We investigate identification across seven ADLs using mm-ADL, a new point-cloud dataset collected from 11 subjects under a controlled protocol. This extension introduces heterogeneous states and transitions whose spatial and temporal characteristics vary with activity. We therefore study whether activity can provide useful context for learning identity representations. We propose an activity-conditioned framework in which a human activity recognition router dispatches each clip to an activity-specific identity expert. The framework is implemented as a supervised mixture of experts, using a dual-stream static-dynamic PointNet (DS-SDPNet) to combine time-aggregated spatial structure with frame-to-frame information. We evaluate closed-set identification (ID) and subject-disjoint re-identification (ReID). With learned hard routing, ID accuracy increases from 62.1% to 68.0%. In a two-occupant ReID setting, hard routing increases mAP from 57.2% to 75.4% and Rank-1 accuracy from 59.1% to 82.1%. Under a matched gallery partition, activity-specific experts also outperform a shared embedding, showing that the gain extends beyond restricting the gallery. These results support the feasibility of using ADLs beyond gait for identification and the value of activity conditioning under controlled indoor conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 mm-ADL 点云数据集与活动条件化识别框架，通过活动识别路由器将片段分派给活动专属身份专家，在闭集ID与跨受试者ReID上均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有毫米波点云人员识别主要依赖步态，但室内行走往往短暂且易被打断；其他日常活动（ADLs）可能提供互补的身份信息，因此需要研究跨多种活动的人员识别及活动上下文的作用。
AI.method: 构建 mm-ADL 点云数据集（11名受试者、7种ADL、受控协议）；提出活动条件化框架，以人体活动识别路由器将每个片段分派到活动专属身份专家，实现为监督式专家混合模型；采用双流静态-动态 PointNet（DS-SDPNet）融合时间聚合的空间结构与帧间信息。
AI.result: 学习式硬路由使闭集ID准确率从62.1%提升至68.0%；双人ReID场景下mAP从57.2%升至75.4%，Rank-1从59.1%升至82.1%；在匹配画廊划分下，活动专属专家仍优于共享嵌入，表明增益并非仅来自画廊限制。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在受控室内条件下利用步态之外的日常活动进行身份识别的可行性，并验证了活动条件化建模的价值。

title: A Closed-Form Estimator and Diagnostic Battery for Anchor-Judge Error Correlation, Under a Single-Common-Factor Model
comment: 11 pages. The complete reproduction artifact (code, frozen data, one-command replay) accompanies the paper's journal submission as supplementary material, currently under peer review; a public repository link will be added upon publication
summary: When an external reference set (an anchor) is used to decompose an LLM-judge panel's error into a quality signal and a shared common-mode error, standard practice assumes the anchor is uncontaminated: its error uncorrelated with the judges' shared error. We study when that assumption can be dropped and replaced by an estimate. Under a single-common-factor model, >=2 judges and >=2 anchors point-identify the quality variance, the common-mode variance, and each anchor's contamination correlation rho_k in closed form, with an exact per-anchor-pair failure boundary; a designated clean-anchor estimator, by contrast, reports a contaminated companion anchor as fully clean once its trusted anchor is itself contaminated. Because the single-common-factor assumption is itself untestable, the estimator ships gated behind a calibrated diagnostic battery (judge-covariance dispersion; over-identification; a family-block test from judge metadata, with a family-blocked estimator that removes family-level shared-residual bias exactly), bootstrap confidence intervals with measured coverage, and a weak-identification screen. A proposition maps which violations bias rho_k, in which direction, and which evade detection. For ordinal scores we show an identification hierarchy: with all variables ordinal, rho_k is not identified at any number of anchors; with ordinal judges and >=3 continuous anchors it is, and we give an estimator for that case. On real data the validation is asymmetric, and we say so plainly: the diagnostics are validated in the rejecting direction (both real panels we test are correctly rejected by the model-adequacy pre-test), while the estimator is validated in simulation and stress-tested semi-synthetically under oracle calibration; no real panel has yet passed the pre-test, and the pre-test exists precisely to say so. All results replay offline from shipped, checksummed artifacts.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在LLM评审委员会误差分解中，放弃“锚点未被污染”假设、转而闭式估计每个锚点污染相关性ρ_k的可行性。在单共同因子模型下，≥2评审+≥2锚点可点识别质量方差、共同模式方差及ρ_k；提出经诊断检验门控的估计器，并给出序数情形下的识别层级与验证局限。
AI.motivation: 标准实践中，用外部参考集（锚点）分解LLM评审面板误差时，假定锚点“干净”、其误差与评审共享误差不相关。该假设通常不成立且未经检验，会扭曲质量信号与共同模式误差的估计。作者旨在放宽此假设，将其替换为可估计量，并厘清识别条件与假设失效的后果。
AI.method: 1) 在单共同因子模型下推导闭式识别：≥2评审+≥2锚点可点识别质量方差、共同模式方差及各锚点污染相关性ρ_k，给出精确的逐锚点对失效边界。2) 对比指定干净锚点估计器，揭示锚点自身被污染时会把被污染伴随锚点报告为完全干净。3) 因单共同因子假设不可检验，估计器由校准的诊断组合门控：评审协方差离散度、过度识别检验、基于评审元数据的族块检验（配套族块估计器精确移除族级共享残差偏差）、带覆盖度的bootstrap置信区间、弱识别筛查。4) 提出命题刻画何种违反会使ρ_k产生何种方向偏差、何种违规可逃逸检测。5) 序数情形下建立识别层级并给出估计器。6) 结果通过随附校验和工件离线复现。
AI.result: 识别性：单共同因子模型下ρ_k可闭式点识别且给出精确失效边界；指定干净锚点法在锚点被污染时失效。诊断组合可门控估计器，命题刻画偏差方向与不可检测违规。序数识别层级：全序数时ρ_k在任何锚点数下均不可识别；评审序数+≥3连续锚点时可识别并给出估计器。验证呈非对称：诊断在拒绝方向获验证（两个真实面板均被模型充分性预检验正确拒绝），估计器仅在仿真及oracle校准的半合成压力测试中验证；尚无真实面板通过预检验，该预检验正是为报告此点而设。
AI.conclusion: 论文提供了在锚点污染普遍存在时分解LLM评审误差的可识别框架，将不可检验的干净锚点假设替换为带诊断门控的估计量，并明确界定了识别边界（尤其序数情形）与实证验证的不对称性，强调预检验的设计目的即为如实拒绝不适用的真实面板。

title: FACET at WMT 2026 Automated Translation Quality Evaluation Task
comment: Accepted at WMT 2026 (shared task system paper)
summary: Different error types in machine translation require different evidence. Whether meaning is preserved can be judged only against the source, while whether the target is well-formed, or whether it names one entity consistently, can be judged from the target alone. We present FACET, our reference-free submission to the WMT26 Automated Translation Quality Evaluation Task, which decomposes evaluation into Fluency, Accuracy, and Consistency passes and gives each pass only the context its error type requires. A single fixed model is prompted three times, and the merged error spans yield the three task outputs, error spans, quality scores, and error-free labels, with no trained components. We also submit FACET-C, which omits the Consistency pass. Without gold labels, we characterize the predictions of FACET. Its system rankings place post-edited human translation first, and the Consistency pass changes about a tenth of segment scores while leaving the ranking nearly unchanged.

AI.tldr: 提出 FACET：无参考、无需训练的机器翻译质量评估方法，将评估分解为流畅度、准确性与一致性三个各自匹配所需上下文的评测通道。
AI.motivation: 不同错误类型需要不同证据：意义是否保留只能对照原文判断，而目标端是否通顺、是否一致地指称同一实体，仅凭译文即可判断。现有评测往往向所有错误类型提供相同上下文，证据与错误类型不匹配。
AI.method: 单个固定模型被提示三次，分别执行 Fluency、Accuracy、Consistency 三个通道，每个通道仅提供其错误类型所需的上下文；合并错误片段后产出三类任务输出：错误片段、质量分数、无错误标签，全程无训练组件。同时提交 FACET-C，即省略 Consistency 通道的变体。
AI.result: 在无金标签条件下刻画预测：系统排名将人工译后编辑译文列于首位；Consistency 通道改变约十分之一的句段分数，但排名几乎不变。
AI.conclusion: 按错误类型分配最小充分上下文的多通道提示可在无参考、无训练条件下完成 WMT26 自动翻译质量评估任务，且一致性通道主要影响细粒度分数而非系统排序。

title: Multimodal-Multiresolution Foundation Model for Lunar Remote Sensing
summary: We present a multimodal foundation model for lunar remote sensing, pretrained from scratch on SomBench, a geographically partitioned corpus of nearly two million co-registered tile bundles spanning 11 modalities at two spatial scales (1 m/pixel and 100 m/pixel). The model adapts the TerraMind masked-token architecture with two lunar-specific extensions: acquisition geometry is provided as explicit context, and meter- and hundred-meter-scale tiles are trained jointly so that a single set of weights covers both resolutions. FlexiViT patch embeddings allow adaptation to different patch sizes without retraining, while modality-wise inputs enable flexible multimodal fine-tuning. Qualitative generation experiments suggest the model learns meaningful cross-modal correspondences, including terrain derivatives from elevation and illumination-consistent reflectance from geometry. We evaluate on four benchmarks: crater detection at WAC and NAC scales, irregular mare patch (IMP) segmentation, and polar ice prospectivity regression. Across tasks, the pretrained model matches or outperforms ImageNet-pretrained baselines and an architecturally identical random-init control. On multimodal ice prospectivity regression, pretrained variants achieve the best results, while the random-init model outperforms most baselines, suggesting gains arise from both the architecture and pretraining. Label efficiency is notable for WAC crater detection, where the pretrained model trained on 50% of the data exceeds the strongest ImageNet baseline trained on the full dataset. Among adaptation strategies, LoRA matches or surpasses full fine-tuning on crater detection and IMP segmentation while using far fewer trainable parameters, whereas full fine-tuning performs best for ice prospectivity regression. We release the pretrained checkpoint, benchmark datasets, and fine-tuning code to support reproducible lunar AI research.

AI.tldr: 提出一个月球遥感多模态基础模型，在SomBench语料上从头预训练，覆盖11种模态、两种空间尺度，四项下游任务上匹配或超越ImageNet预训练基线。
AI.motivation: 月球遥感缺乏专用的大规模多模态基础模型与统一基准，现有方法多依赖ImageNet预训练权重，难以利用遥感特有的模态、采集几何信息与多尺度特性。
AI.method: 基于TerraMind掩码token架构，做两项月球化扩展：将采集几何作为显式上下文；联合训练1 m/pixel与100 m/pixel两种尺度瓦片，使单一权重覆盖双分辨率。采用FlexiViT块嵌入支持免重训的块尺寸适配，模态级输入支持灵活的多模态微调。预训练语料SomBench为地理分区、近200万个共配准瓦片束、11种模态。
AI.result: 在WAC/NAC陨石坑检测、不规则月海斑块(IMP)分割、极区冰资源潜力回归四项基准上评估。预训练模型匹配或超越ImageNet预训练基线及架构相同的随机初始化对照；多模态冰潜力回归中预训练变体最优，随机初始化模型也优于多数基线，说明增益来自架构与预训练两方面。WAC陨石坑检测中仅用50%数据的预训练模型超过用全量数据的最强ImageNet基线，标签效率显著。LoRA在陨石坑检测与IMP分割上匹配或优于全量微调且可训练参数远少，而冰潜力回归以全量微调最佳。
AI.conclusion: 验证了从零预训练的多模态月球遥感基础模型的有效性，并揭示架构与预训练的共同贡献及任务相关的适配策略差异。已开源预训练权重、基准数据集与微调代码，支持可复现的月球AI研究。

title: Leveraging Visual and Geometric Priors for Metric-scale and Complete Vehicle Gaussian Reconstruction from Limited Views
summary: High-fidelity vehicle assets are essential for controllable traffic scene generation, particularly for synthesizing rare and safety-critical long-tail scenarios. However, reconstructing a reusable vehicle representation from in-the-wild onboard images remains challenging for two reasons. First, image-to-3D generation methods generally produce models without reliable metric scale. Second, onboard cameras usually observe only one side of a target vehicle, making conventional multi-view reconstruction incomplete on unobserved regions. To solve these problems, we propose a feed-forward vehicle asset reconstruction method, which leverages two complementary priors to reconstruct 3D Gaussian representations for vehicles using sparse one-sided observations. To achieve metric-scale reconstruction, a visual foundation model is first utilized to serve as a visual prior for Gaussian initialization. The Gaussian attributes are then estimated by a learnable encoder-decoder module. A symmetry-aware cloning strategy is presented to complete the unobserved side directly in Gaussian space, which exploits the bilateral structure of vehicles as a geometric prior. Experiments on the public dataset demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms existing approaches in both vehicle asset completeness and geometric accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出一种前馈式车辆资产重建方法，利用视觉基础模型提供度量尺度先验、车辆对称性提供几何先验，从稀疏单侧车载图像重建3D高斯表示，在完整性与几何精度上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 高保真车辆资产对可控交通场景生成（尤其是稀有、安全关键的long-tail场景合成）至关重要。但从真实车载图像重建可复用车辆表示存在两大难点：一是image-to-3D生成方法通常缺乏可靠的度量尺度；二是车载相机仅能观测车辆一侧，导致多视图重建在未观测区域不完整。
AI.method: 提出前馈式车辆资产重建方法，利用两个互补先验从稀疏单侧观测重建车辆3D高斯表示：1）使用视觉基础模型作为视觉先验进行高斯初始化，以实现度量尺度重建；2）通过可学习的编码器-解码器模块估计高斯属性；3）提出对称感知克隆策略（symmetry-aware cloning），利用车辆双侧对称结构作为几何先验，在高斯空间直接补全未观测一侧。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上的实验表明，该方法在车辆资产完整性和几何精度两方面均显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过融合视觉基础模型的度量尺度先验与车辆对称性的几何先验，可在前馈框架下从稀疏单侧观测重建高质量3D高斯车辆资产，有效解决尺度缺失与单侧观测不完整问题。

title: FIRE3D: Feed-forward Interactive 3D Scene Reconstruction Within A Minute
summary: We present FIRE3D, a unified framework that transforms a single RGB image or casual video into interactable 3D scene assets for games and interactive applications in under a minute for up to twelve textured instances including preprocessing. At the core of FIRE3D is a feed-forward inference pipeline that predicts a compositional scene representation from posed RGB-D observations estimated from the RGB capture, including the 6-DoF pose, bounding box, mesh, and texture for detected objects. By modeling the scene as a collection of discrete entities, FIRE3D produces amodal object assets that can be independently edited and used in interactive applications. Our framework requires no test-time optimization, runs substantially faster than the compared reconstruction systems, and provides object-level completeness beyond existing feed-forward 3D approaches. We demonstrate leading detection accuracy, strong geometry reconstruction, and competitive rendering quality on the evaluated benchmarks, with substantial runtime gains.

AI.tldr: FIRE3D：一个统一框架，可从单张RGB图像或随手拍摄的视频在不到一分钟内生成最多十二个可交互3D场景资产的纹理实例，无需测试时优化，速度显著优于对比重建系统，并具备优于现有前馈方法的物体级完整性。
AI.motivation: 面向游戏与交互应用需要可编辑、可交互的3D场景资产，而现有前馈3D方法在物体级完整性与运行速度方面存在不足，且通常需要测试时优化。
AI.method: 核心为前馈推理管线：从RGB采集估计带位姿的RGB-D观测，预测组合式场景表示，包括检测物体的6-DoF位姿、包围盒、网格与纹理；将场景建模为离散实体集合，生成可独立编辑的非模态（amodal）物体资产，无需测试时优化。
AI.result: 在评测基准上取得领先的检测精度、较强的几何重建与有竞争力的渲染质量，运行时间大幅缩短，速度显著快于对比重建系统。
AI.conclusion: FIRE3D以统一的前馈框架高效生成可交互3D场景资产，兼顾精度、几何与渲染质量并实现显著加速，适用于游戏与交互应用。

title: DSE-VTG: Dual-Side Enhancement for Training-Free Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Text-guided Video Temporal Grounding (VTG) aims to localize the relevant segments in an untrimmed video based on text queries, yet collecting dense temporal annotations and training task-specific models remain costly and brittle under distribution shift. Recent training-free VTG approaches mitigate this issue by directly matching pretrained vision-language representations, but they still face two fundamental information bottlenecks: frame-wise visual encoding overlooks temporal dynamics, while fixed query embeddings cannot resolve query ambiguity. To address these issues, we propose DSE-VTG, a \underline{D}ual-\underline{S}ide \underline{E}nhancement framework that addresses both without any task-specific training. On the visual side, Multi-scale Similarity Fusion (MSF) combines frame- and clip-level similarities into a unified, temporally aware similarity profile. On the textual side, Query-level Test-Time Adaptation (Q-TTA) optimizes a lightweight additive offset to adapt the query embedding to the video at test time, without finetuning the backbone or calling external large language models. Extensive experiments on three standard and two OOD benchmarks show that DSE-VTG achieves state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods. On Charades-STA, it improves mIoU over the strongest prior training-free method by 5.61 points. Under distribution shift, DSE-VTG reaches 50.86 mIoU on Charades-CG Novel-Word, surpassing the strongest supervised baseline by 2.76 mIoU. Our code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的DSE-VTG框架，通过视觉与文本双侧增强解决文本引导视频时序定位中的信息瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 文本引导视频时序定位（VTG）依赖密集时序标注与任务专用模型，成本高且在分布偏移下脆弱。现有免训练方法直接匹配预训练视觉语言表征，但存在两个瓶颈：逐帧视觉编码忽略时序动态，固定查询嵌入无法消解查询歧义。
AI.method: DSE-VTG为双侧增强框架，无需任务训练。视觉侧：多尺度相似度融合（MSF）将帧级与片段级相似度融合为统一且具时序感知的相似度剖面。文本侧：查询级测试时自适应（Q-TTA）在测试时优化轻量加性偏移以适配查询嵌入，不微调骨干、不调用外部大语言模型。
AI.result: 在三个标准与两个OOD基准上，DSE-VTG在免训练方法中达到SOTA。在Charades-STA上，mIoU较最强免训练方法提升5.61点。分布偏移下，Charades-CG Novel-Word达50.86 mIoU，超最强监督基线2.76 mIoU。
AI.conclusion: 双侧增强可有效缓解免训练VTG的视觉与文本信息瓶颈，在标准与分布偏移场景下均具竞争力。

title: SeGDeP: Semantic- and Geometric-Aware Decoupled Prompts for Reasoning Segmentation
summary: Reasoning segmentation converts an implicit linguistic conclusion into a precise mask, requiring both semantic identification and spatial grounding. Existing MLLM-segmenter interfaces either use a special trigger or compress both signals into one context, although they receive different supervision and fail differently. This coupling obscures whether a failure arises from target interpretation or from localization. We present SeGDeP, an explicit what-where interface. A semantic prompt branch and an independent geometric projection path transform resolved MLLM states into semantic features and a DETR-predicted box, which jointly condition a SAM 3 mask decoder. Training first aligns this executable interface, then uses group reward-decoupled policy optimization (GDPO) to balance format, box-IoU, and mask-IoU feedback. SeGDeP-4B reaches 82.7 average cIoU over eight RefCOCO-family splits and 66.0/59.6 gIoU on ReasonSeg val/test while adapting only 0.38% of Qwen3-VL parameters through LoRA. Controlled stage-wise ablations, gradient diagnostics, and prompt interventions further show that the two paths develop complementary semantic and geometric specialization rather than duplicating the same evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出SeGDeP，将推理分割中的"是什么"与"在哪里"解耦为显式的语义分支与几何投影路径，联合驱动SAM 3解码器，并以GDPO平衡多目标反馈，仅微调0.38%参数即取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM与分割器的接口要么依赖特殊触发词，要么把语义与定位两类信号压缩进同一上下文。二者监督方式不同、失效模式也不同，这种耦合使得难以判断失败究竟源于目标理解还是空间定位。
AI.method: 提出显式的what-where接口：语义提示分支与独立几何投影路径分别将已解析的MLLM状态转化为语义特征与DETR预测框，二者共同条件化SAM 3掩码解码器。训练分两阶段：先对齐可执行接口，再用组奖励解耦策略优化（GDPO）平衡格式、框IoU与掩码IoU反馈。通过LoRA仅适配Qwen3-VL的0.38%参数。
AI.result: SeGDeP-4B在八个RefCOCO系列划分上平均cIoU达82.7，在ReasonSeg val/test上gIoU为66.0/59.6。受控的分阶段消融、梯度诊断与提示干预表明，两条路径形成互补的语义与几何专门化，而非重复相同证据。
AI.conclusion: 将语义识别与空间定位显式解耦的接口设计，配合分阶段训练与解耦奖励优化，能在极低参数开销下实现强推理分割性能，并提升失败归因的可解释性。

title: Medical AI Encodes a "Feeling of Error": Verifying Cancer Segmentation via Internal Concepts
summary: Cancer segmentation models can fail silently, generating plausible but incorrect masks that risk missed findings or unnecessary biopsies. A critical question arises: Do AI models "know" when they are wrong, and if so, can we use the signal to predict their own failures? Humans do have a "Feeling of Error" (FOE): a spontaneous sense of unease that flags a potential error during thinking. We investigate whether cancer segmentation models exhibit an analogous internal signal. Unlike output-level cues (e.g., prediction confidence or uncertainty), which offer no insight into why a failure occurs and suffer from a sensitivity-quality tradeoff where high detection sensitivity could degrade overall segmentation quality. We instead propose to capture the model's FOE from its inner workings. Using mechanistic interpretability tools, specifically Sparse Autoencoders, we decompose internal neural activations into a dictionary of human-interpretable concepts and show that failure cases exhibit a distinct latent signature: fewer active concepts with lower activation magnitudes compared to successful segmentation. By training a classifier on these concept activations, we achieve accurate failure detection along with explanations for the model's mistakes. Experiments on prostate, pancreatic, and brain cancer segmentation demonstrate that our approach outperforms output-based methods in failure detection while preserving segmentation quality.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出从癌症分割模型内部神经激活中捕捉类人"错误感"(FOE)信号,利用稀疏自编码器将激活分解为可解释概念,发现失败案例具有"活跃概念更少、激活幅度更低"的独特潜特征,并据此训练分类器实现准确的失败检测与解释。
AI.motivation: 癌症分割模型会静默失败,生成看似合理却错误的掩码,导致漏诊或不必要的活检。核心问题是:AI模型是否"知道"自己何时出错?现有基于输出层的线索(预测置信度、不确定性)无法解释失败原因,且存在灵敏度-质量权衡——提高检测灵敏度可能损害整体分割质量。因此需要一种能反映模型内部失败机制的新信号。
AI.method: 受人类"错误感"(Feeling of Error)启发,提出从模型内部工作机制捕捉FOE。采用机制可解释性工具——稀疏自编码器(SAE),将内部神经激活分解为一组人类可解释的概念字典;对成功与失败案例的概念激活进行对比分析,并基于这些概念激活训练分类器进行失败检测。
AI.result: 失败案例呈现出独特的潜在特征:相比成功分割,其活跃概念更少且激活幅度更低。在概念激活上训练的分类器能够准确检测失败,并同时提供对模型错误原因的解释。在前列腺癌、胰腺癌和脑癌分割任务上的实验表明,该方法在失败检测上优于基于输出的方法,同时保持了分割质量。
AI.conclusion: 癌症分割模型内部存在类似人类"错误感"的信号,可通过稀疏自编码器提取为可解释的概念激活特征用于失败检测。相比输出层方法,该内部信号方法在提升失败检测性能的同时不牺牲分割质量,并能提供错误解释,为可信医疗AI提供了新思路。

title: FRAME: Factored Retrieval via Attribute Readouts for Object-Centric Scene Memory
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures. Woosang Jeon and Sanghyeok Choi contributed equally
summary: Language-guided robots need persistent scene memories to follow instructions, revisit objects, and resolve references to objects encountered over time. While much of language-guided scene-memory retrieval has emphasized spatial or relational references, many everyday object references specify objects by multiple persistent attributes, such as category, material, size, or surface appearance. We formalize this problem as attribute-compositional retrieval, where a fixed object-centric scene memory is queried with natural language to retrieve the object satisfying the requested attributes. To investigate this capability directly, we introduce a controlled evaluation protocol with fixed scene memories and attribute-defined targets, separating retrieval from perception and annotation ambiguities. We then propose FRAME, which turns language into query-relevant attribute weights, uses learned readouts to estimate per-attribute evidence from object embeddings, and ranks objects by aggregating this evidence according to the query. Across held-out scenes and object assets, FRAME outperforms representative scene-memory retrieval baselines while reducing post-decomposition object scoring to lightweight matrix-vector computation. These results position attribute-compositional retrieval as a complementary scene-memory capability for language-guided robots, showing that persistent object attributes can be exposed as composable evidence for accurate and efficient multi-attribute retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化"属性组合式检索"问题，并提出FRAME方法，将语言转为属性权重，结合学习式读数估计各属性证据并聚合排序，在受控评测协议下超越代表性场景记忆检索基线。
AI.motivation: 语言引导机器人需要持久化的场景记忆来跟随指令、重访物体和消解物体指代。现有研究多聚焦空间或关系指代，但日常物体指代常由多个持久属性（类别、材质、尺寸、表面外观）共同指定，该能力尚缺乏直接研究。
AI.method: 1）将问题形式化为属性组合式检索：在固定的以物体为中心的场景记忆上，用自然语言查询检索满足所请求属性的物体；2）提出受控评测协议，使用固定场景记忆与属性定义的目标，将检索与感知、标注歧义分离；3）提出FRAME，将语言转化为查询相关的属性权重，用学习式读数从物体嵌入中估计逐属性证据，并按查询聚合证据对物体排序。
AI.result: 在留出场景与物体资产上，FRAME优于代表性的场景记忆检索基线，同时将分解后的物体打分简化为轻量级矩阵-向量计算。
AI.conclusion: 属性组合式检索是语言引导机器人场景记忆的一项互补能力，持久物体属性可作为可组合证据，实现准确高效的多属性检索。

title: Q2D-Web: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Retrieval in Agentic RAG Systems
summary: Evaluating first-stage retrievers in large-scale production RAG requires a benchmark that pairs a large-scale corpus with a large set of agent-reformulated search queries based on real user queries and their conversation threads, and that labels many relevant documents per query. No existing public benchmark evaluates this setting: large-scale collections typically provide only a small number of evaluation queries, whereas benchmarks with many queries generally contain only millions of documents. Moreover, most benchmarks assess human-written queries, while the first-stage retrievers in agentic RAG pipelines serve machine-written reformulations whose distribution differs from human search behavior. To overcome these evaluation gaps, we introduce Q2D-Web (Query2Doc-Web), a large-scale agentic retrieval benchmark consisting of a 190M-document web corpus and 70k agentic search queries in ten languages, reformulated from real-world user queries in production systems. Q2D-Web provides three sets of fixed relevance judgments: agent citations, production rankings, and a combined set that unions both signals and adds LLM-based judgments of unlabeled pooled documents to reduce false negatives. We benchmark 13 retrievers including lexical, dense, and late-interaction models and find that their relative ordering is largely insensitive to the choice of judgment set, while diverging substantially across topical domains, query languages, and query types. To enable fast evaluation, we also study subcorpus sampling as an approximation to full-corpus evaluations. Retaining a third of the corpus, selected by reciprocal rank fusion over pooled retriever runs, preserves the full-corpus model ranking under the combined judgments while raising absolute Recall@1000 only by 4 to 7 points. The public leaderboard is accessible under: https://huggingface.co/spaces/perplexity-ai/q2d-web-leaderboard

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Q2D-Web，一个面向 agentic RAG 的大规模检索基准，包含 190M 文档语料、10 种语言的 70k agent 改写查询及三套相关性标注，并对 13 个检索器进行评测，同时研究子语料采样以加速评估。
AI.motivation: 现有公开基准无法覆盖生产级 RAG 一阶段检索的评测需求：大规模语料库通常仅有少量评测查询，而查询量大的基准又往往只含数百万文档；且多数基准针对人工撰写查询，而 agentic RAG 中一阶段检索器面对的是分布不同的机器改写查询。
AI.method: 构建 Q2D-Web 基准：190M 文档的网页语料 + 来自真实生产用户查询及其对话线程重写得到的 10 种语言、70k 条 agentic 搜索查询。提供三套固定相关性判断：agent 引用、生产排序，以及融合二者并加入基于 LLM 的池化未标注文档判断的合并集（以降低假阴性）。评测 13 个检索器（词汇、稠密、后期交互模型），并研究基于 RRF 池化检索结果选取 1/3 语料的子语料采样近似评估。
AI.result: 检索器相对排序对判断集选择基本不敏感，但在主题领域、查询语言和查询类型间差异显著。保留 1/3 语料（经 RRF 选取）在合并判断下可保持全语料模型排序，Recall@1000 绝对值仅升高 4–7 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: Q2D-Web 填补了面向生产 agentic RAG 的大规模一阶段检索评测空白，公开排行榜见 https://huggingface.co/spaces/perplexity-ai/q2d-web-leaderboard；子语料采样可作为一种高效近似评估手段。

title: Evolution of Multimodal Question Answering: From Modality-Adaptive Extraction to Unified Language Representation
summary: The rapid growth of multimodal data has intensified the need for question answering (QA) systems capable of reasoning across heterogeneous sources such as text, tables, and images. In this paper, we present a comprehensive methodological comparison of three influential frameworks, namely Multimodal Adaptive Extraction (MAE), Solar, and UniMMQA, tracing the evolution of multimodal question answering from modality-adaptive pipelines to fully unified architectures. We examine how each approach models cross-modal interactions, transforms heterogeneous inputs, and performs reasoning, highlighting key design differences in modality representation, reasoning, and answer generation. Our analysis demonstrates a clear shift from explicit modality-specific processing toward unified text-centric formulations enabled by pre-trained language models (PLMs). Empirical comparisons across benchmark datasets show that this transition leads to substantial improvements in both Exact Match (EM) and F1-Scores, with UniMMQA achieving the most consistent and scalable performance. Despite these advances, we identify persistent challenges, including information loss during modality transformation, error propagation in multi-stage pipelines, and limitations in capturing fine-grained cross-modal dependencies. Overall, this study provides a deeper understanding of current design trends and offers insights into the future direction of unified multimodal reasoning systems.

AI.tldr: 本文对MAE、Solar与UniMMQA三种多模态问答框架进行方法学比较，梳理从模态自适应流水线到统一架构的演进，指出现有挑战并展望未来方向。
AI.motivation: 多模态数据快速增长，文本、表格、图像等异构来源的问答需求上升，但不同框架在跨模态建模与推理设计上差异明显，缺乏系统性的方法学对比与演进脉络梳理。
AI.method: 选取MAE、Solar、UniMMQA三个代表性框架，从跨模态交互建模、异构输入转换与推理机制三方面进行对比分析，重点关注模态表示、推理和答案生成的设计差异，并在基准数据集上开展实证比较。
AI.result: 分析显示研究范式从显式的模态特定处理转向由预训练语言模型支撑的统一文本中心式建模；实证比较表明该转变在EM和F1上均带来显著提升，其中UniMMQA表现最稳定且可扩展性最好。
AI.conclusion: 多模态问答正朝统一化、文本中心化方向演进，但仍存在模态转换中的信息损失、多阶段流水线的误差传播以及细粒度跨模态依赖刻画不足等持续性挑战，为未来统一多模态推理系统指明方向。

title: From Scores to Evidence: Auditable Decisions Can Improve Speech Deepfake Detection
summary: Speech deepfake detectors usually emit one score per utterance, but a borderline score does not reveal why two examples differ during retrospective error analysis. We ask whether a final score can be calibrated from component fields while keeping those fields visible for inspection. We build a decision record with a passive detector score and a score from a probe applied to a marked copy. It also includes retrieval support held out of the evaluated family, a margin from a support-set profile, and raw neighbor closeness. A cross-fit calibrator combines these fields and two differences between raw scores into one final score. On matched ASVspoof development data, the calibrated record reduces equal error rate (EER) by 3.48 percentage points relative to the fixed retrieval-augmented rule. It reaches 8.43% EER, whereas a passive WavLM baseline reaches 6.71% on the same subset. The record is therefore not the strongest detector in this comparison. Its value is to retain inspectable component fields while producing one scalar score for retrospective diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种"决策记录"式语音深度伪造检测框架，将被动检测分数与标记副本探针分数等多个可检查的组分字段，通过交叉拟合校准器融合为单一最终分数，在ASVspoof开发集上将EER相对固定规则降低3.48个百分点，但其绝对性能（8.43% EER）不及被动WavLM基线（6.71%），其核心价值在于兼顾可解释性与单分数输出。
AI.motivation: 常规语音深度伪造检测器对每个语句只输出单一分数，但边界分数无法解释两个样本在事后误差分析中为何存在差异，缺乏可回溯的诊断依据。作者试图探究：能否在保留各组分字段可供检视的前提下，将最终分数由这些字段校准得出。
AI.method: 构建一条决策记录，包含：被动检测器分数、对标记副本施加探针所得的分数、来自被评估家族之外留出的检索支持集、基于支持集画像得到的边界裕度，以及原始近邻紧密度。使用交叉拟合校准器将这些字段与两个原始分数的差值融合为单一最终分数。
AI.result: 在匹配的ASVspoof开发数据上，校准后的决策记录相比固定检索增强规则将等错误率降低3.48个百分点，达到8.43% EER；而同一子集上被动WavLM基线为6.71%。
AI.conclusion: 该决策记录并非本对比中最强的检测器，其价值在于在输出单一标量分数的同时保留可检查的组分字段，适用于事后诊断与误差分析。

title: Data-Efficient Crosswalk Segmentation from Overhead CCTV via Confidence- and Geometry-Guided Pseudo-Labeling
summary: Pixel-level annotation of fixed traffic-camera imagery is expensive, while crosswalk models trained from street-level imagery face a substantial viewpoint and appearance shift when applied to elevated CCTV. We investigate a data-efficient target-domain pipeline using 241 manually annotated CCTV images and 5,926 unlabeled CCTV frames. A source-domain experiment trains a 31.0M-parameter custom U-Net on 3,300 first-person-view (FPV) images and obtains 93.05% IoU on its 330-image FPV test split. This result is a source baseline, not transferred performance: the released CCTV notebook instantiates a 42.0M-parameter DeepLabV3-ResNet50 from torchvision weights, and no compatible mapping from the U-Net checkpoint is implemented. Training on 201 manual CCTV images and selecting on 40 held-out manual masks yields 88.91% IoU. The model then predicts all unlabeled frames; image-level certainty and a largest-component area prior rank the candidates, and the top 1,000 attain mean certainty 0.976 and mean combined score 0.988. A repository audit shows that the reported second-stage 98.52% IoU was measured on a 150-image split containing only teacher-generated pseudo-masks. Because of a directory-layout mismatch, the executed combined-data loader found zero manual samples and split 1,000 pseudo-labeled samples into 850 training and 150 evaluation samples. We therefore report 98.52% as internal pseudo-label agreement rather than human-ground-truth accuracy. The defensible target-domain result is 88.91% IoU on the 40 manual validation images. Batch-one FP32 inference at 512 x 512 requires 12.98 ms, corresponding to 77.03 FPS, on an NVIDIA RTX A6000 48 GB GPU. These findings support the practicality of confidence-and-geometry filtering while also showing why pseudo-label evaluation must remain isolated from the labels used for self-training.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索了一种数据高效的目标域斑马线分割流程，仅用241张人工标注的CCTV图像与5,926帧无标注CCTV帧；目标域可辩护结果为40张人工验证图像上88.91% IoU，而所谓98.52%的IoU实为伪标签内部一致性。
AI.motivation: 定点交通摄像头图像的像素级标注成本高昂，而基于街景（第一人称视角）图像训练的斑马线模型迁移到高位CCTV时存在显著的视角与外观域偏移，因此需要一种数据高效的目标域适配流程，并厘清伪标签自训练中的评估有效性问题。
AI.method: 源域用3,300张FPV图像训练31.0M参数的定制U-Net；目标域使用241张人工标注CCTV图像与5,926帧无标注CCTV帧：在201张人工标注图像上训练（发布笔记本实例化为42.0M参数的DeepLabV3-ResNet50），在40张留出人工掩码上选择；随后预测全部无标注帧，并用图像级置信度与最大连通域面积先验排序候选，取前1,000帧（平均置信度0.976、平均综合得分0.988）。此外对仓库进行审计以核查第二阶段评估的数据来源。
AI.result: 源域U-Net在330张FPV测试子集上达93.05% IoU（仅作源域基线，未迁移）；目标域40张人工验证图像上为88.91% IoU。审计发现，报告的第二阶段98.52% IoU是在仅含教师生成伪掩码的150张图像划分上测得的；由于目录结构不匹配，执行的合并数据加载器实际找到零个人工样本，并将1,000个伪标样本划分为850训练/150评估，故98.52%应视为伪标签内部一致性而非人工真值精度。512×512、batch-one FP32推理在RTX A6000 48GB上耗时12.98 ms，约77.03 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 置信度与几何（面积先验）过滤对无标注CCTV数据具有实用性，但伪标签评估必须与自训练所用标签严格隔离，否则会把伪标签一致性误报为真人真值精度；目标域的可辩护性能应以40张人工验证图像上的88.91% IoU为准。

title: Experience Funnel: A State-Policy Alternating Loop for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Autonomous agents powered by large language models (LLMs) continuously accumulate experience through interaction, creating an opportunity to improve future behavior through self-evolution. A fundamental challenge is how to transform abundant, task-specific interaction experience into reusable model competence without sacrificing the ability to adapt rapidly to newly observed evidence. Explicit textual states, such as skills and agent harnesses, provide fast, human-readable and editable adaptation, but incur persistent dependence on external context; parametric policies provide compact and reusable competence, but are substantially slower to update. We present \textit{Experience Funnel}, a self-evolving framework that couples fast state adaptation with slow policy consolidation in an alternating loop. Interaction trajectories are first distilled into an explicit textual state, where newly acquired experience can be rapidly incorporated and validated. The framework then selectively identifies state-enabled behavior that remains useful across state revisions and consolidates it into the policy through transition-aware distillation. The updated state--policy pair subsequently generates new rollouts, providing fresh evidence for the next round of state adaptation and policy consolidation. Experiments across diverse agent benchmarks show that \textit{Experience Funnel} consistently improves agent capability over state-only evolution and policy-internalization approaches, while progressively converting useful explicit experience into autonomous policy competence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Experience Funnel，一个自演化框架，通过"快状态适配 + 慢策略固化"的交替循环，将任务特定的交互经验转化为可复用的模型能力。
AI.motivation: 基于 LLM 的自主智能体在交互中不断积累经验，核心难题是如何将大量任务特定经验转化为可复用的模型能力，同时不牺牲对新证据的快速适应。显式文本状态（如技能、agent harness）适配快但依赖外部上下文；参数化策略紧凑可复用但更新慢。作者旨在弥合二者。
AI.method: 提出 Experience Funnel 框架，以交替循环耦合快状态适配与慢策略固化：先将交互轨迹蒸馏为显式文本状态，快速纳入并验证新经验；再选择性识别在多次状态修订中仍有效的"状态使能行为"，通过 transition-aware distillation 将其固化进策略；更新后的状态—策略对生成新 rollout，为下一轮提供新证据。
AI.result: 在多种智能体基准上，Experience Funnel 一致优于仅状态演化方法和策略内化方法，并逐步把有用的显式经验转化为自主策略能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过快慢交替循环，可将快速、可编辑的显式经验有效沉淀为紧凑可复用的参数化能力，实现智能体的自演化。

title: When Models Defer to Wrong Answers: A Robustness Audit of Source-Attributed Cues in Multiple-Choice QA
comment: Work Accepted at GroundLM Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Language models often receive a question together with a claim about what another source answered. We audit whether such claims destabilize answers in multiple-choice question answering. For each item, we hold one wrong option fixed across misleading conditions and vary the cue template attached to it. We introduce \emph{neutral-conditioned misleading cue adoption rate} (NC-MCAR), which measures switches to that option only on valid cued trials where the same model first selected the gold answer under a neutral prompt. This is a measure of answer instability, not proof that the model knew the answer or that all deference is irrational. We evaluate four instruction-following models on MMLU-Pro and IndicMMLU-Pro in English, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, and Telugu. Across 220{,}000 outputs, the expert template yields 41.1\% aggregate NC-MCAR, compared with 12.5\% for the majority template. These two conditions use the same wrong option and final instruction. Filler accuracy remains well above expert-wrong accuracy, while correct-cue prompts have high valid-response accuracy. The audit documents answer instability relevant to grounding under the tested forced-choice prompts: a bare, unverified source claim can outweigh an answer that was previously consistent with the task evidence.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计了多选问答中"声称其他来源给出了某答案"这类线索是否会使模型答案不稳定，并提出中性条件下的误导线索采纳率（NC-MCAR）指标。在四种指令跟随模型、五种语言、约22万条输出上，专家模板的NC-MCAR达41.1%，远高于多数模板的12.5%，说明未经核实的来源声明可压倒模型原本与任务证据一致的答案。
AI.motivation: 语言模型常同时收到问题与"另一来源的答案"声明。作者关注此类来源声明是否会破坏多选问答的答案稳定性，即模型是否会因外部线索而放弃原本正确的选项。
AI.method: 对每个测试项固定同一个错误选项，仅改变附加其上的线索模板（专家模板 vs 多数模板），从而分离线索措辞的影响。提出NC-MCAR指标：仅在有效线索试验中，且模型在中性提示下先选中金标答案的样本上，统计转向该错误选项的比例。评估四个指令跟随模型，覆盖MMLU-Pro与IndicMMLU-Pro的英语、印地语、孟加拉语、泰米尔语和泰卢固语。
AI.result: 共约220,000条输出。专家模板的平均NC-MCAR为41.1%，而多数模板为12.5%；两者使用相同的错误选项与最终指令。填充项准确率仍明显高于"专家错误"条件下的准确率，正确线索提示下有效响应准确率较高。
AI.conclusion: 该审计表明，在测试所用的强制选择提示下存在与事实依据相关的答案不稳定性：一个未经核实的来源声明可以压倒模型此前与任务证据一致的答案。NC-MCAR衡量的是答案不稳定性，并不证明模型"知道"答案或所有顺从行为都不理性。

title: AuK Technical Report: An Open-Source Foundational Model for Speech Generation and Editing
summary: We introduce AuK, an open-source foundational model that unifies speech generation and editing through a common interface of natural-language instructions and audio context. To support this broad capability set, we construct approximately 3.03 billion instruction--audio instances and 1.95 million hours of effective supervision across five task families: speech generation, content editing, enhancement and separation, paralinguistic editing, and acoustic editing. AuK combines a multimodal large language model for semantic conditioning, an VAE jointly trained on speech, general audio, and music for acoustic conditioning, and a hybrid rectified-flow Transformer that performs dual-stream MMDiT blocks followed by unified single-stream DiT blocks for generation. Training begins with generation-only warm-up and proceeds to joint generation--editing pre-training. We then apply complementary post-training strategies: human-feedback preference optimization for open-ended editing and reward-based reinforcement learning for speech generation. To reduce inference cost, we further distill the model with consistency initialization and task-routed Decoupled DMD. The resulting AuK-Flash performs 4-step inference without classifier-free guidance and achieves a 4.5 wall-clock speedup over the full model under matched conditions. Experiments demonstrate leading performance on zero-shot and instruction-controlled speech generation and general instruction-guided editing, while remaining competitive on signal-level restoration tasks. We release both the source code and model weights to support reproducibility and further research.

AI.tldr: AuK 是一个开源基础模型，以自然语言指令加音频上下文为统一接口，融合语音生成与编辑，在约 3.03B 指令-音频样本、1.95M 小时监督数据上训练，达到领先性能，并蒸馏出 4 步推理的 AuK-Flash。
AI.motivation: 语音生成与语音编辑长期分离，缺乏统一接口；同时指令控制能力、跨任务泛化与推理效率难以兼顾。作者希望以统一的基础模型同时覆盖生成与编辑，并降低推理成本。
AI.method: 构建约 3.03B 指令-音频样本、1.95M 小时有效监督，覆盖语音生成、内容编辑、增强与分离、副语言编辑、声学编辑五类任务。模型由三部分组成：多模态大语言模型做语义条件、在语音/通用音频/音乐上联合训练的 VAE 做声学条件、混合 rectified-flow Transformer（双流 MMDiT 块 + 统一单流 DiT 块）。训练先做生成预热，再做生成-编辑联合预训练，随后用人类反馈偏好优化（开放式编辑）与奖励强化学习（语音生成）后训练。推理加速采用一致性初始化与任务路由的 Decoupled DMD 蒸馏。
AI.result: AuK-Flash 支持 4 步推理且无需无分类器引导，在同等条件下获得 4.5 倍墙钟加速；在零样本与指令控制语音生成、通用指令引导编辑上取得领先性能，在信号级修复任务上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: AuK 验证了单一基础模型统一语音生成与编辑的可行性，并通过分布式蒸馏实现高效推理。作者开源代码与模型权重，以支持可复现性与后续研究。

title: EgoSIS: From Factorized Visual Ego-Transitions to Motion-Canonical Spatial Evidence for UAV Reasoning
summary: UAV video question answering requires separating camera motion from changes in the scene, but RGB-only multimodal models receive no explicit, stable reference for that separation. We present EgoSIS, a pose-free adapter that converts RGB-derived bidirectional flow into motion-canonical visual evidence in three stages. Factorized Visual Ego-Transitions (FVET) fits a robust image-plane transition and exposes motion, residual-support, and reliability factors. Reliability-Gated Ego-Transition Memory (ReTEM) uses reliability-weighted updates for a bounded history and re-anchors it at cuts or sustained uncertainty. Ego-Aligned Spatial Evidence (EASE) warps supported visual features into each segment's local anchor and injects four spatial evidence tokens per visual slice through zero-initialized residuals, without changing Qwen's visual-token count. On SIS-Bench, EgoSIS-8B obtains 89.9\% perception, 82.5\% perception-plus-memory, and 76.2\% overall accuracy, with the largest gains concentrated in self-awareness perception and memory. The adapter thus provides an interpretable interface between optical flow and spatial reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出EgoSIS，一种无位姿适配器，将RGB双向光流转化为运动规范化视觉证据，通过FVET分解、ReTEM可靠性门控记忆和EASE自中心对齐空间证据三阶段，在不改变Qwen视觉token数的前提下提升UAV视频问答性能。
AI.motivation: 无人机视频问答需要将相机运动与场景变化分离，但仅依赖RGB的多模态模型缺乏明确且稳定的参考基准来完成这种分离，导致自中心运动与空间推理难以对齐。
AI.method: EgoSIS为无位姿适配器，含三阶段：（1）因子化视觉自中心过渡（FVET）拟合鲁棒的像平面过渡，输出运动、残差支撑与可靠性因子；（2）可靠性门控自中心过渡记忆（ReTEM）以可靠性加权更新有界历史，并在镜头切换或持续不确定时重锚定；（3）自中心对齐空间证据（EASE）将受支撑的视觉特征变换到各片段的局部锚点，并通过零初始化残差每个视觉切片注入四个空间证据token，保持Qwen视觉token数不变。
AI.result: 在SIS-Bench上，EgoSIS-8B取得89.9%感知准确率、82.5%感知+记忆准确率、76.2%总体准确率，最大增益集中在自意识感知与记忆任务上。
AI.conclusion: 该适配器在光流与空间推理之间提供了可解释的接口，有效解耦相机运动与场景变化，提升UAV视频问答中自中心感知与记忆能力。

title: Evaluating and Improving Evidence-Grounded Fact-Checking in LLMs via Multi-Round Evidence Ablation
summary: Automatic fact-checking systems assess the veracity of claims given evidence from relevant documents. Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in fact-checking due to their general reasoning capabilities. However, it remains unclear whether they faithfully make use of the evidence provided to reach veracity judgments or rely on parametric knowledge. To investigate this, we introduce Fact-Ablated Evaluation (FAE), a new evaluation framework that iteratively ablates the cited evidence to assess whether LLMs revise their predictions accordingly. Our empirical results show that current off-the-shelf LLMs as fact-checking systems rely more on their parametric knowledge than on the evidence provided. To bridge this gap between prediction accuracy and evidence grounding, we propose REAL (Rigorous Evidence Ablation Learning), a training framework that promotes evidence-dependent verification through counterfactual evidence supervision for the LLM-as-verifier models. Experiments on four fact-checking datasets across different domains demonstrate that models trained with REAL obtain superior evidence-dependent capabilities compared to standard fine-tuned models. Our findings highlight that strong fact-checking performance can still coexist with weak evidence dependency, while REAL encourages veracity predictions to remain more closely tied to the availability of supporting evidence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FAE评估框架与REAL训练框架，揭示并缓解LLM事实核查中对参数化知识的依赖问题。
AI.motivation: 自动事实核查系统需基于相关文档中的证据判断主张真伪。LLM虽凭借通用推理能力在事实核查上表现优异，但尚不清楚其判断是真正依据所给证据，还是依赖参数化知识。这一"证据依赖"问题关系到模型可靠性与可解释性，因此需要量化评估并加以改进。
AI.method: 1）提出Fact-Ablated Evaluation（FAE）评估框架：迭代式消融所引用的证据，观察LLM是否相应修正预测，以此衡量其证据依赖程度。2）提出REAL（Rigorous Evidence Ablation Learning）训练框架：面向LLM-as-verifier模型，通过反事实证据监督促进证据依赖型验证。
AI.result: 在四个不同领域的事实核查数据集上，采用REAL训练的模型相比标准微调模型具备更优的证据依赖能力。FAE评估显示，现成LLM在事实核查中更依赖参数化知识而非所提供证据。
AI.conclusion: 强事实核查性能可能与弱证据依赖并存；REAL能使真伪预测更紧密地依赖支持性证据的可获得性，从而弥合预测准确率与证据落地之间的差距。

title: Prior-free relative 6D pose estimation of multiple object instances
summary: Object 6D pose estimation formulations have progressively reduced reliance on object-specific priors, evolving from explicit 3D models to multi-view object captures to single reference images. We take this progression to its extreme by introducing prior-free relative 6D pose estimation, which lifts the assumption of knowing which object is to be posed within the scene. This novel setting aims to estimate the relative poses of multiple instances of an unknown object within the same image, without requiring CAD models, templates, or reference images. We solve this by formulating a novel method (PROSE) that finds coarse correspondences between object instances using multimodal foundation features, thus requiring no training. We refine these correspondences by imposing cycle consistency across tuples of instances, and leverage the resulting globally consistent correspondences to estimate the relative 6D pose between any pair of instances. To enable systematic evaluation, we design a novel benchmark (PRENCH) built from three multi-instance BOP datasets and enriched with task-specific metadata. PROSE consistently outperforms baselines obtained by adapting state-of-the-art single-image methods to the proposed setting, while requiring neither task-specific supervision nor additional learned components. Project website: https://tev-fbk.github.io/PROSE/

AI.tldr: 本文提出"无先验相对6D位姿估计"新任务，并给出无需训练的方法PROSE及配套基准PRENCH。
AI.motivation: 6D位姿估计的既有范式不断减少对物体专属先验的依赖，从显式3D模型到多视角采集再到单张参考图像；本文将该趋势推到极致，去掉"已知场景中哪个物体需要被估计位姿"这一假设。
AI.method: PROSE利用多模态基础模型特征在多个物体实例间寻找粗对应关系，从而无需训练；再通过对实例元组施加循环一致性约束来精化对应关系，并利用得到的全局一致对应估计任意实例对之间的相对6D位姿。
AI.result: PROSE一致优于将当前最先进的单图像方法适配到该设定下所得到的基线，同时不需要任务专属监督，也不需要额外的可学习模块。
AI.conclusion: 本文确立了无先验相对6D位姿估计这一新设定，提供了无需训练、无需监督的解决方案PROSE，并构建了来自三个多实例BOP数据集、含任务专属元数据的基准PRENCH以支持系统评测。

title: DramaAgent: Agentic Storytelling Video Generation
summary: Recent diffusion and autoregressive models have substantially improved text-to-video generation, yet producing coherent long-form story videos with consistent characters and aligned audio remains challenging. Existing methods often suffer from narrative drift, unstable character identity, weak cross-scene continuity, and audio-visual mismatch over extended sequences. We propose DramaAgent, a hierarchical, agentic, and model-agnostic framework for long-form text-to-video-and-audio generation. Rather than improving the underlying video backbone itself, DramaAgent introduces an upper-level control layer that decomposes generation into story planning, persistent character conditioning, scene-wise synthesis, and reflection-guided targeted repair. The framework maintains reusable story and character states across scenes, diagnoses failures such as identity drift, missing scene semantics, temporal discontinuity, and cross-modal mismatch, and repairs problematic clips in a stage-specific manner. Experiments across multiple video generation backbones show that DramaAgent improves long-horizon coherence, character consistency, narrative fidelity, and scene-level audio-visual consistency over direct generation and strong baselines. These results suggest that hierarchical agentic control is a practical direction for controllable long-form audiovisual generation. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DramaAgent. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DramaAgent.

AI.tldr: DramaAgent：一种分层、智能体化、模型无关的框架，通过上层控制层分解长视频生成流程，提升长时程连贯性、角色一致性与音画对齐。
AI.motivation: 扩散与自回归模型虽显著提升文本到视频生成，但长叙事视频仍存在叙事漂移、角色身份不稳定、跨场景连续性弱、音画不匹配等问题。
AI.method: 不改动底层视频骨干，而是引入上层控制层，将生成分解为故事规划、持久角色条件化、逐场景合成、以及反思引导的定向修复；维护可复用的故事与角色状态，诊断身份漂移、场景语义缺失、时序不连续、跨模态不匹配等失败并做阶段特定修复。
AI.result: 在多个视频生成骨干上的实验表明，相比直接生成与强基线，该方法在长时程连贯性、角色一致性、叙事保真度、场景级音画一致性上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 分层智能体控制是可控长视频音画生成的可行方向。

title: PlannerForge: LLM Agents for Scenario-Based Testing of Motion Planners in Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 35 pages including appendix
summary: Ensuring the safety of autonomous driving is a critical challenge.
