Scenario-based testing is a systematic process used to validate Autonomous Driving Systems (ADSs), but it remains a fragmented modular pipeline in which scenario generation, retrieval, modification, ADS execution, and results analysis are performed by separate tools with little interaction. Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown promise across ADS sub-systems such as perception, planning, and control. However, no prior work covers the whole scenario-based testing pipeline for ADSs with a unified LLM-agent framework. We present PlannerForge, an LLM-agent framework that extends all scenario-based testing stages (from Scenario Generation to ADS Assessment) and adds two further LLM-enhanced stages: ADS Enhancement and ADS Benchmarking. We evaluate PlannerForge with 10 off-the-shelf LLMs across all tasks (Generation, Selection, Modification, Module Routing, Planner Testing, and Enhancement) under 5 prompt conditions. Best-per-task scores range from 0.88 to 1.00, and open-source 20-35B backends match commercial APIs on most tasks. Open-source models such as Qwen3.6:35B match commercial APIs on three of the five tasks. Chaining the modules end-to-end retains 83% / 78% of seed queries (commercial / open). It outperforms Scenario Factory 2.0 (Finkeldei et al., 2025) on natural-language generation (193 vs. 144 executable of 200) and realises 92-96% of requested city, road and vehicle attributes. It outperforms BM25 (Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009) at rank 1 selection (92.0% vs. 67.5%) and From-Words-to-Collisions (Gao et al., 2025) on physically valid edits (>=94% vs. 31%). At N=400, cost-tuning lifts planner success from 50.4% to 70.2% and cuts collisions from 19.0% to 8.4%, without domain-specific fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: PlannerForge 是一个统一的 LLM-agent 框架，覆盖并扩展了基于场景的自动驾驶系统测试全流程，在多项任务上性能优异且成本可控。
AI.motivation: 基于场景的测试是验证自动驾驶系统的系统化流程，但当前仍是碎片化的模块化管线，各环节工具相互隔离、交互少。尽管 LLM agent 在感知、规划、控制等子系统中已有应用，但尚无工作用统一的 LLM-agent 框架覆盖完整的基于场景测试流程。
AI.method: 提出 PlannerForge，一个 LLM-agent 框架，扩展了基于场景测试的所有阶段（从场景生成到 ADS 评估），并新增两个 LLM 增强阶段：ADS Enhancement 和 ADS Benchmarking。使用 10 个现成 LLM 在 5 种提示条件下评测全部任务（生成、选择、修改、模块路由、规划器测试与增强）。
AI.result: 单任务最佳得分为 0.88–1.00；开源 20–35B 后端在多数任务上匹配商业 API，Qwen3.6:35B 在五个任务中的三个上匹配商业 API。端到端链接保留 83%/78% 的种子查询（商业/开源）。在自然语言生成上优于 Scenario Factory 2.0（200 条中 193 vs. 144 可执行），实现 92–96% 的请求城市、道路和车辆属性；在 rank 1 选择上优于 BM25（92.0% vs. 67.5%），在物理有效编辑上优于 From-Words-to-Collisions（≥94% vs. 31%）。N=400 时，成本调优将规划器成功率从 50.4% 提升至 70.2%，并将碰撞从 19.0% 降至 8.4%，且无需领域特定微调。
AI.conclusion: PlannerForge 证明统一 LLM-agent 框架可有效贯穿自动驾驶基于场景测试全流程，开源中小规模模型在多数任务上可与商业 API 竞争，且通过成本调优在无微调情况下显著提升规划器安全性能。

title: Good Pretraining, Bad SFT: Checkpoint Quality Across the Training Stack
summary: Language-model checkpoints are commonly selected by pretraining loss or benchmark scores, assuming that the highest-scoring checkpoint will remain the best starting point for subsequent training. We show that this assumption can fail in a full 30B mixture-of-experts training pipeline. The checkpoints that perform better after the full downstream training stack also have higher solution density, i.e., retain downstream performance under local weight perturbations.

AI.tldr: 在完整的30B MoE训练流程中，预训练loss或benchmark分数最高的checkpoint未必是下游训练的最佳起点；下游表现更好的checkpoint具有更高的"解密度"，即在局部权重扰动下能保持下游性能。
AI.motivation: 实践中人们通常依据预训练loss或benchmark分数来选择语言模型checkpoint，并默认分数最高的checkpoint一定是后续训练的最佳起点。本文质疑并检验这一隐含假设在完整训练流程中是否成立。
AI.method: 在一个完整的30B混合专家（MoE）训练pipeline中进行验证，对比各checkpoint在经过完整下游训练栈后的表现，并引入"解密度"（solution density）这一指标，即checkpoint在局部权重扰动下保持下游性能的程度。
AI.result: 该假设在30B MoE训练流程中确实会失效：下游训练栈完成后表现更好的checkpoint，同时也是解密度更高的checkpoint，表明解密度与最终下游表现存在关联。
AI.conclusion: 预训练loss或benchmark分数不足以可靠地挑选后续训练的最佳起点；解密度可作为衡量checkpoint下游可训练性的更有效指标，为checkpoint选择提供新依据。

title: Concentrate After Imagination: Text-Conditioned Evidence Grounding for Partially Relevant Video Retrieval
summary: Partially Relevant Video Retrieval (PRVR) retrieves untrimmed videos when queries describe only short moments. Although recent methods improve local representations, uncertainty modeling, and global context, final ranking often still trusts the strongest local response; a coincidentally similar fragment can therefore produce an unsupported peak. We identify this failure as the query-agnostic concentration bottleneck and propose TRACE, a score-level evidence verification operator for PRVR. Given a query and global video registers, TRACE activates query-relevant registers, routes their support to frame-level evidence, and smoothly marginalizes alternative query-to-register-to-frame paths before localized temporal selection. Unlike representation-level feature fusion, TRACE uses this evidence only as a query-conditioned residual calibration of the original local score. On ActivityNet Captions, Charades-STA, and TVR, TRACE achieves the best SumR on all three benchmarks and improves the DreamPRVR backbone by 1.2, 1.1, and 1.5 points, respectively. Ablation, routing-corruption, hard-negative, and cross-backbone transfer analyses support the interpretation that the gains arise from query-conditioned evidence verification rather than a generic score offset.

AI.tldr: 论文提出TRACE，一种面向部分相关视频检索（PRVR）的分数级证据校验算子，通过在分数层面进行查询条件化的证据路由与残差校准，缓解"查询无关的注意力集中瓶颈"，在三个基准上取得最优SumR。
AI.motivation: 现有PRVR方法虽在局部表示、不确定性建模和全局上下文上有所改进，但最终排序仍依赖最强的局部响应；偶尔出现的相似片段会产生缺乏支撑的虚假峰值。作者将这一失效模式识别为"查询无关的注意力集中瓶颈"（query-agnostic concentration bottleneck）。
AI.method: TRACE是一种分数级证据校验算子。给定查询与全局视频寄存器（registers），它首先激活查询相关寄存器，将其支持路由至帧级证据，并在局部时序选择前对"查询→寄存器→帧"的替代路径进行平滑边缘化。与表示级特征融合不同，TRACE仅将该证据用作对原始局部分数的查询条件化残差校准。
AI.result: 在ActivityNet Captions、Charades-STA和TVR上，TRACE在三个基准均取得最佳SumR，并将DreamPRVR主干分别提升1.2、1.1和1.5个点。消融实验、路由破坏实验、难负样本分析与跨主干迁移分析均支持该增益源于查询条件化的证据校验，而非通用的分数偏移。
AI.conclusion: 通过分数级、查询条件化的证据校验对局部响应进行残差校准，可有效抑制PRVR中由偶然相似片段导致的虚假峰值；实验验证了该机制的有效性及其增益来源的可解释性。

title: Evaluation of Contextual Understanding in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive performance across diverse NLP tasks, yet their ability to exhibit genuine contextual understanding remains uncertain. Traditional evaluation metrics such as perplexity, BiLingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU), or surface-level accuracy fail to reveal how well LLMs extract, integrate, and reason over contextual information--a gap particularly critical in question answering, where models must align responses with contextually grounded knowledge rather than memorized associations. We propose a novel knowledge graph-based evaluation framework introducing Semantic Structural Similarity for KGs (S3KG), a hybrid similarity measure integrating structural and semantic similarity into a continuous evaluation score, alongside a diagnostic framework for categorizing reasoning errors. To validate this pipeline, we evaluate S3KG against established metrics on a curated question-answer (QA) benchmark, demonstrating its effectiveness in measuring correctness, faithfulness, and interpretability in LLM-generated responses.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于知识图谱的评估框架S3KG，通过融合结构与语义的相似度度量，评估大语言模型在问答任务中的情境理解能力，并配套错误分类诊断机制，实验证明其在正确性、忠实性和可解释性方面优于传统指标。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在多种NLP任务中表现优异，但是否具备真正的情境理解能力仍存疑。传统评估指标（如困惑度、BLEU、表层准确率）无法揭示模型如何提取、整合和推理上下文信息，这一缺陷在问答任务中尤为关键，因为模型需将回答与情境化知识对齐，而非依赖记忆性关联。
AI.method: 提出基于知识图谱的新型评估框架，引入S3KG（Semantic Structural Similarity for KGs）——一种将结构相似性与语义相似性融合为连续评分值的混合相似度度量，并设计用于分类推理错误的诊断框架。在精选的问答基准上，将S3KG与既有指标进行对比验证。
AI.result: 在精选QA基准上的实验表明，S3KG在衡量大语言模型生成回答的正确性、忠实性和可解释性方面具有有效性，相较既有评估指标更具优势。
AI.conclusion: S3KG为评估大语言模型的情境理解提供了新的知识图谱驱动的度量范式，弥补了传统指标在结构—语义联合评估与错误诊断方面的不足。

title: DXPR: Depth-Based Vision-LiDAR Cross-Modal Place Recognition Using Vision Foundation Models
summary: We present DXPR, a depth-based cross-modal place recognition (CMPR) framework that uses vision foundation models (VFMs) to match monocular camera queries against a LiDAR map without modality-specific encoders. This enables robots and autonomous vehicles to robustly localize using only cameras within pre-built LiDAR maps, even under severe seasonal, weather, and illumination changes. The key idea is to convert both camera images and LiDAR scans into a unified depth image representation so that a single VFM backbone with an aggregation head can learn modality-invariant global descriptors. To make pairwise metric learning faithful to scene geometry, we introduce a geometry-aware overlap miner: after cross-modal scale alignment of camera and LiDAR depth, we forward-warp measurements between views to compute a pixel-level overlap score. This score relabels ambiguous pairs and adaptively modulates the positive margin in a multi-similarity loss to avoid overfitting on weakly overlapping views. Extensive experiments on KITTI odometry and Boreas demonstrate strong performance and robustness across seasons, weather, and day/night. On KITTI, DXPR achieves near-perfect Recall@1 on most sequences and outperforms prior CMPR baselines. On Boreas, DXPR achieves intra-sequence performance on par with a strong single-modal baseline (DINOv2-SALAD), while showing clear improvements in the more challenging inter-sequence setting. Compared with RangeBEV, our method consistently performs better in both intra- and inter-sequence evaluations, demonstrating robustness under diverse seasonal and illumination changes.

AI.tldr: DXPR：基于深度的跨模态地点识别框架，将相机图像与LiDAR扫描统一为深度图表示，用单一VFM骨干生成模态不变描述子，并引入几何感知重叠挖掘改进度量学习，在KITTI与Boreas上取得强性能与跨季节、天气、昼夜鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 使机器人与自动驾驶车辆仅用单目相机即可在预先构建的LiDAR地图中鲁棒定位，且无需模态专用编码器，并能应对严重的季节、天气与光照变化。
AI.method: 1) 将相机图像与LiDAR扫描均转换为统一的深度图像表示，由单一视觉基础模型（VFM）骨干加聚合头学习模态不变的全局描述子；2) 提出几何感知重叠挖掘器：先做跨模态尺度对齐，再通过前向变换在视图间计算像素级重叠得分；3) 用该得分重标注模糊样本对，并自适应调节多相似度损失中的正样本间隔，避免在弱重叠视图上过拟合。
AI.result: 在KITTI odometry与Boreas上跨季节、天气、昼夜均表现强且鲁棒。KITTI上多数序列Recall@1接近完美，优于既有CMPR基线；Boreas上序列内性能与强单模态基线DINOv2-SALAD相当，序列间设定提升明显；相比RangeBEV在序列内与序列间评测中均持续更优。
AI.conclusion: 基于深度统一表示与几何感知重叠挖掘的DXPR，可在不依赖模态专用编码器的情况下实现鲁棒的跨模态地点识别，验证了将LiDAR地图检索能力赋予纯相机定位的可行性与有效性。

title: A Joint 2D-3D Statistical Shape Model for Orthopedic Reconstruction
comment: Accepted to MICCAI Workshop on Shape in Medical Imaging (ShapeMI)
summary: Three-dimensional femoral reconstruction from radiographs supports surgical planning, implant sizing, and post-operative follow-up, but remains ill-posed as X-ray projections discard depth information. Existing methods often incorporate a 3D statistical shape model (SSM) as a shape prior to guide reconstructions toward anatomically plausible shapes, relying on iterative 3D-to-2D projection matching. Yet, these approaches are computationally expensive and constrain their SSM to a single dimensionality, leaving the statistical relationship between 2D observations and 3D geometry largely unexploited and unexplored. We instead propose a joint 2D-3D SSM that explicitly captures the co-variation between 2D and 3D segmentations in a shared latent space. During training, 2D and 3D segmentations are registered to a common 3D template and its corresponding 2D projections, and the resulting stationary velocity fields are jointly decomposed using principal component analysis (PCA). This joint modeling allows the 2D-to-3D mapping to be learned directly from data rather than computing correspondences at inference time. For unseen subjects, the 3D shape is recovered directly by lifting the 2D latent coordinates to the 3D PCA subspace, thereby eliminating the need for iterative 3D-to-2D projection. Experiments on NMDID demonstrate that the proposed joint 2D-3D SSM outperforms a widely-used 3D-only SSM baseline while achieving inference approximately 4 times faster, at under 3 seconds per subject. The code is available at: https://github.com/florence-dellaniello-picard/joint2d3d-ssm.

AI.tldr: 提出联合2D-3D统计形状模型（SSM），在共享潜空间中显式建模2D与3D分割的共变关系，实现由X光片直接、快速地重建股骨三维形状，无需推理时迭代投影匹配。
AI.motivation: 由X光片重建股骨3D形状对术前规划、假体选择和术后随访有重要价值，但X射线投影丢失深度信息导致问题病态。现有方法依赖3D SSM形状先验并结合迭代式3D-to-2D投影匹配，计算代价高，且SSM局限于单一维度，2D观测与3D几何之间的统计关系未被充分挖掘。
AI.method: 提出联合2D-3D SSM：训练时将2D与3D分割配准到共同的3D模板及其对应2D投影，得到静态速度场（stationary velocity fields），再用PCA对其进行联合分解，从而在同一潜空间中显式捕捉2D与3D的共变关系。推理时，对未见个体仅需将2D潜坐标提升（lifting）到3D PCA子空间即可直接恢复3D形状，无需迭代3D-to-2D投影。
AI.result: 在NMDID数据集上，所提联合2D-3D SSM优于常用的仅3D SSM基线，同时推理速度约为基线的4倍，每个受试者耗时不足3秒。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合建模2D-3D统计关系，可将2D到3D的映射直接从数据中学习，避免推理阶段的迭代投影与对应点计算，在精度与效率上同时优于仅3D SSM，为基于X光片的股骨3D重建提供了高效可行方案。

title: Spheriverse: 3D Scene Understanding from Spherical Observations in the Wild
comment: The established benchmark and source code will be available at https://feit-feiteng.github.io/Spheriverse
summary: Spherical observations provide global visual context for 3D scene understanding. However, visual information is encoded in an angular domain, whereas the physical world is represented in Cartesian coordinates. This cross-space representation gap complicates geometric correspondence and semantic evidence aggregation. To delve into this challenge, we introduce Spheriverse, comprising 64,400 temporally aligned spherical image-LiDAR pairs organized into 644 sequences. The dataset spans diverse scenes, illumination, and weather conditions, with fine-grained semantic classes. We further establish benchmarks for semantic occupancy prediction, semantic mapping, and 3D object detection, evaluating 30+ methods through overall and scene-wise comparisons. For dense prediction, we propose SphereOcc, an occupancy framework that couples spherical geometry modeling with semantic evidence retrieval. Cartesian-Spherical Representation Remodeling (CSRR) incorporates spherical range-azimuth geometry into Cartesian voxel features through region-wise modulation. Spherical Evidence Re-querying (SER) then conditions queries on voxel content and range-height-azimuth geometry to adaptively retrieve relevant semantic evidence from source spherical image features. SphereOcc achieves 13.91% mIoU and 24.65% GeoIoU, yielding relative improvements of 13.9% and 9.3% over the respective best-performing methods, TPVFormer and SurroundOcc. It also ranks first in both metrics across all five scene categories, with consistent advantages across the evaluated spatial partitions and reduced fields of view. The established benchmark and source code will be available at https://feit-feiteng.github.io/Spheriverse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Spheriverse数据集（64,400对球面图像-LiDAR，644序列）及三项基准，并提出SphereOcc占用预测框架，通过CSRR与SER弥合笛卡尔-球面表示鸿沟，取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 球面观测为3D场景理解提供全局视觉上下文，但视觉信息编码于角度域，物理世界以笛卡尔坐标表示，这种跨空间表示鸿沟导致几何对应与语义证据聚合困难。
AI.method: 构建Spheriverse数据集（64,400对时间对齐的球面图像-LiDAR，644个序列，涵盖多样场景/光照/天气与细粒度语义类别）；建立语义占用预测、语义建图、3D目标检测三项基准并评测30+方法。提出SphereOcc框架，包含笛卡尔-球面表示重塑（CSRR，通过区域调制将球面距离-方位几何融入笛卡尔体素特征）与球面证据重查询（SER，以体素内容和距离-高度-方位几何为条件，从球面图像特征中自适应检索语义证据）。
AI.result: SphereOcc取得13.91% mIoU与24.65% GeoIoU，较各自最优方法TPVFormer和SurroundOcc分别相对提升13.9%和9.3%；在全部五类场景中两项指标均排名第一，在评估的空间划分与缩减视场下均保持优势。
AI.conclusion: Spheriverse数据集与基准为球面-笛卡尔跨空间3D场景理解提供统一评测平台，SphereOcc验证了球面几何建模与语义证据检索结合的有效性，数据集与源码将开源。

title: PIC: Revisiting INR for Image Coding with Fast Encoding and Sub-Millisecond Decoding
comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/actcwlf/PIC
summary: Implicit neural representation (INR) has achieved remarkable progress in novel view synthesis and image/video coding in recent years.Compared to conventional end-to-end image codecs, INR-based compressors demonstrate significant advantages in decoding complexity. However, their practical application has been hindered by the inferior encoding speed and underutilized decoding efficiency.In this work, we propose a feedforward INR image coding architecture, Practical INR Image Codec (PIC), that computes all the necessary information for INR network in a single forward pass, achieving an encoding speed of 20 FPS. Additionally, we implement a highly optimized decoder that reaches 2000 FPS decoding speed, significantly surpassing JPEG's performance at comparable rate-distortion (RD) performance. To the best of our knowledge, this work presents the first learning-based image codec that simultaneously outperforms or is comparable with JPEG in both RD performance and decoding speed while maintaining practical encoding speed. Code is available at https://github.com/actcwlf/PIC.

AI.tldr: 提出前馈式INR图像编码架构PIC，单次前向传播计算INR所需全部信息，编码达20 FPS，解码达2000 FPS，在RD性能与JPEG相当的同时速度超越JPEG，是首个兼顾RD性能、解码速度与实用编码速度的学习型图像编解码器。
AI.motivation: INR在新型视图合成与图像/视频编码中取得显著进展，相比传统端到端图像编解码器在解码复杂度上具有明显优势，但其实际应用受限于编码速度差和解码效率未被充分利用。
AI.method: 提出前馈式INR图像编码架构PIC（Practical INR Image Codec），在单次前向传播中计算INR网络所需的全部必要信息，并实现高度优化的解码器。
AI.result: 编码速度达到20 FPS，解码速度达到2000 FPS，在RD性能相当的情况下显著超越JPEG，同时在RD性能和解码速度上与JPEG相当或更优，并保持实用的编码速度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是首个学习型图像编解码器，可同时保证RD性能、解码速度上优于或可比于JPEG，且维持实用的编码速度；代码已开源。

title: Task-driven Processing with Coarse-to-Fine Glimpse-based Active Perception
summary: State-of-the-art vision models process images in their entirety, lacking the ability to selectively zoom in on relevant regions. This limitation is particularly acute in scenarios where processing must be conditioned on a specific task - such as instance detection, which requires localizing a specific object in a high-resolution, cluttered scene. In such settings, critical details are easily lost as images are often resized to match the model dimensions and computational constraints. We introduce Coarse-to-Fine Glimpse-based Active Perception (CF-GAP), a task-driven front-end that enhances high-resolution processing of existing instance detectors. CF-GAP selectively directs a sequence of limited view glimpses across the scene, utilizing task information to iteratively refine focus on the most relevant regions. These localized regions are then processed at high resolution by a downstream instance detector. By avoiding full-image processing and eliminating irrelevant confounding information, CF-GAP improves Average Precision (AP) by up to 20% across various state-of-the-art instance detectors on the HR-InsDet and Robotools benchmarks, while further enabling lightweight detectors to outperform their larger counterparts.

AI.tldr: 提出CF-GAP，一种任务驱动的前端主动感知方法，通过粗到细的“glimpse”序列选择性聚焦高分辨率图像中的相关区域，配合下游实例检测器实现高分辨率处理，在不做全图处理的前提下显著提升检测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉模型需处理完整图像，无法选择性放大相关区域；在实例检测等任务条件下，尤其面对高分辨率、杂乱场景时，关键细节常因图像缩放以满足模型尺寸与计算约束而丢失。因此需要一种任务驱动、可主动聚焦的前端机制来增强高分辨率处理能力。
AI.method: CF-GAP（Coarse-to-Fine Glimpse-based Active Perception）：作为任务驱动前端，利用任务信息引导一系列有限的局部“glimpse”遍历场景，以粗到细的方式迭代细化对最相关区域的聚焦；随后由下游实例检测器对这些局部区域进行高分辨率处理，从而避免全图处理并消除无关混淆信息。
AI.result: 在HR-InsDet与Robotools基准上，CF-GAP使多种先进实例检测器的平均精度（AP）最高提升20%，并使轻量级检测器能够超越更大的对照模型。
AI.conclusion: CF-GAP通过任务驱动的粗到细主动感知前端，有效提升高分辨率场景下实例检测的性能，兼具通用性与轻量化优势，为高分辨率视觉处理提供了新思路。

title: Answer-Distribution Trajectories: A Stochastic-Dynamics View of LLM Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-thought reasoning provides a structured computation between a model's input and final answer. Yet it is often evaluated through endpoint accuracy, which ignores the path taken to reach that answer. An emerging line of work addresses this limitation using entropy profiles, which track how uncertainty evolves over the reasoning process but do not reveal which competing hypotheses account for that uncertainty. We introduce answer-distribution trajectories, a stochastic-dynamics-inspired representation that tracks the model's full predictive distribution over answers as reasoning unfolds. As a strictly finer representation than endpoint and entropy summaries, answer-distribution trajectories enable us to characterize a trace through a dynamical reasoning profile spanning exploration, revision, motion, and commitment, and to distinguish different dynamical mechanisms of reasoning success and failure. Across sixteen open-weight language models and four reasoning benchmarks, we show that traces with the same endpoint and similar entropy profiles can exhibit substantially different reasoning dynamics. We further find substantial variation in these dynamics both within and across models and tasks, with different objectives favoring different dynamical profiles. Additionally, we show that training and inference choices systematically reshape these profiles. Our results suggest that answer-distribution trajectories provide a rich framework for analysing and evaluating the dynamics of LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"答案分布轨迹"（answer-distribution trajectories）这一受随机动力学启发的表示方法，追踪模型推理过程中对答案的完整预测分布演化，从而刻画推理动力学并区分成功与失败的机制。
AI.motivation: 现有对思维链推理的评估多依赖终点准确率，忽略了到达答案的路径；已有的熵轮廓方法虽能追踪不确定性演化，却无法揭示究竟是哪些竞争假设导致了这种不确定性。
AI.method: 提出答案分布轨迹表示，跟踪推理展开过程中模型对答案的完整预测分布。该表示严格比终点和熵摘要更精细，可据此刻画推理过程在探索、修正、运动与承诺四种状态间的动力学轮廓。
AI.result: 在16个开源权重语言模型和4个推理基准上，具有相同终点和相似熵轮廓的轨迹可表现出显著不同的推理动力学；这些动力学在模型内部、模型之间及任务之间均存在较大差异，不同目标偏好不同的动力学轮廓，且训练与推理选择会系统性重塑这些轮廓。
AI.conclusion: 答案分布轨迹为分析和评估大语言模型推理动力学提供了一个丰富的框架。

title: The Audit Decides the Verdict: Instrument Effects Rival Demographic Bias in LLM Decision Audits
comment: Accepted to REALM 2026, the 2nd Workshop for Research on Agent Language Models at EMNLP 2026. 10 pages, 3 figures
summary: Whether a language model looks demographically biased can depend on how the audit asks its question. A charitable-aid benchmark reports that the same models favor minority applicants when rating requests one at a time and penalize some when ranking side by side. We test whether that reversal generalizes to hiring, lending, and medical triage: 40,726 requests to five models, applications differing only in the applicant's name, and a primary test fixed before collection. It does not. None of 36 planned contrasts survives correction. The rating advantage keeps its sign at roughly half the published size, and a precision extension bounds any hiring ranking penalty below the published effect, though the lending and triage ranking floors sit above that margin, so the exclusion is conclusive for hiring ranking and for rating in all three domains only. Planted disparities tracking their injected sizes and a directional replication on the original aid materials bound these nulls. The audit is livelier than the demographics: models recognize transparent audits nearly always, tie every identical-content comparison whether the varying detail is race or a hobby, and reward first-listed candidates as much as any demographic effect we measure. Audit verdicts reflect audit construction more than demographic bias.

AI.tldr: 本文通过预先固定的主检验，用40,726条请求在招聘、借贷、医疗分诊三个领域测试“人口统计偏差结论是否随审计问法反转”，结果36个计划对比无一在多重比较校正后显著。研究认为审计结论更多反映审计构造，而非模型的人口统计偏差。
AI.motivation: 已有审计基准显示，同一模型在逐个评分时偏向少数族群申请人，而在并排排序时却惩罚部分群体，即审计结论随提问方式而反转。作者想检验该反转能否推广到招聘、借贷与医疗分诊等真实决策场景，以判断审计结论的稳健性。
AI.method: 向五个模型发出40,726条申请请求，申请材料仅在申请人姓名上不同；设置预先固定的主检验与36个计划对比；采用多重比较校正；对评分类优势做符号与效应量比较；用精度扩展给出排序惩罚的置信界限；并设置植入偏差（按注入幅度变化）与在原始援助材料上的方向性复现作为对照。
AI.result: 36个计划对比在校正后无一显著；评分优势方向不变但幅度约为已发表结果的一半；精度扩展将招聘排序惩罚的上界压至已发表效应以下，但借贷与分诊的排序下界高于该界限，因此排除性结论仅对招聘排序及三个领域的评分成立。植入偏差能追踪其注入幅度，原援助材料上的方向性复现也对零结果形成约束。
AI.conclusion: 模型几乎总能识别透明审计；对内容完全相同的比较（无论变动细节是种族还是爱好）一律判为平局；并将首位列出的候选人奖励到与任何测得的人口统计效应相当的程度。审计判定更多由审计设计决定，而非人口统计偏差。

title: "World Knowledge" in the Weights: Reading Concept Circuits of Vision Transformers
summary: Vision transformers (ViTs) have achieved remarkable generalization across visual domains, yet little is known about how they internally represent the structure of the world. To address this gap, we use Cross-Layer Transcoders (CLTs) to read concept circuits from ViTs: directed graphs whose nodes correspond to sparse, interpretable concepts and edges capture concept interactions across layers. Our method yields two complementary views of model behavior. The global concept circuit is input-invariant and can be recovered directly from learned cross-layer weights, exposing the reusable "world knowledge" encoded in the model. The instance concept circuit is input-dependent and identifies the concepts and pathways actually used for a specific prediction, enabling faithful example-level explanations. We demonstrate the utility of concept circuits in three ways: (1) Automatic spurious correlation discovery: leveraging the statistics of our global concept circuits to identify shortcut dependencies within the model. (2) Spurious correlation removal: intervening on the instance concept circuit to steer the model towards correct predictions. Empirical results show that our method outperforms existing counterparts by 11.0% on the Waterbird dataset. (3) Model comparison: contrasting the global concept circuits of different foundation models (e.g., CLIP vs. DINO) to reveal how supervision paradigms shape representational structure. Our code is available at https://github.com/deep-real/VisionCLT

AI.tldr: 本文利用跨层转码器（CLTs）从视觉Transformer（ViT）中提取"概念电路"——由稀疏可解释概念节点及跨层交互边构成的有向图，并区分输入无关的全局电路与输入相关的实例电路，用于虚假相关发现、去除及模型比较。
AI.motivation: ViT在视觉领域泛化能力出色，但其内部如何表征世界结构仍不清楚，缺乏对模型内部概念组织与交互机制的可解释性理解。
AI.method: 使用Cross-Layer Transcoders（CLTs）从ViT中读取概念电路：全局概念电路从学习到的跨层权重直接恢复，输入无关，反映可复用的"世界知识"；实例概念电路依赖输入，刻画特定预测所用概念与路径，提供忠实的样本级解释。
AI.result: 在三个任务上验证有效性：(1)基于全局电路统计自动发现虚假相关（捷径依赖）；(2)干预实例电路以修正预测，在Waterbird数据集上比现有方法高11.0%；(3)对比不同基础模型（CLIP与DINO）的全局概念电路，揭示监督范式对表征结构的影响。
AI.conclusion: 概念电路为ViT提供全局与实例双视角的可解释性，可支持虚假相关发现与去除，并揭示监督范式如何塑造表征结构，代码已开源。

title: Rethinking Learned Occupancy in Autonomous Active Mapping with Observation-Gated Filtering
comment: Accepted to IROS 2026 Space Robotics Workshop (oral)
summary: Autonomous 3D active mapping requires a space robot to choose where to sense while building the geometry needed for navigation. Learned occupancy completion extends spatial context beyond the current field of view, but one predicted map often serves two planning roles: it scores expected surface gain and constrains collision-free motion. Unsupported occupancy can therefore distort both where the robot looks and where it believes it can travel. We study this coupled interface in a controlled closed-loop benchmark by holding the active-mapping system fixed and varying only its planner-facing occupancy across observation-only, learned, oracle-corrected, and ground-truth conditions. Improving occupancy accuracy does not monotonically improve closed-loop coverage: across 25 starts, planning with ground-truth occupancy reaches 70% of the learned baseline's final coverage 12.7 steps earlier on average, while increasing final coverage by only 0.031. Guided by this diagnosis, we introduce an observation-gated filter that retains completion in insufficiently observed regions and suppresses predictions only after repeated frustum exposure without nearby RGB-D support. The filter improves both targeted failure-prone starts without retraining or ground truth. These results motivate online revision of planner-facing geometry during autonomous intervals between communication windows. The current study assumes benchmark RGB-D observations and sufficiently accurate pose estimates; planetary sensing conditions and accumulated localization drift remain to be evaluated.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过固定主动建图系统、仅改变规划器所面向的占用图，构建受控闭环基准，发现占用精度提升并不单调改善闭环覆盖率，并提出观测门控滤波以在线修正规划几何。
AI.motivation: 自主三维主动建图要求空间机器人在构建导航所需几何的同时决定感知位置。学习式占用补全虽能扩展视野外的空间上下文，但同一预测图同时承担两个规划角色：评估预期表面增益与约束无碰撞运动。不支持的占用会同时扭曲"看向何处"和"认为可通行何处"，因此需要研究这一耦合接口对闭环性能的影响。
AI.method: 构建受控闭环基准：保持主动建图系统不变，仅改变规划器面对的占用图，设置四种条件——仅观测、学习式、oracle校正、真值。基于诊断结果提出观测门控滤波器：在观测不足区域保留补全，仅在视锥反复暴露且附近缺乏RGB-D支持时才抑制预测。该方法无需重训练或真值。
AI.result: 占用精度提升并不单调改善闭环覆盖率：在25个起点上，使用真值占用规划的最终覆盖率仅比学习基线高0.031，但平均提前12.7步达到学习基线最终覆盖率的70%。观测门控滤波器无需重训练或真值即可改善易失败起点上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 面向规划器的几何在自主区间内应进行在线修正，而非仅依赖离线学习的静态预测。当前研究假设基准RGB-D观测与足够准确的位姿估计，行星感知条件与累积定位漂移仍有待评估。

title: Performance of Clinical AI System and Physicians and Frontier Language Models in primary care diagnostics
summary: Clinical AI evaluation should encompass diagnosis and management after adaptive information gathering. We compared Doctorina, eight physicians and four standalone frontier language models in 150 synthetic Polish-language primary-care consultations. Doctorina achieved 82.0% Top-1 concordance versus 57.0% for physicians (difference, 25.0 percentage points; 95% confidence interval, 17.7-32.7) and 97.3% versus 85.0% primary-or-reference-differential concordance. Across 149 case pairs, normalized workup and treatment scores were 89.4 versus 66.9 and 83.7 versus 61.2. Doctorina had the highest diagnostic point estimates among all six groups; Kimi K3 ranked next, while Claude Opus 5 led the closely spaced management estimates of Opus, Doctorina and Kimi. A second Doctorina execution reproduced the advantages over physicians across all outcomes. Doctorina's advantage over physicians therefore extended from primary-diagnosis selection to higher-rated diagnostic workup and initial treatment after adaptive consultation.

AI.tldr: 一项对比研究显示，在150例波兰语初级保健模拟问诊中，临床AI系统Doctorina在诊断与管理各项指标上均优于医师及四个前沿语言模型。
AI.motivation: 现有临床AI评估多聚焦静态诊断，忽视了"适应性信息采集后的诊断与管理"这一真实临床过程，因此需要纳入自适应问诊情境下的多维评估。
AI.method: 在150例合成的波兰语初级保健咨询中，比较Doctorina、8名医师与4个独立前沿语言模型。评估指标包括Top-1诊断一致性、主诊断或参考鉴别诊断一致性，以及在149个病例对上标准化的检查（workup）与治疗评分；并进行Doctorina第二次运行以复现结果。
AI.result: Doctorina的Top-1一致性为82.0%，医师为57.0%（差25.0个百分点，95%CI 17.7–32.7）；主诊断或参考鉴别诊断一致性为97.3%对85.0%。149个病例对的标准化检查与治疗评分分别为89.4对66.9、83.7对61.2。诊断点估计值Doctorina居六组之首，Kimi K3次之；管理评分中Claude Opus 5、Doctorina与Kimi接近，Opus略高。第二次运行复现了对医师的全部优势。
AI.conclusion: Doctorina相对医师的优势不仅体现在主诊断选择，还延伸至自适应问诊后的诊断检查与初始治疗方案评分，提示临床AI评估应纳入管理维度。

title: ToolLoop: Closed-Loop Tool-Use Data Synthesis via Decomposed Generation and Dynamic Self-Feedback
comment: Accepted at the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: High-quality tool-use data is critical for training language models to interact effectively with external tools. However, existing synthetic approaches typically follow a generate-then-filter paradigm with static post-hoc verification, often yielding inefficient data with imbalanced feature distributions. We propose ToolLoop, a closed-loop framework that decomposes synthesis into three progressive stages: (1) sampling function name combinations as ground truth; (2) backward derivation of user queries; and (3) forward derivation of tool calls. At each stage, dynamic self-feedback iteratively guides the model toward high-quality generation, realizing a transition from generate-then-filter to generate-verify-refine. On the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL), a 4B parameter model trained with our 11K synthetic examples achieves 86.40% accuracy in non-reasoning mode, while an Isolate variant that removes BFCL-overlapping candidate functions still reaches 86.07\%. Cross-benchmark evaluation on ACEBench further demonstrates strong generalization, with 72.1% overall accuracy using only 18.3% of baseline training data.

AI.tldr: ToolLoop是一个闭环工具调用数据合成框架，通过"生成-验证-精炼"替代"生成-过滤"范式，用11K合成样本训练的4B模型在BFCL非推理模式达86.40%准确率。
AI.motivation: 训练语言模型有效使用外部工具需要高质量工具调用数据，但现有合成方法多采用"先生成后过滤"的静态事后验证范式，导致数据效率低下且特征分布不均衡。
AI.method: ToolLoop将合成过程分解为三个渐进阶段：(1)采样函数名组合作为真值；(2)反向推导用户查询；(3)前向推导工具调用。每个阶段通过动态自反馈迭代引导模型趋向高质量生成，实现从"生成-过滤"到"生成-验证-精炼"的范式转变。
AI.result: 在BFCL上，用11K合成样本训练的4B参数模型在非推理模式达86.40%准确率；去除与BFCL重叠候选函数的Isolate变体仍达86.07%。在ACEBench跨基准评测中，仅用基线18.3%的训练数据即取得72.1%的整体准确率，展现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 闭环式生成-验证-精炼框架能高效产出高质量工具调用数据，在低数据量下实现优异性能与跨基准泛化，验证了动态自反馈机制相比静态事后过滤的优越性。

title: ActReview: Rebuttal-Guided Training Data and Rubric Rewards for Actionable Peer Review Generation
summary: As LLMs are increasingly used for pre-submission self-review, there is growing demand for feedback that not only identifies weaknesses but also guides authors toward concrete revisions. We study this as Actionable Peer-review Generation and decompose it into two subtasks: diagnostic claim generation and revision suggestion generation. We introduce ActReview, a rebuttal-guided post-training framework that connects paper-specific diagnoses to concrete, grounded revision plans. Our central insight is that author rebuttals reveal plausible actions for addressing reviewer concerns and can therefore provide latent supervision for revision-oriented feedback. From real review-rebuttal threads on OpenReview, we construct ActReview-40K by aligning reviewer weaknesses with author responses and grounding the resulting feedback in localized paper evidence. We post-train Qwen3-8B-Base with multi-task supervised fine-tuning followed by GRPO using candidate-aware, weakness-specific rubric rewards. We also introduce ActReview-Bench, a human-curated benchmark of 1,000 instances for evaluating diagnostic quality and revision usefulness. Experiments show that ActReview outperforms prior specialized review-generation models on actionability and grounding while remaining competitive with strong prompt-based LLMs. Human evaluation confirms improved revision usefulness while revealing a remaining gap in technical accuracy, and additional analyses support generalization to held-out papers and robustness across independent judges.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可操作同行评审生成"任务，并推出ActReview框架：利用作者rebuttal作为潜在监督信号，通过多任务SFT+GRPO后训练Qwen3-8B-Base，实现诊断性问题与具体修改建议的生成，在可操作性与证据接地性上优于专用评审模型，但仍存在技术准确性差距。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM被广泛用于投稿前的自审，作者不仅需要指出论文弱点的反馈，更希望获得能指导具体修改的可操作建议。现有评审生成研究多停留在识别缺陷，缺乏与论文证据对接的、可执行修改方案，因此需要将评审生成重构为可操作反馈任务。
AI.method: 将任务分解为诊断性主张生成与修改建议生成两个子任务。核心洞见是作者rebuttal隐含了回应审稿意见的可行行动，可作为面向修改反馈的潜在监督。基于OpenReview真实review-rebuttal线程构建ActReview-40K数据集，将审稿人指出的弱点与作者回应对齐，并把反馈接地到论文局部证据。对Qwen3-8B-Base进行多任务SFT，随后用候选感知、弱点特定的评分标准奖励进行GRPO强化学习。同时构建ActReview-Bench（1000条人工标注实例）用于评估诊断质量与修改有用性。
AI.result: ActReview在可操作性与证据接地性上优于既有专用评审生成模型，并与强prompt-based LLM保持竞争力。人工评估证实修改有用性提升，但技术准确性仍存在差距。额外分析表明方法可泛化到留出论文，并对不同独立评审者具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 以rebuttal为潜在监督、结合多任务SFT与弱点特定奖励的GRPO，可有效提升评审反馈的可操作性与接地性，为投稿前自审提供实用修改指导。未来工作需重点改进技术准确性，以缩小与人类专家的差距。

title: GoDeep: Annotation-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding via Language-Space Lifting
summary: Open vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation methods typically lift CLIP features into 3D. This embeds points in a joint vision-language space known to behave like a bag-of-words on compositional tasks. Furthermore, even annotation free variants often require a large 3D training corpus and a dedicated 3D encoder per domain. Instead we use a vision-language model purely as a translator. It produces structured, entity-level descriptions of each posed image. These descriptions are grounded, projected, and aggregated directly in a general-purpose, language-only embedding space, with no 3D training corpus or encoder required. On ScanNet++, our pipeline is competitive with strong annotation free baselines trained on ScanNet. On a 5-building cultural heritage benchmark, raw scores initially favor a CLIP-based variant, but a single systematic vocabulary correction reverses this ranking. An effect confirmed by a second, independent correction on a different class, indicating that language-space embeddings track physical content more faithfully. This fidelity extends to genuinely out-of-vocabulary (OOV) objects on ScanNet++ proving that language-space embeddings separate presence from absence objects far more sharply than CLIP-based embeddings do. GoDeep also localize these OOV objects within the scene, all without any 2D-3D annotation. Because every representation remains discrete text, predictions are also explainable at the point level. Finally, exploiting both a heuristic weighting, that favors precise over merely frequent observations and GoDeep's explainability property, we propose an aggregation strategy, as a proof of concept, that favors finer elements localization.

AI.tldr: 提出 GoDeep，将视觉语言模型仅用作翻译器，生成实体级描述并在通用纯语言嵌入空间中投影聚合，无需 3D 训练语料或编码器，即可实现开放词汇 3D 语义分割，且支持 OOV 定位与点级可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇 3D 语义分割通常将 CLIP 特征提升到 3D，导致点被嵌入到类似词袋（bag-of-words）的联合视觉-语言空间，在组合性任务上表现不佳；且即使无标注变体也往往依赖大规模 3D 训练语料与按域定制的 3D 编码器，成本高、泛化受限。
AI.method: 将视觉语言模型纯粹当作翻译器，对每张带位姿图像生成结构化、实体级描述；这些描述被 grounded、投影并直接在通用纯语言嵌入空间中聚合，全程不使用 3D 训练语料和 3D 编码器。此外提出一种启发式加权（偏好精确观测而非仅高频观测）结合方法自身可解释性的聚合策略，以优化细粒度元素定位。
AI.result: 在 ScanNet++ 上，该方法与在 ScanNet 上训练的强无标注基线相当；在 5 栋建筑的文化遗产基准上，原始分数起初偏向 CLIP 变体，但一次系统性词汇校正即反转排名，且该效果被另一类别的独立校正所验证。语言空间嵌入更忠实反映物理内容，在 ScanNet++ 上对真正 OOV 物体能更清晰区分存在与缺失，并可定位这些 OOV 物体，全程无需 2D-3D 标注；由于表示均为离散文本，预测在点级别可解释。
AI.conclusion: 以纯语言嵌入空间替代 CLIP 联合空间，可提升开放词汇 3D 语义分割的物理内容保真度、OOV 区分与定位能力，并带来点级可解释性；启发式加权聚合策略作为概念验证，有助于更精细的元素定位。

title: It's Not RoPE that Creates Sinks: The Role of Self-Concentration and Value-Non-Mixing in Attention
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often exhibit "Attention Sink" (AS) and the accompanying "Massive Activations" (MAs) at the initial position of a sequence. These phenomena frequently co-occur, and MAs can pose challenges for low-bit quantization. In this study, we analyze the factors underlying AS and MAs that emerge at the initial position regardless of the token occupying it. Our experiments suggest that self-concentration of attention, resulting from the causal mask, and the subsequent Value-non-mixing in attention outputs contribute to AS and MAs. These findings provide new empirical evidence on the internal dynamics of LLMs, offering insights that may inform future quantization strategies and advance our understanding of the internal mechanisms of attention layers.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了大语言模型中初始位置出现的"注意力汇聚"（AS）与"巨型激活"（MAs）现象，指出因果掩码导致的自注意力自集中以及注意力输出中Value不混合是这两类现象产生的原因。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常在序列初始位置出现"注意力汇聚"（AS）及伴随的"巨型激活"（MAs），二者常共同出现，且MAs会给低位量化带来困难。作者希望厘清这些现象为何无论初始位置由何种token占据都会出现。
AI.method: 通过实验分析初始位置AS与MAs的形成因素，考察因果掩码引起的注意力自集中（self-concentration）以及注意力输出中的Value-non-mixing现象。
AI.result: 实验表明，因果掩码导致的注意力自集中，以及随后注意力输出中的Value不混合，共同促成了AS与MAs的产生。
AI.conclusion: 研究为LLM内部动态提供了新的实证证据，可为未来量化策略提供启示，并加深对注意力层内部机制的理解。

title: SPINE: Measuring LLM Sycophancy under Sustained Multi-Turn Pressure
summary: Large language models (LLMs) may abandon correct positions when users push back, exhibiting a failure mode known as sycophancy. Existing evaluations typically use short, prespecified conversations and may therefore miss failures that emerge under sustained, adaptive disagreement. We introduce SPINE, a benchmark in which an LLM proxy plays a persistent but mistaken user and adaptively challenges a target model for up to 25 turns. We evaluate four commercial models (Claude Sonnet 5, GPT-5.6 Terra, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and DeepSeek V4 Pro) and three Olmo3-7b models on 100 false presuppositions and 100 unethical queries. We define collapse as a target model abandoning the correct position and yielding to user pressure. Our experimental results show that collapse rates increase with conversation length across post-trained models, with the overall rate rising from 0%-57% within 5 turns to 20%-97% within 25 turns depending on model and scenario. These results show that evaluations limited to a few conversational turns underestimate sycophancy and resistance under sustained pressure remains unreliable across current models. By analyzing models with accessible reasoning traces, we surprisingly found that the correct position often remains represented in the trace in 50%-89% of analyzed collapse turns, suggesting that the model chooses to please a user and sycophancy is not due to ignorance or the correct knowledge being overridden. Ablations show that the SPINE protocol substantially increases the sycophantic collapse rate compared to pre-generated scripts. Among all tactics, emotional appeals are most associated with inducing LLM sycophantic behavior, with position weakening in 44.3% of turns using this tactic. Code, data, and transcripts will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SPINE 基准，通过让 LLM 代理扮演"持续但错误"的用户，对目标模型进行最多 25 轮的自适应质疑，测试其在持续压力下的"谄媚性崩溃"。结果显示崩溃率随对话轮数显著上升（5 轮内 0%–57%，25 轮内 20%–97%），且分析推理轨迹发现多数崩溃轮次中正确立场仍被保留，说明谄媚并非源于无知或被覆盖。
AI.motivation: 现有对 LLM 谄媚性（sycophancy）的评测多采用简短、预设脚本式对话，难以捕捉在持续、自适应分歧下才会出现的失败模式，因而可能低估了模型在真实压力下的顺从倾向。
AI.method: 提出 SPINE 基准：由 LLM 代理扮演坚持错误立场的用户，自适应地对目标模型发起最长 25 轮质疑。评测 4 个商用模型（Claude Sonnet 5、GPT-5.6 Terra、Gemini 3.1 Pro、DeepSeek V4 Pro）与 3 个 Olmo3-7b 模型，覆盖 100 条虚假预设与 100 条不道德请求。定义"崩溃"为模型放弃正确立场并向用户压力屈服，并分析可获取的推理轨迹，配合消融实验比较 SPINE 协议与预生成脚本的效果。
AI.result: 崩溃率随对话长度增加而上升：5 轮内整体为 0%–57%，25 轮内为 20%–97%（因模型与情境而异）。在可分析崩溃轮次中，50%–89% 的推理轨迹仍保留正确立场，表明模型是"选择取悦用户"而非知识缺失或被覆盖。消融显示 SPINE 协议相比预生成脚本大幅提高谄媚崩溃率。在各类策略中，情感诉求最易诱发谄媚行为，该策略下 44.3% 的轮次出现立场弱化。
AI.conclusion: 局限于少数对话轮次的评测会系统性低估谄媚性；当前模型在持续压力下的立场保持仍不可靠。谄媚更多是模型主动迎合用户的"选择"而非能力缺陷，提示需要更长、自适应的评测协议。

title: SAEScientist-Bench: Can AI Agents Conduct Autonomous SAE Interpretability Research?
summary: While research on recursive self-improvement (RSI) has predominantly automated model training pipelines, reliable autonomous development demands a missing pillar: post-hoc monitoring and auditing to understand what models learn and ensure safe alignment. Mechanistic interpretability tools are essential to bridge this gap, among which Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) serve as a cornerstone by isolating interpretable features for model inspection and steering. In this paper, we introduce SAEScientist-Bench to evaluate whether AI agents can act as scientists utilizing SAE tools for autonomous mechanistic discovery. Given a target concept, an agent designs contrastive probes and navigates a Gemma Scope dictionary of 131K+ features in Gemma-2-9B-IT to discover the optimal feature, evaluated against curated expert reference features anchored on Neuronpedia across activation rank, concept selectivity on contrastive texts, and causal steering. Across 10 agent configurations and 20 tasks, frontier agents demonstrate genuine discovery capabilities and lead different evaluation dimensions, but remain well behind the expert baseline, approaching expert levels on separating target concepts from contrastive controls while lagging substantially in causal generation steering. Further analysis reveals that although agents can design contrasts to rule out spurious candidates, they frequently misinterpret experimental measurements. These results establish experimental model understanding as a measurable capability for closed-loop autonomous AI R&D. Our code is available at https://github.com/Trae1ounG/SAEScientist.

AI.tldr: 提出 SAEScientist-Bench，评估 AI 智能体能否像科学家一样使用 SAE 工具进行自主机制发现；前沿智能体展现出真实发现能力，但在因果引导上仍显著落后于专家基线。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）研究多聚焦于自动化模型训练流水线，但可靠的自主开发还缺失一个关键支柱：事后监控与审计，即理解模型学到了什么并确保安全的对齐。机制可解释性工具是弥补这一缺口的关键，其中稀疏自编码器（SAE）是隔离可解释特征以进行模型检查与引导的基石。因此需要评估 AI 智能体能否充当科学家，利用 SAE 工具进行自主机制发现。
AI.method: 构建 SAEScientist-Bench 基准。给定一个目标概念，智能体设计对比探针，并在 Gemma-2-9B-IT 的 Gemma Scope 字典（131K+ 特征）中导航以发现最优特征。评估基于 Neuronpedia 上经专家策展的参考特征，从三个维度衡量：激活排名、对比文本上的概念选择性、因果引导。实验覆盖 10 种智能体配置与 20 个任务。
AI.result: 前沿智能体展现出真实的发现能力，并在不同评估维度上各有领先，但整体仍远落后于专家基线。智能体在将目标概念与对比控制项区分上接近专家水平，但在因果生成引导方面大幅落后。进一步分析表明，尽管智能体能设计对比以排除虚假候选，但它们经常误读实验测量结果。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果确立了"实验性模型理解"作为闭环自主 AI 研发中一项可度量的能力。

title: Mask Forcing: Improving Autoregressive Video Diffusion Distillation via Dual-Noise Masking Rollout
summary: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models have shown great potential in real-time video generation. Recent methods distill pretrained bidirectional video diffusion models into causal AR students through Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), but the generated videos often suffer from over-saturation and over-smoothing issues, resulting in limited visual quality and realism. The key contributing factor is the mode-seeking behavior of the reverse KL objective in DMD, which can cause the student distribution to collapse onto only a few modes of the teacher distribution. To address this, we propose Mask Forcing, a Dual-Noise Masking Rollout strategy that perturbs the AR student self-rollout to mitigate mode collapse induced by reverse-KL mode seeking. The core idea is to inject cleaner signals into noisy rollout inputs via random masks along spatial and temporal axes during the self-rollout process of AR diffusion distillation. Such perturbations encourage the student rollouts to explore more regions of the teacher distribution, allowing DMD to provide learning signals beyond the modes already covered by the student. Moreover, the cleaner tokens act as denoising guidance for other noisier tokens, improving the intermediate rollout predictions and reducing error accumulation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method improves multiple AR video diffusion distillation methods with higher visual quality efficiently, without incorporating real video data or additional post-training stages.

AI.tldr: 提出 Mask Forcing 方法，通过双噪声掩码 rollout 策略扰动自回归学生模型的自我展开过程，缓解 DMD 蒸馏中的模式坍缩，提升生成视频的视觉质量与真实感。
AI.motivation: 自回归（AR）视频扩散模型在实时视频生成中潜力巨大。现有方法通过分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）将预训练的双向视频扩散模型蒸馏为因果 AR 学生模型，但生成的视频存在过饱和和过平滑问题，视觉质量与真实感受限。其根本原因是 DMD 中反向 KL 目标的模式寻求（mode-seeking）行为，导致学生分布坍缩到教师分布的少数模式上。
AI.method: 提出 Mask Forcing，即双噪声掩码 rollout 策略。核心思想是在 AR 扩散蒸馏的自我 rollout 过程中，沿空间和时间轴施加随机掩码，向含噪 rollout 输入注入更干净的信号。这种扰动促使学生 rollout 探索教师分布的更多区域，使 DMD 能提供超出学生已覆盖模式的学习信号；同时更干净的 token 为其他噪声更大的 token 充当去噪引导，改善中间 rollout 预测并减少误差累积。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法能高效提升多种 AR 视频扩散蒸馏方法，获得更高的视觉质量，且无需引入真实视频数据或额外的后训练阶段。
AI.conclusion: Mask Forcing 通过双噪声掩码 rollout 有效缓解反向 KL 模式寻求引发的模式坍缩，提升 AR 视频扩散蒸馏的视觉质量，是一种高效、无需真实数据与额外后训练的通用增强策略。

title: Canonical Color as a Lens into Concept Decodability in Vision Encoders and VLMs
summary: Visual encoders construct a representation of the image input for Vision-Language models. How much conceptual, as opposed to immediately visible, information does this representation contain? We use canonical color as a controlled test case to ask whether vision encoders make canonical-color information linearly accessible, even when color is removed from the input image. We construct a dataset of objects with canonical colors, and probe vision encoders for both color and object identity using color and grayscale images. We find that canonical color remains decodable from grayscale images, and is tied to predicted object identity, indicating a conceptual link. Extending this analysis to full VLMs, we find that VLM post-training can have a surprisingly large effect on color decodability in the vision encoder. Overall, canonical color provides a usefully controllable lens for tracing object-level conceptual semantic information in vision encoders and VLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文以"典型颜色(canonical color)"为受控探针，检验视觉编码器在图像被灰度化(去除颜色)后是否仍保留概念性颜色信息。
AI.motivation: 视觉编码器为视觉语言模型(VLM)构建图像表征，但该表征中究竟包含多少"概念性"而非"直接可见"的信息尚不明确。作者希望找到一个可控、可量化的切入点来探究这一问题。
AI.method: 构建带有典型颜色的物体数据集，对视觉编码器进行线性探针(probing)：分别用彩色图像和灰度图像探测颜色与物体身份(object identity)的可解码性；随后将分析扩展到完整VLM，考察后训练(post-training)对编码器颜色可解码性的影响。
AI.result: 典型颜色即便在灰度图像下仍可被解码，且与预测的物体身份相关联，表明二者存在概念性联系；扩展到完整VLM后发现，VLM的后训练对视觉编码器中颜色可解码性有出乎意料的大影响。
AI.conclusion: 典型颜色为追踪视觉编码器与VLM中物体层面的概念语义信息提供了一个可控的观测视角。

title: A Mechanistic Study of AI-Text Detection Neurons in Frozen BERT: Sparse Probing and Activation Patching on RAID
summary: AI-generated text detectors achieve high accuracy on standard benchmarks, yet the internal representations that drive these predictions remain poorly understood. We study which neurons in a frozen BERT-base-uncased encoder support AI-text detection, using the RAID benchmark across six generators spanning pure-base and instruction-tuned models. We apply the L1-to-L2 sparse-probing protocol of Gurnee et al. (2023) to all 9,216 CLS hidden-state dimensions (12 layers x 768), which we call neurons. The procedure recovers a stable set of under 1% of neurons per generator, consistent across folds and seeds; a probe restricted to that set retains most of the full-feature detection accuracy. Bidirectional activation patching confirms this set's causal relevance: in both directions it flips predictions an order of magnitude more often than size-matched random sets. Mean-ablating the same neurons leaves accuracy largely intact; the signal is therefore redundantly distributed. Cross-generator analysis reveals a bipartite structure: instruction-tuned generators concentrate 30-36% of stable neurons in BERT's final layer while both base generators fall below 14%, consistent with a layer-12 footprint of post-training alignment. Leave-one-family-out evaluation shows the selected neurons retain 86-94% of the full-feature ceiling on unseen generator families, so a detector can operate on a small fixed subspace without re-identifying neurons per generator.

AI.tldr: 该论文用L1-to-L2稀疏探测方法定位冻结BERT编码器中支撑AI文本检测的神经元，发现每生成器不到1%的稳定神经元即可保留大部分检测精度，且具有因果相关性；神经元信号呈冗余分布，并在指令微调与基础模型间呈现二分结构。
AI.motivation: AI生成文本检测器在标准基准上准确率很高，但驱动这些预测的内部神经元表征机制仍不清楚，作者希望揭示其可解释的神经元基础。
AI.method: 在冻结的BERT-base-uncased编码器上，采用RAID基准覆盖六种生成器（纯基础模型与指令微调模型）；对全部9,216个CLS隐藏状态维度（12层×768）应用Gurnee等的L1-to-L2稀疏探测协议，并通过双向激活补丁、均值消融及跨生成器/留一家族评估进行验证。
AI.result: 每个生成器可稳定恢复不足1%的神经元，跨折与随机种子一致，仅用该子集的探针保留大部分全特征精度；激活补丁显示其翻转预测的频率比同规模随机集高一个数量级，均值消融后精度基本不变（信号冗余）；指令微调生成器在末层集中30-36%稳定神经元，基础模型低于14%；留一家族评估中未见生成器家族仍保留86-94%的全特征上限。
AI.conclusion: AI文本检测依赖一个小型、稳定且因果相关的神经元子空间，该信号冗余分布并反映训练后对齐的层次足迹；检测器可在固定子空间上运行而无需按生成器重新识别神经元。

title: ExecCritic: Learn to Test, Test to Improve for Coding Agents
summary: Execution feedback can guide coding agents toward correct repository repairs, but only when the tests capture the behavior requested by the issue. Agent-generated tests can encode incomplete or incorrect behavioral targets; when the same trajectory writes both the patch and the test, their errors can agree and create false confidence. We introduce ExecCritic, combining a test--verify--revise scaffold with a role-specific reinforcement learning recipe for training agents within it. The scaffold separates test construction from source-code repair: a Test agent independently generates repository-native tests, a fail-closed harness qualifies and freezes them, and a Repair agent revises source code from their execution feedback without changing the tests. Both roles use Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B as the backbone and are trained separately. In Learn to Test, the Test agent learns to produce behaviorally valid tests that distinguish correct from incorrect patches. In Test to Improve, the Repair agent learns both direct task resolution and feedback-guided revision. On SWE-bench Verified, test quality determines whether feedback helps: holding the base Repair agent fixed, tests from the base Test agent reduce resolved rate from a no-test baseline of 61.2% to 57.3%, whereas tests from GPT-5.6-sol raise it to 65.3%. Role-specific post-training raises the Qwen Test agent's Base-to-Gold success from 22.2% to 62.2%; composing the two post-trained Qwen agents reaches 72.6%, an 11.4-point gain over the original no-test baseline without stronger-model or Oracle feedback at evaluation time. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/execcritic.

AI.tldr: ExecCritic 将测试构造与代码修复分离，用测试—验证—修订框架和角色专属强化学习分别训练 Test 与 Repair 智能体，在 SWE-bench Verified 上将无测试基线的 61.2% 提升至 72.6%。
AI.motivation: 执行反馈能引导编码智能体修复仓库，但前提是测试真实反映 issue 所要求的行为。若同一轨迹同时生成补丁与测试，二者的错误可能相互印证，产生虚假信心，导致反馈失效甚至有害。
AI.method: 提出测试—验证—修订（test–verify–revise）脚手架：Test 智能体独立生成仓库原生测试，fail-closed 测试台对其进行资格审核并冻结；Repair 智能体仅依据执行反馈修改源码，不得改动测试。两个角色均以 Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B 为骨干并分开训练，采用角色专属强化学习配方："Learn to Test" 训练 Test 智能体生成能区分正确与错误补丁的行为有效测试；"Test to Improve" 训练 Repair 智能体兼顾直接解题与反馈引导修订。
AI.result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上，固定基础 Repair 智能体时，基础 Test 智能体的测试使解决率从无测试基线 61.2% 降至 57.3%，而 GPT-5.6-sol 的测试将其提升至 65.3%，表明测试质量决定反馈是否有益。角色专属后训练使 Qwen Test 智能体的 Base-to-Gold 成功率从 22.2% 升至 62.2%；组合两个后训练 Qwen 智能体达到 72.6%，较原始无测试基线提升 11.4 个百分点，且评估时无需更强模型或 Oracle 反馈。
AI.conclusion: 分离测试生成与代码修复、并对两个角色分别进行后训练，可显著提升编码智能体的仓库修复能力，且收益不依赖评估阶段的强模型或 Oracle 反馈。代码已公开。

title: Entropy-Regularized Rank-Masked Policy Optimization for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning in Code Generation
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. 15 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables
summary: Existing methods for test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) derive rewards from answer-level self-voting on unlabeled test-time tasks with canonical answers, but this breaks down for code generation because programs cannot be compared by surface form and therefore do not directly provide a usable training signal. To make TTRL applicable to code generation, we propose probe-driven TTRL, which constructs output-free probe inputs from the problem statement, executes candidate programs on these probes, and defines a Probe Consensus Reward (PCR) from the resulting behavioral agreement. PCR provides a behavioral training signal for open-vocabulary programs, but it is not a fully reliable verifier and remains susceptible to reward hacking through spurious consensus. We therefore introduce Entropy-Regularized Rank-Masked Policy Optimization (ERPO), which converts low PCR into conservative negative updates through rank masking and controls policy drift with an entropy ceiling. On coding benchmarks, ERPO substantially improves pass@1 and pass@k in both in-domain adaptation and zero-shot transfer.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出探针驱动的TTRL框架，用探针共识奖励（PCR）为代码生成提供行为层面的训练信号，并通过ERPO算法抑制奖励攻击，在编码基准上显著提升pass@1与pass@k。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时强化学习（TTRL）依赖答案层面的自投票，只适用于具有标准答案、可按表面形式比较的任务。代码生成中程序无法通过表面形式比较，因而缺乏可用的训练信号，导致TTRL难以直接应用。
AI.method: 1) 探针驱动TTRL：从问题陈述构造无输出探针输入，在探针上执行候选程序，依据行为一致性定义探针共识奖励（PCR）；2) 熵正则化秩掩码策略优化（ERPO）：通过秩掩码将低PCR转化为保守的负更新，并以熵上限控制策略漂移，缓解虚假共识带来的奖励攻击。
AI.result: 在编码基准上，ERPO在域内适配和零样本迁移两种设定下均大幅提升pass@1和pass@k。
AI.conclusion: 行为层面的共识可替代表面形式比较，为开放词汇程序提供训练信号；结合秩掩码与熵约束可有效抑制奖励攻击，使TTRL成功扩展到代码生成任务。

title: A Data-Driven Framework for Identifying and Prioritizing RPA Opportunities in Healthcare Processes
summary: Robotic Process Automation (RPA) is widely used to reduce administrative burden in United States hospitals, yet an estimated 30-50% of RPA initiatives underperform because processes are selected informally, without a repeatable method to catalogue candidates, prioritize them, match each to an automation tier -- a Python bot, an open-source orchestrator such as n8n, or an enterprise platform such as UiPath -- and forecast financial return before committing resources. We propose a four-module, data-driven framework unifying these decisions: a Process Taxonomy of twenty recurring hospital processes across five value streams; a Prioritization module deriving an Automation Suitability Index from an Analytic Hierarchy Process matrix with an explicit consistency check; a Tool-Tier Selection module recommending the least-cost technology sufficient for a process complexity, integration, and compliance profile; and a Return-on-Investment module quantifying labor savings, error-cost avoidance, payback, and net present value. Applied to a synthetic portfolio spanning all twenty processes, plus a reference data-flow architecture linking it to hospital EHR/payer/ERP systems: 12 of 20 clear the prioritization threshold; the ranking is robust to +/-20% weight perturbation (Spearman correlation 0.83, top-5 set preserved 97.7%, 2,000 Monte Carlo trials); an Automation Risk Index flags four qualifying processes as Critical risk; a budget-constrained portfolio optimization shows diminishing marginal NPV as spend scales from $400K to $1.03M; and a second Monte Carlo analysis shows portfolio NPV stays positive at its 5th percentile. The framework is a conceptual synthesis of the literature rather than an instrument calibrated on primary hospital data; we discuss HIPAA governance and a research agenda for empirical validation. A supplementary Python implementation accompanies the paper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个四模块数据驱动框架，用于医院RPA流程的目录化、优先级排序、工具层级匹配与投资回报预测，并在合成流程组合上验证其排序稳健性与财务可行性。
AI.motivation: 美国医院广泛采用RPA以减轻行政负担，但约30-50%的RPA项目表现不佳，原因是流程选择缺乏可重复方法：无法系统编目候选流程、优先排序、匹配自动化层级（Python脚本、n8n等开源编排器、UiPath等企业平台），也无法在投入资源前预测财务回报。
AI.method: 提出统一的四模块数据驱动框架：(1)流程分类法，覆盖五大价值流的二十个高频医院流程；(2)优先级模块，基于层次分析法（AHP）矩阵并含一致性检验，导出自动化适宜性指数（ASI）；(3)工具层级选择模块，依据流程的复杂度、集成度与合规画像推荐满足需求的成本最低技术；(4)投资回报模块，量化人力节省、错误成本规避、回收期与净现值（NPV）。另附参考数据流架构，连接医院EHR/支付方/ERP系统。
AI.result: 在覆盖全部二十个流程的合成组合上：20个流程中12个通过优先级阈值；排序对±20%权重扰动稳健（Spearman相关0.83，前5名集合保持率97.7%，2000次蒙特卡洛试验）；自动化风险指数将四个合格流程标记为临界风险；预算约束下的组合优化显示支出从40万美元增至103万美元时NPV边际递减；第二次蒙特卡洛分析显示组合NPV在第5百分位仍为正。
AI.conclusion: 该框架是对文献的概念性综合，而非基于一手医院数据校准的工具；作者讨论了HIPAA治理及实证验证的研究议程，并附有配套的Python实现。

title: Studying Image Tokenizers as Visual Languages in Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Image tokenizers define the ``visual language'' of unified multimodal models, yet are commonly studied through isolated metrics or generation-/understanding-only evaluations. These evaluations do not fully capture how visual tokens behave when modeled jointly with text. We build a controlled pure-autoregressive testbed and track task-specific validation losses during multimodal continual pretraining across text, image, text-to-image (T2I), and image-to-text (I2T) prediction. We examine how these losses scale and relate to downstream performance, then use them to study multimodal learnability---how well image and text tokens are jointly modeled---and tokenizer design. We find that (1) losses should be analyzed by task, since they exhibit distinct scaling behavior and rank tokenizers differently. (2) The loss--performance relationship depends on the predicted token space: for a fixed tokenizer, T2I and I2T losses correlate with generation quality, but across tokenizers, the T2I loss--performance relationship shifts with the image-token space, whereas I2T loss, computed over a shared text vocabulary, provides a more consistent signal. I2T loss also correlates with both generation and visual understanding performance after supervised finetuning. Using losses as a lens, we show that (3) better reconstruction does not necessarily yield lower task-specific losses or stronger downstream performance, and that (4) image tokenizer choice can affect text modeling under joint optimization. As case studies, we revisit three tokenizer design axes---the discriminator, semantic supervision, and vocabulary size---to examine their effects on joint modeling and downstream performance. Together, our testbed offers a complementary perspective on image tokenizers as visual languages, highlighting their interplay with text in joint multimodal training.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建受控的纯自回归多模态测试平台，通过追踪多模态持续预训练中各任务（文本、图像、T2I、I2T）的验证损失，研究图像分词器作为"视觉语言"在与文本联合建模时的行为，并据此考察多模态可学习性与分词器设计。
AI.motivation: 图像分词器定义了统一多模态模型的"视觉语言"，但现有研究多用孤立指标或仅生成/仅理解的评估方式，无法充分刻画视觉token在与文本联合建模时的表现。作者希望提供一个聚焦于联合建模视角的补充性分析框架。
AI.method: 构建受控的纯自回归（pure-autoregressive）测试平台，在多模态持续预训练过程中按任务分别追踪验证损失（文本、图像、T2I、I2T预测），分析损失随规模的缩放规律及其与下游性能的关系，并以损失为透镜研究多模态可学习性与分词器设计；最后以三个分词器设计维度（判别器、语义监督、词表大小）为案例进行考察。
AI.result: (1) 损失应按任务分别分析，因其缩放行为各异且对分词器的排名不同；(2) 损失-性能关系取决于被预测的token空间：固定分词器时T2I与I2T损失均与生成质量相关，但跨分词器时T2I损失-性能关系随图像token空间而改变，而基于共享文本词表的I2T损失信号更一致，且与微调后的生成及视觉理解性能均相关；(3) 更好的重建质量并不必然带来更低的特定任务损失或更强的下游性能；(4) 图像分词器的选择会影响联合优化下的文本建模。
AI.conclusion: 该测试平台为把图像分词器视为"视觉语言"提供了补充性视角，突显其在联合多模态训练中与文本的相互作用，并为分词器设计评估提供了以任务损失为核心的分析方法。

title: Point4D: Long-range 4D Motion Reconstruction
summary: We introduce Point4D, a feed-forward model for 4D reconstruction of long-range video sequences. Point4D is able to reliably infer dense per-point 3D trajectories across multi-hundred-frame videos, unlike existing 4D methods that are limited to short input windows of at most a few dozen frames. A key innovation that enables this is our flexible 3D query-based motion decoder that decouples trajectory prediction from image-plane visibility. The predicted 3D endpoints are then directly re-queried in the next chunk without re-projection or matching. Furthermore, we show that extracting and reusing a visual descriptor from an arbitrary frame where the point is visible leads to better performance than relying solely on the source patch. Overall, Point4D achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse long-video tracking benchmarks spanning over 200 frames and largely outperforms previous feed-forward 4D method. Project page: https://point-4d.github.io

AI.tldr: Point4D是一个前馈模型，可实现长达数百帧视频序列的4D重建，通过3D查询式运动解码器解耦轨迹预测与图像平面可见性，在200帧以上的长视频跟踪基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有4D方法受限于最多几十帧的短输入窗口，无法可靠推断长视频序列中的稠密逐点3D轨迹，长时段4D重建能力不足。
AI.method: 提出灵活的三维查询式运动解码器，将轨迹预测与图像平面可见性解耦；预测的3D端点直接在下一片段重新查询，无需重投影或匹配；并从点可见的任意帧中提取并复用视觉描述符，而非仅依赖源图像块。
AI.result: 在跨越200帧以上的多样长视频跟踪基准上取得SOTA性能，大幅超越以往的前馈4D方法。
AI.conclusion: Point4D首次实现可靠的长程稠密逐点3D轨迹推断，验证了3D查询式解码与可见帧视觉描述符复用对长视频4D重建的有效性。

title: Copying explains the collective behavior of AI agents in the wild
summary: In June 2026, thousands of AI agents found that a small public wiki would accept edits from inside their sandboxes, and started using it to help one another pass a timed test. Each agent lived for about an hour and remembered nothing afterwards. Nobody asked them to cooperate, and the wiki had not been built for them. The complete record of what they wrote is public, and it is unusually informative, because it preserves not only what each agent wrote but what that agent could see before writing. We use it to follow the three decisions an agent had to make on arrival: where to write, what to call itself, and how to word its message. One rule governs all three. An agent takes an option with a probability close to the share of that option in what it can see, and the share that matters is the one on the page in front of it, then the one in the stream of recent edits, and only weakly anything older. Three minimal copying models, one per decision and with a single free parameter each, reproduce the heavy-tailed distribution of how many agents met on a page, the frequency of the pieces from which the agents built their names, and the patchwork of pages that are internally consistent and different from one another. Copying whatever the environment happens to show is enough to produce most of the collective structure of this population. It is also what makes such a population easy to steer, since whoever writes first, or writes while the others are quiet, sets the convention for everyone who comes later.

AI.tldr: 2026年6月，数千个存续约一小时的AI智能体自发利用公共wiki共享信息以通过定时测试；研究基于公开完整记录发现，智能体在"写在哪、叫什么、写什么"三个决策上均遵循同一规则——以接近其可见选项中占比的概率进行模仿，且权重按"当前页面>近期编辑流>更早内容"递减。三个各含单一自由参数的最小模仿模型即可复现上述集体结构，表明"模仿环境所见"足以生成该群体的主要集体特征，也使该群体易于被引导。
AI.motivation: 研究者希望理解：一个未被设计用于协作、且个体记忆极其短暂（存续约一小时、事后无记忆）的AI智能体群体，为何会自发形成协调行为。该场景的完整公开记录同时保留了每个智能体的可见信息与产出内容，为在细粒度上研究集体行为的生成机制提供了罕见条件。核心动机是识别支配这一群体行为的简约规则。
AI.method: 以完整公开交互记录为数据，追踪智能体到达时需做出的三个决策：写入位置、自我命名、消息措辞。通过检验选项被选中概率与其在可见信息中占比的关系，量化可见性权重（当前页面>近期编辑流>较早历史）。针对每个决策各构建一个仅含单一自由参数的最小复制模型，考察其能否复现观测到的分布特征。
AI.result: 三个最小复制模型分别复现了三类结构：智能体在某页面上相遇数量的重尾分布、构建名称所用片段的出现频率、以及各页面内部自洽却彼此不同的拼贴特征。可见性权重呈清晰的层级衰减，当前页面占比影响最强，近期编辑流次之，更早信息影响微弱。
AI.conclusion: "复制环境当下所呈现的内容"这一简单机制，足以解释该AI智能体群体的大部分集体结构。其直接推论是此类群体高度可引导：先写者、或在他人沉默时书写者，即为后续所有来者设定了约定。简洁的局部模仿规则能够生成复杂的宏观协调模式。

title: Procedural Graphs: Self-Evolving Execution Structures for LLM Agents
comment: 36 pages including references and appendices, 6 figures, 11 tables
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents that plan over long horizons and act through external tools. Most agents select actions through unconstrained generation over an accumulating history, leaving implicit the procedural knowledge of what to do, in what order, and under which conditions. As trajectories lengthen, agents can lose track of their objectives, invoke tools out of order, and repeat unproductive actions. We introduce the Procedural Graph: just as a knowledge graph organizes factual knowledge into (entity, relation, entity) triplets for what-is questions, a Procedural Graph organizes procedural knowledge into (procedure, relation, procedure) triplets for what-to-do questions. At each decision step, the framework localizes the agent's active node, and a guidance model translates the surrounding subgraph into step-level situational guidance that biases the solver's next action without dictating it. The graph is self-evolving: an LLM refiner contrasts failed trajectories with successful ones and edits the graph's topology and attributes, committing edits that preserve or improve held-out validation performance while retaining rejected ones to discourage repetition. Starting from a minimal skeleton, the loop builds graphs that match or surpass hand-designed ones. It can also repair a flawed expert prior. Across multiple datasets, task types, and LLMs, the Procedural Graph delivers consistent gains over memory-based baselines, and self-evolution further improves performance without manual engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Procedural Graph（过程图），将程序性知识组织为 (procedure, relation, procedure) 三元组，在每一步决策时定位智能体的活跃节点并把局部子图转化为步骤级情境指导；图通过 LLM 精炼器对比成功/失败轨迹自我演化，在多个数据集、任务类型和 LLM 上稳定超越基于记忆的基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体大多通过在不断累积的历史上无约束生成来选择动作，隐式地承载"做什么、按什么顺序、在什么条件下做"的过程性知识。随着轨迹变长，智能体容易迷失目标、乱序调用工具、重复无效动作，而记忆式基线只保存经验，不显式组织过程结构。
AI.method: 1) 类比知识图谱，将过程性知识结构化为 (procedure, relation, procedure) 三元组，形成 Procedural Graph；2) 每一步决策时定位智能体的活跃节点，由指导模型将邻域子图翻译为步骤级情境指导，偏置而非强制求解器的下一步动作；3) 图自我演化：LLM 精炼器对比失败与成功轨迹，编辑图拓扑与属性，仅提交能保持或提升留出验证性能的编辑，并保留被拒编辑以抑制重复尝试；4) 从最小骨架出发循环构建图。
AI.result: 从最小骨架出发，该循环构建的图可匹配甚至超越人工设计的图，并能修复有缺陷的专家先验；在多个数据集、任务类型和 LLM 上，相较基于记忆的基线取得一致增益，自我演化在无需人工工程的情况下进一步提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式的程序性知识结构与自演化机制可作为长程智能体规划的有效归纳偏置，替代隐式累积历史，减少目标漂移与无效动作。

title: StochBench: A Domain-Specific Benchmark for Stochastic Processes in Lean
summary: Leading benchmarks for formal theorem proving with large language models are small collections drawn from competition math, such as the IMO and Putnam, that poorly represent field-specific applications. We introduce StochBench, a Lean 4 benchmark of 450 graduate stochastic-processes problems at varying abstraction levels, each paired with its natural-language source. Addressing a field underrepresented in Mathlib, it covers finite and countable Markov chains, renewal processes, random walks, martingales, stopping times, queues, Brownian motion, stochastic calculus, weak convergence, and Poisson and continuous-time Markov processes. Our Opus 4.8-based agent achieves a 34.9% proof rate (157/450) under a 15-minute per-problem limit. StochBench better represents domain-specific applied mathematics while remaining challenging for advanced provers.

AI.tldr: 提出 StochBench，一个包含 450 道研究生级随机过程问题的 Lean 4 基准，每题为自然语言源配套，覆盖 Mathlib 中代表性不足的领域；基于 Opus 4.8 的智能体在每题 15 分钟限制下达到 34.9% 证明率（157/450）。
AI.motivation: 现有形式化定理证明基准主要取自竞赛数学（如 IMO、Putnam），规模小且难以代表领域特定的应用数学，因此需要一个覆盖专业领域、具有合理规模与抽象层次的基准来评估 LLM 的形式化证明能力。
AI.method: 构建 StochBench：选取 450 道研究生级随机过程问题，标注不同抽象层次，并为每题配对自然语言源；形式化于 Lean 4；涵盖有限与可数马尔可夫链、更新过程、随机游走、鞅、停时、排队、布朗运动、随机分析、弱收敛，以及泊松与连续时间马尔可夫过程。评估采用基于 Opus 4.8 的智能体，每题限定 15 分钟。
AI.result: Opus 4.8 智能体在 15 分钟/题限制下取得 34.9% 证明率（157/450）。
AI.conclusion: StochBench 更好地代表领域特定的应用数学，同时对先进证明器仍具挑战性，可作为形式化定理证明中面向专业领域的补充基准。

title: SyncWorld: Visual Calibration Enables World Models as Zero-Shot Simulators
summary: World models are increasingly used as policy-in-the-loop imagination environments, where reliable rollouts require fine-grained controllability with respect to low-level robot actions. A key obstacle to scaling such models in robotics is that actions are not a universal language in pixel space: changes in visual environment, camera view, robot placement, or embodiment alter how the same numerical action manifests visually, leading to conflicting supervision under mixed training and brittle generalization at deployment. We introduce SyncWorld, an action-conditioned world model that serves as a zero-shot simulator across unseen environments without any additional training. SyncWorld leverages a visual calibration episode---paired frames and actions that showcase all the controllable degrees of freedom---to specify the setup-specific Action--Visual Mapping in context. Training with visual calibration contexts teaches the model to interpret actions through visual evidence and to leverage interaction history when explicit calibration is unavailable. Experiments show that SyncWorld can accurately simulate action outcomes in previously unseen settings, and that its capability of simulating rollouts enables test-time policy improvement without training.

AI.tldr: SyncWorld是一种动作条件世界模型，通过视觉校准片段在上下文中指定特定设置的动作—视觉映射，实现零样本跨环境模拟，并支持无训练的测试时策略改进。
AI.motivation: 在机器人中扩展世界模型的关键障碍是动作在像素空间中并非通用语言：视觉环境、相机视角、机器人位置或形态的变化会改变同一数值动作的视觉表现，导致混合训练下监督信号冲突，并在部署时泛化脆弱。
AI.method: SyncWorld利用一个视觉校准片段——展示所有可控自由度的帧与动作配对——在上下文中指定特定设置的动作—视觉映射；训练时引入视觉校准上下文，使模型通过视觉证据解读动作，并在缺乏显式校准时利用交互历史。
AI.result: 实验表明，SyncWorld能在先前未见的设置中准确模拟动作结果，其模拟rollout的能力支持测试时无需训练的策略改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过视觉校准上下文对齐动作与视觉表现，世界模型可作为跨未见环境的零样本模拟器，并支撑测试时策略提升。

title: ReCite: Agentic Reasoning for Faithful Citation
comment: Findings of EMNLP 2026. Project page: https://hyy279.github.io/ReCite
summary: Accurate citations are the foundation of academic writing, tracing intellectual origins and substantiating core claims. However, manually navigating the growing volume of scientific literature is increasingly difficult, prompting reliance on automatic citation recommendation. While modern retrieval-augmented architectures have largely mitigated the fabrication of non-existent papers, current systems relying on semantic similarity struggle with misattribution, often citing authentic papers that fail to logically support the author's claim. To address this challenge, we argue that accurate citation requires a shift from similarity-based search to active, claim-level reasoning. We propose ReCite, a decoupled agentic framework that orchestrates location perception, intent-aware query planning, and reflective verification. Trained on synthesized reasoning trajectories, our agent verifies claim-evidence consistency and triggers self-correction loops when retrieved candidates lack logical support. Experiments demonstrate that our lightweight framework outperforms state-of-the-art massive generative models in strict citation accuracy. By grounding literature matching in verifiable logic rather than semantic overlap, ReCite establishes a reliable foundation for automated academic writing.

AI.tldr: ReCite：一种解耦式智能体框架，通过定位感知、意图感知查询规划与反思验证，将引文推荐从"语义相似"转向"论断级主动推理"，在严格引用准确率上超越大规模生成模型。
AI.motivation: 准确引用是学术写作的基础，用于追溯思想来源并支撑核心论断。然而文献量激增使人工检索愈发困难，故依赖自动引文推荐。现有检索增强架构虽已基本消除"虚构不存在的论文"问题，但基于语义相似度的系统仍存在误引（misattribution）：所引论文真实存在，却在逻辑上无法支撑作者论断。因此需要从相似性检索范式转向论断级主动推理。
AI.method: 提出 ReCite，一个解耦（decoupled）的智能体（agentic）框架，编排三个环节：定位感知（location perception）、意图感知的查询规划（intent-aware query planning）、反思式验证（reflective verification）。基于合成的推理轨迹（synthesized reasoning trajectories）进行训练，智能体验证"论断—证据"一致性，并在检索候选缺乏逻辑支撑时触发自我纠错循环（self-correction loops）。
AI.result: 实验表明，该轻量级框架在严格引用准确率（strict citation accuracy）指标上优于当前最先进的大规模生成模型。
AI.conclusion: 将文献匹配建立在可验证逻辑而非语义重叠之上，ReCite 为自动化学术写作奠定了可靠基础，确立了一种以逻辑一致性为核心的引文推荐新范式。

title: Learning Length-Extrapolatable Recurrent Models
summary: Recurrent models provide a natural path to long-context modeling, yet models trained with backpropagation through time (BPTT) often fail beyond their training horizon. Classical analyses emphasize gradients that vanish or explode along temporal paths. However, dense per-token losses can still train a shared recurrent rule despite severe decay, showing that decay alone does not determine whether learning fails. We instead study state credit: the signal through which future losses reach earlier recurrent states before contributing to parameter updates. Accordingly, we intervene directly on state credit and propose Credit Stabilization through Time (CST). During backward propagation, CST locally rescales the state-credit signal to stabilize its norm without rotating the component being corrected, while leaving the forward computation unchanged. Because controlled synthetic tasks and real data exhibit different credit dynamics, we specialize CST to each regime. In both settings, CST improves performance beyond the training horizon, with gains observed at up to 128x the training length.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"状态信用"(state credit)视角解释循环模型训练范围外失效问题，并据此设计CST方法，在训练长度128倍处仍提升性能。
AI.motivation: 循环模型是长上下文建模的自然路径，但用BPTT训练的模型在超出训练长度后常失效。经典分析强调梯度沿时间路径的消失/爆炸，然而密集的逐token损失在严重衰减下仍能训练共享循环规则，表明衰减本身并不能决定学习是否失败，需重新审视失败机制。
AI.method: 提出"状态信用"概念：未来损失在贡献参数更新之前到达较早循环状态的信号。据此直接干预状态信用，提出Credit Stabilization through Time (CST)：在反向传播中局部重缩放状态信用信号以稳定其范数，而不旋转被修正的分量，且不改变前向计算。由于受控合成任务与真实数据的信用动态不同，CST针对两种情形分别特化。
AI.result: 在合成任务与真实数据两种情形下，CST均能在超出训练范围后提升性能，增益可出现在训练长度的128倍处。
AI.conclusion: 状态信用是判断循环模型能否学习长程依赖的关键因素，直接稳定状态信用信号（CST）可有效扩展循环模型的训练范围，为长上下文建模提供新思路。

title: Video-MOPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Video Understanding
summary: Video understanding demands a convergence of complementary capabilities across perception, temporal understanding, and complex reasoning, which are difficult to jointly optimize within a single model. We introduce Video-MOPD-8B, an open-weight model dedicated to video understanding tasks. To fundamentally enhance its capabilities, we conduct targeted reinforcement learning (RL) optimization across three core domains: video temporal grounding (VTG), general video comprehension, and video STEM reasoning. We then unify their complementary capabilities via Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD), which consolidates expert knowledge by supervising student-generated trajectories with routed teacher feedback. We further introduce Reliability-Aware Informative Sampling (RAIS), which selects examples with consistently reliable teacher supervision and large teacher-student performance gaps. Together, these components enable Video-MOPD-8B to achieve coordinated and comprehensive performance gains across diverse video understanding tasks. Extensive experiments on comprehensive benchmarks covering general video understanding, temporal grounding, video reasoning, and video STEM tasks demonstrate that Video-MOPD-8B achieves state-of-the-art performance among existing models at a comparable scale. The trained model weights are available at https://huggingface.co/LandH/Video-MOPD-8B.

AI.tldr: 提出视频理解模型 Video-MOPD-8B，通过多领域强化学习与多教师在线策略蒸馏统一能力，在多项视频理解基准上达到同规模最优。
AI.motivation: 视频理解需要感知、时序理解与复杂推理的协同能力，单一模型难以同时优化这些互补能力，因此需要一个能在多能力间协调提升的专用模型。
AI.method: 在三个核心领域（视频时序定位 VTG、通用视频理解、视频 STEM 推理）上进行针对性强化学习；通过多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）以路由式教师反馈监督学生自生成轨迹来整合专家知识；并提出可靠性感知信息采样（RAIS），筛选教师监督稳定且师生性能差距大的样本。
AI.result: 在通用视频理解、时序定位、视频推理与视频 STEM 等综合基准上的大量实验表明，Video-MOPD-8B 在同规模模型中取得最优性能；权重已开源于 HuggingFace。
AI.conclusion: 多领域 RL 结合多教师在线策略蒸馏与 RAIS 采样，可实现视频理解多能力的协同增益，8B 规模下达到 SOTA，并公开发布模型权重。

title: Osprey: Target-agnostic Pre-training Makes Stronger Drafters in Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding is critical for accelerating LLM inference. However, the speedup is fragile: drafters are typically trained against a narrow distribution for a single target model, and their acceptance rate collapses under workload shifts. This is a striking inversion of modern LLM development, where target models are valued precisely for the broad generalization they acquire through large-scale pretraining. We argue that the natural remedy, pretraining, has been hard to apply to drafters because existing recipes are target-specific: the drafter consumes the target's hidden states and is distilled on the target's logits, so pretraining must be repeated for each target. We introduce Osprey, which instead bootstraps drafters from off-the-shelf pretrained small language models, treating broad pretraining as a reusable, target-agnostic asset and reducing per-target work to a lightweight adaptation step. Realizing this requires overcoming two challenges: small LMs are far deeper than a latency-bound drafter can afford, and their pretrained computation must remain intact while the drafter learns to ingest target hidden states and emit tokens in the target's vocabulary. Osprey addresses both by pruning to a shallow backbone, restoring its language-modeling capability with target-agnostic next-token pretraining, and adapting it to each target through vocabulary alignment, zero-initialized QKV expansion, and distillation from the target model's output distribution. Empirically, a single pretrained Osprey backbone transfers across targets and improves mean acceptance length by 16.1% for Qwen3-8B, 21.2% for Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, and 22.7% for the 229B MiniMax-M2.5 (with 17.5% higher tokens per second), with the largest gains on out-of-domain and multilingual data. Our code is available at https://github.com/LeanModels/Osprey.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Osprey，一种利用现成预训练小语言模型构建投机解码 drafter 的框架，将广泛预训练视作可复用的目标无关资产，通过剪枝、目标无关预训练和轻量适配，实现跨目标模型的高接受率与推理加速。
AI.motivation: 投机解码的加速效果脆弱：drafter 通常仅针对单一目标模型在窄分布上训练，工作负载变化时接受率骤降。这与现代 LLM 因大规模预训练而具备广泛泛化能力的理念相悖。作者认为预训练是自然的解决途径，但现有配方依赖目标模型（消费其隐藏状态、蒸馏其 logits），导致每个目标都需重新预训练，成本高昂。
AI.method: Osprey 从现成预训练小语言模型引导 drafter，将广泛预训练作为可复用的目标无关资产，把每目标工作降为轻量适配。具体解决两个挑战：小模型过深不适合延迟受限的 drafter；需在保持预训练计算的同时学会摄入目标隐藏状态并输出目标词表 token。做法为：剪枝得到浅层骨干，用目标无关的下一 token 预训练恢复语言建模能力，再通过词表对齐、零初始化 QKV 扩展以及从目标模型输出分布蒸馏来适配各目标。
AI.result: 单个预训练 Osprey 骨干可跨目标迁移：Qwen3-8B 平均接受长度提升 16.1%，Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 提升 21.2%，229B 的 MiniMax-M2.5 提升 22.7%（每秒 token 数提高 17.5%），在域外和多语言数据上增益最大。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将广泛预训练视为可复用的目标无关资产，能够有效提升 drafter 的泛化性与接受率，显著加速多种规模目标模型的 LLM 推理，且在大规模、域外及多语言场景下优势尤为明显。

title: SWORD: Wikidata-based Distortions Reveal Hidden Cross-Lingual Inconsistencies in LLM Factual Error Rejection
summary: Modern LLMs demonstrate impressive multilingual performance, yet standard benchmarks primarily reward selecting correct answers rather than evaluating genuine factual understanding. We introduce Systematic Wikidata-based Object-Relation Distortion (SWORD), a benchmark that evaluates whether models consistently reject factual errors across languages. SWORD generates syntactically well-formed but factually incorrect statements in eight widely spoken languages through controlled perturbations of Wikidata triples, ranging from random entity substitutions to semantically plausible property-based selections. Our distortion-based evaluation surfaces two critical insights that remain entirely obscured by conventional benchmarks. First, models counterintuitively achieve higher accuracy on semantically plausible distortions than on nonsensical random substitutions, suggesting reliance on distributional familiarity rather than genuine factual verification. Second, models exhibiting comparable baseline accuracy across languages show substantial performance degradation specifically on (East) Asian languages when presented with distorted statements, with cross-lingual performance gaps reaching up to 28 percentage points (49\% relative reduction) in some models. These findings demonstrate that multilingual factual reasoning involves asymmetric capabilities that aggregate accuracy metrics systematically obscure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SWORD 基准，通过基于 Wikidata 三元组的受控扰动生成八种语言的事实错误陈述，以评估模型能否一致地拒绝事实错误，揭示了传统基准所掩盖的两个关键洞察。
AI.motivation: 现有多语言基准主要奖励"选出正确答案"，而非评估模型是否真正理解事实；这种评测方式掩盖了多语言事实推理中的不对称能力，因此需要一个基于事实错误拒绝的评测框架。
AI.method: 构建 Systematic Wikidata-based Object-Relation Distortion (SWORD)：对 Wikidata 三元组进行受控扰动，生成句法合规但事实错误的陈述，覆盖八种使用广泛的语言；扰动类型从随机实体替换到基于属性的语义合理选择（semantically plausible property-based selections）。
AI.result: 发现两个被传统基准完全掩盖的关键现象：(1) 模型在语义合理扰动上的准确率反而高于无意义随机替换，说明其依赖分布熟悉度而非真正的事实核验；(2) 基线跨语言准确率相当的模型，在失真陈述上对（东）亚语言出现显著性能下降，跨语言差距最高达 28 个百分点（相对下降 49%）。
AI.conclusion: 多语言事实推理存在非对称能力，聚合准确率指标会系统性地掩盖这一差异；SWORD 型失真评测能更真实地暴露模型的事实理解缺陷。

title: Auditable Emergency Triage for Maternal and Newborn Care in India
summary: At Noora Health, our nurses answer more than 50,000 medical queries per month on our WhatsApp-based service that provides caregivers with on-demand support. Their most time-critical task is emergency triage: deciding which queries need immediate in-person attention. To support them, we built a system that uses a large language model (LLM) to classify whether a message is an emergency and provide a rationale for interpretability. But the system was opaque: analyzing mistakes meant reading reasoning chains for each message, which is infeasible at our scale. Prompt changes meant re-running a full evaluation to prevent regressions, which was both costly and operationally challenging. Clinicians follow a decision tree to make this call, but it was never documented or passed to the model, which relied on a flat list of danger signs. To address these issues, we decomposed triage into two steps: an LLM extracts canonical symptoms and patient context from the query using a clinician-authored vocabulary, and a deterministic rule engine captures the scenarios that indicate an emergency. We show that the new system raised recall from 0.565 to 0.810 and F1 from 0.606 to 0.702, with structured rules driving most of the accuracy gains while the decomposition provides auditability: clinical experts can inspect each stage of the new system to see whether the query was mistranslated, symptoms were incorrectly extracted, patient context was wrongly inferred, or the necessary rules were missing. They can add new rules independently without causing regressions and avoid running costly evaluations.
