Since deployment, the new system has triaged 152,421 patient queries and flagged 28,535 (18.7%) as emergencies. The over-escalation rate has been 17.8%, without any increase in missed emergencies. Clinicians have also added 48 new rules since deployment, evidence of the faster correction loop we set out to build.

AI.tldr: 将LLM黑箱式急救分诊拆解为"症状/情境抽取+确定性规则引擎"，召回率由0.565升至0.810、F1由0.606升至0.702，并实现可审查的错误归因与无需重跑全量评估的规则迭代。
AI.motivation: Noora Health的护士每月需通过WhatsApp处理逾5万条医疗咨询，其中最紧迫的是急救分诊。原系统用LLM直接判定是否急诊并输出理由，但存在三个问题：错误分析需逐条阅读推理链，规模上不可行；任何提示词改动都要重跑全量评估以防性能回退，成本高且操作困难；临床医生实际遵循的决策树从未被文档化或传入模型，模型仅依赖一份平铺的危险信号清单。
AI.method: 将分诊任务分解为两步：第一步由LLM依据临床医生撰写的规范词表，从咨询中抽取标准化症状与患者情境；第二步由确定性规则引擎捕获指示急诊的场景。该设计把不可解释的推理链转化为可逐级检查的流水线，使规则可独立增删。
AI.result: 召回率从0.565提升至0.810，F1从0.606提升至0.702，准确率提升主要来自结构化规则。可审计性使临床专家能定位错误来源：查询被误译、症状抽取错误、患者情境推断错误，或缺失必要规则。部署后共分诊152,421条咨询，标记28,535条（18.7%）为急诊，过度升级率17.8%，未出现漏诊急诊增加，医生已新增48条规则。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM分诊分解为症状抽取与确定性规则引擎，可在显著提升召回与F1的同时获得可审计性；临床专家无需重跑昂贵评估即可独立扩充规则且不引发性能回退，形成了更快的纠错闭环。

title: DensePol: Dense-Angle Polarization Dataset for Learning-Based Polarimetric Vision
summary: Polarimetric vision is gaining increasing attention because it provides physical cues about scene shape, material, and reflection that are difficult to recover from RGB alone. Recent work has therefore explored predicting polarization directly from conventional RGB images; however, the fidelity of these methods strongly depends on the polarization supervision used for training. Most existing datasets rely on Division-of-Focal-Plane (DoFP) cameras with four spatially interleaved analyzer orientations, which provide limited angular redundancy and introduce interpolation and instantaneous-field-of-view errors. We introduce DensePol, a high-redundancy RGB--polarization dataset based on Division-of-Time (DoT) acquisition, capturing 180 full-resolution analyzer orientations at $1^\circ$ intervals. DensePol contains 2,018 paired RGB--polarization images with the angular measurements and fitting residuals retained. Dense angular sampling substantially improves polarization stability, reducing AoLP deviation from $13.36^\circ$ to $2.21^\circ$. We further introduce a deterministic diffusion-based RGB-to-polarization framework with cyclic AoLP representation and a local DoLP refiner. Experiments demonstrate improved polarization prediction and downstream surface-normal estimation. The dataset and code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出DensePol高冗余RGB-偏振数据集（DoT采集，180个全分辨率偏振方向，1°间隔，2018对图像），并引入确定性扩散RGB-to-偏振框架，提升偏振预测与表面法线估计。
AI.motivation: 偏振视觉可提供形状、材质、反射等RGB难以恢复的物理线索，RGB-to-偏振预测受训练监督质量制约；现有数据集多基于DoFP相机（四个空间交错偏振方向），角度冗余有限，且存在插值与瞬时视场误差。
AI.method: 构建基于Division-of-Time（DoT）采集的高冗余RGB-偏振数据集DensePol，含180个1°间隔的全分辨率偏振方向、2018对配准图像并保留角度测量与拟合残差；提出确定性扩散RGB-to-偏振框架，采用循环AoLP表示与局部DoLP精修模块。
AI.result: 密集角度采样显著提升偏振稳定性，AoLP偏差由13.36°降至2.21°；实验显示偏振预测与下游表面法线估计均有改善。
AI.conclusion: DensePol数据集与确定性扩散框架为高保真RGB-to-偏振预测提供更可靠监督，并促进表面法线等下游任务，数据集与代码将公开。

title: Do LLMs Make More Mistakes If They Do Not Believe the Input Data?
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, to be published in INLG 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are prone to hallucinating or misinterpreting facts, which impairs their usability in retrieval-augmented generation or data-to-text systems. We analyse how faithfulness of LLMs to provided context depends on how plausible they perceive the context to be (context-memory conflict). To better identify error patterns, we make use of the increased difficulty of non-English and low-resource language text generation and input data based on local knowledge, only partially captured in models' parametric knowledge. We let the models generate text in English, Czech, Slovak and Upper Sorbian from factual (FA), counterfactual (CFA) and fictional (FI) RDF triples containing local Czech and Slovak data. Contrary to our expectations, we observe only a weak context-memory conflict on the human-annotated sample. For Kimi K3 as an LLM judge, which agrees well with human annotations on the sample, counterfactual inputs receive only slightly lower faithfulness scores than factual ones (-0.05 on a 1-5 scale). We also find that a suboptimal choice of LLM judge would lead to overestimating the strength of the context-memory conflict.

AI.tldr: 本文分析大语言模型对给定上下文的事实忠实度如何受上下文可信度（上下文—记忆冲突）影响，使用英语、捷克语、斯洛伐克语和上索布语的RDF三元组生成任务，发现人类标注样本中冲突仅较弱存在，且不合适的LLM评判会高估该冲突。
AI.motivation: LLM易产生幻觉或曲解事实，损害其在检索增强生成与数据到文本系统中的应用；需厘清忠实度是否以及多大程度上受模型对上下文可信度感知（即与参数化记忆的冲突）影响，并识别错误模式。
AI.method: 利用非英语、低资源语言生成难度更大且输入基于本地知识（仅部分被模型参数化知识覆盖）的特点，让模型以英语、捷克语、斯洛伐克语和上索布语，基于包含捷克与斯洛伐克本地数据的事实（FA）、反事实（CFA）和虚构（FI）RDF三元组生成文本，并进行人工标注与LLM评判对比。
AI.result: 与预期相反，人类标注样本上仅观察到较弱的上下文—记忆冲突；以Kimi K3作为LLM评判时与人工标注一致性较好，反事实输入忠实度得分仅略低于事实输入（1-5分制下低0.05分）；若选用次优LLM评判，则会高估上下文—记忆冲突的强度。
AI.conclusion: LLM对上下文的忠实度并未因上下文与记忆冲突而显著下降；上下文—记忆冲突的强度易被不恰当的LLM评判器高估，因此评估忠实度时需谨慎选择并校验自动评判器。

title: The Living Library: Transforming Archival Collections into Conversational Knowledge Systems -- Lessons from the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library
summary: We present the Living Library, an end-to-end framework for transforming fragmented digital archives into governed, conversational, in-person exhibit experiences. Developed and deployed at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, the framework comprises four layers: digitization and corpus creation, AI-powered processing, retrieval and reasoning, and an optional embodied conversational interface. The first three layers aggregate a 300,000-record collection, apply OCR and structured metadata enrichment for expert curatorial review, and publish records to a hybrid dense/semantic index. Expert review is conducted through the Archivist App, a curator-facing interface that supports correction of AI-generated transcriptions and metadata. The governed corpus powers both a researcher-facing interface and Talk to TR, a continuously operating exhibit that embodies Theodore Roosevelt as a full-scale digital human within a museum environment. To support live, face-to-face interactions, Cross-Era Analogical Grounding reframes contemporary questions through documented historical parallels, allowing Roosevelt to address present-day topics without inventing facts. Dual-path retrieval and end-to-end streaming keep responses grounded and responsive. Layered watchdogs, visitor-session isolation, automated conversation management, and independently restartable services enable reliable unattended operation for hundreds of visitors. Avatar realism, spatial audio, lighting, staging, and conversational design are developed and evaluated as an integrated experience. Rather than report a controlled benchmark, we describe lessons from operating Talk to TR as a public exhibit and offer a transferable model for transforming archival collections into believable, in-person conversational experiences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Living Library 框架，将碎片化数字档案转化为可治理、可对话的实体展览体验，并在罗斯福总统图书馆落地部署；其核心是四层架构，通过跨时代类比锚定与双路径检索等技术，支撑名为 Talk to TR 的真人大小数字人展项实现无人值守、面向数百名访客的稳定运行。
AI.motivation: 数字档案通常碎片化且缺乏治理，难以直接转化为可信、可交互的公众体验；同时博物馆场景中的对话式数字人需要在不虚构事实的前提下回应现代议题，并满足无人值守、长时间稳定运行的工程要求。
AI.method: 端到端四层框架：(1) 数字化与语料构建，汇集 30 万条记录；(2) AI 处理，进行 OCR 与结构化元数据增强，并通过面向策展人的 Archivist App 支持人工校订 AI 生成的转录与元数据；(3) 检索与推理，发布至稠密/语义混合索引，采用双路径检索与端到端流式生成；(4) 可选的具身对话界面。关键技术为 Cross-Era Analogical Grounding，将当代问题映射到有史料支撑的历史平行事件；配套分层看门狗、访客会话隔离、自动对话管理与服务独立重启机制；并将形象真实感、空间音频、灯光、舞台调度与对话设计作为整体体验进行开发与评估。
AI.result: 系统已在实际博物馆环境中持续运营，支撑数百名访客的面对面实时交互；人工审核保证了语料治理质量，跨时代类比锚定使数字人能回应现代话题而不编造事实，双路径检索与流式响应维持了回答的接地性与响应速度，分层容错机制实现了可靠的无人值守运行。
AI.conclusion: 本文不以受控基准评测为目标，而是总结 Talk to TR 作为公共展项的运营经验，提出一套可迁移的模型，用于将档案藏品转化为可信、面对面的对话式体验。

title: What Does MMLU Actually Measure? A Psychometric Audit of Difficulty Structure in Aggregate Benchmark Scores
summary: Although MMLU is widely adopted as a benchmark for calibrating general AI capabilities, we psychometrically demonstrate that its aggregate score primarily evaluates a model's factual retrieval capacity rather than its reasoning ability. By calibrating item difficulty for 1,000 open-weights language models over 14,042 MMLU test items using Item Response Theory, we show that evaluating both abilities via a single test is inherently flawed. Difficulty is then regressed on a deterministic, text-extractable framework of structural complexity. Applying a joint Wald test with subject-clustered covariances demonstrates that the MMLU conflates fundamentally separable constructs. The mapping from structural complexity to difficulty is not invariant across the benchmark's STEM and non-STEM partitions. This finding has practical consequences. Aggregate leaderboard ranks track non-STEM accuracy more closely than STEM accuracy, so selecting a Top-50 model on the aggregate for a reasoning-intensive deployment displaces roughly 22% of the STEM-appropriate choices. Furthermore, when controlling for the multiple-choice guessing floor natively inside the response model, we find that higher-ability models continue to degrade more steeply under increased reasoning depth. The MMLU aggregate therefore weights retrieval capacity and reasoning stability unequally, inadvertently favoring models optimized for retrieval. We release our deterministic framework as a reproducible auditing instrument and recommend disaggregated reporting.

AI.tldr: 该论文用项目反应理论对1000个开源模型、14042道MMLU题目进行心理测量学分析，证明MMLU总分主要测量事实检索能力而非推理能力，两者是根本可分离的构念，建议分项报告。
AI.motivation: MMLU被广泛用作校准通用AI能力的基准，但其总分是否真正衡量推理能力缺乏心理测量学验证；作者希望检验单一测试能否同时测量检索与推理两种能力。
AI.method: 用项目反应理论（IRT）对1000个开放权重语言模型在14042道MMLU题目上标定题目难度；将难度对确定性、可从文本抽取的结构复杂度框架做回归；采用带学科聚类协方差的联合Wald检验；在响应模型中控制多选题猜测下限。
AI.result: 联合Wald检验表明MMLU混淆了可分离的构念；结构复杂度到难度的映射在STEM与非STEM子集间不具不变性；总分排行榜排名更贴近非STEM准确率，按总分选Top-50用于推理密集型部署会挤掉约22%的STEM合适模型；控制猜测下限后，高能力模型在推理深度增加时性能下降更陡。
AI.conclusion: MMLU总分对检索容量与推理稳定性的加权不均衡，无意中偏向检索优化的模型；作者发布确定性框架作为可复现的审计工具，并建议采用分项（分领域）报告。

title: OmniPoint: Universal Monocular Metric Pointcloud from Any Camera
summary: Recovering metric 3D geometry from monocular images is a fundamental computer vision task, yet current methods remain heavily fragmented by fixed camera model assumptions and inflexible input schemes. We present OmniPoint, a unified framework designed to generalize metric reconstruction across diverse imaging sensors, including pinhole, fisheye, and equirectangular projections, while accommodating varying geometric priors. To overcome projection rigidity, OmniPoint abandons conventional planar depth regression. It instead adopts a decoupled ray and distance representation alongside a decoupled training objective, explicitly separating the camera projection model from the scene structure. To address the severe scarcity of training data for alternative cameras, we introduce a bidirectional augmentation strategy that explicitly bridges labeled perspective data and unlabeled omnidirectional domains in 3D space. Furthermore, to seamlessly integrate optional inputs like camera intrinsics or sparse depth without destabilizing the network through feature distribution shifts, we propose a robust information injection mechanism. This mechanism utilizes learnable input state embeddings to resolve architectural ambiguity and applies vectorized Gaussian smoothing to densify irregular measurements. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniPoint achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance across multiple benchmarks, establishing a robust new standard for unified monocular 3D reconstruction.

AI.tldr: OmniPoint：统一单目度量3D重建框架，通过解耦射线-距离表示、双向增强和鲁棒信息注入，实现针孔/鱼眼/等距柱状投影下的泛化，达到零样本SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有单目度量3D重建方法受固定相机模型假设约束、输入方案僵化，方法彼此割裂，难以跨多种成像传感器泛化；且非透视相机训练数据严重稀缺。
AI.method: 提出OmniPoint统一框架：放弃传统平面深度回归，采用解耦的射线与距离表示及解耦训练目标，将相机投影模型与场景结构显式分离；引入双向增强策略，在3D空间中桥接有标注透视数据与无标注全向域；设计鲁棒信息注入机制，用可学习输入状态嵌入消除架构歧义，并以向量化高斯平滑稠密化不规则测量，实现相机内参、稀疏深度等可选输入的无缝集成。
AI.result: 在多个基准上取得最先进的零样本性能，为统一单目3D重建树立了新的稳健标准。
AI.conclusion: OmniPoint通过表示解耦、跨域数据增强与鲁棒信息注入，实现了跨相机模型的统一度量3D重建，验证了通用化单目重建的可行性。

title: VANTAGE-Bench: Evaluating the Infrastructure AI Gap in Vision-Language Models
comment: 23 pages, 2 figures, 14 tables. Project page: https://vantage-bench.org/; dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/PhysicalAI-VANTAGE-Bench;
summary: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) advance toward physical deployment, the focus has remained on action-oriented Embodied AI evaluated on subject-centric consumer video. This overlooks a pervasive class of Physical AI: Infrastructure AI, which relies on fixed cameras for open-loop insights like safety monitoring and operational logging. We introduce VANTAGE-Bench, a benchmark measuring this "Infrastructure AI Gap." It spans three operational domains (Logistics, Transportation, and Smart Spaces), unifies image and video evaluation across semantic, spatial, temporal, and spatio-temporal capabilities, and moves beyond multiple-choice to eight task formulations including dense captioning and spatio-temporal grounding. It adds a single-pass trajectory protocol for Single Object Tracking and, to our knowledge, the first such evaluation on fixed-camera infrastructure video, scored against specialist trackers. Annotation spans three regimes over 3,346 media assets: 3,342 video-task annotations, 4,281 image-grounding annotations, and 27,404 detection boxes. Evaluating 17 models zero-shot, we find the shortfall relative to consumer-centric benchmarks is concentrated, not general. Event verification, referring expressions, and temporal localization fall roughly 9 to 24 points at every model scale, while video question answering stays within 5.3 points of VideoMME and 2D spatial pointing shows no shortfall against BLINK. The temporal pillar is weakest in absolute terms: no system exceeds 55.7 mIoU on temporal localization or 37.3 SODA_c on dense video captioning. On tracking, frontier models come within roughly 5 points of specialist trackers over short horizons but separate as the horizon extends. Open-weight models lead 2D object localization outright, so neither scale nor proprietary access explains the pattern. Data, evaluation harness, and leaderboard: https://vantage-bench.org/

AI.tldr: 论文提出VANTAGE-Bench，首个面向固定摄像头基础设施场景（物流、交通、智能空间）的Physical AI基准，揭示VLM在"基础设施AI"上的集中性能力缺口。
AI.motivation: 现有具身AI研究聚焦以主体为中心的消费级视频与行动导向任务，忽视了依赖固定摄像头的开环基础设施AI（如安全监控、运营记录）这一广泛类别，形成"基础设施AI缺口"。
AI.method: 构建VANTAGE-Bench基准，覆盖物流、交通、智能空间三大领域，统一图像与视频在语义、空间、时间、时空四个维度的评测；采用八种任务形式（含稠密描述、时空定位），突破多选问答；引入单次轨迹协议用于单目标跟踪，首次在固定摄像头基础设施视频上评测，并以专家跟踪器为参照。标注涵盖3,346个媒体资产：3,342条视频任务标注、4,281条图像定位标注、27,404个检测框。零样本评测17个模型。
AI.result: 相对消费级基准，缺陷是集中而非全面的：事件验证、指代表达、时间定位在各模型规模上落后约9–24分；视频问答与VideoMME差距在5.3分内，2D空间指向相对BLINK无缺口。时间维度绝对最弱：时间定位mIoU不超过55.7，稠密视频描述SODA_c不超过37.3。跟踪方面前沿模型短时域接近专家跟踪器（约5分内），但随时域延长而拉开差距。开源权重模型在2D目标定位上 outright 领先，说明规模与专有访问均非成因。
AI.conclusion: 基础设施AI缺口具有集中性与可测性，时间能力是核心瓶颈；能力差异不由模型规模或专有访问解释。数据、评测框架与排行榜见 https://vantage-bench.org/。

title: Benchmarking Hybrid Deep Research Across Database Querying and Web Search
summary: While autonomous agents have made significant strides in "deep research" by iteratively navigating the open web to synthesize information, real-world problem-solving is rarely confined to a single environment. Complex analytical tasks inherently require agents to weave together evidence from both ambiguous unstructured text (e.g., the open web) and highly precise structured data (e.g., relational databases). However, existing benchmarks evaluate these modalities in isolation, failing to capture the critical "handoff" - the ability to preserve constraints when moving evidence between systems. We introduce HybridDeepResearch, to our knowledge the first deep-research benchmark that requires both web search and SQL to form a complete, verifiable answer. The benchmark contains 380 tool-dependent tasks grounded in LiveSQLBench-Base-Lite databases and public web corpora, validated through automated checks and human review, and covering three reasoning patterns: SQL2S, S2SQL, and Parallel. Evaluations across proprietary and open-weight models under various agentic scaffolds reveal that even state-of-the-art models like GLM-5.2, Claude-Sonnet-4.6 and GPT-5 achieve only about 50-54% Pass@8 on the hard subset. Notably, results show that directional reasoning is substantially more difficult than parallel intersection, highlighting that bridging structured and unstructured information spaces without losing constraints remains a major open challenge for agentic systems. Code and datasets are publicly available at GitHub (https://github.com/Snowflake-AI-Research/HybridDeepResearch) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/datasets/Snowflake/HybridDeepResearch).

AI.tldr: 提出首个需同时使用网络搜索与SQL、且答案可验证的深度研究基准HybridDeepResearch，含380项工具依赖任务，覆盖SQL2S、S2SQL、Parallel三种推理模式；顶尖模型在困难子集Pass@8仅约50-54%，表明跨结构化与非结构化信息空间的约束保持仍是难题。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究基准将非结构化文本（开放网络）与结构化数据（关系数据库）割裂评估，无法刻画真实分析任务所需的跨系统"交接"能力，即证据在系统间流转时保持约束条件的能力。
AI.method: 构建HybridDeepResearch基准：380个工具依赖任务，基于LiveSQLBench-Base-Lite数据库与公开网络语料，经自动化检查与人工复核验证；涵盖SQL2S（先SQL后搜索）、S2SQL（先搜索后SQL）、Parallel（并行交叉）三种推理模式；在多种智能体框架下评测闭源与开源模型。
AI.result: 即便是GLM-5.2、Claude-Sonnet-4.6、GPT-5等最先进模型，在困难子集上Pass@8也仅约50-54%；方向性推理（SQL2S/S2SQL）显著难于并行交集（Parallel）。
AI.conclusion: 跨结构化与非结构化信息空间、在证据交接中不丢失约束，仍是智能体系统面临的重要开放挑战；代码与数据已在GitHub和Hugging Face公开。

title: Vision-language models know more about agriculture than they show and rubric-grounded verifications close the gap
comment: Submitted to the AI for Science Workshop (NeurIPS Workshops 2026)
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) show promise for agricultural classification, but zero-shot performance on disease, pest, damage, quality, and species identification remains poor, and it is unclear whether this reflects weak visual features or a failure to connect them to domain knowledge. We build a benchmark of 116 datasets, 834 classes, and 8,324 images spanning these tasks to isolate where the gap arises. Linear probing shows VLM vision encoders already encode agricultural features nearly as separable as a self-supervised DINOv3 baseline, ruling out weak visual representations as the primary bottleneck. Conditioning each model on an oracle reference description (an upper bound on its parametric knowledge) closes most of the gap left by an unaided lower bound, showing VLMs already know more about agriculture than they show. To close this gap without an oracle description at inference time, we structure test-time reasoning around a fixed, per-task diagnostic rubric: the model generates $K$ candidate responses and a Probabilistic Pivot Tournament (PPT) verifier, scored pairwise against the rubric, selects the best one. This nearly doubles judged F1 over the lower bound and matches or exceeds the upper bound on several tasks, notably pushing Gemma 4 E4B-it's disease F1 to 0.71, above its own upper bound of 0.60. However, the verifier's letter-scale confidence score has the opposite of its intended effect: filtering to its most confident predictions does not improve accuracy and correlates negatively with correctness across every model and pool size tested, so the score cannot serve as a measure of predictive uncertainty, and most of the observed gain likely comes from rubric-grounded generation rather than pairwise verification.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了涵盖116个数据集、834个类别、8324张图像的农业视觉-语言基准，证明VLM的瓶颈不在于视觉表征，而在于视觉特征与领域知识的连接，并提出基于诊断量规的测试时推理方法（PPT）显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: VLM在农业分类（病害、虫害、损伤、品质、物种识别）上的零样本性能较差，但尚不清楚这一差距源于视觉特征薄弱，还是未能将视觉特征与领域知识相连接。作者希望定位真正的瓶颈所在。
AI.method: 1）构建跨5类任务、116个数据集、834类、8324图的农业基准；2）用线性探针比较VLM视觉编码器与自监督DINOv3基线的特征可分性；3）用oracle参考描述（参数知识上界）与无辅助下界做对比；4）提出Probabilistic Pivot Tournament（PPT）验证器，围绕固定的逐任务诊断量规，对K个候选回答进行成对评分并选出最优。
AI.result: 线性探针显示VLM视觉编码器的农业特征可分性接近DINOv3，排除视觉表征为主要瓶颈；oracle描述能弥合大部分差距，说明VLM已具备多于其表现出的农业知识。PPT方法使判定F1较下界近乎翻倍，并在多项任务上达到或超过上界，如将Gemma 4 E4B-it的病害F1提升至0.71（超过其上界0.60）。但验证器的字母量表置信度与正确性负相关，过滤高置信预测不能提升精度，无法作为预测不确定性度量；主要增益来自量规引导的生成而非成对验证。
AI.conclusion: VLM在农业分类中的主要瓶颈是视觉特征与领域知识的连接，而非视觉表征本身；通过量规引导的测试时生成可有效释放潜在知识，但成对验证器提供的置信度不可靠，不能用作不确定性估计。

title: Longitudinal tracking of multiple sclerosis lesions in the spinal cord: A validation study
summary: Longitudinal characterization of multiple sclerosis (MS) lesions remains constrained by the lack of frameworks capable of establishing consistent instance-level correspondences across time. Conventional segmentation approaches produce semantic lesion masks at each visit and therefore fail to capture the complex instance temporal patterns associated with lesion appearance, disappearance, splitting, or merging. This study presents a comparative evaluation of five strategies for automated tracking of spinal cord MS lesions in longitudinal MRI data from a multi-site cohort. The investigated strategies rely either on deformable registration or on a spinal anatomical reference system, and encompass overlap-based matching, coordinate-based Hungarian algorithm, gradient-boosted classification, and Siamese model classification. Tracking accuracy is quantified using instance-level true positives, false positives, and false negatives, allowing to assess the presence of one-to-many and many-to-one associations. Results show best performance for the registration-based overlap method. This study provides the first systematic analysis of lesion-instance correspondence in the spinal cord and outlines the strengths and limitations of registration-based and registration-free paradigms for longitudinal MS assessment. The code is available at http://github.com/ivadomed/longitudinal-sc-ms-lesion-tracking .

AI.tldr: 该研究系统比较了五种脊髓多发性硬化病灶纵向MRI追踪策略，发现基于配准的重叠匹配法表现最佳，为脊髓病灶实例级对应关系提供首个系统性分析。
AI.motivation: 传统分割方法仅在每次随访生成语义病灶掩膜，无法建立跨时间一致的实例级对应关系，因而难以刻画病灶出现、消失、分裂、合并等复杂时间模式。脊髓MS病灶的纵向实例追踪此前缺乏系统性框架与研究。
AI.method: 基于多中心纵向MRI队列，比较五种脊髓MS病灶自动追踪策略：策略依赖形变配准或脊髓解剖参考系统，涵盖基于重叠的匹配、基于坐标的匈牙利算法、梯度提升分类以及孪生网络（Siamese）分类。采用实例级真阳性、假阳性、假阴性量化追踪精度，并评估一对多与多对一关联情形。
AI.result: 结果显示基于配准的重叠匹配方法性能最佳。通过实例级指标可有效评估一对多和多对一错误关联的发生情况。
AI.conclusion: 本研究首次对脊髓病灶实例对应关系进行系统性分析，阐明了基于配准与免配准两类范式在纵向MS评估中的优势与局限。代码已开源。

title: Edu-QuRating: Multi-Dimensional Educational Data Curation with Distilled Pairwise Judgements
summary: Educational data filters have become a practical way to improve language-model pre-training, but most filters treat educational value as a single scalar property. This may be too broad for some applications, especially if the data set already features a high density of educational material. Useful learning material needs to be accurate, engaging, well structured, and appropriate for the intended audience and application (e.g. learner- vs teacher-facing). Following QuRating (Wettig et al. 2024), we introduce Edu-QuRating: a pipeline for multi-dimensional educational data scoring and curation. Edu-QuRating defines education-specific rubrics, uses an LLM judge to label sampled document pairs and distills those pairwise preferences into reusable Edu-QuRaters, which can score individual text chunks on a set of educational criteria. Across two sequence-classification base models and six educational criteria, the best Edu-QuRater recovers held-out GPT-4.1-mini pairwise judgements with mean accuracy 0.917. We then apply the resulting scorers in two applications. First, we investigate the potential of Edu-QuRaters for corpus filtering to improve pretraining of small language models. We scored 322.25M FineWeb-Edu-Fortified documents to obtain a filtered pre-training mixture. In matched single-run pre-training comparisons, models trained with Edu-QuRating-based mixtures reached higher observed aggregate accuracy across nine benchmarks than the FineWeb-Edu baseline, with gains concentrated in particular tasks. Second, we used Edu-QuRater scores as reward terms for GRPO post-training. In held-out pairwise judge evaluations, combining Edu-QuRater and answer-structure rewards produced responses preferred to the Qwen3-4B base model on both pedagogical quality and instruction following.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Edu-QuRating，一个多维教育数据评分与筛选流水线：定义教育专属评分标准，用 LLM 评审标注文档对偏好，并蒸馏为可复用的 Edu-QuRater 打分器，用于预训练语料过滤与 GRPO 后训练奖励。
AI.motivation: 现有的教育数据过滤器通常将"教育价值"视为单一标量属性，粒度过粗，尤其当数据集本身已含大量教育材料时难以区分优劣。真正有用的学习材料需在准确性、吸引力、结构性和受众适配性（如面向学习者还是教师）等多方面满足要求，因此需要多维度的教育数据评分与筛选方法。
AI.method: 沿用 QuRating 思路，构建 Edu-QuRating 流水线：1）定义教育专属的多维评分标准（共六项）；2）用 LLM 评审对采样文档对进行成对偏好标注；3）将成对偏好蒸馏为可复用的 Edu-QuRater 序列分类器，对单个文本块按各教育维度独立打分。随后在两个场景中应用：一是对 3.2225 亿篇 FineWeb-Edu-Fortified 文档打分，构建过滤后的预训练混合语料；二是将 Edu-QuRater 分数作为 GRPO 后训练的奖励项。
AI.result: 在两种序列分类基座模型和六项教育标准上，最佳 Edu-QuRater 对留出集 GPT-4.1-mini 成对判断的复现平均准确率达 0.917。预训练方面，匹配单次运行的对比中，使用 Edu-QuRating 混合语料的模型在九项基准上的观测聚合准确率高于 FineWeb-Edu 基线，提升集中在部分特定任务上。后训练方面，在留出集成对评审中，结合 Edu-QuRater 奖励与答案结构奖励所得回答，在教学质量和指令遵循两方面均优于 Qwen3-4B 基座模型。
AI.conclusion: Edu-QuRating 将教育价值从单一标量拓展为可复用、多维度的评分体系，能同时服务于预训练语料过滤与后训练奖励塑形，并在这两类应用中均带来可观测的收益。

title: Harness or Model? Isolating the Harness Effect in Agentic Coding with a Contamination-Controlled Private Suite
comment: 25 pages, 5 figures. Revised 8 September 2026 (telemetry correction). Code and derived data in the replication package
summary: An agentic coding system couples a language model to a harness: the tools, prompts and control flow that turn a chat model into an autonomous software engineer. Vendors ship harnesses tuned to their own models, and practitioners assume the vendor-native pairing solves more tasks. We measure that assumption with paired same-model contrasts on a private, contamination-controlled suite of 256 repository and post-cutoff contest tasks. The same 80 tasks ran under claude-agent-sdk and under deepagents on claude-opus-4-8, and under the openai-codex SDK and deepagents on gpt-5.5, with gemini-3.5-flash and deepseek-v3.2 as side cells. 792 of 800 planned runs were graded by an isolated oracle. Neither contrast resolves an average advantage for either harness: -1.25 pp for Opus 4.8 (48.8% vs 50.0%, task-bootstrap 95% CI [-10.0, +7.5]) and +1.25 pp for GPT-5.5 (55.6% vs 54.4%, CI [-4.4, +6.9]). The Opus average combines opposite strata: the native harness trails by 9.0 pp on the 61 repository tasks and leads by 23.7 pp on the 19 contest tasks (label-permutation p = 0.003). The partition was chosen after seeing the data and needs a designed replication. Correctness and completion also separate: 22 of 81 runs cancelled at the wall-clock ceiling had produced a passing patch. Re-priced from raw per-turn usage at frozen list prices, the neutral harness cost 1.3 to 1.6 times as much per solved task on Opus 4.8 and 1.2 times on GPT-5.5. These are observed-usage estimates. On the Anthropic account 58 runs left no usage record, and allocating that spend to either cell would move the Opus ratio between 0.7 and 2.3, so the billed ordering is unresolved. This revision corrects an August 2026 manuscript whose cost figures rested on a usage-semantics defect in our own telemetry (Section 5.1). We release the orchestrator, grading oracle, reanalysis code and derived aggregates. The tasks stay private.

AI.tldr: 本文通过配对同模型对照实验，检验“厂商原生智能体脚手架优于通用脚手架”的假设。在256个私有、抗污染任务上，原生与中性脚手架的平均成功率差异不显著（Opus 4.8 为 -1.25pp，GPT-5.5 为 +1.25pp），但Opus内部存在方向相反的分层效应，成本估计则因用量记录缺失而无法定论。
AI.motivation: 业界普遍假设厂商为其自身模型定制的智能体脚手架（harness，含工具、提示与控制流）能解决更多任务，但该假设缺乏严格实证。作者希望用配对同模型对照，量化脚手架选择本身对任务成功率的贡献，并同时考察其对成本的影响。
AI.method: 在私有、抗污染（含截止日期后竞赛题）的256任务套件上进行配对同模型对照。80个任务分别在 claude-opus-4-8 上运行 claude-agent-sdk 与 deepagents，在 gpt-5.5 上运行 openai-codex SDK 与 deepagents，并设 gemini-3.5-flash、deepseek-v3.2 侧翼单元。计划800次运行中792次由隔离oracle评分；采用任务自助法置信区间与标签置换检验；成本按冻结列表价的原始逐轮用量重新计价。
AI.result: 两组对照均未显示任一脚手架的显著平均优势：Opus 4.8 为 -1.25pp（48.8% vs 50.0%，95% CI [-10.0, +7.5]），GPT-5.5 为 +1.25pp（55.6% vs 54.4%，CI [-4.4, +6.9]）。Opus均值掩盖了方向相反的分层：原生脚手架在61个仓库任务上落后9.0pp，在19个竞赛任务上领先23.7pp（标签置换 p=0.003），但该分层为事后划分，需设计性重复验证。正确性与完成度分离：81次因墙钟上限取消的运行中22次已产生通过补丁。按冻结价格计价，中性脚手架在Opus 4.8上每解决任务成本为原生的1.3–1.6倍，GPT-5.5上为1.2倍；Opus计费顺序不确定（Anthropic账户58次运行无用记录，比值区间0.7–2.3）。本版本修正了2026年8月稿因自身遥测用量语义缺陷导致的成本数据。
AI.conclusion: 在受控配对对照下，未发现厂商原生脚手架具有普遍成功率优势；平均值可能掩盖任务类型间的异质性效应，需设计性重复确认。成本方面，基于观测用量的估计提示中性脚手架单位解题成本更高，但计费顺序因用量记录缺失而无法判定。作者公开编排器、评分oracle、再分析代码与派生聚合数据，任务本身保持私有。

title: Low-Rank Prompt Learning for Vision-Language Models with Fixed-Token Bases
summary: Prompt learning adapts CLIP to downstream recognition by replacing hand-written templates with learned continuous context vectors, which in Context Optimization (CoOp) form a dense prompt matrix $\mathbf{P}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times d}$ trained from only a few examples per class. We study whether this matrix is over-parameterized by factorizing it as $\mathbf{P}=\mathbf{B}\mathbf{A}$, which cuts the trainable prompt parameters from $md$ to $r(m+d)$, and to $rd$ once the token-side factor $\mathbf{B}$ is fixed. Across seven few-shot benchmarks and two CLIP backbones, low-rank prompts match or improve dense CoOp at far fewer parameters, with the clearest gains on low-shot base-to-new generalization. We then find that the token-side factor need not be learned at all: fixing $\mathbf{B}$ to a Gaussian, orthogonal, SVD-derived, or even random basis and training only the embedding-side factor $\mathbf{A}$ stays on par with the fully trainable factorization, and a source-trained $\mathbf{B}$ offers no advantage over a random one. A prompt-factor asymmetry and a local update-space dimension gap show why fixing $\mathbf{B}$ is far less restrictive than fixing $\mathbf{A}$, and a smoothness-only guarantee certifies that optimizing $\mathbf{A}$ over a fixed $\mathbf{B}$ converges. In the CLIP prompt setting, the embedding-side coefficients carry the adaptation while the token basis can simply be fixed.

AI.tldr: 本文将 CoOp 的可学习密集提示矩阵 P∈R^{m×d} 分解为 P=BA 以研究其过参数化问题，发现低秩提示能以更少参数匹配或超越密集 CoOp，且 token 侧因子 B 可直接固定为随机基，仅学习嵌入侧 A 即可。
AI.motivation: CoOp 用学习的连续上下文向量替代手工模板，其密集提示矩阵 P∈R^{m×d} 参数总量大，在每类仅几个样本的少样本场景下是否存在过参数化尚不清楚，因此需要研究该矩阵的冗余性及可压缩性。
AI.method: 将提示矩阵因式分解为 P=BA，把可训练参数从 md 降至 r(m+d)，固定 token 侧 B 后进一步降至 rd。在七个少样本基准与两个 CLIP 主干上评测；并尝试将 B 固定为高斯、正交、SVD 导出乃至随机基，仅训练嵌入侧 A；同时从提示因子不对称性和局部更新空间维度差距加以分析，并给出仅依赖平滑性的收敛保证。
AI.result: 在七个少样本基准和两个 CLIP 主干上，低秩提示用远少参数即匹配或优于密集 CoOp，在低样本 base-to-new 泛化上提升最明显。固定 B 为高斯、正交、SVD 或随机基，仅训练 A，性能与完全可训练因式分解相当；源数据训练的 B 相对随机 B 无优势。提示因子不对称性与局部更新空间维度差距解释了固定 B 比固定 A 限制小得多，平滑性保证表明在固定 B 上优化 A 可收敛。
AI.conclusion: 在 CLIP 提示学习中，提示矩阵高度过参数化：嵌入侧系数 A 承担适配任务，token 侧基 B 可直接固定，无需学习，从而实现显著的参数压缩而不损失性能。

title: From Fixed Keys to Readable Schemas: Small Language Models for Vehicle Agent Function Calls
comment: Camera-ready version. Accepted at the SLM-Agents Workshop at NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival)
summary: In-vehicle assistants must translate natural-language requests into accurate vehicle function calls under strict memory and latency constraints, making small language models (SLMs) attractive for on-device deployment. For such models, a key design choice is how the available function surface is presented. Two approaches are to represent each function with a dedicated Functional Token (FT) or provide function schemas directly in the prompt. FTs enable compact inference but are restricted to functions learned during training, whereas Schema-in-Prompt (SIP) can generalize to unseen functions at the cost of longer prompts and higher inference overhead. We introduce a benchmark of 9,822 single-turn examples spanning 79 vehicle functions derived from Android Automotive, including held-out functions and requests requiring refusal. We compare both approaches under matched fine-tuning across four SLMs from 270M to 1.7B parameters. On functions seen during training, scaling provides limited benefit: the 270M model can match the 1.7B model, and the highest Seen accuracy in our main grid occurs at 0.6B. On held-out functions, FT achieves zero accuracy by construction, whereas SIP generalizes and improves substantially with scale. On out-of-scope requests, FT can invoke an unavailable function it was trained to emit, while SIP more reliably refuses based on the functions offered. This flexibility comes with a higher inference cost, chiefly the latency of processing the schema prompt. Our theoretical analysis formalizes why only SIP can predict functions withheld as training targets and why longer schema contexts increase inference cost. Overall, function-surface representation, rather than model scale alone, determines the capabilities and failure modes of SLM-based vehicle function calling.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了面向车载助手的函数调用基准（9,822条单轮样本、79个Android Automotive函数），在4个270M–1.7B参数的SLM上对比Functional Token（FT）与Schema-in-Prompt（SIP）两种函数表示方式，发现函数表示形式而非模型规模才是决定能力与失败模式的关键。
AI.motivation: 车载助手需在严格内存与延迟约束下将自然语言请求转为准确的车辆函数调用，因而小语言模型（SLM）成为端侧部署的理想选择。对此类模型而言，如何在上下文中呈现可用函数集合是关键设计决策，但FT与SIP两种方案在能力边界、泛化性与推理开销上的权衡缺乏系统性、可比对的实证研究。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个包含9,822条单轮样本、覆盖79个源自Android Automotive的车辆函数的基准，其中包含留出函数（held-out functions）以及需要拒答的请求。在匹配的微调条件下，对4个参数规模为270M至1.7B的SLM分别采用FT（以专用Functional Token表示各函数）与SIP（在提示中直接提供函数schema）两种函数表面表示方式进行对比评估，并结合理论分析。
AI.result: 在训练中见过的函数上，规模带来的收益有限：270M模型可匹敌1.7B模型，主实验网格中最高的Seen准确率出现在0.6B。在留出函数上，FT按构造即零准确率，而SIP可泛化且随规模显著提升。在超出范围的请求上，FT可能调用其被训练输出的不可用函数，而SIP更能基于所提供的函数可靠拒答。SIP的灵活性代价是更高的推理成本，主要是处理schema提示的延迟。
AI.conclusion: 理论分析形式化地说明了为何只有SIP能够预测被作为训练目标而保留的函数，以及为何更长的schema上下文会增加推理成本。总体而言，在基于SLM的车载函数调用中，函数表面的表示方式（而非单纯的模型规模）决定了其能力与失败模式，这为端侧车载助手的函数接口设计提供了依据。

title: LeCor: Learning to Be Corrected by Meta-Learned Test-Time Training for Interactive 3D Lung-Tumour Segmentation
summary: Delineating lung tumours on computed tomography (CT) takes a considerable share of the time spent on radiotherapy planning, and a contour proposed by a model can be refined interactively by the clinician. Promptable foundation models such as SAM 3 support this workflow by writing each correction into a session memory that conditions the remaining slices, while the model weights stay fixed. On 690 test cases from five public CT cohorts, fine-tuning SAM 3 on lung tumours raises the Dice obtained from a single point prompt from 0.298 to 0.757, and seven rounds of corrections raise it further to 0.765, but under memory conditioning alone the accuracy on slices the annotator has not touched stops improving after six rounds. We therefore treat each correction as a training signal and propose LeCor, which performs test-time training on a small set of case adapters that are reset for every case and meta-learned such that a single gradient step driven by a click improves the slices that were not clicked. On the 133 test cases that span at least eight slices, LeCor raises the Dice reached after seven correction rounds from 0.787 with the fine-tuned model to 0.827, reduces the number of cases that never reach a Dice of 0.80 from 47 to 27, and reaches in three correction rounds the accuracy that the fine-tuned model attains in seven.

AI.tldr: 提出LeCor方法，将每次交互修正当作训练信号，对每个病例的适配器进行测试时训练与元学习，从而提升SAM 3在肺肿瘤CT分割中未点击切片的精度。
AI.motivation: CT肺肿瘤勾画在放疗计划中耗时较多，可提示基础模型（如SAM 3）虽支持逐次修正并写入会话记忆、权重固定，但在仅依赖记忆条件时，未被标注者点击的切片精度在第六轮修正后不再提升。
AI.method: 将每次修正视为训练信号，提出LeCor：对每例重置的小规模病例适配器做测试时训练，并通过元学习使一次由点击驱动的梯度步即可改善未被点击的切片。
AI.result: 在五个公开CT队列共690例测试中，微调SAM 3使单点提示Dice从0.298升至0.757，七轮修正进一步升至0.765；在覆盖至少八个切片的133例测试中，LeCor将七轮修正后的Dice从微调模型的0.787提升至0.827，未达Dice 0.80的病例数由47降至27，且三轮修正即达到微调模型七轮的精度。
AI.conclusion: LeCor通过测试时训练与元学习有效利用交互修正信号，显著提升未点击切片的泛化精度并加快收敛，优于仅依赖会话记忆的固定权重修正策略。

title: Infra-Bench CLS: A Global, Open-Source Benchmark for Critical Infrastructure Classification with Earth Observation Foundation Models
comment: 9 figures. Supporting information with 10 figures and 13 tables. Submitted to Big Earth Data
summary: Critical infrastructure location data is often incomplete and unevenly distributed globally, especially in developing regions. Earth observation foundation models are proposed as a new step in enabling us to more efficiently understand the natural and built environment, raising questions as to their effectiveness in performing challenging downstream tasks. Yet, foundation models remain largely untested for detecting and classifying the facility-scale critical infrastructure that underpins a range of important societal and economic functions. Subsequently, Infra-Bench CLS is introduced as a benchmark to test foundation models on 18,756 Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 multispectral facility-scale critical infrastructure asset images covering seven continents and 13 infrastructure classes, with results reported for the 10 retained classes. Using linear probing and fine-tuning for two training dataset levels (1.0x and 0.3x), seven foundation models are evaluated (SatlasPretrain S2, SatlasPretrain S1, CROMA, Prithvi-EO-2.0, AlphaEarth Foundations, OlmoEarth v1.1-Base, and DINOv3 ViT-L/16). When comparing macro F1 scores to a ResNet-18 supervised baseline of 39.2 percent, the best foundation model achieved 57.9 percent, a 48 percent improvement. Top performing classes were airports (F1 85.3 percent), train stations (F1 82.1 percent), and data centers (F1 77.6 percent). By contrast, many of the power sector classes perform poorly (F1 27.5-46.2 percent). These findings suggest foundation models can enable superior critical infrastructure classification, but future work should evaluate performance on higher-resolution imagery, particularly for poorly performing sectors, such as power.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 Infra-Bench CLS 基准，用 18,756 张 Sentinel-1/2 设施级关键基础设施影像评测 7 个地球观测基础模型；最佳模型宏 F1 达 57.9%，较 ResNet-18 基线（39.2%）提升 48%。
AI.motivation: 关键基础设施位置数据在全球范围内不完整且分布不均，尤其在发展中地区；地球观测基础模型虽被寄予厚望，但在设施级关键基础设施检测与分类这一挑战性下游任务上仍缺乏系统评测。
AI.method: 构建 Infra-Bench CLS 基准，涵盖七大洲、13 类基础设施（保留 10 类）共 18,756 张 Sentinel-1 SAR 与 Sentinel-2 多光谱设施级影像；采用线性探测与微调两种方式，在两个训练数据规模（1.0x、0.3x）下评测 7 个基础模型：SatlasPretrain S2、SatlasPretrain S1、CROMA、Prithvi-EO-2.0、AlphaEarth Foundations、OlmoEarth v1.1-Base、DINOv3 ViT-L/16，并以 ResNet-18 监督基线作对照。
AI.result: 最佳基础模型宏 F1 为 57.9%，较 ResNet-18 基线 39.2% 提升约 48%。表现最优类别为机场（85.3%）、火车站（82.1%）和数据中心（77.6%）；电力部门类别表现较差（27.5%–46.2%）。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型能够显著提升关键基础设施分类性能，但后续工作应评估更高分辨率影像上的表现，尤其针对电力等表现不佳的部门。

title: Efficient Fairness Auditing Across Guidance Scales in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Causal Abstraction
summary: Fairness auditing of text-to-image diffusion models often requires generating large numbers of images across sampling configurations, making comprehensive evaluation computationally expensive. We propose a causal-abstraction-based audit instrument for efficiently evaluating fairness under interventions on the classifier-free guidance scale. Given a fixed prompt and a target feature function, we represent the diffusion process as a low-level structural causal model and construct a corresponding high-level model over abstract denoising states. We characterize the projected causal structure, establish identifiability of the fairness-relevant interventional query, and provide sufficient conditions under which the high-level model preserves this query. A probabilistic transformer implements the high-level model as an amortized predictor of target-feature distributions across guidance scales. Experiments evaluate distributional fidelity, fairness-query accuracy, and computational efficiency. We present two auditing demonstrations: one using standard Stable Diffusion 1.5 and another using StayFair, a fairness-enhanced Stable Diffusion model, to examine their behavior across guidance scales.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于因果抽象的审计工具，用于高效评估文本到图像扩散模型在无分类器引导尺度干预下的公平性。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型的公平性审计通常需要在不同采样配置下生成大量图像，导致全面评估在计算上非常昂贵，亟需一种高效的评价方法。
AI.method: 将扩散过程表示为低层结构因果模型，并在抽象去噪状态上构建对应的高层模型；刻画投影因果结构，证明公平性相关干预查询的可识别性，并给出高层模型保持该查询的充分条件；用概率Transformer实现高层模型，作为跨引导尺度的目标特征分布的摊销预测器。
AI.result: 实验评估了分布保真度、公平性查询准确性和计算效率，并展示了两项审计演示：一项使用标准Stable Diffusion 1.5，另一项使用公平性增强的StayFair模型，考察其在各引导尺度下的行为。
AI.conclusion: 该因果抽象审计工具能够在引导尺度干预下高效进行公平性评估，兼顾查询准确性与计算效率，并可适用于标准及公平性增强的扩散模型。

title: Learning Global Camera Poses from Noisy View-Graphs for Structure from Motion
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://vgpa-sfm.github.io/
summary: Camera pose estimation is a key step in 3D reconstruction and view-synthesis pipelines. We present a deep, global Structure-from-Motion framework based on learned view-graph aggregation. Our method employs a permutation-equivariant, edge-conditioned graph neural network that takes noisy pairwise relative poses as input and outputs globally consistent camera extrinsics. The network is trained without ground-truth supervision, relying solely on a relative-pose consistency objective. This is followed by 3D point triangulation and robust bundle adjustment. Our approach is efficient, scalable to more than a thousand images, and robust to graph density. We evaluate our method on MegaDepth, 1DSfM, Strecha, and BlendedMVS. These experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior rotation and translation accuracy compared to deep track-centric methods while registering more images across many scenes, and competitive results compared to state-of-the-art classical pipelines, while being much faster.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于可学习视图图聚合的深度全局SfM框架，用置换等变、边条件图神经网络从噪声相对位姿回归全局一致相机外参，无需真值监督，仅靠相对位姿一致性目标训练，再配合三角化与鲁棒BA，在多个数据集上兼顾精度、可扩展性与速度。
AI.motivation: 相机位姿估计是三维重建与视图合成流水线的关键步骤，现有深度方法多为track-centric且需真值监督，经典全局SfM虽精度高但速度慢，亟需兼顾精度、可扩展性与效率的全局方案。
AI.method: 采用置换等变、边条件的图神经网络，将噪声成对相对位姿作为输入，输出全局一致的相机外参；训练不使用真值监督，仅依赖相对位姿一致性目标；随后进行三维点三角化与鲁棒光束法平差（BA）。
AI.result: 方法高效、可扩展至千张以上图像，且对图密度鲁棒；在MegaDepth、1DSfM、Strecha、BlendedMVS上实验表明，旋转与平移精度优于深度track-centric方法，在多个场景中配准更多图像，与最先进经典流水线相比结果具竞争力且速度快得多。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了基于学习视图图聚合的深度全局SfM框架的可行性：无需真值监督即可获得全局一致位姿，并在精度、配准数量与效率之间取得良好平衡，可作为经典SfM的高效替代方案。

title: The Mutations of Machine Speech
summary: Algorithmic outputs now populate the digital environments through which contemporary life is organized. The role of law in facilitating and constituting (rather than merely responding to) these processes is gaining increasing traction across scholarly accounts. This inquiry traces the evolution of algorithmic outputs attending to their legal underpinnings and social implications, surfacing the mutations of machine speech. The first mutation redefined speech as data to be queried: search engines transformed the web from a space of information retrieval into an economic regime of algorithmic visibility. The second mutation reframed speech as engagement: social media platforms fused moderation with amplification, turning expression into a metric of attention, governed by corporate architectures. The third mutation emerges in conversational systems and interfaces, where generative text displaces information retrieval, bringing with it dense technolegal entanglements and profound epistemic consequences. Scholars of freedom of expression, informational privacy, and communication studies have long grappled with these dynamics, yet their implications for broader legal thought have also become urgent. This piece seeks to organize and clarify the evolving debate around algorithmic speech, making this critical but often fragmented discourse more accessible to wider legal and interdisciplinary audiences. In doing so, it bridges the gap between observing technological transformation and critically assessing the constitutive role of law within it, offering a conceptual resource for researchers, students, policymakers, and practitioners navigating and contesting this evolving landscape.

AI.tldr: 本文梳理算法输出的三次"变异"——从数据、参与度到生成式对话，揭示法律对算法言论的建构性作用，旨在整合碎片化讨论，为法律与跨学科读者提供概念框架。
AI.motivation: 算法输出已深度嵌入当代生活的数字环境，而法律不仅是回应者，更是这些进程的促成者与构成者。然而，围绕"算法言论"的讨论分散于言论自由、信息隐私与传播研究等领域，缺乏系统整合，其更广泛的法律意涵变得紧迫。
AI.method: 采用概念性与批判性文献综述路径，以"变异（mutation）"为分析框架，追踪算法输出的历史演进，剖析其法律基础与社会意涵：第一变异（搜索引擎，言论变为可查询的数据）、第二变异（社交媒体，言论变为参与度）、第三变异（对话式与生成式系统，生成文本取代信息检索）。
AI.result: 揭示三次变异分别重塑了言论的法律与经济定位：搜索将网络从信息检索空间转化为算法可见性的经济制度；平台将表达纳入注意力度量，由企业架构治理，审核与放大相融合；生成式对话系统带来密集的技术—法律纠缠与深刻的认知后果。
AI.conclusion: 本文组织并澄清关于算法言论的演进辩论，使这一关键却碎片化的话语更易被法律与跨学科受众理解；同时弥合"观察技术变革"与"批判评估法律的构成性角色"之间的鸿沟，为研究者、学生、政策制定者与实务者提供概念资源。

title: RoMa-$Ω$: What Feed-Forward 3D Models Know About Image Matching
summary: Learned image matching has experienced significant progress in recent years, culminating in robust and accurate matchers such as RoMa, whose robustness is often attributed to its use of frozen DINO features. In a parallel development, feed-forward reconstruction models, such as VGGT, have been trained on ever-growing datasets to accurately regress dense 3D point maps and camera poses. The distinction between matchers and feed-forward reconstruction models has become increasingly blurred with the introduction of matching losses in models such as MASt3R and VGGT-$Ω$. This raises a natural question: what do feed-forward 3D models know about image matching? In this work, we answer this question by analyzing three scenarios: (i) zero-shot matching of patch features, (ii) direct matching of 3D point predictions, and (iii) training a full matcher on top of the learned representations. We find that, despite performing poorly in zero-shot matching, especially in later layers, feed-forward reconstruction models provide strong representations for linear probing and full matching pipelines. We further show that, even without any training, their raw predictions alone enable competitive matching, albeit only under moderate viewpoint changes and modality gaps. Based on these insights, we retrain RoMa v2 by replacing its DINO backbone with VGGT-$Ω$. Our resulting model, \ours, outperforms state-of-the-art matchers on a wide range of benchmarks, e.g. +8.1 mAA compared to RoMa v2 on WxBS.

AI.tldr: 本文系统探究前馈三维重建模型（如VGGT/VGGT-Ω）在图像匹配方面的能力，发现其虽零样本匹配较弱，但表征适合线性探测与完整匹配器训练，据此以VGGT-Ω替换RoMa v2的DINO骨干，所得模型在多个基准上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 匹配器与前馈重建模型的界限日益模糊（MASt3R、VGGT-Ω引入匹配损失），但前馈三维模型究竟"知道"多少关于图像匹配的知识尚不明确，本文旨在回答这一自然的问题。
AI.method: 从三个场景展开分析：(i) patch特征的零样本匹配；(ii) 三维点预测的直接匹配；(iii) 在学习到的表征之上训练完整匹配器。基于分析结论，将RoMa v2的DINO骨干替换为VGGT-Ω并重新训练，得到新模型。
AI.result: 前馈重建模型零样本匹配表现较差（尤其在后层），但能提供适合线性探测和完整匹配流程的强表征；其原始预测在无训练情况下即可实现有竞争力的匹配，但仅限中等视角变化与模态差异条件。替换骨干后的模型在广泛基准上优于SOTA匹配器，例如在WxBS上相较RoMa v2提升8.1 mAA。
AI.conclusion: 前馈三维重建模型蕴含可用于图像匹配的强表征，可作为匹配器的高质量骨干，从而在多个基准上取得领先性能。

title: AnimalLift: Reconstructing Animatable 3D Animals from a Single Image by Learning Canonical Shape, Texture, and Fur Maps
summary: Reconstructing a fully animatable 3D animal from a single image remains challenging because animation-ready assets require not only plausible geometry, but also a unified topology, editable appearance, and fur representations compatible with deformation and simulation. Existing image-to-3D approaches often rely on implicit or loosely structured representations that are difficult to rig or edit, while parametric animal models support animation but cannot capture detailed texture and fur appearance. We present AnimalLift, a framework for reconstructing structured, animation-compatible 3D animal assets with explicit fur from a single image. Our method lifts an input image into a shared canonical space with a consistent topology and UV parameterization across the dataset, enabling joint prediction of canonical geometry, texture, and fur in a unified feed-forward architecture. A key component of our representation is a UV-aligned fur map that encodes strand geometry in a surface-aligned canonical domain, allowing explicit fur reconstruction compatible with mesh deformation and fur simulation. To train the model, we introduce a procedural data generation pipeline that provides large-scale supervision with aligned geometry, texture, and fur across diverse animal species and appearances. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate strong reconstruction quality and generalization across animal categories. Beyond reconstruction, our structured representation directly supports downstream applications including animation, pose transfer, fur editing, and simulation-compatible rendering.

AI.tldr: AnimalLift：从单图重建结构化、可动画的3D动物资产（含显式毛发）。
AI.motivation: 单图重建完全可动画的3D动物仍具挑战：动画就绪资产不仅需要合理几何，还需统一拓扑、可编辑外观、以及与形变/仿真兼容的毛发表示。现有图到3D方法多依赖隐式或弱结构化表示，难以绑定骨骼或编辑；参数化动物模型虽支持动画，却无法捕捉细节纹理与毛发外观。
AI.method: 提出AnimalLift框架：将输入图像提升至具有一致拓扑与UV参数化的共享规范空间，在统一前馈架构中联合预测规范几何、纹理与毛发。核心表示是UV对齐的毛发图（fur map），在表面对齐的规范域中编码毛束几何，实现与网格形变及毛发仿真兼容的显式毛发重建。训练上引入程序化数据生成管线，提供跨物种、跨外观的大规模对齐监督（几何、纹理、毛发对齐）。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据集上取得较强的重建质量，并在多类动物上展现良好泛化能力；结构化表示可直接支持动画、姿态迁移、毛发编辑与仿真兼容渲染等下游应用。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享规范空间与UV对齐毛发图的统一表示，AnimalLift实现了从单图到结构化、可动画3D动物资产的直接重建，兼顾几何、外观与显式毛发，并具备良好的下游可扩展性。

title: MotionBlind: Probing the Illusion of Motion Understanding in Video-LLMs
summary: Video large language models (Video-LLMs) are increasingly used as the perceptual front end of world models, a role that assumes they can read motion: how fast something moves, which way it travels, how hard it is pushed. We show they cannot. A Video-LLM can watch two clips of the same person in the same room, name every object in both, and still fail to say which clip moves faster. We introduce MotionBlind, a contrastive benchmark of self-recorded video for physically grounded motion(speed, magnitude, and direction), the variables a world model must predict. Each instance is a pair of near-identical clips that differ only in motion. Each clip carries two complementary yes/no questions, giving four items per instance, and a model earns credit only if all four are correct. We report Instance Accuracy(IAcc), which has a 6.25% chance floor. Single-frame, appearance, and language-only shortcuts all collapse to it. MotionBlind complements the recent TimeBlind benchmark. We run a controlled study of six open and two frontier Video-LLMs, varying whether the video is present, whether frames are shown in the correct temporal order, and how frames are sampled (1 to 24 frames, four selection strategies). Open models sit near the 6.25% floor, and scale does not help. Removing the video drops every model to zero IAcc, and shuffling frames collapses IAcc to chance, so the task genuinely needs video in order. Neither more frames nor smarter frame selection closes the gap, because these change which frames are seen, not whether motion is read. Only Gemini3.1 Pro clears the benchmark overall, and even it fails on speed. A frontend that cannot tell two speeds of the same action apart is not yet a trustworthy source of supervision, reward, or evaluation for a world model.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MotionBlind对比基准，发现现有Video-LLM普遍无法读取视频运动信息（速度、幅度、方向），开源模型准确率接近6.25%随机下限，仅Gemini3.1 Pro整体通过但仍在速度判断上失败。
AI.motivation: Video-LLM日益被用作世界模型的感知前端，这一角色预设其能读取运动信息（运动快慢、方向、受力大小）。但作者发现模型即使能识别两个近同视频中的所有物体，也无法判断哪段运动更快，因此需要系统性检验这一能力假设。
AI.method: 构建MotionBlind对比基准：由自录视频组成，聚焦物理接地运动变量（速度、幅度、方向）。每个实例是一对仅运动不同的近同片段，每段配两个互补的是/否问题，共4项，全对才得分。指标为Instance Accuracy（IAcc），随机下限6.25%。对6个开源和2个前沿Video-LLM进行控制实验，变化视频是否存在、帧序是否正确、采样帧数（1–24帧）与四种选帧策略。
AI.result: 开源模型IAcc接近6.25%下限，扩大规模无帮助；移除视频后所有模型IAcc降为0，打乱帧序后IAcc跌至随机水平，证明任务确实需要有序视频；增加帧数或改进选帧策略均无法缩小差距，因其只改变所见帧而非是否读取运动。仅Gemini3.1 Pro整体通过基准，但在速度判断上仍失败。
AI.conclusion: 现有Video-LLM作为世界模型感知前端尚不可靠：无法区分同一动作的两种速度，因而不能作为可信的监督、奖励或评估来源。MotionBlind与近期TimeBlind基准互补，揭示了运动读取这一根本能力缺口。

title: ChainDoRA: Tensor-Train Factorized Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation for Parameter-Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) adapts large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks while updating only a small fraction of their pretrained parameters. Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) uses two trainable low-rank matrices, while Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation (DoRA) further separates weight magnitude and direction but retains the dense LoRA-style factorization in its directional branch. We propose ChainDoRA, a weight-decomposed adaptation framework that constructs the directional low-rank factors from a connected Tensor-Train (TT) chain, where the adapter rank forms the boundary rank between input- and output-side TT contractions and an independent TT rank controls representation capacity and parameter cost. Under a controlled 15,119-example response-only adaptation setting with LLaMA-7B, ChainDoRA is evaluated against matched LoRA and DoRA baselines on seven commonsense reasoning benchmarks. ChainDoRA with TT rank 16 achieves a seven-task average accuracy of 72.30%, compared with 69.88% for LoRA and 69.39% for DoRA, while requiring only 5.35M trainable parameters versus 56.10M for LoRA and 56.98M for DoRA, corresponding to a 90.62% reduction relative to DoRA. Ablations over TT rank and adapter placement show controllable parameter-accuracy trade-offs, indicating that connected TT parameterization can substantially reduce the parameter cost of magnitude-direction adaptation while preserving, and in this setting improving, downstream reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 ChainDoRA，用连通的 Tensor-Train 链构造权重分解适配的方向低秩因子，在常识推理任务上以极少参数量超越 LoRA/DoRA。
AI.motivation: LoRA 用两个可训练低秩矩阵，DoRA 进一步分离权重幅度与方向，但其方向分支仍保留稠密 LoRA 式分解，参数开销大。作者希望在保持幅度-方向适配能力的同时显著降低参数成本。
AI.method: ChainDoRA 是权重分解适配框架，方向低秩因子由连通的 Tensor-Train (TT) 链构造；适配器秩作为输入侧与输出侧 TT 收缩间的边界秩，独立的 TT 秩控制表示能力与参数开销。在 LLaMA-7B 上以 15,119 例 response-only 适配设置，与参数量匹配的 LoRA、DoRA 基线在七个常识推理基准上对比，并对 TT 秩与适配器放置进行消融。
AI.result: TT 秩 16 的 ChainDoRA 七任务平均准确率 72.30%，LoRA 69.88%，DoRA 69.39%；可训练参数仅 5.35M，而 LoRA 为 56.10M、DoRA 为 56.98M，相对 DoRA 减少 90.62%。TT 秩与适配器放置消融显示可控的参数-准确率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 连通的 TT 参数化能在大幅降低幅度-方向适配参数成本的同时保持甚至提升下游推理性能。
